/-- **Left-to-right Mealy transduction** (design §12.8a, R8.2). Run the
finite-state transducer `δ` over `w` from state `a`: each cell is rewritten
by `δ`'s output and the state advances. Returns the final state and the
rewritten word. -/

name: mealyRun
header:
def mealyRun {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) : A → List Γ → A × List Γ
  | a, [] => (a, [])
  | a, γ :: w =>
    let r
chunk:
/-- **Left-to-right Mealy transduction** (design §12.8a, R8.2). Run the
finite-state transducer `δ` over `w` from state `a`: each cell is rewritten
by `δ`'s output and the state advances. Returns the final state and the
rewritten word. -/
def mealyRun {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) : A → List Γ → A × List Γ
  | a, [] => (a, [])
  | a, γ :: w =>
    let r := δ a γ
    let s := mealyRun δ r.1 w
    (s.1, r.2 :: s.2)

/-- Mealy runs split over an append (the per-cell step of both passes of the trace). -/

name: mealyRun_append
header:
private theorem mealyRun_append {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A) (l₁ l₂ : List Γ) :
    mealyRun δ a (l₁ ++ l₂) =
      ((mealyRun δ (mealyRun δ a l₁).1 l₂).1,
        (mealyRun δ a l₁).2 ++ (mealyRun δ (mealyRun δ a l₁).1 l₂).2)
chunk:
/-- Mealy runs split over an append (the per-cell step of both passes of the trace). -/
private theorem mealyRun_append {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A) (l₁ l₂ : List Γ) :
    mealyRun δ a (l₁ ++ l₂) =
      ((mealyRun δ (mealyRun δ a l₁).1 l₂).1,
        (mealyRun δ a l₁).2 ++ (mealyRun δ (mealyRun δ a l₁).1 l₂).2) := by
  induction l₁ generalizing a with
  | nil => simp [mealyRun]
  | cons γ l ih => simp [mealyRun, ih]

/-- The structural induction used for Mealy invariants. Proof sketch: expose one
transducer step and pass its recursive result to the cons case. -/

name: mealyRun_induction
header:
private theorem mealyRun_induction {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ)
    (P : A → List Γ → A × List Γ → Prop)
    (hnil : ∀ a, P a [] (a, []))
    (hcons : ∀ a γ l r, P (δ a γ).1 l r → P a (γ :: l) (r.1, (δ a γ).2 :: r.2))
    (a : A) (l : List Γ) : P a l (mealyRun δ a l)
chunk:
/-- The structural induction used for Mealy invariants. Proof sketch: expose one
transducer step and pass its recursive result to the cons case. -/
private theorem mealyRun_induction {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ)
    (P : A → List Γ → A × List Γ → Prop)
    (hnil : ∀ a, P a [] (a, []))
    (hcons : ∀ a γ l r, P (δ a γ).1 l r → P a (γ :: l) (r.1, (δ a γ).2 :: r.2))
    (a : A) (l : List Γ) : P a l (mealyRun δ a l) := by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => exact hnil a
  | cons γ l ih => exact hcons a γ l _ (ih (δ a γ).1)

/-- Mealy runs preserve length (the scan's rewritten interval is the word interval). -/

name: mealyRun_length
header:
private theorem mealyRun_length {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A) (l : List Γ) :
    (mealyRun δ a l).2.length = l.length
chunk:
/-- Mealy runs preserve length (the scan's rewritten interval is the word interval). -/
private theorem mealyRun_length {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A) (l : List Γ) :
    (mealyRun δ a l).2.length = l.length := by
  refine mealyRun_induction δ (fun _ w r => r.2.length = w.length)
    (fun _ => rfl) ?_ a l
  intro b γ w r hr
  exact congrArg Nat.succ hr

/-- Extending a Mealy prefix reads the next input cell and emits the corresponding
cell of the full output. Proof sketch: split the input at that cell and use append. -/

name: mealyRun_next
header:
private theorem mealyRun_next {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A)
    (w : List Γ) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length) :
    (mealyRun δ a (w.take (r + 1))).1 = (δ (mealyRun δ a (w.take r)).1 w[r]).1 ∧
      (mealyRun δ a w).2[r]'(by rw [mealyRun_length]; exact hr) =
        (δ (mealyRun δ a (w.take r)).1 w[r]).2
chunk:
/-- Extending a Mealy prefix reads the next input cell and emits the corresponding
cell of the full output. Proof sketch: split the input at that cell and use append. -/
private theorem mealyRun_next {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a : A)
    (w : List Γ) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length) :
    (mealyRun δ a (w.take (r + 1))).1 = (δ (mealyRun δ a (w.take r)).1 w[r]).1 ∧
      (mealyRun δ a w).2[r]'(by rw [mealyRun_length]; exact hr) =
        (δ (mealyRun δ a (w.take r)).1 w[r]).2 := by
  constructor
  · rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hr, mealyRun_append]
    rfl
  · have he : w = w.take r ++ w[r] :: w.drop (r + 1) := by
      rw [← List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hr, List.take_append_drop]
    have hl : (mealyRun δ a (w.take r)).2.length = r := by
      rw [mealyRun_length, List.length_take, Nat.min_eq_left hr.le]
    have hlookup : (mealyRun δ a w).2[r]? =
        some (δ (mealyRun δ a (w.take r)).1 w[r]).2 := by
      rw [congrArg (mealyRun δ a) he, mealyRun_append]
      simp only [mealyRun]
      rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)]
      simp only [hl, Nat.sub_self, List.getElem?_cons_zero]
    have hrout : r < (mealyRun δ a w).2.length := by
      simpa only [mealyRun_length] using hr
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hrout] at hlookup
    exact Option.some.inj hlookup

/-- **The two-pass scan result** (design §12.8a, R8.2): transduce `w` left to
right by `δf` from `a₀`, then right to left by `δb` from the state the first
pass ends in. Returns the final state and the rewritten word, in its original
order. -/

name: scanResult
header: def scanResult {A Γ : Type*} (δf δb : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) : A × List Γ
chunk:
/-- **The two-pass scan result** (design §12.8a, R8.2): transduce `w` left to
right by `δf` from `a₀`, then right to left by `δb` from the state the first
pass ends in. Returns the final state and the rewritten word, in its original
order. -/
def scanResult {A Γ : Type*} (δf δb : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) : A × List Γ :=
  let f := mealyRun δf a₀ w
  let b := mealyRun δb f.1 f.2.reverse
  (b.1, b.2.reverse)

/-- **Phase alphabet of the scan** (design §12.8a, R8.2), each phase carrying
the transducer state: the forward pass, the backward pass, and the live exit
anchors, one per final state. -/

name: ScanPhase
header:
inductive ScanPhase (A : Type) where
  /-- the forward pass -/
  | fwd (a : A)
  /-- the backward pass -/
  | bwd (a : A)
  /-- the live exit anchors, one per final transducer state -/
  | done (a : A)
deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

§13d revision). Rewrite the delimited word under the head of tape `i` cell by
cell, left to right by `δf` and then back by `δb`, carrying a finite state
from `a₀`. The right delimiter turns the head, and the left delimiter steps
right into `done a` with the final state `a` as the verdict. Fold, in-place
map, head-mark shifts and carry odometers are instances
(`Turing.scanResult_fold` and its siblings). -/

name: scanTM
chunk:
/-- **R8.2, the two-pass transducer scan** (design §12.8a; the G2 core of the
§13d revision). Rewrite the delimited word under the head of tape `i` cell by
cell, left to right by `δf` and then back by `δb`, carrying a finite state
from `a₀`. The right delimiter turns the head, and the left delimiter steps
right into `done a` with the final state `a` as the verdict. Fold, in-place
map, head-mark shifts and carry odometers are instances
(`Turing.scanResult_fold` and its siblings). -/
def scanTM {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) (δf δb : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) :
    MultiTapeTM k Γ (ScanPhase A) where
  q₀ := .fwd a₀
  tr := fun q _ w =>
    match q with
    | .fwd a =>
      match w i with
      | some γ => tapeAction i 0 (some (some (δf a γ).2)) .pos (.fwd (δf a γ).1)
      | none => tapeAction i 0 none .neg (.bwd a)
    | .bwd a =>
      match w i with
      | some γ => tapeAction i 0 (some (some (δb a γ).2)) .neg (.bwd (δb a γ).1)
      | none => tapeAction i 0 none .pos (.done a)
    | .done a => inputMoveAction 0 (.done a)

/-- **R8.2, scan, framed** (design §12.8a). From any configuration in the
forward phase at `a₀` whose tape `i` carries the delimited word `w`, the scan
reaches `done` at exactly `2|w| + 2` and no `done` anchor earlier. At that
point the control state is `done` of the final state of
`Turing.scanResult δf δb a₀ w`, the word interval `[pos, pos + |w|)` holds its
rewritten word, and every other cell, the head positions, the input position
and the output are unchanged. Up to the exit the head of tape `i` stays within
`[pos - 1, pos + |w|]`, and every other head is fixed.

**Proof sketch.** The `catalog_trace_run` skeleton, with the forward and
backward cell maps of the two Mealy passes in place of the sweeps'. Induct on
the cells for each pass: the forward pass takes `|w|` steps, writing
`mealyRun δf`'s outputs; the right delimiter turns the head in one step; the
backward pass takes `|w|` steps over the forward output in reverse, writing
`mealyRun δb`'s outputs; the left delimiter supplies the entry step. -/

    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) :
    (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
        { d with
          state
chunk:
/-- **R8.2, scan, framed** (design §12.8a). From any configuration in the
forward phase at `a₀` whose tape `i` carries the delimited word `w`, the scan
reaches `done` at exactly `2|w| + 2` and no `done` anchor earlier. At that
point the control state is `done` of the final state of
`Turing.scanResult δf δb a₀ w`, the word interval `[pos, pos + |w|)` holds its
rewritten word, and every other cell, the head positions, the input position
and the output are unchanged. Up to the exit the head of tape `i` stays within
`[pos - 1, pos + |w|]`, and every other head is fixed.

**Proof sketch.** The `catalog_trace_run` skeleton, with the forward and
backward cell maps of the two Mealy passes in place of the sweeps'. Induct on
the cells for each pass: the forward pass takes `|w|` steps, writing
`mealyRun δf`'s outputs; the right delimiter turns the head in one step; the
backward pass takes `|w|` steps over the forward output in reverse, writing
`mealyRun δb`'s outputs; the left delimiter supplies the entry step. -/
theorem scanTM_run_ofCfg {Γ : Type*} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ} (i : Fin k)
    (δf δb : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some (.fwd a₀))
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) :
    (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some (.done (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).1)
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
              then FinTM.bufferTape (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).2 (q - d.workTapePos j)
            else d.workTapes j q } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ∀ a,
        ((scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (.done a)) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2 →
        if j = i then
          ((scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ))
        else ((scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  let f := mealyRun δf a₀ w
  let b := fun r => mealyRun δb f.1 (f.2.reverse.take (w.length - r))
  let F : ℕ → Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x := fun r => { d with
    state := some (.fwd (mealyRun δf a₀ (w.take r)).1)
    workTapes := fun j q =>
      if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (r : ℤ)
        then FinTM.bufferTape f.2 (q - d.workTapePos j) else d.workTapes j q
    workTapePos := fun j => d.workTapePos j + if j = i then (r : ℤ) else 0 }
  let R : ℕ → Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x := fun r => { d with
    state := some (.bwd (b r).1)
    workTapes := fun j => if j = i then
      catalogTape (d.workTapes j) (d.workTapePos j) (f.2.take r ++ (b r).2.reverse)
      else d.workTapes j
    workTapePos := fun j => d.workTapePos j + if j = i then (r : ℤ) - 1 else 0 }
  let D : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x := { d with
    state := some (.done (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).1)
    workTapes := fun j q =>
      if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ)
        then FinTM.bufferTape (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).2 (q - d.workTapePos j)
        else d.workTapes j q }
  have fl : f.2.length = w.length := mealyRun_length δf a₀ w
  have ft : f.2.take w.length = f.2 := List.take_of_length_le (by omega)
  have bl (r : ℕ) : (b r).2.length = w.length - r := by
    simp [b, mealyRun_length, fl]
  have wl (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ w.length) :
      (f.2.take r ++ (b r).2.reverse).length = w.length := by
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_take, List.length_reverse, bl, fl,
      Nat.min_eq_left hr]
    omega
  have h0 : F 0 = d := by
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [F, mealyRun, hstate]
    funext j q
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
  have hF (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length) :
      (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).step (F r) = F (r + 1) := by
    have hs : (F r).workTapeSymbols i = some w[r] := by
      simp only [F, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, ↓reduceIte, true_and]
      rw [if_neg (by omega)]
      simpa only [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hr] using
        hw r (by omega) (by omega)
    have hn := mealyRun_next δf a₀ w r hr
    rw [step_of_tapeAction_write (scanTM k i δf δb a₀) (F r)
      (q' := .fwd (δf (mealyRun δf a₀ (w.take r)).1 w[r]).1) i 0
      (some (δf (mealyRun δf a₀ (w.take r)).1 w[r]).2) .pos rfl
      (by simp only [scanTM, hs])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · simp only [F, hn.1]
    · simp [F]
    · funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        have ht := catalog_write_take (d.workTapes i) (d.workTapePos i) f.2 r
          (by simpa only [fl] using hr)
        simpa only [F, Function.update_self, ↓reduceIte, true_and, f, hn.2] using ht
      · simp [F, hj]
    · funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        simp [F, SignType.pos_eq_one]
        omega
      · simp [F, hj]
    · rfl
  have hturn : (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).step (F w.length) = R w.length := by
    have hs : (F w.length).workTapeSymbols i = none := by
      simp only [F, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, ↓reduceIte, true_and]
      rw [if_neg (by omega)]
      simpa using hw w.length (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [step_of_tapeAction_move (scanTM k i δf δb a₀) (F w.length)
      (q := .fwd f.1) (q' := .bwd f.1) i 0 .neg
      (by simp [F, f]) (by simp only [scanTM, hs])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · simp [R, b, mealyRun]
    · simp [F, R]
    · funext j q
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        simp [F, R, b, mealyRun, catalogTape, fl, ft]
      · simp [F, R, hj]
    · funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        simp [F, R, SignType.cast, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc]
      · simp [F, R, hj]
    · rfl
  have hR (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length) :
      (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).step (R (r + 1)) = R r := by
    have hrout : r < f.2.length := by omega
    have hb : b r = ((δb (b (r + 1)).1 f.2[r]).1,
        (b (r + 1)).2 ++ [(δb (b (r + 1)).1 f.2[r]).2]) := by
      have hi : w.length - (r + 1) < f.2.reverse.length := by simp only [List.length_reverse]; omega
      have he : f.2.reverse[w.length - (r + 1)] = f.2[r] := by
        rw [List.getElem_reverse]
        congr 1
        omega
      have hn : w.length - r = (w.length - (r + 1)) + 1 := by omega
      change mealyRun δb f.1 (f.2.reverse.take (w.length - r)) = _
      rw [hn, List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hi, mealyRun_append]
      simp only [he, mealyRun]
      rfl
    have hword : f.2.take (r + 1) ++ (b (r + 1)).2.reverse =
        f.2.take r ++ f.2[r] :: (b (r + 1)).2.reverse := by
      rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hrout, List.append_assoc]
      rfl
    have hl : (f.2.take r).length = r := by simp [fl, Nat.min_eq_left hr.le]
    have hs : (R (r + 1)).workTapeSymbols i = some f.2[r] := by
      simp only [R, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [show d.workTapePos i + (((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) = d.workTapePos i + r by omega]
      unfold catalogTape
      rw [wl (r + 1) (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]
      rw [show d.workTapePos i + (r : ℤ) - d.workTapePos i = r by omega,
        FinTM.bufferTape_nat, hword, List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)]
      simp [hl]
    rw [step_of_tapeAction_write (scanTM k i δf δb a₀) (R (r + 1))
      (q' := .bwd (δb (b (r + 1)).1 f.2[r]).1) i 0
      (some (δb (b (r + 1)).1 f.2[r]).2) .neg rfl
      (by simp only [scanTM, hs])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · simp [R, hb]
    · simp [R]
    · funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        have ht := catalog_write_middle (d.workTapes i) (d.workTapePos i)
          (f.2.take r) (b (r + 1)).2.reverse f.2[r] (δb (b (r + 1)).1 f.2[r]).2
        simpa only [R, Function.update_self, ↓reduceIte, hword, hl, hb,
          List.reverse_append, List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append,
          List.singleton_append,
          show d.workTapePos i + (((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) = d.workTapePos i + r by omega]
          using ht
      · simp [R, hj]
    · funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        simp [R, SignType.cast]
        omega
      · simp [R, hj]
    · rfl
  have hentry : (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).step (R 0) = D := by
    have hb0 : b 0 = mealyRun δb f.1 f.2.reverse := by
      dsimp [b]
      rw [List.take_of_length_le (by simp [fl])]
    have result : scanResult δf δb a₀ w = ((b 0).1, (b 0).2.reverse) := by
      rw [hb0]
      rfl
    have hs : (R 0).workTapeSymbols i = none := by
      simp only [R, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, ↓reduceIte, Nat.cast_zero, zero_sub, catalogTape]
      rw [if_neg (by omega)]
      simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using hw (-1) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [step_of_tapeAction_move (scanTM k i δf δb a₀) (R 0)
      (q' := .done (b 0).1) i 0 .pos rfl (by simp only [scanTM, hs])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · simp [D, result]
    · simp [R, D]
    · funext j q
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        simp [R, D, catalogTape, result, bl]
      · simp [R, D, hj]
    · funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst j
        simp [R, D, SignType.pos_eq_one]
      · simp [R, D, hj]
    · rfl
  have hD : (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).step D = D := by
    rw [step_of_inputMoveAction (scanTM k i δf δb a₀) D 0 rfl rfl, moveInputPos_zero]
  have trace (t : ℕ) : (scanTM k i δf δb a₀).runFrom d t =
      catalogTrace F R D w.length t := by
    rw [← h0]
    exact catalog_trace_run _ F R D _ hF hturn hR hentry hD t
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [trace]
    simp [catalogTrace, show ¬2 * w.length + 2 ≤ w.length by omega, D]
  · intro t ht a
    rw [trace]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all [F, R]
    omega
  · intro j t ht
    rw [trace]
    simp only [catalogTrace]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all [F, R, D, Finset.mem_Icc] <;> omega

/-! ### The scan's instances -/

/-- **The identity step** (design §12.8a, R8.2): keep the state and the cell.
As the backward step, it makes a scan a single forward pass plus a return. -/

name: scanKeep
header: def scanKeep {A Γ : Type*} : A → Γ → A × Γ
chunk:
/-- **The identity step** (design §12.8a, R8.2): keep the state and the cell.
As the backward step, it makes a scan a single forward pass plus a return. -/
def scanKeep {A Γ : Type*} : A → Γ → A × Γ := fun a γ => (a, γ)

/-- **The fold step** (design §12.8a, R8.2): update the state by `δ` and keep
the cell. -/

name: scanFold
header: def scanFold {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A) : A → Γ → A × Γ
chunk:
/-- **The fold step** (design §12.8a, R8.2): update the state by `δ` and keep
the cell. -/
def scanFold {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A) : A → Γ → A × Γ := fun a γ => (δ a γ, γ)

/-- **The map step** (design §12.8a, R8.2): keep the state and rewrite the cell
by `f`. -/

name: scanMap
header: def scanMap {A Γ : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ) : A → Γ → A × Γ
chunk:
/-- **The map step** (design §12.8a, R8.2): keep the state and rewrite the cell
by `f`. -/
def scanMap {A Γ : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ) : A → Γ → A × Γ := fun a γ => (a, f γ)

/-- **The delay step** (design §12.8a, R8.2): read the mark `get γ` of the
cell into the state, and write the previous mark into the cell by `set`. As
the forward step it shifts the marks one cell right; as the backward step,
one cell left. -/

name: scanShift
header: def scanShift {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) : B → Γ → B × Γ
chunk:
/-- **The delay step** (design §12.8a, R8.2): read the mark `get γ` of the
cell into the state, and write the previous mark into the cell by `set`. As
the forward step it shifts the marks one cell right; as the backward step,
one cell left. -/
def scanShift {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) : B → Γ → B × Γ :=
  fun b γ => (get γ, set γ b)

/-- **The carry step** (design §12.8a, R8.2): with the carry set, advance the
digit by `next` and keep the carry exactly when the digit was the top one
(`top`), which wraps; with the carry clear, keep the digit. -/

name: scanCarry
header: def scanCarry {Γ : Type*} (top : Γ → Bool) (next : Γ → Γ) : Bool → Γ → Bool × Γ
chunk:
/-- **The carry step** (design §12.8a, R8.2): with the carry set, advance the
digit by `next` and keep the carry exactly when the digit was the top one
(`top`), which wraps; with the carry clear, keep the digit. -/
def scanCarry {Γ : Type*} (top : Γ → Bool) (next : Γ → Γ) : Bool → Γ → Bool × Γ :=
  fun c γ => if c then (top γ, next γ) else (false, γ)

/-- The identity step transduces nothing. -/

name: mealyRun_keep
header: private theorem mealyRun_keep {A Γ : Type*} (a : A) (l : List Γ) : mealyRun scanKeep a l = (a, l)
chunk:
/-- The identity step transduces nothing. -/
private theorem mealyRun_keep {A Γ : Type*} (a : A) (l : List Γ) : mealyRun scanKeep a l = (a, l) := by
  refine mealyRun_induction scanKeep (fun b w r => r = (b, w))
    (fun _ => rfl) ?_ a l
  intro b γ w r hr
  cases hr
  rfl

/-- With the identity return, a scan is its forward pass (four of the five identities
reduce to a `mealyRun` induction through this). -/

name: scanResult_keep
header:
private theorem scanResult_keep {A Γ : Type*} (δf : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult δf scanKeep a₀ w = mealyRun δf a₀ w
chunk:
/-- With the identity return, a scan is its forward pass (four of the five identities
reduce to a `mealyRun` induction through this). -/
private theorem scanResult_keep {A Γ : Type*} (δf : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult δf scanKeep a₀ w = mealyRun δf a₀ w := by
  simp [scanResult, mealyRun_keep]

/-- The one list identity `scanResult_shiftLeft` needs beyond `scanResult_shiftRight`:
the right shift of the reversed word, reversed back, is the left shift. -/

name: shiftLeft_list
header:
private theorem shiftLeft_list {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B)
    (w : List Γ) :
    (List.zipWith set w.reverse (b₀ :: w.reverse.map get)).reverse =
      List.zipWith set w (w.tail.map get ++ [b₀])
chunk:
/-- The one list identity `scanResult_shiftLeft` needs beyond `scanResult_shiftRight`:
the right shift of the reversed word, reversed back, is the left shift. -/
private theorem shiftLeft_list {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B)
    (w : List Γ) :
    (List.zipWith set w.reverse (b₀ :: w.reverse.map get)).reverse =
      List.zipWith set w (w.tail.map get ++ [b₀]) := by
  cases w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a w =>
    -- the reversed right shift reads one mark too many; `zipWith` drops it
    have h1 : List.zipWith set (a :: w).reverse (b₀ :: (a :: w).reverse.map get) =
        List.zipWith set (w.reverse ++ [a]) (b₀ :: w.reverse.map get) := by
      have h := List.zipWith_append (f := set) (l₁ := w.reverse ++ [a]) (l₁' := [])
        (l₂ := b₀ :: w.reverse.map get) (l₂' := [get a]) (by simp)
      simp only [List.append_nil, List.zipWith_nil_left] at h
      rw [← h]
      simp
    -- both lists now have length `|w| + 1`, so reversal commutes with `zipWith`
    have h2 : List.zipWith set (w.reverse ++ [a]) (b₀ :: w.reverse.map get) =
        (List.zipWith set (a :: w) (w.map get ++ [b₀])).reverse := by
      rw [List.reverse_zipWith (by simp)]
      simp
    rw [h1, h2, List.reverse_reverse]
    rfl

/-- Once the carry clears, every subsequent cell and the clear flag stay unchanged. -/

name: mealyRun_carry_clear
header:
private theorem mealyRun_carry_clear {Γ : Type*} (top : Γ → Bool) (next : Γ → Γ)
    (w : List Γ) : mealyRun (scanCarry top next) false w = (false, w)
chunk:
/-- Once the carry clears, every subsequent cell and the clear flag stay unchanged. -/
private theorem mealyRun_carry_clear {Γ : Type*} (top : Γ → Bool) (next : Γ → Γ)
    (w : List Γ) : mealyRun (scanCarry top next) false w = (false, w) := by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons γ w ih => simp [mealyRun, scanCarry, ih]

/-- **Scan instance, fold** (design §12.8a, R8.2). The scan by the fold step
and the identity return computes `w.foldl δ a₀` and leaves the word intact.
With `Turing.scanTM_run_ofCfg`, the fold's verdict is `done (w.foldl δ a₀)` at
exactly `2|w| + 2`.

**Proof sketch.** Generalize `a₀` and induct on `w`: the forward pass is
`(w.foldl δ a₀, w)`, and the identity backward pass returns its input. -/

name: scanResult_fold
header:
theorem scanResult_fold {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult (scanFold δ) scanKeep a₀ w = (w.foldl δ a₀, w)
chunk:
/-- **Scan instance, fold** (design §12.8a, R8.2). The scan by the fold step
and the identity return computes `w.foldl δ a₀` and leaves the word intact.
With `Turing.scanTM_run_ofCfg`, the fold's verdict is `done (w.foldl δ a₀)` at
exactly `2|w| + 2`.

**Proof sketch.** Generalize `a₀` and induct on `w`: the forward pass is
`(w.foldl δ a₀, w)`, and the identity backward pass returns its input. -/
theorem scanResult_fold {A Γ : Type*} (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult (scanFold δ) scanKeep a₀ w = (w.foldl δ a₀, w) := by
  rw [scanResult_keep]
  refine mealyRun_induction (scanFold δ) (fun b l r => r = (l.foldl δ b, l))
    (fun _ => rfl) ?_ a₀ w
  intro b γ l r hr
  simp only [scanFold, List.foldl_cons, hr]

/-- **Scan instance, identity** (the brief-inventory API, round 3; user 2026-10-17): the scan by
the identity step both ways returns its state and word unchanged,
`scanResult scanKeep scanKeep a₀ w = (a₀, w)`.

**Proof sketch.** The identity step is the fold by the constant update, so
`Turing.scanResult_fold` gives `(w.foldl (fun b _ => b) a₀, w)`, and that fold is `a₀`. -/

name: scanResult_keep_keep
header:
theorem scanResult_keep_keep {A Γ : Type*} (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult scanKeep scanKeep a₀ w = (a₀, w)
chunk:
/-- **Scan instance, identity** (the brief-inventory API, round 3; user 2026-10-17): the scan by
the identity step both ways returns its state and word unchanged,
`scanResult scanKeep scanKeep a₀ w = (a₀, w)`.

**Proof sketch.** The identity step is the fold by the constant update, so
`Turing.scanResult_fold` gives `(w.foldl (fun b _ => b) a₀, w)`, and that fold is `a₀`. -/
theorem scanResult_keep_keep {A Γ : Type*} (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult scanKeep scanKeep a₀ w = (a₀, w) := by
  have hf : ∀ b : A, w.foldl (fun b (_ : Γ) => b) b = b := by
    induction w with
    | nil => exact fun _ => rfl
    | cons γ w ih => exact fun b => ih b
  have h := scanResult_fold (fun b (_ : Γ) => b) a₀ w
  rw [hf] at h
  exact h

/-- **Scan instance, in-place map** (design §12.8a, R8.2). The scan by the map
step and the identity return rewrites the word to `w.map f`, with the state
unchanged.

**Proof sketch.** Generalize `a₀` and apply the shared Mealy induction: the forward
pass is `(a₀, w.map f)`, and the identity backward pass returns its input. -/

name: scanResult_map
header:
theorem scanResult_map {A Γ : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult (scanMap f) scanKeep a₀ w = (a₀, w.map f)
chunk:
/-- **Scan instance, in-place map** (design §12.8a, R8.2). The scan by the map
step and the identity return rewrites the word to `w.map f`, with the state
unchanged.

**Proof sketch.** Generalize `a₀` and apply the shared Mealy induction: the forward
pass is `(a₀, w.map f)`, and the identity backward pass returns its input. -/
theorem scanResult_map {A Γ : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult (scanMap f) scanKeep a₀ w = (a₀, w.map f) := by
  rw [scanResult_keep]
  refine mealyRun_induction (scanMap f) (fun b l r => r = (b, l.map f))
    (fun _ => rfl) ?_ a₀ w
  intro b γ l r hr
  simp only [scanMap, List.map_cons, hr]

/-- **Scan instance, head-mark shift right** (design §12.8a, R8.2). The scan by
the delay step forward and the identity return writes into cell `j` the mark
of cell `j - 1`, and `b₀` into cell `0`. The final state is the mark of the
last cell, or `b₀` when `w = []`.

**Proof sketch.** Generalize `b₀` and induct on `w`: the first cell receives
`b₀`, and the tail is the shift of the tail from the first cell's mark. -/

name: scanResult_shiftRight
header:
theorem scanResult_shiftRight {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B)
    (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult (scanShift get set) scanKeep b₀ w =
      ((w.map get).getLast?.getD b₀, List.zipWith set w (b₀ :: w.map get))
chunk:
/-- **Scan instance, head-mark shift right** (design §12.8a, R8.2). The scan by
the delay step forward and the identity return writes into cell `j` the mark
of cell `j - 1`, and `b₀` into cell `0`. The final state is the mark of the
last cell, or `b₀` when `w = []`.

**Proof sketch.** Generalize `b₀` and induct on `w`: the first cell receives
`b₀`, and the tail is the shift of the tail from the first cell's mark. -/
theorem scanResult_shiftRight {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B)
    (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult (scanShift get set) scanKeep b₀ w =
      ((w.map get).getLast?.getD b₀, List.zipWith set w (b₀ :: w.map get)) := by
  rw [scanResult_keep]
  induction w generalizing b₀ with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons γ w ih =>
    simp only [mealyRun, scanShift, ih, List.map_cons, List.zipWith_cons_cons,
      List.getLast?_cons, Option.getD_some]

/-- **Scan instance, head-mark shift left** (design §12.8a, R8.2). The scan by
the identity forward pass and the delay step backward writes into cell `j`
the mark of cell `j + 1`, and `b₀` into the last cell. The final state is the
mark of cell `0`, or `b₀` when `w = []`.

**Proof sketch.** The forward pass is `(b₀, w)`. The backward pass is the
right shift of `w.reverse` from `b₀`, by the induction of
`Turing.scanResult_shiftRight`; reversing it gives the left shift. -/

name: scanResult_shiftLeft
header:
theorem scanResult_shiftLeft {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B)
    (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult scanKeep (scanShift get set) b₀ w =
      ((w.map get).head?.getD b₀, List.zipWith set w (w.tail.map get ++ [b₀]))
chunk:
/-- **Scan instance, head-mark shift left** (design §12.8a, R8.2). The scan by
the identity forward pass and the delay step backward writes into cell `j`
the mark of cell `j + 1`, and `b₀` into the last cell. The final state is the
mark of cell `0`, or `b₀` when `w = []`.

**Proof sketch.** The forward pass is `(b₀, w)`. The backward pass is the
right shift of `w.reverse` from `b₀`, by the induction of
`Turing.scanResult_shiftRight`; reversing it gives the left shift. -/
theorem scanResult_shiftLeft {B Γ : Type*} (get : Γ → B) (set : Γ → B → Γ) (b₀ : B)
    (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult scanKeep (scanShift get set) b₀ w =
      ((w.map get).head?.getD b₀, List.zipWith set w (w.tail.map get ++ [b₀])) := by
  have h := scanResult_shiftRight get set b₀ w.reverse
  rw [scanResult_keep] at h
  simp only [scanResult, mealyRun_keep, h]
  rw [shiftLeft_list]
  simp only [List.map_reverse, List.getLast?_reverse]

/-- **Scan instance, carry odometer** (design §12.8a, R8.2). The scan by the
carry step from a set carry, with the identity return, is the little-endian
increment of a digit word: every top digit of the maximal top prefix wraps by
`next`, the first other digit advances by `next`, and the rest is kept. The
final carry is set exactly when every digit was top, that is, on overflow.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on `w`. A top first digit wraps and passes the carry
to the tail; any other first digit advances and clears the carry, after which
the carry step is the identity. -/

name: scanResult_carry
header:
theorem scanResult_carry {Γ : Type*} (top : Γ → Bool) (next : Γ → Γ) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult (scanCarry top next) scanKeep true w =
      (w.all top, (w.takeWhile top).map next ++ ((w.dropWhile top).take 1).map next ++
        (w.dropWhile top).drop 1)
chunk:
/-- **Scan instance, carry odometer** (design §12.8a, R8.2). The scan by the
carry step from a set carry, with the identity return, is the little-endian
increment of a digit word: every top digit of the maximal top prefix wraps by
`next`, the first other digit advances by `next`, and the rest is kept. The
final carry is set exactly when every digit was top, that is, on overflow.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on `w`. A top first digit wraps and passes the carry
to the tail; any other first digit advances and clears the carry, after which
the carry step is the identity. -/
theorem scanResult_carry {Γ : Type*} (top : Γ → Bool) (next : Γ → Γ) (w : List Γ) :
    scanResult (scanCarry top next) scanKeep true w =
      (w.all top, (w.takeWhile top).map next ++ ((w.dropWhile top).take 1).map next ++
        (w.dropWhile top).drop 1) := by
  rw [scanResult_keep]
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons γ w ih =>
    cases ht : top γ <;>
      simp [mealyRun, scanCarry, ht, mealyRun_carry_clear, ih]

end Turing

name: cert_tail_test
chunk:
/-- The two cells just left of the output head characterize the singleton `true` word.
**Proof sketch.** A blank second cell forces the word to have length at most one;
the first cell then distinguishes the singleton from the empty word. -/
private theorem cert_tail_test (w : List Bool) :
    (FinTM.bufferTape w ((w.length : ℤ) - 1) = some true ∧
      FinTM.bufferTape w ((w.length : ℤ) - 2) = none) ↔ w = [true] := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hfirst, hsecond⟩
    have hlen : w.length ≤ 1 := by
      by_contra hn
      have hz : 0 ≤ (w.length : ℤ) - 2 := by omega
      have hi : ((w.length : ℤ) - 2).toNat < w.length := by omega
      simp only [FinTM.bufferTape, if_pos hz, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff] at hsecond
      omega
    cases w with
    | nil => simp at hfirst
    | cons b rest =>
      have hr : rest = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by simpa using hlen)
      subst rest
      simpa [FinTM.bufferTape] using hfirst
  · rintro rfl
    norm_num [FinTM.bufferTape]

name: certVerdictTM
header:
private def certVerdictTM (k : ℕ) (cap : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin 3) where

chunk:
/-- Verdict controller starting just past a captured output. There is no catalog row
for the exact singleton verdict: one left move, a `true` test, and a left-blank test.
It emits once and halts; the source's output never reaches the physical output. -/
private def certVerdictTM (k : ℕ) (cap : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin 3) where
  q₀ := 0
  tr := fun q _ w =>
    if q = 0 then
      ⟨0, fun i => (none, if i = cap then -1 else 0), none, some 1⟩
    else if q = 1 then
      if w cap = some true then
        ⟨0, fun i => (none, if i = cap then -1 else 0), none, some 2⟩
      else ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), some false, none⟩
    else ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), some (decide (w cap = none)), none⟩

/-- The captured-output verdict is complete after three steps, preserving the
physical prefix and appending precisely the singleton-equality bit.
**Proof sketch.** Expand the three finite transitions. The rejecting second step
is absorbed at step three. The accepting branch reads the two cells in `cert_tail_test`. -/

/-- The capture projection of the public silent configuration, for an unselected
capture tape. This missing projection is a promotion candidate in `Build/Embed`.
**Proof sketch.** No source index maps to the capture tape, so the finite lookup
returns `none` and the two capture clauses of the configuration apply. -/
private theorem cert_capture_fields {m k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (cap : Fin k) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι)
    (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin k → ℤ)
    (pre out₀ : List Bool) (d : Cfg m Bool S x) :
    (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ d).workTapes cap =
        FinTM.bufferTape (pre ++ d.output) ∧
      (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads pre out₀ d).workTapePos cap =
        ((pre ++ d.output).length : ℤ) := by
  have hfind : (List.finRange m).find? (fun i => decide (ι i = cap)) = none := by
    apply List.find?_eq_none.mpr

      | some i => d.workTapes i
      | none => if cap = cap then FinTM.bufferTape (pre ++ d.output) else tapes cap) = _ ∧
    (match (List.finRange m).find? (fun i => decide (ι i = cap)) with
      | some i => d.workTapePos i
      | none => if cap = cap then ((pre ++ d.output).length : ℤ) else heads cap) = _
  simp only [hfind, ↓reduceIte, and_self]

chunk:
/-- The core reaches a halting verdict within four steps beyond the supplied
source deadline, on arbitrary physical input and ambient frame.
**Proof sketch.** Select the source's first halt. Z1 transfers liveness and that
halt, R1' captures the entire output including the last emission, and R2 runs the
three-step verdict scan. All three machine traces are cited from the public rows. -/
private theorem certCore_run {k : ℕ} (P : FinTM Bool)
    (ι : Fin (1 + P.k) ↪ Fin k) (cap : Fin k) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι)
    {x y : List Bool} (d : Cfg P.k Bool P.State x) (hd : d.state ≠ none)
    (tag : Bool) (htag : FinTM.VirtualTag d.inputPos tag)
    (p : Fin (y.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (heads : Fin k → ℤ) (deadline : ℕ)
    (hhalt : (P.tm.runFrom d deadline).state = none) :
    ∃ t ≤ deadline + 4,
      let start := (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads [] []
        (vhostCfg d tag p [])).mapState (fun q => Sum.inl (Sum.inl q))
      ((certCoreTM P ι cap).tm.runFrom start t).state = none ∧
        ((certCoreTM P ι cap).tm.runFrom start t).output =
          [decide ((P.tm.runFrom d deadline).output = [true])] := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hlive, heq⟩ := P.tm.exists_first_halt d hhalt
  let H := vhostEmitTM P.tm
  let v := vhostCfg d tag p []
  have hv : v.state ≠ none := by simpa [v, vhostCfg] using hd
  have hvlive : ∀ s < r, (H.runFrom v s).state ≠ none := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨b, _, hrun⟩ := vhostEmitTM_runFrom P.tm d tag htag p [] s
    rw [hrun]
    simpa [vhostCfg, Cfg.Halted] using hlive s hs
  obtain ⟨b, _, hvr⟩ := vhostEmitTM_runFrom P.tm d tag htag p [] r
  have hvhalt : (H.runFrom v r).state = none := by
    rw [hvr, heq]
    simp [vhostCfg, hhalt]
  have hvout : (H.runFrom v r).output = (P.tm.runFrom d deadline).output := by
    rw [hvr, heq]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨_, hret, hcut⟩ := embedSilentRetTM_run ι cap hcap H tapes heads [] [] v r
    hv hvlive hvhalt
  let finish : Cfg k Bool ((P.State × Bool) ⊕ Unit) y :=
    { embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads [] [] (H.runFrom v r) with state := some (.inr ()) }
  let scan := finish.mapState (fun _ => (0 : Fin 3))
  have hc := cert_capture_fields ι cap hcap tapes heads [] [] (H.runFrom v r)
  have hs := certVerdict_run cap scan (P.tm.runFrom d deadline).output rfl
    (by simpa only [scan, finish, Cfg.mapState, List.nil_append, hvout] using hc.1)
    (by simpa only [scan, finish, Cfg.mapState, List.nil_append, hvout] using hc.2)
  have hseam := seamCompTM_run_ofCfg (embedSilentRetTM ι cap H) (.inr ())
    (certVerdictTM k cap) 0 hret rfl hcut
    (show (certVerdictTM k cap).runFrom scan 3 = _ from rfl)
  refine ⟨r + 1 + 3, by omega, ?_⟩
  change ((certCoreTM P ι cap).tm.runFrom _ _).state = none ∧
    ((certCoreTM P ι cap).tm.runFrom _ _).output = _
  rw [show (certCoreTM P ι cap).tm.runFrom
      ((embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads [] [] v).mapState
        (fun q => Sum.inl (Sum.inl q))) (r + 1 + 3) =
      ((certVerdictTM k cap).runFrom scan 3).mapState Sum.inr from by
        simpa only [Cfg.mapState, Option.map_map, Function.comp_def] using hseam]
  constructor
  · simpa only [Cfg.mapState, hs.1, Option.map_none]
  · simpa only [Cfg.mapState, scan, finish, embedSilentCfg, List.nil_append] using hs.2

**Proof sketch.** Distinct entry and exit already give the extra cut. If they
coincide, the public release adapter provides a fresh entry at the same cost. -/
private theorem cert_call_cut {A : Type} (k : ℕ) (S : Type)
    [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (en ex : S)
    (input : A → List Bool) (before after : A → Fin k → List Bool) (budget : A → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ a, ∃ t ≤ budget a, 0 < t ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u → u < t →
        (M.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := input a) en (before a)) u).state ≠ some ex) ∧
      M.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := input a) en (before a)) t =
        Cfg.ofWords ex (after a)) :
    ∃ (S' : Type) (_ : Fintype S') (_ : DecidableEq S')
      (N : MultiTapeTM k Bool S') (start finish : S'),
      ∀ a, ∃ t ≤ budget a,
        (∀ u < t, (N.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := input a) start (before a)) u).state ≠
          some finish) ∧
        N.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := input a) start (before a)) t =
          Cfg.ofWords finish (after a) := by
  by_cases he : en = ex
  · subst ex
    refine ⟨Unit ⊕ S, inferInstance, inferInstance, seamReleaseTM M en,
      Sum.inl (), Sum.inr en, ?_⟩
    intro a
    rcases h a with ⟨t, ht, hpos, hprefix, hdone⟩
    have release := seamReleaseTM_firstReturn M en rfl hpos hdone rfl hprefix
    refine ⟨t, ht, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [Cfg.mapState, Cfg.ofWords, Option.map_some] using release.2
    · simpa only [Cfg.mapState, Cfg.ofWords, Option.map_some] using release.1
  · refine ⟨S, inferInstance, inferInstance, M, en, ex, ?_⟩
    intro a
    rcases h a with ⟨t, ht, _, hprefix, hdone⟩
    refine ⟨t, ht, fun u hu => ?_, hdone⟩
    by_cases hu0 : u = 0
    · subst u
      simpa [Cfg.ofWords] using he
    · exact hprefix u (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hu0) hu

    (hhead : ∀ i, d.workTapePos i = 0) (ho : d.output = []) (hc : w cap = []) :

/-- Canonical ambient words agree with a silent transport whose selected tapes
have those words and whose capture is empty. Only the control is relabeled.
**Proof sketch.** Selected tapes and heads use the public projections, the capture
uses `cert_capture_fields`, and the remainder uses R1's frame contract at time zero. -/
private theorem cert_silent_words {m k : ℕ} {S U : Type} {y : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (cap : Fin k)
    (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι) (w : Fin k → List Bool) (d : Cfg m Bool S y)
    (q : S) (finish : U) (hs : d.state = some q) (hp : d.inputPos = 1)
    (htape : ∀ i, d.workTapes i = FinTM.bufferTape (w (ι i)))
    (hhead : ∀ i, d.workTapePos i = 0) (ho : d.output = []) (hc : w cap = []) :
    (embedSilentCfg ι cap (fun i => FinTM.bufferTape (w i)) (fun _ => 0) [] [] d).mapState
      (fun _ => finish) = Cfg.ofWords finish w := by
  have frame := (embedSilentTM_frame ι cap hcap M (fun i => FinTM.bufferTape (w i))
    (fun _ => 0) [] [] d 0).1
  have capture := cert_capture_fields ι cap hcap (fun i => FinTM.bufferTape (w i))
    (fun _ => 0) [] [] d
  apply Cfg.ext
  · simp only [Cfg.mapState, embedSilentCfg, hs, Option.map_some, Cfg.ofWords]
  · exact hp
  · funext i
    change (embedSilentCfg ι cap (fun i => FinTM.bufferTape (w i)) (fun _ => 0) [] [] d).workTapes i = FinTM.bufferTape (w i)
    by_cases hi : i ∈ Set.range ι
    · obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hi
      rw [embedSilentCfg_selected_tape]
      exact htape r
    · by_cases he : i = cap
      · subst i
        simpa only [ho, hc, List.nil_append] using capture.1
      · exact (frame i hi he).1
  · funext i
    change (embedSilentCfg ι cap (fun i => FinTM.bufferTape (w i)) (fun _ => 0) [] [] d).workTapePos i = 0
    by_cases hi : i ∈ Set.range ι
    · obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hi
      rw [embedSilentCfg_selected_pos]
      exact hhead r
    · by_cases he : i = cap
      · subst i
        simpa only [ho, List.nil_append, List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero] using capture.2
      · exact (frame i hi he).2
  · rfl

/-- The split search and the certificate language give the same success condition.
**Proof sketch.** On failure, any certificate would supply an element accepted by
the bounded search. On success, use the public split-uniqueness theorem to identify
any proposed witness with the recovered prefix and suffix. -/
private theorem certSplit_language (C c : ℕ) (out : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (y : List Bool) :
    (∃ x u, y = x ++ u ∧ u.length = C * (x.length + 1) ^ c ∧ out x u = [true]) ↔
      match solveSplit C c y.length with
      | none => False
      | some i => out (y.take i) (y.drop i) = [true] := by
  cases hs : solveSplit C c y.length with
  | none =>
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, u, hy, hu, _⟩
      have hmissing := List.find?_eq_none.mp hs x.length
        (by simp only [List.mem_range]; rw [hy, List.length_append]; omega)
      apply hmissing
      simp only [beq_iff_eq]
      rw [hy, List.length_append, hu]

chunk:
/-- Reject the split emitter's empty failure value before invoking any core.
No catalog row supplies this reject-or-return guard. A valid encoded pair is
nonempty even when both components are empty. -/
private def certGuardTM (k : ℕ) (slot : Fin k) : MultiTapeTM k Bool Bool where
  q₀ := false
  tr := fun _ _ work =>
    if work slot = none then ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), some false, none⟩
    else ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some true⟩

/-- One guard transition either rejects the empty word or returns the unchanged word seam. -/

name: certGuard_run
chunk:
/-- One guard transition either rejects the empty word or returns the unchanged word seam. -/
private theorem certGuard_run {k : ℕ} {y : List Bool} (slot : Fin k)
    (w : Fin k → List Bool) :
    (certGuardTM k slot).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) false w) 1 =
      if w slot = [] then
        { Cfg.ofWords (input := y) true w with state := none, output := [false] }
      else Cfg.ofWords true w := by
  have he : FinTM.bufferTape (w slot) 0 = none ↔ w slot = [] := by
    cases w slot <;> simp [FinTM.bufferTape]
  simp [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, MultiTapeTM.step, certGuardTM,
    Cfg.ofWords, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, Action.apply, he]
  split <;> simp

/-- The guard does not reach its success anchor before its one transition. -/

name: certGuard_cut
chunk:
/-- The guard does not reach its success anchor before its one transition. -/
private theorem certGuard_cut {k : ℕ} {y : List Bool} (slot : Fin k)
    (w : Fin k → List Bool) :
    ∀ t < 1, ((certGuardTM k slot).runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) false w) t).state ≠
      some true := by
  intro t ht
  have : t = 0 := by omega
  subst t
  simp [Cfg.ofWords]

/-- The loader interface, parameterized by the core and the reserved

**Proof sketch.** Allocate disjoint banks for the two install-mode extractors,
the reserved native-call machine, the virtual input and source tapes, and capture.
Duplicate the split word from the reserved bank into the first extractor; install
its first component and transfer it to the virtual-input buffer. Transfer the saved
pair into the second extractor, install its second component, and transfer it to

contracts with `cert_embed_call`. Chain the copy, two clean calls and three transfers

The copy and transfers are read from the framed contracts `copyTM_run_ofCfg` and
`transferTM_run_ofCfg` at canonical seams, whose endpoints are canonical seams again by
`Cfg.ofWords_copy_endpoint` and `Cfg.ofWords_transfer_endpoint`; their word-layout
proofs are cited, not repeated. -/
private theorem cert_prepare_exists (P : FinTM Bool) (j : Fin P.k) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ (D : FinTM Bool) (exit : D.State) (ρ : Fin m ↪ Fin D.k)
      (ι : Fin (1 + P.k) ↪ Fin D.k) (cap : Fin D.k) (a : ℕ),
      cap ∉ Set.range ι ∧
      ∀ (y x u : List Bool),
        ∃ t ≤ a * (x.length + u.length + 1),
          ∃ (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ),
          (∀ s < t, (D.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) D.tm.q₀
              (Function.update (fun _ => []) (ρ ⟨0, hm⟩) (pairEncode x u))) s).state ≠
                some exit) ∧
          D.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := y) D.tm.q₀
              (Function.update (fun _ => []) (ρ ⟨0, hm⟩) (pairEncode x u))) t =
            (embedSilentCfg ι cap tapes heads [] []
              (vhostCfg (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) P.tm.q₀
                (Function.update (fun _ => []) j u)) true (1 : Fin (y.length + 2)) [])).mapState
                  (fun _ => exit) := by
  obtain ⟨F, f, hf⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairFst
  obtain ⟨F₀, fen, fex, af, hkF, hF₀⟩ := FinTM.exists_installCallTM F _ _ hf
  obtain ⟨FS, ff, fd, FM, fe, fx, hF⟩ := cert_call_cut F₀.k F₀.State F₀.tm fen fex
    (fun z : List Bool × List Bool => z.1) (fun z => stateWord F₀.k z.2)
    (fun z => stateWord F₀.k (((pairDecode z.2).map Prod.fst).getD []))
    (fun z => af * (f * (z.2.length + 1) + z.2.length +
      (((pairDecode z.2).map Prod.fst).getD []).length + 1)) (fun z => hF₀ z.1 z.2)
  letI : Fintype FS := ff
  letI : DecidableEq FS := fd
  obtain ⟨S, s, hs⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairSnd
  obtain ⟨S₀, sen, sex, as, hkS, hS₀⟩ := FinTM.exists_installCallTM S _ _ hs
  obtain ⟨SS, sf, sd, SM, se, sx, hS⟩ := cert_call_cut S₀.k S₀.State S₀.tm sen sex
    (fun z : List Bool × List Bool => z.1) (fun z => stateWord S₀.k z.2)
    (fun z => stateWord S₀.k (((pairDecode z.2).map Prod.snd).getD []))
    (fun z => as * (s * (z.2.length + 1) + z.2.length +
      (((pairDecode z.2).map Prod.snd).getD []).length + 1)) (fun z => hS₀ z.1 z.2)
  letI : Fintype SS := sf
  letI : DecidableEq SS := sd
  let K := m + (F₀.k + (S₀.k + ((1 + P.k) + 1)))
  let ρ : Fin m ↪ Fin K := Fin.castAddEmb _
  let σF : Fin F₀.k ↪ Fin K := (Fin.castAddEmb _).trans (Fin.natAddEmb m)
  let σS : Fin S₀.k ↪ Fin K :=
    ((Fin.castAddEmb _).trans (Fin.natAddEmb F₀.k)).trans (Fin.natAddEmb m)
  let ι : Fin (1 + P.k) ↪ Fin K :=
    (((Fin.castAddEmb 1).trans (Fin.natAddEmb S₀.k)).trans (Fin.natAddEmb F₀.k)).trans
      (Fin.natAddEmb m)
  let cap : Fin K := Fin.natAdd m (Fin.natAdd F₀.k (Fin.natAdd S₀.k (vhostCap P.k)))
  have hρ (i : Fin m) : (ρ i).val = i.val := rfl
  have hσF (i : Fin F₀.k) : (σF i).val = m + i.val := rfl
  have hσS (i : Fin S₀.k) : (σS i).val = m + (F₀.k + i.val) := rfl
  have hι (i : Fin (1 + P.k)) : (ι i).val = m + (F₀.k + (S₀.k + i.val)) := rfl

    simp only [cap, vhostCap_eq, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.val_zero, Nat.add_zero]

  let vf := σF ⟨0, hkF⟩
  let vs := σS ⟨0, hkS⟩
  let vx := ι (vhostBuffer P.k)
  let vu := ι (vhostBank j)

    rintro ⟨i, he⟩
    have hval := congrArg Fin.val he
    have hi := i.isLt
    simp only [hι, hcapval] at hval
    omega
  have hdistinct : v ≠ vf ∧ v ≠ vx ∧ v ≠ vs ∧ v ≠ vu ∧
      vf ≠ vx ∧ vf ≠ vs ∧ vf ≠ vu ∧ vx ≠ vs ∧ vx ≠ vu ∧ vs ≠ vu := by
    repeat' constructor
    all_goals
      apply Fin.ne_of_val_ne
      simp only [v, vf, vs, vx, vu, hρ, hσF, hσS, hι,
        vhostBuffer_eq, vhostBank_eq, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_natAdd]

  let CS := embedEmitTM σS SM
  let M₀ := copyTM (Symbol := Bool) K v vf
  let M₁ := seamCompTM M₀ .done CF fe
  let M₂ := seamCompTM M₁ (.inr fx) (transferTM K vf vx) .sweep
  let M₃ := seamCompTM M₂ (.inr .done) (transferTM K v vs) .sweep
  let M₄ := seamCompTM M₃ (.inr .done) CS se
  let M₅ := seamCompTM M₄ (.inr sx) (transferTM K vs vu) .sweep
  let D : FinTM Bool := ⟨K, _,
    {M₅ with q₀ := .inl (.inl (.inl (.inl (.inl SweepPhase.sweep))))}⟩
  have hD_run {y : List Bool} (c : Cfg K Bool D.State y) (t : ℕ) :
      D.tm.runFrom c t = M₅.runFrom c t :=
    MultiTapeTM.runFrom_with_q₀ _ _ _ _
  refine ⟨D, .inr .done, ρ, ι, cap, 30 + af * (3 * f + 4) + as * (3 * s + 4), hcap, ?_⟩
  intro y x u
  let pair := pairEncode x u
  let w₀ := Function.update (fun _ : Fin K => []) v pair
  let w₁ := Function.update w₀ vf pair
  let w₂ := Function.update w₀ vf x
  let w₃ := Function.update (Function.update w₂ vf []) vx x
  let w₄ := Function.update (Function.update w₃ v []) vs pair
  let w₅ := Function.update (Function.update w₃ v []) vs u
  let w₆ := Function.update (Function.update w₅ vs []) vu u

    funext z
    by_cases hzv : z = v
    · subst z

    by_cases hzf : z = vf
    · subst z

      all_goals
        apply Fin.ne_of_val_ne
        simp only [v, vf, vx, hρ, hσF, hσS, hι,
        vhostBuffer_eq, Fin.coe_castAdd]
        have hi := i.isLt

    simp [w₃, w₂, w₀, hn.1, hn.2.1, hn.2.2]

  have hk₀ := copyTM_run_ofCfg (x := y) v vf hvf (w₀ v) (Cfg.ofWords .sweep w₀) (Cfg.ofWords_state _ _)
    (fun p _ _ => by rw [Cfg.ofWords_workTapes, Cfg.ofWords_workTapePos, zero_add])
  have hr₀ := hk₀.1.trans (Cfg.ofWords_copy_endpoint _ _ w₀ v vf (by simp [w₀, hvf.symm]))
  have hc₀ := hk₀.2.1
  have h0 : w₀ v = pair := Function.update_self _ _ _
  simp only [h0] at hr₀ hc₀
  set t₀ := 2 * pair.length + 2 with ht₀def
  have ht₀ : t₀ ≤ 3 * pair.length + 3 := by omega
  obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁, hc₁, hr₁⟩ := hF (y, pair)
  simp only [pair, pairDecode_pairEncode, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some] at ht₁ hr₁ hc₁
  obtain ⟨hfRun, hfCut⟩ := cert_embed_call FM σF fe fx (stateWord F₀.k pair)
    (stateWord F₀.k x) w₁ w₂ (cert_bank_word hkF σF w₀ hblankF pair)
    (cert_bank_word hkF σF w₀ hblankF x)
    (by
      intro i hi
      have hn : i ≠ vf := fun he => hi ⟨⟨0, hkF⟩, he.symm⟩
      simp [w₁, w₂, hn]) hr₁ hc₁

  have hk₂ := transferTM_run_ofCfg (x := y) vf vx hfx (w₂ vf) (Cfg.ofWords .sweep w₂) (Cfg.ofWords_state _ _)
    (fun p _ _ => by rw [Cfg.ofWords_workTapes, Cfg.ofWords_workTapePos, zero_add])
  have hr₂ := hk₂.1.trans (Cfg.ofWords_transfer_endpoint _ _ w₂ vf vx hfx
    (by simp [w₂, w₀, hfx.symm, hvx.symm]))
  have hc₂ := hk₂.2.1
  simp only [h2] at hr₂ hc₂
  set t₂ := 2 * x.length + 2 with ht₂def
  have ht₂ : t₂ ≤ 3 * x.length + 3 := by omega
  have h3 : w₃ v = pair := by simp [w₃, w₂, w₀, hvx, hvf]
  have hk₃ := transferTM_run_ofCfg (x := y) v vs hvs (w₃ v) (Cfg.ofWords .sweep w₃) (Cfg.ofWords_state _ _)
    (fun p _ _ => by rw [Cfg.ofWords_workTapes, Cfg.ofWords_workTapePos, zero_add])
  have hr₃ := hk₃.1.trans (Cfg.ofWords_transfer_endpoint _ _ w₃ v vs hvs
    (by simp [w₃, w₂, w₀, hxs.symm, hfs.symm, hvs.symm]))
  have hc₃ := hk₃.2.1
  simp only [h3] at hr₃ hc₃
  set t₃ := 2 * pair.length + 2 with ht₃def
  have ht₃ : t₃ ≤ 3 * pair.length + 3 := by omega
  obtain ⟨t₄, ht₄, hc₄, hr₄⟩ := hS (y, pair)
  simp only [pair, pairDecode_pairEncode, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some] at ht₄ hr₄ hc₄

    (stateWord S₀.k u) w₄ w₅ (cert_bank_word hkS σS _ hblankS pair)
    (cert_bank_word hkS σS _ hblankS u)
    (by
      intro i hi
      have hn : i ≠ vs := fun he => hi ⟨⟨0, hkS⟩, he.symm⟩
      simp [w₄, w₅, hn]) hr₄ hc₄

  have hk₅ := transferTM_run_ofCfg (x := y) vs vu hsu (w₅ vs) (Cfg.ofWords .sweep w₅) (Cfg.ofWords_state _ _)
    (fun p _ _ => by rw [Cfg.ofWords_workTapes, Cfg.ofWords_workTapePos, zero_add])
  have hr₅ := hk₅.1.trans (Cfg.ofWords_transfer_endpoint _ _ w₅ vs vu hsu
    (by simp [w₅, w₃, w₂, w₀, hsu.symm, hvu.symm, hxu.symm, hfu.symm]))
  have hc₅ := hk₅.2.1

    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := append_split_unique (f := fun n => C * (n + 1) ^ c)
      (certificateLength_strictMono C c) hu hu' he
    exact ⟨u, hu, ho⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, ho⟩
    exact ⟨u, hu, x, u, rfl, hu, ho⟩

end Turing

name: Cfg.InWindow
header:
def Cfg.InWindow {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type} {x : List Symbol} (s : ℕ)
    (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) : Prop
chunk:
/-- A configuration lies **in the radius-`s` window** when every work head
sits within `[-s, s]` and every work cell outside `[-s, s]` is blank — the
side condition under which the packaged codec of
`Complexity.exists_adjacency_codec_cnf` is faithful. (The input head needs no
clause: its type bounds it.) It is equally the side condition under which a
configuration record determines its configuration core, together with its
separately supplied tag (`Turing.cfgRecord_inj`);
relocated here from `TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBF` (decision 12.8.2). -/
def Cfg.InWindow {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type} {x : List Symbol} (s : ℕ)
    (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, |c.workTapePos i| ≤ (s : ℤ)) ∧
  ∀ (i : Fin k) (z : ℤ), (s : ℤ) < |z| → c.workTapes i z = none

/-- **Windows grow with the radius**: a configuration in the radius-`s` window is in the
radius-`s'` window whenever `s ≤ s'`. -/

name: Cfg.InWindow.mono
header:
theorem Cfg.InWindow.mono {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type} {x : List Symbol} {s s' : ℕ}
    {c : Cfg k Symbol State x} (hc : c.InWindow s) (hs : s ≤ s') : c.InWindow s'
chunk:
/-- **Windows grow with the radius**: a configuration in the radius-`s` window is in the
radius-`s'` window whenever `s ≤ s'`. -/
theorem Cfg.InWindow.mono {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type} {x : List Symbol} {s s' : ℕ}
    {c : Cfg k Symbol State x} (hc : c.InWindow s) (hs : s ≤ s') : c.InWindow s' :=
  ⟨fun i => (hc.1 i).trans (by exact_mod_cast hs),
    fun i z hz => hc.2 i z (lt_of_le_of_lt (by exact_mod_cast hs) hz)⟩

/-- **One step from a window**: if `c` lies in the radius-`s` window, then applying an action `a`
keeps it there exactly when, for every work tape `i`, the head is not at `-s` with `a` moving it
left, and not at `s` with `a` moving it right. The write lands under the old head, which is inside
the window, so it cannot create a nonblank cell outside.

**Proof sketch.** Split the three possible moves. Interior positions stay inside; at each
boundary only its outward move fails. Outside cells are unchanged by the point update. -/

name: Cfg.InWindow.apply_iff
header:
theorem Cfg.InWindow.apply_iff {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type} {x : List Symbol} {s : ℕ}
    {c : Cfg k Symbol State x} (hc : c.InWindow s) (a : Action k Symbol State) :
    (a.apply c).InWindow s ↔ ∀ i,
      ¬ (c.workTapePos i = -(s : ℤ) ∧ (a.workTapes i).2 = -1) ∧
      ¬ (c.workTapePos i = (s : ℤ) ∧ (a.workTapes i).2 = 1)
chunk:
/-- **One step from a window**: if `c` lies in the radius-`s` window, then applying an action `a`
keeps it there exactly when, for every work tape `i`, the head is not at `-s` with `a` moving it
left, and not at `s` with `a` moving it right. The write lands under the old head, which is inside
the window, so it cannot create a nonblank cell outside.

**Proof sketch.** Split the three possible moves. Interior positions stay inside; at each
boundary only its outward move fails. Outside cells are unchanged by the point update. -/
theorem Cfg.InWindow.apply_iff {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type} {x : List Symbol} {s : ℕ}
    {c : Cfg k Symbol State x} (hc : c.InWindow s) (a : Action k Symbol State) :
    (a.apply c).InWindow s ↔ ∀ i,
      ¬ (c.workTapePos i = -(s : ℤ) ∧ (a.workTapes i).2 = -1) ∧
      ¬ (c.workTapePos i = (s : ℤ) ∧ (a.workTapes i).2 = 1) := by
  have heads (i : Fin k) : |c.workTapePos i + ((a.workTapes i).2 : ℤ)| ≤ (s : ℤ) ↔
      ¬ (c.workTapePos i = -(s : ℤ) ∧ (a.workTapes i).2 = -1) ∧
      ¬ (c.workTapePos i = (s : ℤ) ∧ (a.workTapes i).2 = 1) := by
    have h := hc.1 i
    rw [abs_le] at h ⊢
    cases hm : (a.workTapes i).2 <;>
      simp only [SignType.zero_eq_zero, SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, SignType.pos_eq_one,
        SignType.coe_zero, SignType.coe_neg, SignType.coe_one, Int.reduceNeg, add_zero,
        le_add_neg_iff_add_le, neg_add_le_iff_le_add, add_neg_le_iff_le_add,
        SignType.neg_eq_self_iff, SignType.self_eq_neg_iff, reduceCtorEq, zero_ne_one, one_ne_zero,
        and_false, and_true, true_and, and_self, not_false_eq_true, iff_true] at * <;>
      omega
  constructor
  · intro h i
    have hi := h.1 i
    rw [Action.apply_workTapePos] at hi
    exact (heads i).mp hi
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Action.apply_workTapePos]
      exact (heads i).mpr (h i)
    intro i z hz
    have hne : z ≠ c.workTapePos i := by
      intro he
      subst z
      have := hc.1 i
      omega
    rw [Action.apply_workTapes, Function.update_of_ne hne]
    exact hc.2 i z hz

/-! ### The record alphabet -/

/-- **The record alphabet** (design §12.8a §2) over machine states `Q` and tags
`T`: binary digits, simulated work cells with a head-mark track, the state
cell, and the tag cell. Fields of a record are separated by blank cells. -/

name: RecSym
header:
inductive RecSym (Q T : Type) where
  /-- a binary digit: the input-position field, counters, and the native input -/
  | digit (b : Bool)
  /-- one simulated work cell: its content and whether the head is on it -/
  | cell (content : Option Bool) (mark : Bool)
  /-- the state cell, `none` for halted -/
  | st (q : Option Q)
  /-- the tag cell: a summary of what the run has emitted -/
  | tag (τ : T)
deriving DecidableEq

/-- The record alphabet is finite when the states and tags are; this is the
`Fintype` instance `Turing.FinTM.alphabet_reduction` needs. -/

/-- **The digit embedding** (design §12.8a §2): `Bool` into the record alphabet
