/-- Writing the next prefix cell follows the public framed-write identity.

**Proof sketch.** The one-tape action supplies the configuration update;
`catalog_write_take` supplies the entire tape equality, including its frame. -/
private theorem inputLength_write {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg 1 Bool InputLengthPhase x)
    (w : List Bool) (r : ℕ) (hr : r < w.length) (s s' : InputLengthPhase)
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (m : SignType)
    (htr : inputLengthMachine.tr s
      (inputLengthCfg d w r s ip r).inputSymbol
      (inputLengthCfg d w r s ip r).workTapeSymbols =
        tapeAction 0 0 (some (some w[r])) m s') :
    inputLengthMachine.step (inputLengthCfg d w r s ip r) =
      inputLengthCfg d w (r + 1) s' ip ((r : ℤ) + m) := by
  rw [step_of_tapeAction_write _ _ 0 0 (some w[r]) m rfl htr]
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rfl
  · simp only [inputLengthCfg, moveInputPos_zero]
  · funext j
    have : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst j
    simpa only [Function.update_self, inputLengthCfg] using
      catalog_write_take (d.workTapes 0) (d.workTapePos 0) w r hr
  · funext j
    have : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst j
    simp only [Function.update_self, inputLengthCfg]
    omega
  · rfl


/-- One input symbol drives one framed increment, including width extension.

**Proof sketch.** The forward configurations replace successive low bits by
zeros; the first non-true cell is replaced by one on the turn. The return
configurations keep this prefix and move over its zeros to the left delimiter.
The two direct inductions concern this cyclic table, whose return state starts
the next round. At every intermediate time the head is between minus one and
`p`, relative to the entry head. -/

name: inputLength_round
header:
private theorem inputLength_round {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg 1 Bool InputLengthPhase x) (n p : ℕ) (v : List Bool)
    (hs : d.state = some .count) (hip : d.inputPos.val = n + 1) (hn : n < x.length)
    (old : n.bits = List.replicate p true ++ false :: v ∨
      n.bits = List.replicate p true ∧ v = [])
    (next : (n + 1).bits = List.replicate p false ++ true :: v)
    (htape : ∀ a : ℤ, -1 ≤ a → a ≤ (n.bits.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + a) = FinTM.bufferTape n.bits a) :
    inputLengthMachine.runFrom d (2 * p + 3) =
        inputLengthCfg d (n + 1).bits (p + 1) .count
          (moveInputPos d.inputPos .pos) 0 ∧
      ∀ u ≤ 2 * p + 3,
        d.workTapePos 0 - 1 ≤ (inputLengthMachine.runFrom d u).workTapePos 0 ∧
        (inputLengthMachine.runFrom d u).workTapePos 0 ≤ d.workTapePos 0 + (p : ℤ)
chunk:
/-- One input symbol drives one framed increment, including width extension.

**Proof sketch.** The forward configurations replace successive low bits by
zeros; the first non-true cell is replaced by one on the turn. The return
configurations keep this prefix and move over its zeros to the left delimiter.
The two direct inductions concern this cyclic table, whose return state starts
the next round. At every intermediate time the head is between minus one and
`p`, relative to the entry head. -/
private theorem inputLength_round {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg 1 Bool InputLengthPhase x) (n p : ℕ) (v : List Bool)
    (hs : d.state = some .count) (hip : d.inputPos.val = n + 1) (hn : n < x.length)
    (old : n.bits = List.replicate p true ++ false :: v ∨
      n.bits = List.replicate p true ∧ v = [])
    (next : (n + 1).bits = List.replicate p false ++ true :: v)
    (htape : ∀ a : ℤ, -1 ≤ a → a ≤ (n.bits.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + a) = FinTM.bufferTape n.bits a) :
    inputLengthMachine.runFrom d (2 * p + 3) =
        inputLengthCfg d (n + 1).bits (p + 1) .count
          (moveInputPos d.inputPos .pos) 0 ∧
      ∀ u ≤ 2 * p + 3,
        d.workTapePos 0 - 1 ≤ (inputLengthMachine.runFrom d u).workTapePos 0 ∧
        (inputLengthMachine.runFrom d u).workTapePos 0 ≤ d.workTapePos 0 + (p : ℤ) := by
  let w := (n + 1).bits
  let ip := moveInputPos d.inputPos .pos
  let F := fun r : ℕ => inputLengthCfg d w r .carry ip r
  let R := fun r : ℕ => inputLengthCfg d w (p + 1) .back ip ((r : ℤ) - 1)
  let D := inputLengthCfg d w (p + 1) .count ip 0
  have plen : p < w.length := (inputLength_charge n p v old next).2
  have oldlen : p ≤ n.bits.length := by
    rcases old with h | ⟨h, _⟩ <;> simp [h]
  have fzero : inputLengthMachine.step d = F 0 := by
    have hi : d.inputSymbol = some x[n] := inputSymbolInner n (by omega) hn
    rw [step_of_inputMoveAction _ _ .pos hs (q' := .carry) (by
      simp [inputLengthMachine, hi])]
    exact (inputLengthCfg_zero d w .carry ip).symm
  have forward (r : ℕ) (hr : r < p) : inputLengthMachine.step (F r) = F (r + 1) := by
    have read : (F r).workTapeSymbols 0 = some true := by
      have cell := htape r (by omega) (by omega)
      have bit : n.bits[r]? = some true := by
        rcases old with h | ⟨h, _⟩ <;>
          simp [h, List.getElem?_append, hr]
      simpa [F, inputLengthCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, FinTM.bufferTape_nat] using
        cell.trans (by simpa using bit)
    have digit : w[r] = false := by
      simp [w, next, hr]
    simpa only [F, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, SignType.cast] using
      inputLength_write d w r (by omega) .carry .carry ip .pos (by
        simp only [F] at read
        simp [inputLengthMachine, read, digit])
  have turn : inputLengthMachine.step (F p) = R p := by
    have read : (F p).workTapeSymbols 0 ≠ some true := by
      have cell := htape p (by omega) (by omega)
      have bit : n.bits[p]? ≠ some true := by
        rcases old with h | ⟨h, _⟩ <;> simp [h]
      simpa [F, inputLengthCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, cell] using bit
    have digit : w[p] = true := by simp [w, next]
    simpa only [F, R, SignType.cast, sub_eq_add_neg] using
      inputLength_write d w p plen .carry .back ip .neg (by
        simp only [F] at read
        simp [inputLengthMachine, read, digit])
  have backward (r : ℕ) (hr : r < p) : inputLengthMachine.step (R (r + 1)) = R r := by
    have read : (R (r + 1)).workTapeSymbols 0 = some false := by
      have digit : w[r]? = some false := by
        simp [w, next, List.getElem?_append, hr]
      simp [R, inputLengthCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, show (r : ℤ) < p + 1 by omega,
        FinTM.bufferTape_nat, digit]
    rw [step_of_tapeAction_move _ _ 0 0 .neg rfl (q' := .back) (by
      simp [inputLengthMachine, read])]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp only [R, inputLengthCfg, moveInputPos_zero]
    funext j
    have : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst j
    simp only [Function.update_self, SignType.cast]
    omega
  have entry : inputLengthMachine.step (R 0) = D := by
    have read : (R 0).workTapeSymbols 0 = none := by
      have cell := htape (-1) (by omega) (by omega)
      simpa [R, inputLengthCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, FinTM.bufferTape_left] using cell
    rw [step_of_tapeAction_move _ _ 0 0 .pos rfl (q' := .count) (by
      simp [inputLengthMachine, read])]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp only [R, D, inputLengthCfg, moveInputPos_zero]
    funext j
    have : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst j
    simp [SignType.cast]
  have step_run (a : Cfg 1 Bool InputLengthPhase x) (u : ℕ) :
      inputLengthMachine.runFrom a (u + 1) =
        inputLengthMachine.step (inputLengthMachine.runFrom a u) :=
    MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step'
  have reachesF : ∀ r ≤ p, inputLengthMachine.runFrom d (r + 1) = F r := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero => intro _; exact fzero
    | succ r ih =>
      intro hr
      rw [step_run, ih (by omega), forward r (by omega)]
  have reachesR : ∀ r ≤ p, inputLengthMachine.runFrom d (p + 2 + r) = R (p - r) := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      simpa only [Nat.add_zero, Nat.sub_zero] using
        (show inputLengthMachine.runFrom d (p + 2) = R p by
          rw [show p + 2 = (p + 1) + 1 by omega, step_run,
            reachesF p le_rfl, turn])
    | succ r ih =>
      intro hr
      rw [show p + 2 + (r + 1) = (p + 2 + r) + 1 by omega,
        step_run, ih (by omega)]
      rw [show p - r = (p - (r + 1)) + 1 by omega, backward _ (by omega)]
  have finish : inputLengthMachine.runFrom d (2 * p + 3) = D := by
    rw [show 2 * p + 3 = (p + 2 + p) + 1 by omega,
      step_run, reachesR p le_rfl, Nat.sub_self, entry]
  refine ⟨finish, ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  by_cases hz : u = 0
  · subst u; simp
  by_cases hf : u ≤ p + 1
  · rw [show u = (u - 1) + 1 by omega, reachesF _ (by omega)]
    simp only [F, inputLengthCfg]
    constructor <;> omega
  by_cases hb : u ≤ 2 * p + 2
  · rw [show u = p + 2 + (u - (p + 2)) by omega, reachesR _ (by omega)]
    simp only [R, inputLengthCfg]
    constructor <;> omega
  · rw [show u = 2 * p + 3 by omega, finish]
    simp only [D, inputLengthCfg, add_zero]
    constructor <;> omega

/-- A completely written word agrees with its buffer throughout the originally
blank slot, including both delimiters. -/

name: inputLengthCfg_read
header:
private theorem inputLengthCfg_read {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg 1 Bool InputLengthPhase x) (w : List Bool) (s : InputLengthPhase)
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (N : ℕ)
    (blank : ∀ a : ℤ, -1 ≤ a → a ≤ (N : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + a) = none)
    (a : ℤ) (ha : -1 ≤ a) (hb : a ≤ (N : ℤ)) :
    (inputLengthCfg d w w.length s ip 0).workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + a) =
      FinTM.bufferTape w a

/-- A completely written word agrees with its buffer throughout the originally
blank slot, including both delimiters. -/
private theorem inputLengthCfg_read {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg 1 Bool InputLengthPhase x) (w : List Bool) (s : InputLengthPhase)
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (N : ℕ)
    (blank : ∀ a : ℤ, -1 ≤ a → a ≤ (N : ℤ) →

    (inputLengthCfg d w w.length s ip 0).workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + a) =

  simp only [inputLengthCfg, add_sub_cancel_left]
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl

      simp [FinTM.bufferTape, hn, List.getElem?_eq_none hw']

/-- Consecutive canonical counter words differ only in the overwritten carry
prefix; overwriting that prefix therefore composes the two exterior frames.

**Proof sketch.** Below the origin nothing is touched. Inside the new prefix
the two sides read the new word. Above it the old and new words have the same
suffix, and their upper boundaries agree there, even on width extension. -/

name: inputLengthCfg_merge
header:
private theorem inputLengthCfg_merge {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg 1 Bool InputLengthPhase x) (n p : ℕ) (v : List Bool)
    (old : n.bits = List.replicate p true ++ false :: v ∨
      n.bits = List.replicate p true ∧ v = [])
    (next : (n + 1).bits = List.replicate p false ++ true :: v)
    (ip ip' : Fin (x.length + 2)) :
    inputLengthCfg (inputLengthCfg d n.bits n.bits.length .count ip 0)
        (n + 1).bits (p + 1) .count ip' 0 =
      inputLengthCfg d (n + 1).bits (n + 1).bits.length .count ip' 0
chunk:
/-- Consecutive canonical counter words differ only in the overwritten carry
prefix; overwriting that prefix therefore composes the two exterior frames.

**Proof sketch.** Below the origin nothing is touched. Inside the new prefix
the two sides read the new word. Above it the old and new words have the same
suffix, and their upper boundaries agree there, even on width extension. -/
private theorem inputLengthCfg_merge {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg 1 Bool InputLengthPhase x) (n p : ℕ) (v : List Bool)
    (old : n.bits = List.replicate p true ++ false :: v ∨
      n.bits = List.replicate p true ∧ v = [])
    (next : (n + 1).bits = List.replicate p false ++ true :: v)
    (ip ip' : Fin (x.length + 2)) :
    inputLengthCfg (inputLengthCfg d n.bits n.bits.length .count ip 0)
        (n + 1).bits (p + 1) .count ip' 0 =
      inputLengthCfg d (n + 1).bits (n + 1).bits.length .count ip' 0 := by
  have plen : p < (n + 1).bits.length := (inputLength_charge n p v old next).2
  apply Cfg.ext <;> simp only [inputLengthCfg, add_zero]
  funext j a
  by_cases hlow : d.workTapePos 0 ≤ a
  · by_cases hpre : a < d.workTapePos 0 + ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)

/-- **R8.5c, the input length** (design §12.8a §3, §12.8b). There is a `Bool`
module with an entry and an exit state and `K + 1` tapes with the following
contract. Start it at its entry with the input head at position `1`, tape `0`
blank on the `|bits |x|| + 2` cells from one left of its head to one right of
where the word will end, and the other tapes blank. It reaches its exit within
`C·(|x| + 1)` steps, and not earlier. At that point tape `0` holds
`Nat.bits |x|` from its head, and every other cell, every head, the input
position and the output are as they were. Up to the exit every work head stays
within `C·(|bits |x|| + 1)` cells of its entry position, so the work space is
logarithmic in `|x|` however far the input head travels. At `x = []` nothing is
written, since `Nat.bits 0 = []`.

**Proof sketch.** One pass over the input drives an in-place binary counter on
tape `0`. For each input symbol, move the input head right and increment the
counter: the carry turns the maximal `true` prefix to `false` and writes `true`
on the next cell, which is the blank just after the word when the counter
overflows, so the width grows by one cell exactly at the powers of two. A
return pass brings the counter head back to its first cell, guided by the
blank delimiter on its left. At the input's right end marker, walk the input
head back to position `1` (the `Turing.inputFoldTM_run_ofCfg` return) and exit.
The increments from `0` to `|x|` cost `Σ_v (2·p_v + 2)` for the true-prefix
lengths `p_v`, which telescopes against twice the number of `true` cells, as
in `Turing.counterOverhead_le_of_le` mirrored, so the total is linear in
`|x|`. Route: the counting phase is the transition table of Catalog's private
`f2_counterTM` without its emission, framed; no public input-driven loop host
exists (`Turing.counterLoopTM` needs its round count on a tape, which is what
is being computed), so the fill proves the framed round induction for this
table directly and records the pair with `f2_counterTM` for 12.2c, which can
re-derive `Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits_spaceUsed` from this row.
The counter head stays in `[pos - 1, pos + |bits |x||]`. -/

theorem exists_inputLengthTM :
    ∃ (K : ℕ) (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S) (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 1) Bool S)

      ∀ {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (K + 1) Bool S x), d.state = some entry → d.inputPos = 1 →
        (∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ((Nat.bits x.length).length : ℤ) →
          d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + p) = none) →
        (∀ j : Fin (K + 1), j ≠ 0 → ∀ p, d.workTapes j p = none) →
        ∃ t ≤ C * (x.length + 1),
          (∀ u < t, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
          (∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j : Fin (K + 1),
            |(R.runFrom d u).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤
              ((C * ((Nat.bits x.length).length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧
          R.runFrom d t =
            { d with
              state := some exit
              workTapes := fun j q =>
                if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧
                    q < d.workTapePos j + ((Nat.bits x.length).length : ℤ)
                  then FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits x.length) (q - d.workTapePos j)

    .count, .done, 6, ?_⟩
  intro x d hs hip blank _
  obtain ⟨t, charge, counted, countHeads⟩ := inputLength_count d hs hip blank x.length le_rfl
  let c := inputLengthCfg d x.length.bits x.length.bits.length .count
    (⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) 0

  have turn : inputLengthMachine.step c = back := by
    rw [step_of_inputMoveAction _ _ 0 rfl (q' := .returnStart) (by
      simp [inputLengthMachine, endSymbol])]
    simp only [moveInputPos_zero]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨r, hr, returned, returnHeads⟩ := FinTM.rewind_heads inputLengthMachine
    .returnStart .returnScan (some .done) (by intros; rfl)
    (by intro inp work; cases inp <;> rfl) back rfl

    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', counted]
    exact turn

    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, reachedBack, returned]

    have hr' : r ≤ x.length + 3 := by simpa [back, c, inputLengthCfg] using hr

      (inputLengthMachine.runFrom d u).workTapePos 0 ≤

    · exact countHeads u h
    · have hu' : u - (t + 1) ≤ r := by omega

        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, reachedBack, returnHeads _ hu']

    rw [step_of_inputMoveAction _ _ 0 firstState (q' := .done) rfl]
    simp only [moveInputPos_zero]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [firstState]

    | .start => FinTM.controlAction .neg (some .scan)

are the start's.

`p - r` (in `scan` for `r ≥ 1`): the first step moves left unconditionally, and each later step,
at `1 ≤ r < p`, reads an input symbol, since then `1 ≤ p - r ≤ |x|`, and moves left
(`Turing.FinTM.controlAction_apply`). At time `p` the head is on the left blank, and one step
right enters `done` at position `1`. -/

theorem inputRewindTM_run {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg k Bool InputRewindPhase x)

      (∀ t < d.inputPos.val + 1, ((inputRewindTM k).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      ∀ t ≤ d.inputPos.val + 1,
        ((inputRewindTM k).runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧
        ((inputRewindTM k).runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧

    · show some (if 0 = 0 then InputRewindPhase.start else .scan) = d.state

    · refine Fin.ext ?_

    intro r hr

    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hs]

    | zero => rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hT0]
    | succ r ih =>
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega), hstep r (by omega)]
  have hfinal : (inputRewindTM k).step (T d.inputPos.val) =
      { d with state := some .done, inputPos := 1 } := by
    have hs : (T d.inputPos.val).state = some .scan := by
      show some (if d.inputPos.val = 0 then InputRewindPhase.start else .scan) = some .scan
      rw [if_neg (by omega)]
    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hs]
    have hzero : (T d.inputPos.val).inputPos = 0 := by
      refine Fin.ext ?_
      show d.inputPos.val - d.inputPos.val = (0 : Fin (x.length + 2)).val
      rw [Fin.val_zero]
      omega
    have hread : (T d.inputPos.val).inputSymbol = none := Cfg.inputSymbol_of_zero hzero
    have htr : (inputRewindTM k).tr .scan (T d.inputPos.val).inputSymbol
        (T d.inputPos.val).workTapeSymbols = FinTM.controlAction .pos (some .done) := by
      rw [hread]
      rfl
    rw [htr, FinTM.controlAction_apply]
    refine Cfg.ext rfl ?_ rfl rfl rfl
    show moveInputPos (T d.inputPos.val).inputPos .pos = (1 : Fin (x.length + 2))
    rw [hzero, moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right (0 : Fin (x.length + 2))
      (by rw [Fin.val_zero]; omega)]
    exact Fin.ext (by simp)
  have hend : (inputRewindTM k).runFrom d (d.inputPos.val + 1) =
      { d with state := some .done, inputPos := 1 } := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', hrun d.inputPos.val le_rfl, hfinal]
  refine ⟨hend, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    rw [hrun t (by omega)]
    show some (if t = 0 then InputRewindPhase.start else .scan) ≠ some .done
    by_cases ht0 : t = 0
    · rw [if_pos ht0]; decide
    · rw [if_neg ht0]; decide
  · intro t ht
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t (d.inputPos.val + 1) with hlt' | hge
    · rw [hrun t (by omega)]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    · rw [show t = d.inputPos.val + 1 by omega, hend]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: inputRewindTM_step_done
header:
theorem inputRewindTM_step_done {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool InputRewindPhase x)
    (hc : c.state = some .done) : (inputRewindTM k).step c = c
chunk:
/-- **The park stays put**: at `done` the rewind's step changes nothing. -/
theorem inputRewindTM_step_done {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool InputRewindPhase x)
    (hc : c.state = some .done) : (inputRewindTM k).step c = c := by
  rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hc]
  show (FinTM.controlAction 0 (some InputRewindPhase.done)).apply c = c
  rw [FinTM.controlAction_apply]

chunk:
/-- The one-step copy body on one work tape. In state `false`, on an input symbol it writes the
symbol, moves the tape head and the input head right and stays in `false`; at the input's right
end it moves to `true` without writing or moving. -/
private def iw_body : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool Bool where
  q₀ := false
  tr := fun q inp _ =>
    if q then FinTM.controlAction 0 (some true)
    else match inp with
      | none => FinTM.controlAction 0 (some true)
      | some b => ⟨1, fun _ => (some (some b), 1), none, some false⟩

name: iw_one

name: iw_patch
header:
private def iw_patch (tape : ℤ → Option Bool) (head : ℤ) (v : List Bool) :

chunk:
/-- Overwrite a finite interval of a tape, leaving its exterior intact. -/
private def iw_patch (tape : ℤ → Option Bool) (head : ℤ) (v : List Bool) :
    ℤ → Option Bool := fun q =>
  if head ≤ q ∧ q < head + (v.length : ℤ)
    then FinTM.bufferTape v (q - head) else tape q

/-- Appending a bit to the copied interval changes exactly its next cell.

**Proof sketch.** At the next cell use the buffer's append equation. Inside the old interval
that equation preserves the old symbol; outside the enlarged interval both tapes are framed. -/

name: iw_patch_append
header:
private theorem iw_patch_append (tape : ℤ → Option Bool) (head : ℤ)
    (v : List Bool) (b : Bool) :
    iw_patch tape head (v ++ [b]) =
      Function.update (iw_patch tape head v) (head + (v.length : ℤ)) (some b)

/-- Appending a bit to the copied interval changes exactly its next cell.

name: iw_prefix
chunk:
/-- The body configuration after copying `r` input cells starting at input index `p`. -/
private def iw_prefix {z : List Bool} (c : Cfg 1 Bool Bool z) (p r : ℕ)
    (hr : p + r ≤ z.length) : Cfg 1 Bool Bool z where
  state := some false
  inputPos := ⟨p + 1 + r, by omega⟩
  workTapes := fun _ => iw_patch (c.workTapes 0) (c.workTapePos 0) ((z.drop p).take r)
  workTapePos := fun _ => c.workTapePos 0 + (r : ℤ)
  output := c.output

name: iw_prefix_zero
chunk:
/-- The zero-length copied prefix is the initial configuration. -/
private theorem iw_prefix_zero {z : List Bool} (c : Cfg 1 Bool Bool z) (p : ℕ)
    (hp : p ≤ z.length) (hc : c.state = some false) (hi : c.inputPos.val = p + 1) :
    iw_prefix c p 0 (by omega) = c := by
  apply Cfg.ext hc.symm
  · apply Fin.ext
    simpa only [iw_prefix, Nat.add_zero] using hi.symm
  · funext i q
    have hz : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _

    simp [iw_prefix, iw_patch]
  · funext i
    have hz : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _

    simp only [iw_prefix, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero]
  · rfl

next free destination cell, which is exactly the interval append equation. -/

name: iw_prefix_step
header:
private theorem iw_prefix_step {z : List Bool} (c : Cfg 1 Bool Bool z) (p r : ℕ)
    (hr : p + r < z.length) :
    iw_body.runFrom (iw_prefix c p r (by omega)) 1 =
      iw_prefix c p (r + 1) (by omega)

private theorem iw_orbit {z : List Bool} (c : Cfg 1 Bool Bool z) (p : ℕ)

name: iw_machine
header:
private def iw_machine : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool (CounterLoopState Bool) where
  q₀
chunk:
/-- The counter loop's escape anchor takes one silent stationary step to its done anchor.
Every other transition is the counter loop's. -/
private def iw_machine : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool (CounterLoopState Bool) where
  q₀ := .dec .run

/-- The two-tape copier stops after the available window, with its counter width preserved.

**Proof sketch.** If the counter value fits in the remaining input, use the returning loop
contract and its whole-run underflow bound. Otherwise use the escape contract after one
additional blank-reading round, then the stationary exit join. Both contracts exclude an
earlier exit; their ledgers give the common coefficient six. -/
private theorem iw_local {z : List Bool} (c : Cfg 1 Bool Bool z) (p : ℕ)
    (hc : c.state = some false) (hi : c.inputPos.val = p + 1) (_hp : p ≤ z.length)
    (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Bool) (cp : ℤ)
    (hw : ∀ q : ℤ, -1 ≤ q → q ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → ct (cp + q) = FinTM.bufferTape w q)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n = min (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat)) (z.length - p)) :
    ∃ T ≤ 6 * (n + 1) + 2 * w.length, ∃ v : List Bool, v.length = w.length ∧
      iw_machine.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) c ct cp) T =
        counterLoopCfg (some .done)
          (iw_prefix c p n (by
            have := Nat.min_le_right (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat)) (z.length - p)
            omega)) (iw_patch ct cp v) cp ∧
      ∀ u < T,
        (iw_machine.runFrom (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) c ct cp) u).state ≠ some .done := by

  let start := counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) c ct cp
  have horbit (r : ℕ) (hr : p + r ≤ z.length) := iw_orbit c p hc hi r hr
  by_cases hd : d ≤ z.length - p
  · have hnd : n = d := hn.trans (Nat.min_eq_left hd)
    subst hnd
    let t := d + counterOverhead w (d + 1)
    obtain ⟨hend, hcut, _, _⟩ := counterLoopTM_run_done iw_body false (some true)
      (fun _ => 1) c w ct cp hw d rfl (fun r hr => by
        refine ⟨?_, Nat.one_pos, (fun u hu hu' => by dsimp only at hu'; omega), ?_⟩
        · rw [horbit r (by omega)]; rfl
        · rw [horbit (r + 1) (by omega)]; rfl) t (by simp [t])
    have hsame : iw_machine.runFrom start t =
        (counterLoopTM iw_body false (some true)).runFrom start t :=

    refine ⟨t, ?_, List.replicate w.length true, List.length_replicate, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hover := counterOverhead_le w
      change counterOverhead w (d + 1) ≤ 4 * d + 2 * w.length + 2 at hover
      dsimp only [t]
      omega
    · rw [hsame, hend, horbit d (by omega), iw_patch_true]
    · intro u hu
      rw [iw_join_prefix start u (fun s hs => (hcut s (by omega)).2)]
      exact (hcut u hu).1
  · have hnd : n = z.length - p := hn.trans (Nat.min_eq_right (by omega))
    have hpn : p + n = z.length := by omega
    have hnd' : n < d := by omega
    let t := n + 1 + counterOverhead w (n + 1)

    obtain ⟨hend, hcut, _, _⟩ := counterLoopTM_run_escape iw_body false true (by decide)

        refine ⟨?_, Nat.one_pos, (fun u hu hu' => by dsimp only at hu'; omega)⟩
        rw [horbit r (by omega)]; rfl) (by rw [hfinal]) t (by simp [t])

        (counterLoopTM iw_body false (some true)).runFrom start u :=
      iw_join_prefix start u (fun s hs => (hcut s (by omega)).2)
    have hex : (iw_machine.runFrom start t).state = some .escape := by
      rw [hsame t le_rfl, hend, counter_cfg_eq]
    refine ⟨t + 1, ?_, counterWord w (n + 1), counterWord_length _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hover := counterOverhead_le_of_le w (n + 1) hnd'
      dsimp only [t]
      omega
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, iw_join_step _ hex, hsame t le_rfl, hend, hfinal]
      have hpatch : iw_patch ct cp (counterWord w (n + 1)) = fun q =>
          if cp ≤ q ∧ q < cp + (w.length : ℤ) then
            FinTM.bufferTape (counterWord w (n + 1)) (q - cp)
          else ct q := by
        funext q
        simp only [iw_patch, counterWord_length]
      simp only [counter_cfg_eq, hpatch]
    · intro u hu
      by_cases hut : u < t
      · rw [hsame u (by omega)]
        exact (hcut u hut).1
      · have hut' : u = t := by omega
        subst u
        rw [hex]
        simp

name: iw_select
header: private def iw_select {k : ℕ} (j dst : Fin k) (hjd : j ≠ dst) : Fin 2 ↪ Fin k
chunk:
/-- Select the destination as tape zero and the distinct counter as tape one. -/
private def iw_select {k : ℕ} (j dst : Fin k) (hjd : j ≠ dst) : Fin 2 ↪ Fin k :=
  ⟨fun i => if i = 0 then dst else j, by
    intro a b h
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp_all⟩

/-- **The bounded input window copier.** For work tapes `j ≠ dst` there is a machine with an
entry state `entry`, a live exit `done` and a constant `C` such that: started at `entry` with its
input head at native position `p + 1` (on the `p`-th input symbol) and a delimited binary counter
word `w` of value `d` on tape `j` from its head (little-endian, blanks at both ends, the
convention of `Turing.counterLoopTM`), it copies the window `y = (z.drop p).take d` (the next
`d` input symbols, fewer if the input ends) onto tape `dst` from that tape's head. It reaches
`done` within `C·(|y| + 1) + 2|w|` steps, and not before, with the input head just after the
window, the head of `dst` just after the copy, the counter head back at its start, the counter
word replaced by some word of the same width, and every other tape, head and the output
unchanged. No `|z|` term. (A leaf row of the construction layer; [AB09, §1.2].)

**Proof sketch.** `Turing.counterLoopTM` over a one-step body on the native input and tape
`dst`: at an input symbol, write it on `dst` and move both heads right, returning to the body's
anchor; at the input's right end, escape. Each round costs a fixed number of steps; the round
count is `|y|`, or `|y| + 1` when the input ends first. The counter ledger has two cases. On
exhaustion (`|y| = d`), the whole counter overhead of the `d + 1` decrements, the final
underflow included, is at most `4d + 2|w| + 2` (`Turing.counterOverhead_le`, used once). On
early input end (`|y| < d`), the loop escapes in round `r = |y| + 1 ≤ d`, after `r`
decrements, which cost at most `4r + 2|w|` (`Turing.counterOverhead_le_of_le`). Either way the
total is at most `C·(|y| + 1) + 2|w|`. The exit-time and endpoint clauses are those of
`Turing.counterLoopTM_run_done` and `Turing.counterLoopTM_run_escape`. -/

name: exists_inputWindowCopyTM
header:
theorem exists_inputWindowCopyTM (k : ℕ) (j dst : Fin k) (hjd : j ≠ dst) :
    ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (W : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q)
      (entry done : Q) (C : ℕ),
      ∀ {z : List Bool} (d : Cfg k Bool Q z) (p : ℕ) (w : List Bool),
        d.state = some entry → d.inputPos.val = p + 1 →
        (∀ q : ℤ, -1 ≤ q → q ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
          d.workTapes j (d.workTapePos j + q) = FinTM.bufferTape w q) →
        let y
chunk:
/-- **The bounded input window copier.** For work tapes `j ≠ dst` there is a machine with an
entry state `entry`, a live exit `done` and a constant `C` such that: started at `entry` with its
input head at native position `p + 1` (on the `p`-th input symbol) and a delimited binary counter
word `w` of value `d` on tape `j` from its head (little-endian, blanks at both ends, the
convention of `Turing.counterLoopTM`), it copies the window `y = (z.drop p).take d` (the next
`d` input symbols, fewer if the input ends) onto tape `dst` from that tape's head. It reaches
`done` within `C·(|y| + 1) + 2|w|` steps, and not before, with the input head just after the
window, the head of `dst` just after the copy, the counter head back at its start, the counter
word replaced by some word of the same width, and every other tape, head and the output
unchanged. No `|z|` term. (A leaf row of the construction layer; [AB09, §1.2].)

**Proof sketch.** `Turing.counterLoopTM` over a one-step body on the native input and tape
`dst`: at an input symbol, write it on `dst` and move both heads right, returning to the body's
anchor; at the input's right end, escape. Each round costs a fixed number of steps; the round
count is `|y|`, or `|y| + 1` when the input ends first. The counter ledger has two cases. On
exhaustion (`|y| = d`), the whole counter overhead of the `d + 1` decrements, the final
underflow included, is at most `4d + 2|w| + 2` (`Turing.counterOverhead_le`, used once). On
early input end (`|y| < d`), the loop escapes in round `r = |y| + 1 ≤ d`, after `r`
decrements, which cost at most `4r + 2|w|` (`Turing.counterOverhead_le_of_le`). Either way the
total is at most `C·(|y| + 1) + 2|w|`. The exit-time and endpoint clauses are those of
`Turing.counterLoopTM_run_done` and `Turing.counterLoopTM_run_escape`. -/
theorem exists_inputWindowCopyTM (k : ℕ) (j dst : Fin k) (hjd : j ≠ dst) :
    ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (W : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q)
      (entry done : Q) (C : ℕ),
      ∀ {z : List Bool} (d : Cfg k Bool Q z) (p : ℕ) (w : List Bool),
        d.state = some entry → d.inputPos.val = p + 1 →
        (∀ q : ℤ, -1 ≤ q → q ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
          d.workTapes j (d.workTapePos j + q) = FinTM.bufferTape w q) →
        let y := (z.drop p).take (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat))
        ∃ T ≤ C * (y.length + 1) + 2 * w.length, ∃ w' : List Bool, w'.length = w.length ∧
          (W.runFrom d T).state = some done ∧
          (W.runFrom d T).inputPos.val = p + 1 + y.length ∧
          (W.runFrom d T).workTapes =
            Function.update (Function.update d.workTapes dst (fun q =>
              if d.workTapePos dst ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos dst + (y.length : ℤ) then
                FinTM.bufferTape y (q - d.workTapePos dst)
              else d.workTapes dst q)) j (fun q =>
              if d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then
                FinTM.bufferTape w' (q - d.workTapePos j)
              else d.workTapes j q) ∧
          (W.runFrom d T).workTapePos =
            Function.update d.workTapePos dst (d.workTapePos dst + (y.length : ℤ)) ∧
          (W.runFrom d T).output = d.output ∧
          ∀ u < T, (W.runFrom d u).state ≠ some done := by
  let ι := iw_select j dst hjd
  refine ⟨CounterLoopState Bool, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    embedEmitTM ι iw_machine, .dec .run, .done, 6, ?_⟩
  intro z c p w hc hi hw
  let body : Cfg 1 Bool Bool z :=
    ⟨some false, c.inputPos, fun _ => c.workTapes dst,
      fun _ => c.workTapePos dst, c.output⟩
  let y := (z.drop p).take (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat))
  have hp : p ≤ z.length := by have := c.inputPos.isLt; omega
  have hn : y.length = min (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat)) (z.length - p) := by
    simp only [y, List.length_take, List.length_drop]
  have hbound : p + y.length ≤ z.length := by
    have := Nat.min_le_right (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat)) (z.length - p)
    omega
  have htake : (z.drop p).take y.length = y := by
    simpa only [y, List.length_take] using
      (List.take_eq_take_min (l := z.drop p) (i := Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat))).symm
  obtain ⟨T, hT, v, hv, hrun, hfirst⟩ :=
    iw_local body p rfl hi hp w (c.workTapes j) (c.workTapePos j) hw y.length hn
  let start := counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) body (c.workTapes j) (c.workTapePos j)
  let finish := counterLoopCfg (some .done) (iw_prefix body p y.length hbound)
    (iw_patch (c.workTapes j) (c.workTapePos j) v) (c.workTapePos j)
  let out : Cfg k Bool (CounterLoopState Bool) z :=
    ⟨some .done, (iw_prefix body p y.length hbound).inputPos,
      Function.update (Function.update c.workTapes dst
        (iw_patch (c.workTapes dst) (c.workTapePos dst) y)) j
        (iw_patch (c.workTapes j) (c.workTapePos j) v),
      Function.update c.workTapePos dst (c.workTapePos dst + (y.length : ℤ)), c.output⟩
  have hstart : embedEmitCfg ι c.workTapes c.workTapePos [] start = c := by
    apply embedEmitCfg_eq
    · simpa only [start, counter_cfg_eq] using hc.symm
    · simp only [start, counter_cfg_eq, body]
    · simp only [start, counter_cfg_eq, body, List.nil_append]
    · intro i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [start, counter_cfg_eq, body, ι, iw_select] <;> exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · intro i _
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have hend : embedEmitCfg ι c.workTapes c.workTapePos [] finish = out := by
    apply embedEmitCfg_eq
    · simp only [finish, counter_cfg_eq, out]
    · simp only [finish, counter_cfg_eq, out]
    · simp only [finish, counter_cfg_eq, iw_prefix, body, out, List.nil_append]
    · intro i
      fin_cases i <;>
        simp [finish, counter_cfg_eq, out, iw_prefix, body, ι, iw_select, htake, hjd,
          Ne.symm hjd] <;> exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · intro i hnone
      have hd : i ≠ dst := by
        intro he
        apply hnone
        exact ⟨0, by simp [ι, iw_select, he]⟩
      have hj : i ≠ j := by
        intro he
        apply hnone
        exact ⟨1, by simp [ι, iw_select, he]⟩
      simp [out, hd, hj]
  have hlift (u : ℕ) : (embedEmitTM ι iw_machine).runFrom c u =
      embedEmitCfg ι c.workTapes c.workTapePos [] (iw_machine.runFrom start u) := by
    calc
      _ = (embedEmitTM ι iw_machine).runFrom
          (embedEmitCfg ι c.workTapes c.workTapePos [] start) u :=
        congrArg (fun d => (embedEmitTM ι iw_machine).runFrom d u) hstart.symm
      _ = _ := embedEmitTM_runFrom ι iw_machine c.workTapes c.workTapePos [] start u
  have he : (embedEmitTM ι iw_machine).runFrom c T = out := by
    rw [hlift T, hrun]
    exact hend
  refine ⟨T, hT, v, hv, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [he, out]
  · simp only [he, out, iw_prefix, y]
  · rw [he, ← hv]
    rfl
  · simp only [he, out, y]
  · simp only [he, out]
  · intro u hu
    rw [hlift u, embedEmitCfg_state]
    exact hfirst u hu

end Turing

theorem seamCompTM_step {k : ℕ} {S₁ S₂ : Type} [DecidableEq S₁] {x : List Bool}
    (A : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₁) (exit₁ : S₁) (B : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₂)
    (entry₂ exit₂ : S₂)
    {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Bool S₁ x} {c₂ : Cfg k Bool S₂ x} {T₁ T₂ : ℕ}
    (h₁ : A.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c₁) (hx₁ : c₁.state = some exit₁)
    (hcut₁ : ∀ t < T₁, (A.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some exit₁)
    (h₂ : B.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry₂) T₂ = c₂)
    (hx₂ : c₂.state = some exit₂)
    (hcut₂ : ∀ t < T₂,
      (B.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry₂) t).state ≠ some exit₂) :

        c₂.mapState (Sum.inr : S₂ → S₁ ⊕ S₂) ∧
      (c₂.mapState (Sum.inr : S₂ → S₁ ⊕ S₂)).state = some (Sum.inr exit₂) ∧
      ∀ t < T₁ + 1 + T₂,
        ((seamCompTM A exit₁ B entry₂).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) t).state ≠

/-- **One seam step.** Composing a verified segment with a verified next phase through the seam
`Turing.seamCompTM`: the endpoint and its control state, reached after the two runs and one
additional dispatch transition (at time `T₁ + 1 + T₂`), and the inherited first return of the
phase's exit. [AB09, §1.4.1]

**Proof sketch.** The general-configuration seam run and its inherited first-return cut,
with the endpoint state projected through the state renaming. -/
theorem seamCompTM_step {k : ℕ} {S₁ S₂ : Type} [DecidableEq S₁] {x : List Bool}
    (A : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₁) (exit₁ : S₁) (B : MultiTapeTM k Bool S₂)

    {c₀ c₁ : Cfg k Bool S₁ x} {c₂ : Cfg k Bool S₂ x} {T₁ T₂ : ℕ}
    (h₁ : A.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c₁) (hx₁ : c₁.state = some exit₁)
    (hcut₁ : ∀ t < T₁, (A.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ some exit₁)
    (h₂ : B.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry₂) T₂ = c₂)
    (hx₂ : c₂.state = some exit₂)
    (hcut₂ : ∀ t < T₂,
      (B.runFrom (c₁.mapState fun _ => entry₂) t).state ≠ some exit₂) :
    (seamCompTM A exit₁ B entry₂).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) (T₁ + 1 + T₂) =
        c₂.mapState (Sum.inr : S₂ → S₁ ⊕ S₂) ∧
      (c₂.mapState (Sum.inr : S₂ → S₁ ⊕ S₂)).state = some (Sum.inr exit₂) ∧
      ∀ t < T₁ + 1 + T₂,
        ((seamCompTM A exit₁ B entry₂).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl) t).state ≠
          some (Sum.inr exit₂) := by
  refine ⟨seamCompTM_run_ofCfg A exit₁ B entry₂ h₁ hx₁ hcut₁ h₂, ?_,
    seamCompTM_firstReturn_ofCfg A exit₁ B entry₂ exit₂ h₁ hx₁ hcut₁ h₂ hx₂
      hcut₂⟩
  rw [Cfg.mapState_state, hx₂, Option.map_some]

theorem prefixCanon_pairExtract_halt (first : Bool) (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :

header:
theorem embedSilentCfg_initCfg {m n : ℕ} {S : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
    (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin n) (cap : Fin n) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι) (x : List Bool) :
    (embedSilentCfg ι cap (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] []

chunk:
/-- **A fresh capture's start.** Silently capturing a fresh run starts from the initial
configuration of the capture host: blank host tapes and zero work heads. [AB09, §1.4.1]

**Proof sketch.** Partition host tapes into selected tapes, the capture tape, and the frame.
The selected tapes inherit the blank initial configuration; the empty captured output makes
its tape blank; the frame is blank by construction. Compare all configuration fields. -/
theorem embedSilentCfg_initCfg {m n : ℕ} {S : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
    (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin n) (cap : Fin n) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι) (x : List Bool) :
    (embedSilentCfg ι cap (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] []
      (M.initCfg x)).mapState Sum.inl =
      Cfg.init (Sum.inl M.q₀ : S ⊕ Unit) x := by
  classical
  have hfields (j : Fin n) :
      (embedSilentCfg ι cap (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] []
        (M.initCfg x)).workTapes j = (fun _ => none) ∧
      (embedSilentCfg ι cap (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] []
        (M.initCfg x)).workTapePos j = 0 := by
    by_cases hj : j ∈ Set.range ι
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hj
      rw [embedSilentCfg_selected_tape, embedSilentCfg_selected_pos,
        MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq]
      exact ⟨funext fun z => Cfg.init_workTapes _ _ i z, Cfg.init_workTapePos _ _ i⟩
    · by_cases he : j = cap
      · subst j
        have hh := embedSilentCfg_cap ι cap hcap (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)
          [] [] (M.initCfg x)
        simpa only [MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_output, List.nil_append,
          FinTM.bufferTape_nil, List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero] using hh
      · exact embedSilentCfg_unselected ι cap (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)
          [] [] (M.initCfg x) j hj he
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, embedSilentCfg_state, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq,
      Cfg.init_state, Option.map_some, Cfg.init_state]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos, embedSilentCfg_inputPos, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq,
      Cfg.init_inputPos, Cfg.init_inputPos]
  · funext j z
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes, Cfg.init_workTapes, (hfields j).1]
  · funext j
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, Cfg.init_workTapePos, (hfields j).2]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_output, embedSilentCfg_output, Cfg.init_output]

selected word on the capture tape and the native head at the suffix. Unselected tapes other than
the capture retain their contents and heads; no description of the projection's final scratch
bank is needed. [AB09, §1.4.1]

**Proof sketch.** Use the header's bounded halt and the returning capture lemma. Project the
capture, input-position, output and unselected-tape equations at that return. -/

selected word on the capture tape and the native head at the suffix. Unselected tapes other than

theorem headerCapture_run (first : Bool) (K : ℕ) (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (ι : Fin (prefixCanonTM
      (if first then FinTM.pairExtractTM true false else FinTM.pairExtractTM false true)).k ↪

    (cap : Fin K) (hcap : cap ∉ Set.range ι)

    ∃ T ≤ 16 * (Nat.bits t).length + 8 * α.length + 25,

machine family `M` on the input `⟨⟨bits t, α⟩, x⟩` under a binary deadline. Write

`costI α` steps (the shape of `Turing.FinTM.exists_installCallTM`'s contract), there is one
machine `U`, uniform in `α`, `x` and `t`, with four role tapes and `p` passive tapes, such that
the following holds. From `entry` on the native input, with every head at `0`, empty output, the
passive tapes holding any words and every other tape blank, `U` first reaches `done` at a time
`T ≤ costI α + A (|α| + |w α| + 1) + B (|bits t| + min t |x| + 1)`. There the input head is at

* the counter tape `jctr` holds `bits t`;
* the window tape `jwin` holds `x.take t`;
* the table tape `jtbl` holds `tableBitsK (M α).tr`;
* the summary tape `jsm` holds `StepBlock.summaryCells none (unaryFin (M α).q₀)`;

3. the header pass capturing `α`;

    (α.length + 2) + 1 + TI + 1 + TL + 1 + ((x.take t).length + 2) with hTPRE
  have hl1 : (e₁.mapState (fun _ => InputRewindPhase.start)).inputPos.val =
      4 * (Nat.bits t).length + 2 * α.length + 7 := by
    rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos]
    exact h₁pos
  have hl2 : ((e₆.mapState (Sum.inr : _ → St₆)).mapState
      (fun _ => InputRewindPhase.start)).inputPos.val =
      4 * (Nat.bits t).length + 2 * α.length + 7 + (x.take t).length := by
    rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos, Cfg.mapState_inputPos]
    exact h₆pos
  have hmin : (x.take t).length = min t x.length := by simp
  -- The passive tapes, by the clean ledger.
  have hpassive : ∀ i : Fin p,
      e₁₁.workTapes (ιP i) = tapes₀ (ιP i) ∧ e₁₁.workTapePos (ιP i) = 0 := by
    intro i
    have hv := hιP i
    have hi := i.isLt
    obtain ⟨ht, hp⟩ := hth' (ιP i)
      (hinst_unsel (ιP i) (by omega) (by omega))
      (by intro hmem; have := congrArg Fin.val hmem; omega)
      (by intro hmem; have := congrArg Fin.val hmem; omega)
      (by intro hmem; have := congrArg Fin.val hmem; omega)
      (by intro hmem; have := congrArg Fin.val hmem; omega)
    obtain ⟨ht8, hp8⟩ := hclean₈ (ιP i)
      (by intro hmem; rw [hr₁] at hmem; omega)
      (by intro hmem; have := congrArg Fin.val hmem; omega)
      (by intro hmem; rw [hr₂] at hmem; omega)
      (by intro hmem; have := congrArg Fin.val hmem; omega)
      (by intro hmem; have := congrArg Fin.val hmem; omega)
      (by intro hmem; have := congrArg Fin.val hmem; omega)
    exact ⟨ht.trans ht8, hp.trans hp8⟩
  -- The time: the phases' bounds and the seams' steps.
  have hTsum : TPRE ≤ costI α +
      CL * ((pairEncode (n α).bits (unaryFin (M α).q₀ ++ tableBitsK (M α).tr)).length + 1) +
      21 * α.length +
      45 * (Nat.bits t).length + CW * (min t x.length + 1) + 2 * min t x.length + 84 := by
    rw [hTPRE, hl1, hl2, hmin]
    omega
  have hTle : TPRE ≤ costI α +
      (120 + CL) * (α.length +
        (pairEncode (n α).bits (unaryFin (M α).q₀ ++ tableBitsK (M α).tr)).length + 1) +
      (47 + CW) * ((Nat.bits t).length + min t x.length + 1) := by
    refine hTsum.trans ?_
    nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (CL * α.length),
      Nat.zero_le (CL * (pairEncode (n α).bits (unaryFin (M α).q₀ ++ tableBitsK (M α).tr)).length),
      Nat.zero_le (CW * (Nat.bits t).length), Nat.zero_le (CW * min t x.length)]
  refine ⟨TPRE, hTle, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hstart, s11run]
    exact s11st
  · intro u hu
    rw [hstart]
    exact s11cut u hu
  · dsimp only
    rw [hstart, s11run]
    have hT : ∀ j, (e₁₁.mapState (Sum.inr : RewindPhase → St₁₀ ⊕ RewindPhase)).workTapes j =
        e₁₁.workTapes j := by
      intro j
      funext a
      rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes]
    refine ⟨by rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos]; exact he₁₁in, by rw [Cfg.mapState_output]; exact he₁₁out,
      by rw [hT]; exact hctr₁₁.1, by rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]; exact hctr₁₁.2,
      by rw [hT]; exact hwin₁₁, by rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]; exact he₁₁poswin,
      by rw [hT]; exact htbl₁₁.1, by rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]; exact htbl₁₁.2,
      by rw [hT]; exact hsm₁₁.1, by rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]; exact hsm₁₁.2,
      fun i => ⟨by rw [hT]; exact (hpassive i).1,
        by rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]; exact (hpassive i).2⟩⟩

end Turing

/-- **The loop summation lemma** (the generic form of
the enumerator's proved `enumLoop_run`, which is the harvest template;
round-1 audit verdict: Pass, including `N = 0`).
Given round configurations `cfg 0, …, cfg N` of one machine with empty
outputs, such that each round `j < N` within budget `B` either halts with
the verdict `[true]` (when `accept j`) or reaches `cfg (j+1)`, and the
exhaustion round `cfg N` halts with `[false]` within `B`: the run from
`cfg 0` halts within `(N + 1) · B` steps with the single verdict bit
`(List.range N).any accept`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the first accepting round (or `N` when none
accepts), composing the advance segments with
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add` and absorbing halted tails with
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_of_halt`; empty round outputs make the final
output exactly the one emitted verdict. -/

name: loop_run
header:
theorem loop_run {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x)
    (accept : ℕ → Bool) (B N : ℕ)
    (hout : ∀ j ≤ N, (cfg j).output = [])
    (hend : ∃ t ≤ B, (tm.runFrom (cfg N) t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom (cfg N) t).output = [false])
    (hround : ∀ j < N, ∃ t ≤ B,
      if accept j then
        (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).state = none ∧
          (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).output = [true]
      else tm.runFrom (cfg j) t = cfg (j + 1)) :
    ∃ t ≤ (N + 1) * B, (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).output = [(List.range N).any accept]
chunk:
/-- **The loop summation lemma** (the generic form of
the enumerator's proved `enumLoop_run`, which is the harvest template;
round-1 audit verdict: Pass, including `N = 0`).
Given round configurations `cfg 0, …, cfg N` of one machine with empty
outputs, such that each round `j < N` within budget `B` either halts with
the verdict `[true]` (when `accept j`) or reaches `cfg (j+1)`, and the
exhaustion round `cfg N` halts with `[false]` within `B`: the run from
`cfg 0` halts within `(N + 1) · B` steps with the single verdict bit
`(List.range N).any accept`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the first accepting round (or `N` when none
accepts), composing the advance segments with
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add` and absorbing halted tails with
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_of_halt`; empty round outputs make the final
output exactly the one emitted verdict. -/
theorem loop_run {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x)
    (accept : ℕ → Bool) (B N : ℕ)
    (hout : ∀ j ≤ N, (cfg j).output = [])
    (hend : ∃ t ≤ B, (tm.runFrom (cfg N) t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom (cfg N) t).output = [false])
    (hround : ∀ j < N, ∃ t ≤ B,
      if accept j then
        (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).state = none ∧
          (tm.runFrom (cfg j) t).output = [true]
      else tm.runFrom (cfg j) t = cfg (j + 1)) :
    ∃ t ≤ (N + 1) * B, (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom (cfg 0) t).output = [(List.range N).any accept] := by
  induction N generalizing cfg accept with
  | zero => simpa using hend
  | succ N ih =>
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hc⟩ := hround 0 (by omega)
    have hany : (List.range (N + 1)).any accept =
        (accept 0 || (List.range N).any (fun j => accept (j + 1))) := by
      simp [List.range_succ_eq_map, List.any_map, Function.comp_def]
    by_cases hb : accept 0 = true
    · simp only [hb, ↓reduceIte] at hc
      refine ⟨t, ht.trans ?_, hc.1, ?_⟩
      · exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left B (by omega)
      · simpa [hany, hb] using hc.2
    · simp only [hb] at hc
      -- Shift the round family by one, retaining the same terminal segment.
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hhalt, hout'⟩ := ih
        (fun j => cfg (j + 1)) (fun j => accept (j + 1))
        (fun j hj => hout (j + 1) (by omega)) hend
        (fun j hj => hround (j + 1) (by omega))
      refine ⟨t + s, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Nat.succ_mul]; omega
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc]; exact hhalt
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc]
        simpa [hany, hb] using hout'

end Turing

/-- Replace a possibly padded halting-time witness by its first halt,
retaining the entire endpoint configuration.
**Proof sketch.** The first halt `Turing.MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt` gives the least
halting time with its liveness guard and endpoint; it is positive because the starting
configuration is live. -/

name: loop_first_halt
header:
private lemma loop_first_halt {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ)
    (hstart : cfg.state ≠ none) (hhalt : (tm.runFrom cfg t).state = none) :
    ∃ u, 0 < u ∧ u ≤ t ∧
      (∀ v < u, ¬(tm.runFrom cfg v).Halted) ∧
      (tm.runFrom cfg u).state = none ∧ tm.runFrom cfg u = tm.runFrom cfg t
chunk:
/-- Replace a possibly padded halting-time witness by its first halt,
retaining the entire endpoint configuration.
**Proof sketch.** The first halt `Turing.MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt` gives the least
halting time with its liveness guard and endpoint; it is positive because the starting
configuration is live. -/
private lemma loop_first_halt {k : ℕ} {S : Type*} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ)
    (hstart : cfg.state ≠ none) (hhalt : (tm.runFrom cfg t).state = none) :
    ∃ u, 0 < u ∧ u ≤ t ∧
      (∀ v < u, ¬(tm.runFrom cfg v).Halted) ∧
      (tm.runFrom cfg u).state = none ∧ tm.runFrom cfg u = tm.runFrom cfg t := by
  obtain ⟨u, hut, hlive, he⟩ := MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt tm cfg hhalt
  have hu : (tm.runFrom cfg u).state = none := by rw [he]; exact hhalt
  refine ⟨u, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hz => hstart ?_, hut, hlive, hu, he⟩
  rw [hz, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero] at hu
  exact hu

name: loopBodyTM

/-- Stop the body at the next anchor entry, distinguishing that return from
a genuine source halt on an extra one-cell flag tape. A true release bit
forces one source action, even at the anchor; every source successor clears
the release bit. The body's full output is retained for subsequent capture. -/
private def loopBodyTM (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) : FinTM Bool where
  k := body.k + 1
  State := body.State × Bool
  tm :=
    { q₀ := (body.tm.q₀, false)
      tr := fun q inp work =>
        if q.1 = anchor ∧ q.2 = false then
          { inputTape := 0
            workTapes := fun i =>
              if (i : ℕ) < body.k then (none, 0) else (some (some false), 0)
            output := none
            state := none }
        else
          let a := body.tm.tr q.1 inp (fun i => work i.castSucc)
          { inputTape := a.inputTape
            workTapes := fun i =>
              if h : (i : ℕ) < body.k then a.workTapes ⟨i, h⟩
              else (if a.state = none then some (some true) else none, 0)
            output := a.output
            state := a.state.map (fun s => (s, false)) } }

/-- Embed a source configuration with its release bit and the one-cell
halt-kind flag. The flag head stays at the origin throughout a body call. -/
private def loopBodyCfg (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x) (release : Bool) (flag : Option Bool) :
    Cfg (loopBodyTM body anchor).k Bool (loopBodyTM body anchor).State x where
  state := c.state.map (fun s => (s, release))
  inputPos := c.inputPos
  workTapes := fun i => if h : (i : ℕ) < body.k then c.workTapes ⟨i, h⟩
    else fun z => if z = 0 then flag else none
  workTapePos := fun i => if h : (i : ℕ) < body.k then c.workTapePos ⟨i, h⟩ else 0
  output := c.output

/-- At an unreleased anchor the stop wrapper takes one silent step and
records rejection, without changing the body's configuration data. -/
private lemma loopBody_stop (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) {x : List Bool}

/-- Away from an unreleased anchor, the wrapper executes exactly one body
action and records a true flag precisely on a genuine halting transition. -/

name: loopBody_step
header:
private lemma loopBody_step (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x) (q : body.State) (release : Bool)
    (flag : Option Bool) (hc : c.state = some q)
    (hgo : ¬(q = anchor ∧ release = false)) :
    (loopBodyTM body anchor).tm.step (loopBodyCfg body anchor c release flag) =
      loopBodyCfg body anchor (body.tm.step c) false
        (if (body.tm.step c).state = none then some true else flag)
chunk:
/-- Away from an unreleased anchor, the wrapper executes exactly one body
action and records a true flag precisely on a genuine halting transition. -/
private lemma loopBody_step (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x) (q : body.State) (release : Bool)
    (flag : Option Bool) (hc : c.state = some q)
    (hgo : ¬(q = anchor ∧ release = false)) :
    (loopBodyTM body anchor).tm.step (loopBodyCfg body anchor c release flag) =
      loopBodyCfg body anchor (body.tm.step c) false
        (if (body.tm.step c).state = none then some true else flag) := by
  let a := body.tm.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols
  have hb : body.tm.step c = a.apply c := by simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hc, a]
  rw [hb]
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  simp only [loopBodyCfg, hc, Option.map_some, loopBodyTM, hgo, ↓reduceIte]
  have hr : (fun i : Fin body.k =>
      (loopBodyCfg body anchor c release flag).workTapeSymbols i.castSucc) =
        c.workTapeSymbols := by
    funext i
    simp [loopBodyCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, i.isLt]
  change (let a' : Action body.k Bool body.State :=
            body.tm.tr q c.inputSymbol (fun i : Fin body.k =>
              (loopBodyCfg body anchor c release flag).workTapeSymbols i.castSucc);
    ({
      inputTape := a'.inputTape
      workTapes := fun i => if h : (i : ℕ) < body.k then a'.workTapes ⟨i, h⟩
        else (if a'.state = none then some (some true) else none, 0)
      output := a'.output
      state := a'.state.map (fun s => (s, false)) } :
        Action (body.k + 1) Bool (body.State × Bool))).apply _ = _
  rw [hr]
  dsimp only
  dsimp only [a] at *
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
  · funext i z
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < body.k
    · simp [Action.apply, hi]
    · by_cases ha : (body.tm.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).state = none
      · simp only [Action.apply, hi, ↓reduceDIte, ha, ↓reduceIte]
        by_cases hz : z = 0 <;> simp [hz, hi, Function.update]
      · simp [Action.apply, hi, ha]
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < body.k <;> simp [Action.apply, hi]

/-- Up to the first halt or anchor return, the stop wrapper simulates the
body exactly. The release flag is consumed by the first action.
**Proof sketch.** Induct on elapsed time. Strict liveness supplies a source
state; the no-anchor condition, except for the released first action,
enables the one-step lemma. Its flag update records a halting emission's
transition without discarding that emission. -/

name: loopBody_run
header:
private lemma loopBody_run (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x) (release : Bool) (hc : c.state ≠ none)
    (t : ℕ) (hlive : ∀ u < t, (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ none)
    (hanchor : ∀ u < t, (u = 0 ∧ release = true) ∨
      (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ some anchor) :
    (loopBodyTM body anchor).tm.runFrom (loopBodyCfg body anchor c release none) t =
      loopBodyCfg body anchor (body.tm.runFrom c t) (if t = 0 then release else false)
        (if (body.tm.runFrom c t).state = none then some true else none)
chunk:
/-- Up to the first halt or anchor return, the stop wrapper simulates the
body exactly. The release flag is consumed by the first action.
**Proof sketch.** Induct on elapsed time. Strict liveness supplies a source
state; the no-anchor condition, except for the released first action,
enables the one-step lemma. Its flag update records a halting emission's
transition without discarding that emission. -/
private lemma loopBody_run (body : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg body.k Bool body.State x) (release : Bool) (hc : c.state ≠ none)
    (t : ℕ) (hlive : ∀ u < t, (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ none)
    (hanchor : ∀ u < t, (u = 0 ∧ release = true) ∨
      (body.tm.runFrom c u).state ≠ some anchor) :
    (loopBodyTM body anchor).tm.runFrom (loopBodyCfg body anchor c release none) t =
      loopBodyCfg body anchor (body.tm.runFrom c t) (if t = 0 then release else false)
        (if (body.tm.runFrom c t).state = none then some true else none) := by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [hc]
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
    rw [ih (fun u hu => hlive u (by omega)) (fun u hu => hanchor u (by omega))]
    have ht := hlive t (by omega)
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp ht
    have hgo : ¬(q = anchor ∧ (if t = 0 then release else false) = false) := by
      rcases hanchor t (by omega) with ⟨hz, hr⟩ | hn
      · simp [hz, hr]
      · rintro ⟨rfl, _⟩
        exact hn hq
    rw [if_neg ht, loopBody_step body anchor _ q _ none hq hgo]
    simp only [Nat.succ_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']

header: private abbrev LoopHostState (body F : FinTM Bool)
chunk:
/-- Disjoint finite control for fuel, body calls, and fourteen controller phases. -/
private abbrev LoopHostState (body F : FinTM Bool) :=
  F.State ⊕ ((Bool × (body.State × Bool)) ⊕ Fin 14)

/-- Relocate the fuel machine past the untouched body, flag, and counter tapes. -/

name: loopFuelSource
chunk:
/-- Relocate the fuel machine past the untouched body, flag, and counter tapes. -/
private def loopFuelSource (body F : FinTM Bool) :
    MultiTapeTM (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) Bool F.State where
  q₀ := F.tm.q₀
  tr := fun q inp work =>
    rightAction (body.k + 1) id (rightAction 1 id
      (F.tm.tr q inp fun i => work (Fin.natAdd (body.k + 1) (Fin.natAdd 1 i))))

/-- Extend the stopped body with a preserved counter and the fuel-phase residue. -/

name: loopBodySource
chunk:
/-- Extend the stopped body with a preserved counter and the fuel-phase residue. -/
private def loopBodySource (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) :
    MultiTapeTM (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) Bool (body.State × Bool) where
  q₀ := (body.tm.q₀, false)
  tr := fun q inp work => leftAction (1 + F.k) id
    ((loopBodyTM body anchor).tm.tr q inp fun i => work (Fin.castAdd (1 + F.k) i))

/-- A controller action touches only the flag, counter, and capture tapes. -/

name: loopControlAction
header:
private def loopControlAction (body F : FinTM Bool) (inp : SignType)
    (flag : Option (Option Bool)) (counter payload : Option (Option Bool) × SignType)
    (out : Option Bool) (next : Option (LoopHostState body F)) :
    Action (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) where
  inputTape
chunk:
/-- A controller action touches only the flag, counter, and capture tapes. -/
private def loopControlAction (body F : FinTM Bool) (inp : SignType)
    (flag : Option (Option Bool)) (counter payload : Option (Option Bool) × SignType)
    (out : Option Bool) (next : Option (LoopHostState body F)) :
    Action (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) where
  inputTape := inp
  workTapes := fun i =>
    if (i : ℕ) = body.k then (flag, 0)
    else if (i : ℕ) = body.k + 1 then counter
    else if (i : ℕ) = body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) then payload
    else (none, 0)
  output := out
  state := next

/-- Body dispatch of the shared loop controller: `forward = false` captures body
emissions on the payload tape (`Turing.captureAction`); `forward = true` forwards them
to the physical output (`Turing.emitAction`), payload tape stationary. -/

name: loopBodyDispatch
header:
private def loopBodyDispatch (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward : Bool)
    (startup : Bool) (s : body.State × Bool) (inp : Option Bool)
    (work : Fin (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) → Option Bool) :
    Action (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F)
chunk:
/-- Body dispatch of the shared loop controller: `forward = false` captures body
emissions on the payload tape (`Turing.captureAction`); `forward = true` forwards them
to the physical output (`Turing.emitAction`), payload tape stationary. -/
private def loopBodyDispatch (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward : Bool)
    (startup : Bool) (s : body.State × Bool) (inp : Option Bool)
    (work : Fin (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) → Option Bool) :
    Action (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) :=
  bif forward then
    leftAction 1 id (Turing.emitAction (fun s => .inr (.inl (startup, s)))
      (.inr (.inr (if startup then 6 else 7)))
      ((loopBodySource body F anchor).tr s inp (fun i => work i.castSucc)))
  else
    captureAction (fun s => .inr (.inl (startup, s)))
      (.inr (.inr (if startup then 6 else 7)))
      ((loopBodySource body F anchor).tr s inp fun i => work i.castSucc)

/-- Concrete loop controller, with fixed-verdict and payload-replay modes.
Fuel is captured, rewound, copied into the fixed-width counter while the
capture tape is cleared, and both heads are rewound together. Two further
phases rewind the native input before starting the body. Body startup and
active rounds have disjoint return states; only an active rejection debits.
The release bit forces one body action before another anchor is recognized.

Control phases: 0/1 fuel rewind; 2 counter copy; 3 counter/capture rewind;
4/5 input rewind; 6 startup return; 7 round return; 8 borrow; 9/10 successful
and underflow rewinds; 11 exhaustion; 12/13 payload rewind and replay.
The fuel work tapes are never cleared or reused after the fuel phase. -/

name: loopHostM
chunk:
/-- Concrete loop controller, with fixed-verdict and payload-replay modes.
Fuel is captured, rewound, copied into the fixed-width counter while the
capture tape is cleared, and both heads are rewound together. Two further
phases rewind the native input before starting the body. Body startup and
active rounds have disjoint return states; only an active rejection debits.
The release bit forces one body action before another anchor is recognized.

Control phases: 0/1 fuel rewind; 2 counter copy; 3 counter/capture rewind;
4/5 input rewind; 6 startup return; 7 round return; 8 borrow; 9/10 successful
and underflow rewinds; 11 exhaustion; 12/13 payload rewind and replay.
The fuel work tapes are never cleared or reused after the fuel phase. -/
private def loopHostM (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State) (forward findMode : Bool) :
    FinTM Bool where
  k := body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1
  State := LoopHostState body F
  tm :=
    { q₀ := .inl F.tm.q₀
      tr := fun q inp work =>
        let ctrl (j : Fin 14) : LoopHostState body F := .inr (.inr j)
        let call (startup : Bool) (s : body.State × Bool) : LoopHostState body F :=
          .inr (.inl (startup, s))
        let flag : Fin (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) := ⟨body.k, by omega⟩
        let counter : Fin (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) := ⟨body.k + 1, by omega⟩
        let payload := Fin.last (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k))
        let act := loopControlAction body F
        match q with
        | .inl s => captureAction Sum.inl (ctrl 0)
            ((loopFuelSource body F).tr s inp fun i => work i.castSucc)
        | .inr (.inl (startup, s)) => loopBodyDispatch body F anchor forward startup s inp work
        | .inr (.inr phase) =>
            if phase = 0 then act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 1))
            else if phase = 1 then
              match work payload with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 1))
              | none => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .pos) none (some (ctrl 2))
            else if phase = 2 then
              match work payload with
              | some b => act 0 none (some (some b), .pos) (some none, .pos) none
                  (some (ctrl 2))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 3))
            else if phase = 3 then
              match work counter with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 3))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .pos) (none, .pos) none (some (ctrl 4))
            else if phase = 4 then act .neg none (none, 0) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 5))
            else if phase = 5 then
              match inp with
              | some _ => act .neg none (none, 0) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 5))
              | none => act .pos none (none, 0) (none, 0) none
                  (some (call true (body.tm.q₀, false)))
            else if phase = 6 then act 0 (some none) (none, 0) (none, 0) none
              (some (call false (anchor, true)))
            else if phase = 7 then
              if work flag = some true then
                if findMode then act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 12))
                else act 0 none (none, 0) (none, 0) (some true) none
              else act 0 (some none) (none, 0) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 8))
            else if phase = 8 then
              match work counter with
              | some false => act 0 none (some (some true), .pos) (none, 0) none
                  (some (ctrl 8))
              | some true => act 0 none (some (some false), .neg) (none, 0) none
                  (some (ctrl 9))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 10))
            else if phase = 9 then
              match work counter with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 9))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .pos) (none, 0) none
                  (some (call false (anchor, true)))
            else if phase = 10 then
              match work counter with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, .neg) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 10))
              | none => act 0 none (none, .pos) (none, 0) none (some (ctrl 11))
            else if phase = 11 then
              act 0 none (none, 0) (none, 0) (if findMode then none else some false) none
            else if phase = 12 then
              match work payload with
              | some _ => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .neg) none (some (ctrl 12))
              | none => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .pos) none (some (ctrl 13))
            else
              match work payload with
              | some b => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, .pos) (some b) (some (ctrl 13))
              | none => act 0 none (none, 0) (none, 0) none none }

/-- **The loop host**. The decision and find host of the bounded loop: it runs the fuel machine `F`
with its output captured, copies the fuel word `Nat.bits R` into a fixed-width counter, rewinds,
starts `body`, and then alternates captured body rounds from the `anchor` seam with fixed-width
debits of the counter (the first anchor entry is free). An accepting round halts with `[true]`, or
in find mode replays the round's own output; underflow of the counter halts with `[false]`, or with
nothing in find mode. It is the non-forwarding instance `loopHostM body F anchor false findMode` of
the shared controller. -/

    FinTM Bool

    (q : Option (LoopHostState body F)) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (flag counter payload : ℤ → Option Bool) (ch ph : ℤ) (out : List Bool) :
    Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) x where
  state := q
  inputPos := p
  workTapes := fun i =>
    if (i : ℕ) = body.k then flag
    else if (i : ℕ) = body.k + 1 then counter
    else if (i : ℕ) = body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) then payload
    else base.workTapes i
  workTapePos := fun i =>
    if (i : ℕ) = body.k then 0
    else if (i : ℕ) = body.k + 1 then ch
    else if (i : ℕ) = body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) then ph
    else base.workTapePos i
  output := out

name: loopControl_apply
header:
private lemma loopControl_apply (body F : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) x)
    (q : Option (LoopHostState body F)) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (flag counter payload : ℤ → Option Bool) (ch ph : ℤ) (out : List Bool)

    (ca pa : Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (emit : Option Bool)
    (next : Option (LoopHostState body F)) :
    (loopControlAction body F inp fw ca pa emit next).apply
        (loopFrame body F base q p flag counter payload ch ph out) =
      loopFrame body F base next (moveInputPos p inp)

chunk:
/-- Controller actions preserve the inactive frame and perform precisely
the three declared track operations. -/
private lemma loopControl_apply (body F : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (base : Cfg (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) + 1) Bool (LoopHostState body F) x)
    (q : Option (LoopHostState body F)) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (flag counter payload : ℤ → Option Bool) (ch ph : ℤ) (out : List Bool)
    (inp : SignType) (fw : Option (Option Bool))
    (ca pa : Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (emit : Option Bool)
    (next : Option (LoopHostState body F)) :
    (loopControlAction body F inp fw ca pa emit next).apply
        (loopFrame body F base q p flag counter payload ch ph out) =
      loopFrame body F base next (moveInputPos p inp)
        (loopWrite flag 0 fw) (loopWrite counter ch ca.1) (loopWrite payload ph pa.1)
        (ch + ca.2) (ph + pa.2) (out ++ emit.toList) := by
  have hcf : body.k + 1 ≠ body.k := by omega
  have hpf : body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) ≠ body.k := by omega
  have hpc : body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) ≠ body.k + 1 := by omega
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
  · funext i
    by_cases hf : (i : ℕ) = body.k
    · simp only [Action.apply, loopControlAction, loopFrame, hf, ↓reduceIte]
      cases fw <;> rfl
    · by_cases hc : (i : ℕ) = body.k + 1
      · simp only [Action.apply, loopControlAction, loopFrame, hc, hcf, ↓reduceIte]
        cases ca.1 <;> rfl
      · by_cases hp : (i : ℕ) = body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)
        · simp only [Action.apply, loopControlAction, loopFrame, hp, hpf, hpc, ↓reduceIte]
          cases pa.1 <;> rfl
        · simp [Action.apply, loopControlAction, loopFrame, hf, hc, hp]
  · funext i
    by_cases hf : (i : ℕ) = body.k
    · simp [Action.apply, loopControlAction, loopFrame, hf]
    · by_cases hc : (i : ℕ) = body.k + 1
      · simp [Action.apply, loopControlAction, loopFrame, hc]
      · by_cases hp : (i : ℕ) = body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) <;>
          simp [Action.apply, loopControlAction, loopFrame, hf, hc, hp, hpf]

name: loopReplay_step
header:
private lemma loopReplay_step (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (pre rest out : List Bool) :
    loopReplayTM.tm.step (loopReplayCfg x p (some ()) pre.length (pre ++ rest) out) =
      match rest with
      | [] => loopReplayCfg x p none pre.length pre out
      | b :: bs => loopReplayCfg x p (some ()) (pre.length + 1) (pre ++ b :: bs) (out ++ [b])
chunk:
/-- A replay step emits the current bit without modifying the captured word;
at the right blank it halts without an additional bit. -/
private lemma loopReplay_step (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (pre rest out : List Bool) :
    loopReplayTM.tm.step (loopReplayCfg x p (some ()) pre.length (pre ++ rest) out) =
      match rest with
      | [] => loopReplayCfg x p none pre.length pre out
      | b :: bs => loopReplayCfg x p (some ()) (pre.length + 1) (pre ++ b :: bs) (out ++ [b]) := by
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  change (loopReplayTM.tm.tr () _ _).apply _ = _
  simp only [loopReplayTM, loopReplayCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, loopBuffer_read]
  cases rest with
  | nil =>
    refine Cfg.ext rfl (moveInputPos_zero p) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp
    · funext i; simp [Action.apply]
    · simp [Action.apply]
  | cons b rest =>
    refine Cfg.ext rfl (moveInputPos_zero p) rfl ?_ rfl
    funext i; simp [Action.apply]

/-- Replay emits exactly the remaining payload in its length plus one steps,
including an empty payload.
**Proof sketch.** Induct on the unprocessed suffix. The step lemma emits
one bit and moves the frontier; the empty suffix supplies the final blank
test. Concatenation associativity preserves the exact output order. -/

name: loopReplay_run
header:
private lemma loopReplay_run (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (rest : List Bool) : ∀ pre out : List Bool,
    loopReplayTM.tm.runFrom (loopReplayCfg x p (some ()) pre.length (pre ++ rest) out)
        (rest.length + 1) =
      loopReplayCfg x p none (pre ++ rest).length (pre ++ rest) (out ++ rest)
chunk:
/-- Replay emits exactly the remaining payload in its length plus one steps,
including an empty payload.
**Proof sketch.** Induct on the unprocessed suffix. The step lemma emits
one bit and moves the frontier; the empty suffix supplies the final blank
test. Concatenation associativity preserves the exact output order. -/
private lemma loopReplay_run (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (rest : List Bool) : ∀ pre out : List Bool,
    loopReplayTM.tm.runFrom (loopReplayCfg x p (some ()) pre.length (pre ++ rest) out)
        (rest.length + 1) =
      loopReplayCfg x p none (pre ++ rest).length (pre ++ rest) (out ++ rest) := by
  induction rest with
  | nil =>
    intro pre out
    simpa [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step] using loopReplay_step x p pre [] out
  | cons b rest ih =>
    intro pre out
    rw [List.length_cons, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, loopReplay_step]
    simpa [List.append_assoc, List.length_append, List.length_cons, Nat.cast_add,
      Nat.cast_one, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using ih (pre ++ [b]) (out ++ [b])

name: loopControl_payload
header:
private lemma loopControl_payload (body F : FinTM Bool) (d : SignType)
    (out : Option Bool) (next : Option (LoopHostState body F)) :
    loopControlAction body F 0 none (none, 0) (none, d) out next =
      rightAction (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) id
        (⟨0, fun _ : Fin 1 => (none, d), out, next⟩ : Action 1 Bool (LoopHostState body F))
chunk:
/-- A payload-only controller action is the right-block action extension. -/
private lemma loopControl_payload (body F : FinTM Bool) (d : SignType)
    (out : Option Bool) (next : Option (LoopHostState body F)) :
    loopControlAction body F 0 none (none, 0) (none, d) out next =
      rightAction (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) id
        (⟨0, fun _ : Fin 1 => (none, d), out, next⟩ : Action 1 Bool (LoopHostState body F)) := by
  simp only [loopControlAction, rightAction, Option.map_id]
  congr 1
  funext i
  refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ i
  · intro j
    have hj : (j : ℕ) ≠ body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) := Nat.ne_of_lt j.isLt
    simp [hj]
  · intro j
    have hj : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst j
    have hf : body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k) ≠ body.k := by omega
    simp [hf]

/-- Phase 13 replays the captured payload in the actual host, preserving
the arbitrary completed body/fuel tapes. -/

name: loopHost_replay
header:
private lemma loopHost_replay (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (word out : List Bool)
    (tapes : Fin (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (heads : Fin (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) → ℤ) :
    (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
        (rightCfg (fun _ : Unit => Sum.inr (Sum.inr (13 : Fin 14)))
          (loopReplayCfg x p (some ()) 0 word out) tapes heads) (word.length + 1) =
      rightCfg (fun _ : Unit => Sum.inr (Sum.inr (13 : Fin 14)))
        (loopReplayCfg x p none word.length word (out ++ word)) tapes heads
chunk:
/-- Phase 13 replays the captured payload in the actual host, preserving
the arbitrary completed body/fuel tapes. -/
private lemma loopHost_replay (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (findMode : Bool) (x : List Bool) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (word out : List Bool)
    (tapes : Fin (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (heads : Fin (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) → ℤ) :
    (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.runFrom
        (rightCfg (fun _ : Unit => Sum.inr (Sum.inr (13 : Fin 14)))
          (loopReplayCfg x p (some ()) 0 word out) tapes heads) (word.length + 1) =
      rightCfg (fun _ : Unit => Sum.inr (Sum.inr (13 : Fin 14)))
        (loopReplayCfg x p none word.length word (out ++ word)) tapes heads := by
  have htr : ∀ q inp work,
      (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm.tr (.inr (.inr (13 : Fin 14))) inp work =
        rightAction (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k))
          (fun _ : Unit => Sum.inr (Sum.inr (13 : Fin 14)))
          (loopReplayTM.tm.tr q inp fun i => work (Fin.natAdd (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) i)) := by
    intro q inp work
    cases q
    change (match work (Fin.last (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k))) with
      | some b => loopControlAction body F 0 none (none, 0) (none, .pos) (some b)
          (some (.inr (.inr 13)))
      | none => loopControlAction body F 0 none (none, 0) (none, 0) none none) = _
    cases hw : work (Fin.last (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)))
    · simpa only [loopReplayTM, show Fin.natAdd (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) (0 : Fin 1) =
          Fin.last (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) from rfl, hw] using
        loopControl_payload body F 0 none none
    · simpa only [loopReplayTM, show Fin.natAdd (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) (0 : Fin 1) =
          Fin.last (body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) from rfl, hw] using
        loopControl_payload body F .pos _ _
  refine (rightCfg_run (k := body.k + 1 + (1 + F.k)) (l := 1)
    loopReplayTM.tm (loopHostTM body F anchor findMode).tm
    (fun _ : Unit => Sum.inr (Sum.inr (13 : Fin 14))) htr
    (loopReplayCfg x p (some ()) 0 word out) tapes heads (word.length + 1)).trans ?_
  have hr := loopReplay_run x p word [] out
  simpa using congrArg
    (fun c => rightCfg (fun _ : Unit => Sum.inr (Sum.inr (13 : Fin 14))) c tapes heads) hr

chunk:
/-- Relocating fuel through the counter and body blocks preserves every run.
**Proof sketch.** Apply the right-block simulation twice. Each inactive block
has its own blank tapes and origin heads, retained throughout the source run. -/
private lemma loopFuel_run (body F : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
