      rw [hcap, bufferTape_nat]; simp [List.append_assoc]
    have hs : (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.step
        (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 2 arg (bufferTape cap) 0 pre.length []) =
        emCallFinishCfg emit x p 2 arg (bufferTape cap) 0 ((pre.length : ℤ) - 1) [] := by
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, emCallFinishCfg, emCallFinishTM, Cfg.workTapeSymbols,
        Fin.isValue, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, ↓reduceIte, hread]
      refine Cfg.ext rfl (moveInputPos_zero _) rfl ?_ rfl
      funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [Action.apply, emCallFinishCfg, sub_eq_add_neg]
    have hlen : ((pre ++ [b]).length : ℤ) - 1 = pre.length := by simp
    rw [hlen, List.length_append, List.length_singleton,
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, hs]
    exact ih (b :: suf) (by simpa [List.append_assoc] using hcap)

/-- Transfer the capture in order, either to the argument tape or to physical
output. Capture itself remains intact until the erase-and-rewind pass.
**Proof sketch.** Induct on the untransferred suffix. Each live cell either
appends one work-tape bit or emits one bit. At the right blank, turn both
install heads, or only the emit capture head, left for cleanup. -/

name: emCall_finish_transfer
header:
private lemma emCall_finish_transfer (emit : Bool) (x arg cap : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) : ∀ rest pre : List Bool, cap = pre ++ rest →
    (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom
      (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 3 (bufferTape (if emit then arg else pre))
        (bufferTape cap) (if emit then 0 else pre.length) pre.length
        (if emit then pre else [])) (rest.length + 1) =
      emCallFinishCfg emit x p 4 (bufferTape (if emit then arg else cap))
        (bufferTape cap) (if emit then 0 else (cap.length : ℤ) - 1)
        ((cap.length : ℤ) - 1) (if emit then cap else [])
chunk:
/-- Transfer the capture in order, either to the argument tape or to physical
output. Capture itself remains intact until the erase-and-rewind pass.
**Proof sketch.** Induct on the untransferred suffix. Each live cell either
appends one work-tape bit or emits one bit. At the right blank, turn both
install heads, or only the emit capture head, left for cleanup. -/
private lemma emCall_finish_transfer (emit : Bool) (x arg cap : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) : ∀ rest pre : List Bool, cap = pre ++ rest →
    (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom
      (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 3 (bufferTape (if emit then arg else pre))
        (bufferTape cap) (if emit then 0 else pre.length) pre.length
        (if emit then pre else [])) (rest.length + 1) =
      emCallFinishCfg emit x p 4 (bufferTape (if emit then arg else cap))
        (bufferTape cap) (if emit then 0 else (cap.length : ℤ) - 1)
        ((cap.length : ℤ) - 1) (if emit then cap else []) := by
  intro rest
  induction rest with
  | nil =>
    intro pre hcap
    have he : cap = pre := by simpa using hcap
    subst cap
    simp only [List.append_nil, List.length_nil]
    have hblank : bufferTape pre pre.length = none := by simp [bufferTape_nat]
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, emCallFinishCfg, emCallFinishTM, Cfg.workTapeSymbols,
      Fin.isValue, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, ↓reduceIte, hblank]
    refine Cfg.ext rfl (moveInputPos_zero _) rfl ?_ (by simp [Action.apply])
    funext i; fin_cases i <;> cases emit <;>
      simp [Action.apply, emCallFinishCfg, sub_eq_add_neg]
  | cons b rest ih =>
    intro pre hcap
    have hread : bufferTape cap pre.length = some b := by
      rw [hcap, bufferTape_nat]; simp
    have hs : (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.step
        (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 3 (bufferTape (if emit then arg else pre))
          (bufferTape cap) (if emit then 0 else pre.length) pre.length
          (if emit then pre else [])) =
        emCallFinishCfg emit x p 3 (bufferTape (if emit then arg else pre ++ [b]))
          (bufferTape cap) (if emit then 0 else (pre ++ [b]).length)
          (pre ++ [b]).length (if emit then pre ++ [b] else []) := by
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, emCallFinishCfg, emCallFinishTM, Cfg.workTapeSymbols,
        Fin.isValue, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, ↓reduceIte, hread]
      refine Cfg.ext rfl (moveInputPos_zero _) ?_ ?_ ?_
      · funext i; fin_cases i <;> cases emit <;>
          simp [Action.apply, emCallFinishCfg, bufferTape_append]
      · funext i; fin_cases i <;> cases emit <;>
          simp [Action.apply, emCallFinishCfg, sub_eq_add_neg]
      · cases emit <;> simp [Action.apply, emCallFinishCfg, sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [List.length_cons, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, hs]
    exact ih (pre ++ [b]) (by simpa [List.append_assoc] using hcap)

/-- Erase capture while returning its head to zero. In install mode the
result head moves with it; in emit mode the argument head stays at zero.
**Proof sketch.** Remove the last remaining captured bit and induct on the
prefix length. The install head follows the same backward moves; the emit
head is stationary. The final left-blank transition restores zero positions. -/

name: emCall_finish_erase
header:
private lemma emCall_finish_erase (emit : Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (arg : ℤ → Option Bool) (out : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre : List Bool, (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom
      (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 4 arg (bufferTape pre)
        (if emit then 0 else (pre.length : ℤ) - 1) ((pre.length : ℤ) - 1) out)
        (pre.length + 1) =
      emCallFinishCfg emit x p 5 arg (fun _ => none) 0 0 out
chunk:
/-- Erase capture while returning its head to zero. In install mode the
result head moves with it; in emit mode the argument head stays at zero.
**Proof sketch.** Remove the last remaining captured bit and induct on the
prefix length. The install head follows the same backward moves; the emit
head is stationary. The final left-blank transition restores zero positions. -/
private lemma emCall_finish_erase (emit : Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (arg : ℤ → Option Bool) (out : List Bool) :
    ∀ pre : List Bool, (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom
      (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 4 arg (bufferTape pre)
        (if emit then 0 else (pre.length : ℤ) - 1) ((pre.length : ℤ) - 1) out)
        (pre.length + 1) =
      emCallFinishCfg emit x p 5 arg (fun _ => none) 0 0 out := by
  intro pre
  induction pre using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil =>
    simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero, zero_sub, zero_add, bufferTape_nil]
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, emCallFinishCfg, emCallFinishTM, Cfg.workTapeSymbols,
      Fin.isValue, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, ↓reduceIte]
    refine Cfg.ext rfl (moveInputPos_zero _) rfl ?_ (by simp [Action.apply])
    funext i; fin_cases i <;> cases emit <;> simp [Action.apply, emCallFinishCfg, sub_eq_add_neg]
  | append_singleton pre b ih =>
    have hread : bufferTape (pre ++ [b]) pre.length = some b := by simp [bufferTape_nat]
    have hs : (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.step
        (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 4 arg (bufferTape (pre ++ [b]))
          (if emit then 0 else pre.length) pre.length out) =
        emCallFinishCfg emit x p 4 arg (bufferTape pre)
          (if emit then 0 else (pre.length : ℤ) - 1) ((pre.length : ℤ) - 1) out := by
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, emCallFinishCfg, emCallFinishTM, Cfg.workTapeSymbols,
        Fin.isValue, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, ↓reduceIte, hread]
      refine Cfg.ext rfl (moveInputPos_zero _) ?_ ?_ (by simp [Action.apply])
      · funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [Action.apply, emCallFinishCfg, emCall_erase_last]
      · funext i; fin_cases i <;> cases emit <;>
          simp [Action.apply, emCallFinishCfg, sub_eq_add_neg]
    have hlen : ((pre ++ [b]).length : ℤ) - 1 = pre.length := by simp
    rw [hlen, List.length_append, List.length_singleton,
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, hs]
    exact ih

/-- Finalize a captured result with a full clean endpoint. The exact cost is
argument length plus three result passes plus five dispatches; empty words
are included.
**Proof sketch.** From the known right blanks, rewind (and optionally erase)
the argument, rewind capture, transfer capture, then erase and rewind capture.
The install result is kept, or the emit argument is kept and the result is
physical output. Each phase equality includes both tapes and both heads. -/

name: emCall_finish_run
header:
private lemma emCall_finish_run (emit : Bool) (x arg cap : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) :
    (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom
      (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 0 (bufferTape arg) (bufferTape cap)
        arg.length cap.length []) (arg.length + 3 * cap.length + 5) =
      emCallFinishCfg emit x p 5 (bufferTape (if emit then arg else cap))
        (fun _ => none) 0 0 (if emit then cap else [])
chunk:
/-- Finalize a captured result with a full clean endpoint. The exact cost is
argument length plus three result passes plus five dispatches; empty words
are included.
**Proof sketch.** From the known right blanks, rewind (and optionally erase)
the argument, rewind capture, transfer capture, then erase and rewind capture.
The install result is kept, or the emit argument is kept and the result is
physical output. Each phase equality includes both tapes and both heads. -/
private lemma emCall_finish_run (emit : Bool) (x arg cap : List Bool)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) :
    (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom
      (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 0 (bufferTape arg) (bufferTape cap)
        arg.length cap.length []) (arg.length + 3 * cap.length + 5) =
      emCallFinishCfg emit x p 5 (bufferTape (if emit then arg else cap))
        (fun _ => none) 0 0 (if emit then cap else []) := by
  have hs : (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.step
      (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 0 (bufferTape arg) (bufferTape cap)
        arg.length cap.length []) =
      emCallFinishCfg emit x p 1 (bufferTape arg) (bufferTape cap)
        ((arg.length : ℤ) - 1) cap.length [] := by
    refine Cfg.ext rfl (moveInputPos_zero _) rfl ?_ rfl
    funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [MultiTapeTM.step, emCallFinishCfg,
      emCallFinishTM, Action.apply, sub_eq_add_neg]
  have harg := emCall_finish_arg emit x arg cap p arg [] (by simp)
  have hrew := emCall_finish_rewind emit x cap p
    (bufferTape (if emit then arg else [])) cap [] (by simp)
  have htransfer := emCall_finish_transfer emit x arg cap p cap [] (by simp)
  have herase := emCall_finish_erase emit x p
    (bufferTape (if emit then arg else cap)) (if emit then cap else []) cap
  simp only [ite_self] at harg
  simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero, ite_self] at htransfer
  have hsrun : (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom
      (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 0 (bufferTape arg) (bufferTape cap)
        arg.length cap.length []) 1 =
      emCallFinishCfg emit x p 1 (bufferTape arg) (bufferTape cap)
        ((arg.length : ℤ) - 1) cap.length [] := by
    simpa only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero] using hs
  have h1 := (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom_add
    (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 0 (bufferTape arg) (bufferTape cap)
      arg.length cap.length []) 1 (arg.length + 1)
  rw [hsrun, harg] at h1
  have h2 := (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom_add
    (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 0 (bufferTape arg) (bufferTape cap)
      arg.length cap.length []) (1 + (arg.length + 1)) (cap.length + 1)
  rw [h1, hrew] at h2
  have h3 := (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom_add
    (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 0 (bufferTape arg) (bufferTape cap)
      arg.length cap.length []) (1 + (arg.length + 1) + (cap.length + 1)) (cap.length + 1)
  rw [h2, htransfer] at h3
  have h4 := (emCallFinishTM emit).tm.runFrom_add
    (emCallFinishCfg emit x p 0 (bufferTape arg) (bufferTape cap)
      arg.length cap.length [])
    (1 + (arg.length + 1) + (cap.length + 1) + (cap.length + 1)) (cap.length + 1)
  rw [h3, herase] at h4
  convert h4 using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> omega

/-- The prepared source phase has one genuine argument tape, three tracked
banks, and one capture tape, even when the source machine has no work tapes. -/

name: emCallSource
header: private abbrev emCallSource (M : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool
chunk:
/-- The prepared source phase has one genuine argument tape, three tracked
banks, and one capture tape, even when the source machine has no work tapes. -/
private abbrev emCallSource (M : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool :=
  emCallEvalTM (emCallRightTM (emCallTrackTM M))

/-- Fixed control for evaluation, successive triple cleanups, and finalization.
The extra bank index is the dispatch after all source banks are clean. -/

name: emCallState
header: private abbrev emCallState (M : FinTM Bool)
chunk:
/-- Fixed control for evaluation, successive triple cleanups, and finalization.
The extra bank index is the dispatch after all source banks are clean. -/
private abbrev emCallState (M : FinTM Bool) :=
  (emCallSource M).State ⊕ ((Fin (M.k + 1) × Fin 4) ⊕ Fin 6)

/-- Physical index of a source tape's data, interval, or origin component. -/

name: emCallTripleIndex
header:
private def emCallTripleIndex (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin M.k) (r : Fin 3) :
    Fin (emCallSource M).k
chunk:
/-- Physical index of a source tape's data, interval, or origin component. -/
private def emCallTripleIndex (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin M.k) (r : Fin 3) :
    Fin (emCallSource M).k :=
  match r.val with
  | 0 => ⟨1 + i.val, by have := i.isLt; dsimp [emCallSource, emCallEvalTM,
      bufferedCompTM, emCallIdleTM, emCallRightTM, emCallTrackTM]; omega⟩
  | 1 => ⟨1 + M.k + i.val, by have := i.isLt; dsimp [emCallSource, emCallEvalTM,
      bufferedCompTM, emCallIdleTM, emCallRightTM, emCallTrackTM]; omega⟩
  | _ => ⟨1 + M.k + M.k + i.val, by have := i.isLt; dsimp [emCallSource, emCallEvalTM,
      bufferedCompTM, emCallIdleTM, emCallRightTM, emCallTrackTM]; omega⟩

/-- Partial inverse of the triple layout; all other host tapes are inactive. -/

name: emCallTripleSelect
header:
private def emCallTripleSelect (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin M.k)
    (j : Fin (emCallSource M).k) : Option (Fin 3)
chunk:
/-- Partial inverse of the triple layout; all other host tapes are inactive. -/
private def emCallTripleSelect (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin M.k)
    (j : Fin (emCallSource M).k) : Option (Fin 3) :=
  if j.val = 1 + i.val then some 0 else
  if j.val = 1 + M.k + i.val then some 1 else
  if j.val = 1 + M.k + M.k + i.val then some 2 else none

/-- The three slots of a genuine source tape are distinct and select back
to their corresponding cleaner tape. -/

name: emCall_triple_inverse
header:
private lemma emCall_triple_inverse (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin M.k) (r : Fin 3) :
    emCallTripleSelect M i (emCallTripleIndex M i r) = some r
chunk:
/-- The three slots of a genuine source tape are distinct and select back
to their corresponding cleaner tape. -/
private lemma emCall_triple_inverse (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin M.k) (r : Fin 3) :
    emCallTripleSelect M i (emCallTripleIndex M i r) = some r := by
  have hk : 0 < M.k := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt
  fin_cases r <;> simp [emCallTripleSelect, emCallTripleIndex, show M.k ≠ 0 by omega]
  all_goals repeat first | rfl | omega | split
  all_goals repeat first | rfl | omega | split

/-- Argument and result capture occupy the first and last physical tapes. -/

name: emCallPairIndex
header: private def emCallPairIndex (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin 2) : Fin (emCallSource M).k
chunk:
/-- Argument and result capture occupy the first and last physical tapes. -/
private def emCallPairIndex (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin 2) : Fin (emCallSource M).k :=
  if i = 0 then ⟨0, by dsimp [emCallSource, emCallEvalTM]; omega⟩
  else Fin.last (bufferedCompTM emCallIdleTM (emCallRightTM (emCallTrackTM M))).k

/-- Select only the argument and capture from a full call layout. -/

name: emCallPairSelect
header:
private def emCallPairSelect (M : FinTM Bool) (j : Fin (emCallSource M).k) :
    Option (Fin 2)
chunk:
/-- Select only the argument and capture from a full call layout. -/
private def emCallPairSelect (M : FinTM Bool) (j : Fin (emCallSource M).k) :
    Option (Fin 2) :=
  if j.val = 0 then some 0 else
  if j.val = (bufferedCompTM emCallIdleTM (emCallRightTM (emCallTrackTM M))).k
    then some 1 else none

/-- The finalizer's two tape indices satisfy the relocation inverse law. -/

name: emCall_pair_inverse
header:
private lemma emCall_pair_inverse (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin 2) :
    emCallPairSelect M (emCallPairIndex M i) = some i
chunk:
/-- The finalizer's two tape indices satisfy the relocation inverse law. -/
private lemma emCall_pair_inverse (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin 2) :
    emCallPairSelect M (emCallPairIndex M i) = some i := by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [emCallPairIndex, emCallPairSelect, emCallIdleTM,
    bufferedCompTM, emCallRightTM, emCallTrackTM]

/-- The cleaner's three selected tapes form an injective physical bank. -/

name: emCallTripleEmbedding
header:
private def emCallTripleEmbedding (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin M.k) :
    Fin 3 ↪ Fin (emCallSource M).k
chunk:
/-- The cleaner's three selected tapes form an injective physical bank. -/
private def emCallTripleEmbedding (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin M.k) :
    Fin 3 ↪ Fin (emCallSource M).k :=
  ⟨emCallTripleIndex M i, by
    intro a b h
    have he := congrArg (emCallTripleSelect M i) h
    simpa only [emCall_triple_inverse, Option.some.injEq] using he⟩

/-- The argument and capture are distinct physical tapes. -/

name: emCallPairEmbedding
header: private def emCallPairEmbedding (M : FinTM Bool) : Fin 2 ↪ Fin (emCallSource M).k
chunk:
/-- The argument and capture are distinct physical tapes. -/
private def emCallPairEmbedding (M : FinTM Bool) : Fin 2 ↪ Fin (emCallSource M).k :=
  ⟨emCallPairIndex M, by
    intro a b h
    have he := congrArg (emCallPairSelect M) h
    simpa only [emCall_pair_inverse, Option.some.injEq] using he⟩

/-- **The clean call**. From the entry seam holding an argument word on tape `0`, it runs `M` on
that argument through tracked banks with `M`'s output captured, clears every bank to its observed
extent, and then either installs the result in place of the argument (`emit = false`) or forwards it
to the physical output and keeps the argument (`emit = true`), erases its administrative storage,
and enters its exit state. -/

name: callTM
header:
def callTM (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k
chunk:
/-- **The clean call**. From the entry seam holding an argument word on tape `0`, it runs `M` on
that argument through tracked banks with `M`'s output captured, clears every bank to its observed
extent, and then either installs the result in place of the argument (`emit = false`) or forwards it
to the physical output and keeps the argument (`emit = true`), erases its administrative storage,
and enters its exit state. -/
def callTM (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := (emCallSource M).k
  State := emCallState M
  tm := {
    q₀ := .inl (.inl (.inr (.inr ((emCallRightTM (emCallTrackTM M)).tm.q₀, true))))
    tr := fun q inp work => match q with
      | .inl q =>
        if q = .inr () then controlAction 0 (some (.inr (.inl (0, 0))))
        else ((embedEmitTM (Function.Embedding.refl _) (emCallSource M).tm).tr
          q inp work).mapState Sum.inl
      | .inr (.inl (i, q)) =>
        if hi : i.val < M.k then
          if q = 3 then controlAction 0 (some (.inr (.inl (⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩, 0))))
          else ((embedEmitTM (emCallTripleEmbedding M ⟨i.val, hi⟩) emCallClearTM.tm).tr
            q inp work).mapState
            (fun s => .inr (.inl (i, s)))
        else controlAction 0 (some (.inr (.inr 0)))
      | .inr (.inr q) => ((embedEmitTM (emCallPairEmbedding M) (emCallFinishTM emit).tm).tr
          q inp work).mapState
          (fun s => .inr (.inr s)) }

/-- **The clean call's entry state**. The start state of the clean call. -/

name: callEntry
header: def callEntry (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : (callTM M emit).State
chunk:
/-- **The clean call's entry state**. The start state of the clean call. -/
def callEntry (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : (callTM M emit).State := (callTM M emit).tm.q₀

/-- **The clean call's exit state**. The absorbing exit anchor of the finishing phase; it is a
different summand of the state type from `callEntry`. -/

name: callExit
header: def callExit (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : (callTM M emit).State
chunk:
/-- **The clean call's exit state**. The absorbing exit anchor of the finishing phase; it is a
different summand of the state type from `callEntry`. -/
def callExit (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : (callTM M emit).State := .inr (.inr 5)

/-- **The clean call has a tape**. The clean call's tape count is positive, so its argument seam
lives on a genuine tape.

**Proof sketch.** The layout's tape count is a successor; `Nat.zero_lt_succ`. -/

name: callTM_k_pos
header: theorem callTM_k_pos (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : 0 < (callTM M emit).k
chunk:
/-- **The clean call has a tape**. The clean call's tape count is positive, so its argument seam
lives on a genuine tape.

**Proof sketch.** The layout's tape count is a successor; `Nat.zero_lt_succ`. -/
theorem callTM_k_pos (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) : 0 < (callTM M emit).k :=
  Nat.zero_lt_succ _

/-- Canonical tape layout for the call: argument, data bank, visited bank,
origin bank, capture. The same layout is used for contents and head positions. -/

name: emCallLayout
header:
private def emCallLayout {α : Type} (M : FinTM Bool) (arg cap : α)
    (data marks origin : Fin M.k → α) : Fin (emCallSource M).k → α
chunk:
/-- Canonical tape layout for the call: argument, data bank, visited bank,
origin bank, capture. The same layout is used for contents and head positions. -/
private def emCallLayout {α : Type} (M : FinTM Bool) (arg cap : α)
    (data marks origin : Fin M.k → α) : Fin (emCallSource M).k → α :=
  Fin.addCases (tapeBlocks (fun i : Fin 0 => i.elim0) arg
    (emCallSlots data marks origin)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => cap)

/-- An index in the call layout is either an argument slot, one of the three
source-bank slots, or the capture slot. -/

name: emCall_layout_cases
chunk:
/-- An index in the call layout is either an argument slot, one of the three
source-bank slots, or the capture slot. -/
private lemma emCall_layout_cases (M : FinTM Bool) (j : Fin (emCallSource M).k) :
    j = emCallPairIndex M 0 ∨ j = emCallPairIndex M 1 ∨
      ∃ i r, j = emCallTripleIndex M i r := by
  have hj : j.val < (1 + (M.k + (M.k + M.k))) + 1 := by
    simpa only [emCallSource, emCallEvalTM, bufferedCompTM, emCallIdleTM,
      emCallRightTM, emCallTrackTM, Nat.zero_add] using j.isLt
  by_cases hz : j.val = 0
  · left; apply Fin.ext; simpa [emCallPairIndex] using hz
  · right
    by_cases hc : j.val = 1 + (M.k + (M.k + M.k))
    · left; apply Fin.ext; simpa [emCallPairIndex, bufferedCompTM, emCallIdleTM,
        emCallRightTM, emCallTrackTM] using hc
    · right
      by_cases h1 : j.val < 1 + M.k
      · refine ⟨⟨j.val - 1, by omega⟩, 0, ?_⟩
        apply Fin.ext; dsimp [emCallTripleIndex]; omega
      · by_cases h2 : j.val < 1 + M.k + M.k
        · refine ⟨⟨j.val - (1 + M.k), by omega⟩, 1, ?_⟩
          apply Fin.ext; dsimp [emCallTripleIndex]; omega
        · refine ⟨⟨j.val - (1 + M.k + M.k), by omega⟩, 2, ?_⟩
          apply Fin.ext; dsimp [emCallTripleIndex]; omega

/-- Projecting a cleaner component from the full layout gives exactly its
source data, interval, or origin value.
**Proof sketch.** Express the bank index through the nested finite sums of
the argument, tracked source banks, and capture. The three possible local
indices then project the data, interval marker, and origin marker directly. -/

name: emCall_layout_triple
header:
private lemma emCall_layout_triple {α : Type} (M : FinTM Bool) (arg cap : α)
    (data marks origin : Fin M.k → α) (i : Fin M.k) (r : Fin 3) :
    emCallLayout M arg cap data marks origin (emCallTripleIndex M i r) =
      match r.val with | 0 => data i | 1 => marks i | _ => origin i
chunk:
/-- Projecting a cleaner component from the full layout gives exactly its
source data, interval, or origin value.
**Proof sketch.** Express the bank index through the nested finite sums of
the argument, tracked source banks, and capture. The three possible local
indices then project the data, interval marker, and origin marker directly. -/
private lemma emCall_layout_triple {α : Type} (M : FinTM Bool) (arg cap : α)
    (data marks origin : Fin M.k → α) (i : Fin M.k) (r : Fin 3) :
    emCallLayout M arg cap data marks origin (emCallTripleIndex M i r) =
      match r.val with | 0 => data i | 1 => marks i | _ => origin i := by
  fin_cases r
  · have he : emCallTripleIndex M i 0 =
        Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 0 (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd (M.k + M.k) i))) := by
      apply Fin.ext; simp [emCallTripleIndex]
    erw [he]
    simp only [emCallLayout, tapeBlocks, Fin.addCases_left]
    erw [Fin.addCases_right, Fin.addCases_right]
    simp only [emCallSlots, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right]
  · have he : emCallTripleIndex M i 1 =
        Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 0 (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd M.k (Fin.castAdd M.k i)))) := by
      apply Fin.ext; simp [emCallTripleIndex, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]
    erw [he]
    simp only [emCallLayout, tapeBlocks, Fin.addCases_left]
    erw [Fin.addCases_right, Fin.addCases_right]
    simp only [emCallSlots, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right]
  · have he : emCallTripleIndex M i 2 =
        Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 0 (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd M.k (Fin.natAdd M.k i)))) := by
      apply Fin.ext; simp [emCallTripleIndex, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]
    erw [he]
    simp only [emCallLayout, tapeBlocks, Fin.addCases_left]
    erw [Fin.addCases_right, Fin.addCases_right]
    simp only [emCallSlots, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right]

/-- Projecting the two administrative slots gives the argument and capture. -/

name: emCall_layout_pair
header:
private lemma emCall_layout_pair {α : Type} (M : FinTM Bool) (arg cap : α)
    (data marks origin : Fin M.k → α) (i : Fin 2) :
    emCallLayout M arg cap data marks origin (emCallPairIndex M i) =
      if i = 0 then arg else cap
chunk:
/-- Projecting the two administrative slots gives the argument and capture. -/
private lemma emCall_layout_pair {α : Type} (M : FinTM Bool) (arg cap : α)
    (data marks origin : Fin M.k → α) (i : Fin 2) :
    emCallLayout M arg cap data marks origin (emCallPairIndex M i) =
      if i = 0 then arg else cap := by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [emCallLayout, emCallPairIndex, tapeBlocks, emCallSlots,
    Fin.addCases, bufferedCompTM, emCallIdleTM, emCallRightTM, emCallTrackTM]

/-- A cleaner does not select either administrative tape. -/

name: emCall_triple_pair
header:
private lemma emCall_triple_pair (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin M.k) (r : Fin 2) :
    emCallTripleSelect M i (emCallPairIndex M r) = none
chunk:
/-- A cleaner does not select either administrative tape. -/
private lemma emCall_triple_pair (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin M.k) (r : Fin 2) :
    emCallTripleSelect M i (emCallPairIndex M r) = none := by
  have hi := i.isLt
  fin_cases r <;> simp [emCallTripleSelect, emCallPairIndex, bufferedCompTM,
    emCallIdleTM, emCallRightTM, emCallTrackTM]
  all_goals repeat first | rfl | omega | split
  all_goals repeat first | rfl | omega | split
  all_goals repeat first | rfl | omega | split

/-- A triple selector acts only on the named source bank. -/

name: emCall_triple_other
chunk:
/-- A triple selector acts only on the named source bank. -/
private lemma emCall_triple_other (M : FinTM Bool) (i j : Fin M.k) (r : Fin 3) :
    emCallTripleSelect M i (emCallTripleIndex M j r) =
      if j = i then some r else none := by
  have hi := i.isLt
  have hj := j.isLt
  by_cases he : j = i
  · subst j; simp [emCall_triple_inverse]
  · have hv : j.val ≠ i.val := fun h => he (Fin.ext h)
    fin_cases r <;> simp [emCallTripleSelect, emCallTripleIndex, he, hv]
    all_goals repeat first | rfl | omega | split
    all_goals repeat first | rfl | omega | split
    all_goals repeat first | rfl | omega | split

/-- The two-tape finalizer never acts on tracked source storage. -/

name: emCall_pair_triple
header:
private lemma emCall_pair_triple (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin M.k) (r : Fin 3) :
    emCallPairSelect M (emCallTripleIndex M i r) = none
chunk:
/-- The two-tape finalizer never acts on tracked source storage. -/
private lemma emCall_pair_triple (M : FinTM Bool) (i : Fin M.k) (r : Fin 3) :
    emCallPairSelect M (emCallTripleIndex M i r) = none := by
  have hi := i.isLt
  fin_cases r <;> simp [emCallPairSelect, emCallTripleIndex, bufferedCompTM,
    emCallIdleTM, emCallRightTM, emCallTrackTM]
  all_goals repeat first | rfl | omega | split

/-- Full host frame during cleanup. The argument and capture are retained
at their known right boundaries while all three source banks are normalized. -/

name: emCallFrame
chunk:
/-- Full host frame during cleanup. The argument and capture are retained
at their known right boundaries while all three source banks are normalized. -/
private def emCallFrame (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) (x arg cap : List Bool)
    (q : emCallState M) (data marks origin : Fin M.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (heads : Fin M.k → ℤ) : Cfg (callTM M emit).k Bool (callTM M emit).State x :=
  ⟨some q, 1, emCallLayout M (bufferTape arg) (bufferTape cap) data marks origin,
    emCallLayout M arg.length cap.length heads heads heads, []⟩

/-- The prefix of cleaned source banks is blank, the remaining banks retain
the source's exact halted trace. The native time is analysis data only. -/

name: emCallBankFrame
chunk:
/-- The prefix of cleaned source banks is blank, the remaining banks retain
the source's exact halted trace. The native time is analysis data only. -/
private def emCallBankFrame (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool) (x arg cap : List Bool)
    (T j : ℕ) (q : emCallState M) :
    Cfg (callTM M emit).k Bool (callTM M emit).State x :=
  emCallFrame M emit x arg cap q
    (fun i => if i.val < j then fun _ => none else
      (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg arg) T).workTapes i)
    (fun i => if i.val < j then fun _ => none else emCallSpan (emCallLo M arg T i) (emCallHi M arg T i))
    (fun i => if i.val < j then fun _ => none else bufferTape [true])
    (fun i => if i.val < j then 0 else (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg arg) T).workTapePos i)

/-- Embedding one cleaner into a bank frame realizes any target cleaned prefix that
agrees with the original prefix away from the selected bank. The cleaner supplies exactly
the target bank's three tapes and common head, and its state supplies the target control.

**Proof sketch.** Apply `embedEmitCfg_mapState_eq`. The selected-bank equation is the
three-slot layout equation. Off the selection, the two administrative slots agree directly;
every other bank agrees because its cleaned-prefix membership is unchanged. -/

name: emCall_bank_embed
header:
private lemma emCall_bank_embed (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (i : Fin M.k) (j : ℕ) (q : Fin 4)
    (hrest : ∀ l : Fin M.k, l ≠ i → (l.val < i.val ↔ l.val < j)) :
    let frame
chunk:
/-- Embedding one cleaner into a bank frame realizes any target cleaned prefix that
agrees with the original prefix away from the selected bank. The cleaner supplies exactly
the target bank's three tapes and common head, and its state supplies the target control.

**Proof sketch.** Apply `embedEmitCfg_mapState_eq`. The selected-bank equation is the
three-slot layout equation. Off the selection, the two administrative slots agree directly;
every other bank agrees because its cleaned-prefix membership is unchanged. -/
private lemma emCall_bank_embed (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (i : Fin M.k) (j : ℕ) (q : Fin 4)
    (hrest : ∀ l : Fin M.k, l ≠ i → (l.val < i.val ↔ l.val < j)) :
    let frame := emCallBankFrame M emit x arg cap T i.val (.inr (.inl (i.castSucc, 0)))
    emCallEmbeddedCfg (emCallTripleEmbedding M i) (fun s => .inr (.inl (i.castSucc, s)))
      frame.workTapes frame.workTapePos
      (emCallClearCfg x 1 q
        (if i.val < j then fun _ => none else
          (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg arg) T).workTapes i)
        (if i.val < j then fun _ => none else
          emCallSpan (emCallLo M arg T i) (emCallHi M arg T i))
        (if i.val < j then fun _ => none else bufferTape [true])
        (if i.val < j then 0 else (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg arg) T).workTapePos i)) =
      emCallBankFrame M emit x arg cap T j (.inr (.inl (i.castSucc, q))) := by
  dsimp only
  simp only [emCallEmbeddedCfg]
  refine embedEmitCfg_mapState_eq _ _ _ _ [] _ _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [emCallClearCfg, emCallBankFrame, emCallFrame, Option.map_some]
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · intro r
    fin_cases r <;> constructor <;>
      simp [emCallClearCfg, emCallBankFrame, emCallFrame, emCallTripleEmbedding,
        emCall_layout_triple]
  · intro k hk
    rcases emCall_layout_cases M k with h | h | ⟨l, r, h⟩
    · subst k
      constructor <;> simp only [emCallBankFrame, emCallFrame, emCall_layout_pair]
    · subst k
      constructor <;> simp only [emCallBankFrame, emCallFrame, emCall_layout_pair]
    · subst k
      have he : l ≠ i := by
        intro he
        subst l
        exact hk ⟨r, rfl⟩
      constructor <;> simp only [emCallBankFrame, emCallFrame, emCall_layout_triple, hrest l he]

/-- Embedding one cleaner at the current bank reproduces the full bank frame.
Every other bank and both administrative tapes are retained exactly.
**Proof sketch.** Extensionality reduces the claim to individual tape slots.
The active triple uses the relocation inverse law; every other triple, the
argument, and the capture use the disjointness laws and are unchanged. -/

name: emCall_bank_initial
chunk:
/-- Embedding one cleaner at the current bank reproduces the full bank frame.
Every other bank and both administrative tapes are retained exactly.
**Proof sketch.** Extensionality reduces the claim to individual tape slots.
The active triple uses the relocation inverse law; every other triple, the
argument, and the capture use the disjointness laws and are unchanged. -/
private lemma emCall_bank_initial (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (i : Fin M.k) :
    let frame := emCallBankFrame M emit x arg cap T i.val (.inr (.inl (i.castSucc, 0)))
    emCallEmbeddedCfg (emCallTripleEmbedding M i) (fun q => .inr (.inl (i.castSucc, q)))
      frame.workTapes frame.workTapePos
      (emCallClearCfg x 1 0 ((M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg arg) T).workTapes i)
        (emCallSpan (emCallLo M arg T i) (emCallHi M arg T i)) (bufferTape [true])
        ((M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg arg) T).workTapePos i)) = frame := by
  dsimp only
  simpa only [Nat.lt_irrefl, ↓reduceIte] using
    emCall_bank_embed M emit x arg cap T i i.val 0 (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)

/-- The cleaner's complete blank endpoint enlarges the cleaned bank prefix
by exactly one, while retaining every inactive tape and head.
**Proof sketch.** Separate the completed bank from every other tape slot.
Its three tapes and heads equal the cleaner's blank endpoint. Arithmetic on
the bank indices identifies this update with increasing the cleaned prefix. -/

name: emCall_bank_final
chunk:
/-- The cleaner's complete blank endpoint enlarges the cleaned bank prefix
by exactly one, while retaining every inactive tape and head.
**Proof sketch.** Separate the completed bank from every other tape slot.
Its three tapes and heads equal the cleaner's blank endpoint. Arithmetic on

shape, with `K = 6` (so `6 + 13 M.k + 3K = 24 + 13 M.k`).
**Proof sketch.** Compose the complete prepared evaluation, all sequential
bank cleanups, and result finalization. The bank prefix induction accounts for
every source tape. Each term is charged to the actual argument deadline or a
word length; no native transition reads a numerical deadline. -/
private lemma emCall_complete (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesInTime arg cap T) :
    ∃ t ≤ (24 + 13 * M.k) * (T + arg.length + cap.length + 1),
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callTM M emit).tm.q₀ (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) t =
        { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (.inr (.inr (5 : Fin 6)) : emCallState M)
            (stateWord (callTM M emit).k (if emit then arg else cap))
          with output := if emit then cap else [] } := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, he⟩ := emCall_prepare_run M emit x arg cap T hM
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hf⟩ := emCall_banks_run M emit x arg cap T M.k (le_refl _)
  let B := T + arg.length + cap.length + 1
  have hbank : b ≤ (13 * M.k) * B := by
    calc
      b ≤ M.k * (6 * T + 8) := hb
      _ ≤ M.k * (13 * B) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left M.k (by dsimp [B]; omega)
      _ = (13 * M.k) * B := by simp [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm]
  have hrest : a + (arg.length + 3 * cap.length + 6) ≤ 24 * B := by
    dsimp [B]; omega
  refine ⟨a + b + (arg.length + 3 * cap.length + 6), ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      a + b + (arg.length + 3 * cap.length + 6) ≤ 24 * B + (13 * M.k) * B := by omega
      _ = (24 + 13 * M.k) * B := (Nat.add_mul _ _ _).symm
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add,
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom_add _ a b, he, hf]
    exact emCall_finalize_run M emit x arg cap T

/-- Sum consecutive emitting segments from arbitrary accumulated output.
Each segment contributes its exact chunk, and the final segment halts.
**Proof sketch.** Induct on the number of rounds. Prefix commutation turns
the next clean-seam segment into a segment after the preceding chunks.
Concatenation follows the same order as the configuration indices. This is
a new summation lemma; the frozen empty-output `loop_run` is not used. -/
private lemma emLoop_sum {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (cfg : ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x)
    (chunk : ℕ → List Bool) (B : ℕ) : ∀ N,
    (∀ i < N, (cfg i).output = []) →
    (∀ i < N, ∃ t ≤ B,
      if i + 1 < N then tm.runFrom (cfg i) t = {cfg (i + 1) with output := chunk i}
      else (tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).state = none ∧ (tm.runFrom (cfg i) t).output = chunk i) →
    0 < N → ∀ pre, ∃ t ≤ N * B,
      (tm.runFrom {cfg 0 with output := pre} t).state = none ∧
      (tm.runFrom {cfg 0 with output := pre} t).output =
        pre ++ (List.range N).flatMap chunk := by
  intro N
  induction N generalizing cfg chunk with
  | zero => intro _ _ h; omega
  | succ N ih =>
    intro hout hseg _ pre
    obtain ⟨a, ha, he⟩ := hseg 0 (by omega)
    have hp := MultiTapeTM.runFrom_output_prepend tm (cfg 0) pre a
    rw [hout 0 (by omega), List.append_nil] at hp
    cases N with
    | zero =>
      simp only [Nat.lt_irrefl, ↓reduceIte] at he
      refine ⟨a, by simpa using ha, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hp]; exact he.1
      · rw [hp]; simp [he.2]
    | succ N =>
      simp only [show 0 + 1 < (N + 1) + 1 by omega, ↓reduceIte] at he
      rw [he] at hp
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hh, ho⟩ := ih (fun i => cfg (i + 1)) (fun i => chunk (i + 1))
        (fun i hi => hout (i + 1) (by omega))
        (fun i hi => by
          obtain ⟨t, ht, h⟩ := hseg (i + 1) (by omega)
          exact ⟨t, ht, by simpa only [Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right] using h⟩)
        (by omega) (pre ++ chunk 0)
      refine ⟨a + b, by rw [Nat.succ_mul]; omega, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hp]
        exact hh
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hp, ho]
        rw [List.range_succ_eq_map (n := N + 1), List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_map]
        simp [List.append_assoc, Function.comp_def]

/-- **The emitting loop's time**. Under the hypotheses of `exists_emitLoopTM` (fuel, invariant,
startup, and rounds that advance to the stepped seam in positive time at most `T |x|` while emitting
exactly `emitF x s`), the emitting loop outputs the concatenation of
`emitF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))` over `i = 0, …, R |x|` within `10·(T n + 1)·(R n + 2)` steps.

**Proof sketch.** The fuel preparation and the body startup take at most `10·(T |x| + 1)` steps
(`loopHost_prepare`, `loopHost_start`); each round, its anchor stop and its debit take at most
`10·(T |x| + 1)` (`emLoopHost_round`); the prefix-summation lemma `emLoop_sum` concatenates the
`R |x| + 1` chunks. -/
theorem emitLoopTM_computes (body F : FinTM Bool) (anchor : body.State)
    (Inv : List Bool → List Bool → Prop)
    (stepF emitF : List Bool → List Bool → List Bool)
    (s0 : List Bool → List Bool) (R T : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hF : F.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => Nat.bits (R x.length)) T)
    (hInv0 : ∀ x : List Bool, Inv x (s0 x))
    (hInvStep : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s → Inv x (stepF x s))
    (hstart : ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ T x.length,
      (∀ t' < t,
        (body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t').state ≠ some anchor) ∧
      body.tm.runFrom (body.tm.initCfg x) t =
        Cfg.ofWords anchor (stateWord body.k (s0 x)))
    (hround : ∀ (x s : List Bool), Inv x s →
      ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T x.length ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (body.tm.runFrom
            (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t').state
              ≠ some anchor) ∧
        body.tm.runFrom
          (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k s)) t =
            { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k (stepF x s))
                with output := emitF x s }) :
    (emitLoopTM body F anchor).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => (List.range (R x.length + 1)).flatMap
        (fun i => emitF x ((stepF x)^[i] (s0 x))))
      (fun n => 10 * (T n + 1) * (R n + 2)) := by
  refine (computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mpr fun x => ?_
  let E := emitLoopTM body F anchor
  obtain ⟨fuel, ftime, hfh, hfo, hft, hprepare, -⟩ :=
    loopHost_prepare body F anchor true true R T hF x
  obtain ⟨btime, hbt, hbguard, hbend⟩ := hstart x
  let words (i : ℕ) := (fun w => (loopDebit w).1)^[i] (Nat.bits (R x.length))
  let orbit (i : ℕ) := (stepF x)^[i] (s0 x)
  let candidate (i : ℕ) := loopCall body F anchor false
    (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) anchor (stateWord body.k (orbit i))) true none (words i) fuel
  have hwidth (i : ℕ) : (words i).length ≤ T x.length := by
    dsimp only [words]
    rw [loopDebit_iterate_length]
    exact loop_fuel_width F R T hF x
  have hsuccess (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ R x.length) :
      (loopDebit (words i)).2 = true ↔ i < R x.length := by
    rw [loopDebit_success]
    dsimp only [words]
    rw [loopDebit_iterate_value _ _ hi]
    omega
  have hsegments : ∀ i < R x.length + 1, ∃ t ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1),
      if i + 1 < R x.length + 1 then
        E.tm.runFrom (candidate i) t = {candidate (i + 1) with output := emitF x (orbit i)}
      else
        (E.tm.runFrom (candidate i) t).state = none ∧
        (E.tm.runFrom (candidate i) t).output = emitF x (orbit i) := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨t, htpos, ht, hguard, hend⟩ := hround x (orbit i)
      (loop_orbit_inv Inv stepF s0 hInv0 hInvStep x i)
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hsegment⟩ := emLoopHost_round body F anchor
      (orbit i) (stepF x (orbit i)) (emitF x (orbit i)) (words i) fuel t htpos hguard hend
    refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hw := hwidth i
      omega
    · simpa only [E, candidate, words, orbit, Function.iterate_succ_apply',
        hsuccess i (by omega), Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right] using hsegment
  let startup := ftime + (btime + 2)
  have hs : startup ≤ 10 * (T x.length + 1) := by dsimp only [startup]; omega
  have hinit : E.tm.runFrom (E.tm.initCfg x) startup = candidate 0 := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hprepare,
      loopHost_start body F anchor true true (s0 x) btime fuel hbguard hbend]
    simp only [candidate, words, orbit, Function.iterate_zero_apply, hfo]
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hhalt, houtput⟩ := emLoop_sum E.tm candidate
    (fun i => emitF x (orbit i)) (10 * (T x.length + 1)) (R x.length + 1)
    (by intro j hj; simp only [candidate, loopCall, captureCfg_output]) hsegments (by omega) []
  have hclean : {candidate 0 with output := []} = candidate 0 := by
    refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl rfl rfl ?_
    simp only [candidate, loopCall, captureCfg_output]
  rw [hclean] at hhalt houtput
  exact loop_computes_of_startup E x _ (candidate 0) startup t
    (10 * (T x.length + 1)) (R x.length + 1) hs hinit ht hhalt

theorem callTM_run (M : FinTM Bool) (emit : Bool)
    (x arg cap : List Bool) (T : ℕ) (hM : M.ComputesInTime arg cap T) :
    ∃ t ≤ (24 + 13 * M.k) * (T + arg.length + cap.length + 1),
      0 < t ∧
      (∀ j < t, ((callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M emit) (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) j).state
          ≠ some (callExit M emit)) ∧
      (callTM M emit).tm.runFrom
        (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callEntry M emit) (stateWord (callTM M emit).k arg)) t =
        { Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (callExit M emit)
            (stateWord (callTM M emit).k (if emit then arg else cap))
          with output := if emit then cap else [] } :=
  emCall_first M emit x arg cap T hM

/-- **E5a, the install-mode clean call** (spec, added at the emitter-infra
round-1 repair — finding 1's prepared-input/clean-return bridge;
customers: loop and emit-loop bodies calling a catalog transducer on
their tape-resident data, in particular `computesFunInTime_splitSolveWith`'s
evaluator rounds and 3B-cont's token/counter installs). A function-level
contract says nothing about a witness's terminal heads or scratch — a
machine may dirty a tape on its final transition and still compute `f`
within `T` — so the bridge supplies what the function contract cannot:
for any such witness, a **callable module** with designated entry and
exit states whose entry and exit are both the canonical clean seam. From
`Cfg.ofWords entry (stateWord C.k arg)` — the argument as the sole
tape-resident word, every other tape blank, input head at one, empty
output, over an **arbitrary, untouched** native input — the module
reaches, at its first positive visit to `exit`, exactly
`Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (f arg))`: the result installed, all
scratch restored, nothing emitted.

**Construction sketch** (attribution corrected per the emitter-infra
round-3 audit, finding 1). Prepare a virtual input from the
tape-resident argument (the relocated-read discipline of the proved
hosts); run the witness through the capture wrapper over **tracked
banks** — the A-continuation's proved visited-interval/origin-marker
family (`e3cTrackTM`/`e3c_track_run`, `e3cClearTM`/`e3c_clear_run`) —
then sequence the per-triple cleaner over the fixed `M.k` banks: at a
clean entry seam the module's scratch starts blank, so clearing the
tracked interval **is** the restoration, and no overwritten-symbol
history is needed; install the captured result on tape zero (or replay
it, in emit mode); erase the capture; rewind. The history/undo
alternative remains valid independently (round-2 audit, finding 4),
but is not what the delivered continuation proves. Every phase is
charged to `T`, the argument length, or the result length.

The `0 < C.k` clause is load-bearing (emitter-infra round-2 audit,
finding 1): at tape count zero, `stateWord 0 a = stateWord 0 b` for all
`a, b` — the empty-domain degeneracy — and a two-state zero-tape machine
would satisfy the rest of this conclusion for an arbitrary, even
noncomputable, `f`. The positive tape count makes the seam equality
yield `bufferTape (f arg)` at the genuine index zero, so the installed
result is actually extractable by the caller.

**Batch L completion.** `callTM M false` reserves a genuine argument tape,
executes the prepared input through tracked banks, and sequences every
triple cleaner after the observed evaluator return. Since scratch starts
blank, clearing the visited intervals restores the complete clean seam.
`emCall_complete` charges evaluation, bank dispatch/cleanup, result install,
capture erasure, and rewinds within coefficient `24 + 13 * M.k` (the ledger's
`6 + 13 * M.k + 3 * K` with `K = 6`). `emCall_first` cuts at the first visit
to a fresh absorbing exit; no time bound occurs in the transition table. -/

  /-- first rewind step -/
  | rew
  /-- rewinding the yardstick -/
  | rew2
  /-- the clocked attempt: the attempt's state and its captured output -/
  | run (q : Option AS) (cap : Option (Option Bool))
  /-- first reset sweep (leftward) -/
  | p0
  /-- second reset sweep (rightward) -/
  | p1
  /-- third reset sweep (leftward) -/
  | p2
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

namespace ClockHost

/-! ### Tape layout: yardstick bank, attempt bank, yardstick tape -/

section Slots

variable {α : Type*} {s a : ℕ}

/-- Assemble a per-tape family from the yardstick bank, the attempt bank and the tape `Y`. -/

name: slots
header: def slots (f : Fin s → α) (g : Fin a → α) (y : α) : Fin (s + a + 1) → α
chunk:
/-- Assemble a per-tape family from the yardstick bank, the attempt bank and the tape `Y`. -/
def slots (f : Fin s → α) (g : Fin a → α) (y : α) : Fin (s + a + 1) → α :=
  Fin.append (Fin.append f g) fun _ => y

/-- The yardstick-bank tape `i`. -/

name: sI
header: def sI (i : Fin s) : Fin (s + a + 1)

name: aI
header: def aI (i : Fin a) : Fin (s + a + 1)

name: yI
header: def yI : Fin (s + a + 1)
chunk:
/-- The yardstick tape. -/
def yI : Fin (s + a + 1) := Fin.natAdd (s + a) 0

/-- A yardstick-bank slot. -/
@[simp] theorem slots_sI (f : Fin s → α) (g : Fin a → α) (y : α) (i : Fin s) :
    slots f g y (sI i) = f i := by simp [slots, sI]

/-- An attempt-bank slot. -/
@[simp] theorem slots_aI (f : Fin s → α) (g : Fin a → α) (y : α) (i : Fin a) :
    slots f g y (aI i) = g i := by simp [slots, aI]

/-- The yardstick-tape slot. -/
@[simp] theorem slots_yI (f : Fin s → α) (g : Fin a → α) (y : α) :
    slots f g y (yI : Fin (s + a + 1)) = y := by simp [slots, yI]

/-- Every tape index is a yardstick-bank, attempt-bank or yardstick index. -/

name: slots_cases
header:
theorem slots_cases {P : Fin (s + a + 1) → Prop} (hs : ∀ i, P (sI i)) (ha : ∀ i, P (aI i))
    (hy : P yI) (j : Fin (s + a + 1)) : P j
chunk:
/-- Every tape index is a yardstick-bank, attempt-bank or yardstick index. -/
theorem slots_cases {P : Fin (s + a + 1) → Prop} (hs : ∀ i, P (sI i)) (ha : ∀ i, P (aI i))
    (hy : P yI) (j : Fin (s + a + 1)) : P j := by
  refine Fin.addCases (fun j => Fin.addCases (fun i => hs i) (fun i => ha i) j) (fun i => ?_) j
  have : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst this
  exact hy

end Slots

/-- A work tape after an action: written at the head if the action writes, as computed by
`Turing.Action.apply` (to which it unfolds). -/

name: tapeAfter
header:
def tapeAfter (act : Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (t : ℤ → Option Bool) (p : ℤ) :
    ℤ → Option Bool
chunk:
/-- A work tape after an action: written at the head if the action writes, as computed by
`Turing.Action.apply` (to which it unfolds). -/
def tapeAfter (act : Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (t : ℤ → Option Bool) (p : ℤ) :
    ℤ → Option Bool :=
  (Action.apply (⟨0, fun _ => act, none, none⟩ : Action 1 Bool Unit)
    (⟨none, 0, fun _ => t, fun _ => p, []⟩ : Cfg 1 Bool Unit [])).workTapes 0

/-- A host configuration from its parts. -/

name: hostCfg
header:
def hostCfg {SS AS : Type} {s a : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (q : Option (ClockPhase SS AS))
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (sT : Fin s → ℤ → Option Bool) (sP : Fin s → ℤ)
    (aT : Fin a → ℤ → Option Bool) (aP : Fin a → ℤ) (yT : ℤ → Option Bool) (yP : ℤ)
    (out : List Bool) : Cfg (s + a + 1) Bool (ClockPhase SS AS) x
chunk:
/-- A host configuration from its parts. -/
def hostCfg {SS AS : Type} {s a : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (q : Option (ClockPhase SS AS))
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (sT : Fin s → ℤ → Option Bool) (sP : Fin s → ℤ)
    (aT : Fin a → ℤ → Option Bool) (aP : Fin a → ℤ) (yT : ℤ → Option Bool) (yP : ℤ)
    (out : List Bool) : Cfg (s + a + 1) Bool (ClockPhase SS AS) x :=
  ⟨q, ip, slots sT aT yT, slots sP aP yP, out⟩

/-- Applying a slot-assembled action to a host configuration acts slot by slot. -/

name: apply_hostCfg
header:
theorem apply_hostCfg {SS AS : Type} {s a : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (im : SignType)
    (sa : Fin s → Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (aa : Fin a → Option (Option Bool) × SignType)
    (ya : Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (o : Option Bool) (q' q : Option (ClockPhase SS AS))
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (sT : Fin s → ℤ → Option Bool) (sP : Fin s → ℤ)
    (aT : Fin a → ℤ → Option Bool) (aP : Fin a → ℤ) (yT : ℤ → Option Bool) (yP : ℤ)
    (out : List Bool) :
    (⟨im, slots sa aa ya, o, q'⟩ : Action (s + a + 1) Bool (ClockPhase SS AS)).apply
        (hostCfg q ip sT sP aT aP yT yP out) =
      hostCfg q' (moveInputPos ip im) (fun i => tapeAfter (sa i) (sT i) (sP i))
        (fun i => sP i + (sa i).2) (fun i => tapeAfter (aa i) (aT i) (aP i))
        (fun i => aP i + (aa i).2) (tapeAfter ya yT yP) (yP + ya.2) (out ++ o.toList)
chunk:
/-- Applying a slot-assembled action to a host configuration acts slot by slot. -/
theorem apply_hostCfg {SS AS : Type} {s a : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (im : SignType)
    (sa : Fin s → Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (aa : Fin a → Option (Option Bool) × SignType)
    (ya : Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (o : Option Bool) (q' q : Option (ClockPhase SS AS))
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (sT : Fin s → ℤ → Option Bool) (sP : Fin s → ℤ)
    (aT : Fin a → ℤ → Option Bool) (aP : Fin a → ℤ) (yT : ℤ → Option Bool) (yP : ℤ)
    (out : List Bool) :
    (⟨im, slots sa aa ya, o, q'⟩ : Action (s + a + 1) Bool (ClockPhase SS AS)).apply
        (hostCfg q ip sT sP aT aP yT yP out) =
      hostCfg q' (moveInputPos ip im) (fun i => tapeAfter (sa i) (sT i) (sP i))
        (fun i => sP i + (sa i).2) (fun i => tapeAfter (aa i) (aT i) (aP i))
        (fun i => aP i + (aa i).2) (tapeAfter ya yT yP) (yP + ya.2) (out ++ o.toList) := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
  · funext j
    revert j
    refine slots_cases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) ?_ <;>
      simp only [Action.apply, hostCfg, slots_sI, slots_aI, slots_yI, tapeAfter]
  · funext j
    revert j
    refine slots_cases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) ?_ <;>
      simp only [Action.apply, hostCfg, slots_sI, slots_aI, slots_yI]

/-- The symbol read on a yardstick-bank tape. -/
@[simp] theorem hostCfg_symbols_sI {SS AS : Type} {s a : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (q : Option (ClockPhase SS AS)) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (sT : Fin s → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (sP : Fin s → ℤ) (aT : Fin a → ℤ → Option Bool) (aP : Fin a → ℤ) (yT : ℤ → Option Bool)
    (yP : ℤ) (out : List Bool) (i : Fin s) :
    (hostCfg q ip sT sP aT aP yT yP out).workTapeSymbols (sI i) = sT i (sP i) := by
  simp [hostCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols]

/-- The symbol read on an attempt-bank tape. -/
@[simp] theorem hostCfg_symbols_aI {SS AS : Type} {s a : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (q : Option (ClockPhase SS AS)) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (sT : Fin s → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (sP : Fin s → ℤ) (aT : Fin a → ℤ → Option Bool) (aP : Fin a → ℤ) (yT : ℤ → Option Bool)
    (yP : ℤ) (out : List Bool) (i : Fin a) :
    (hostCfg q ip sT sP aT aP yT yP out).workTapeSymbols (aI i) = aT i (aP i) := by
  simp [hostCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols]

/-- The symbol read on the yardstick tape. -/
@[simp] theorem hostCfg_symbols_yI {SS AS : Type} {s a : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (q : Option (ClockPhase SS AS)) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (sT : Fin s → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (sP : Fin s → ℤ) (aT : Fin a → ℤ → Option Bool) (aP : Fin a → ℤ) (yT : ℤ → Option Bool)
    (yP : ℤ) (out : List Bool) :
    (hostCfg q ip sT sP aT aP yT yP out).workTapeSymbols yI = yT yP := by
  simp [hostCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols]

/-! ### The machine -/

variable (S : FinTM Bool) (A : FinNDTM Bool) (loop : Bool)

/-- No write, no move. -/

name: idle
header: abbrev idle : Option (Option Bool) × SignType
chunk:
/-- No write, no move. -/
abbrev idle : Option (Option Bool) × SignType := (none, 0)

/-- Heads under the idle action stay put. -/

name: heads_idle
header: theorem heads_idle {n : ℕ} (P : Fin n → ℤ) : (fun i => P i + ((idle.2 : SignType) : ℤ)) = P
chunk:
/-- Heads under the idle action stay put. -/
theorem heads_idle {n : ℕ} (P : Fin n → ℤ) : (fun i => P i + ((idle.2 : SignType) : ℤ)) = P :=
  funext fun i => by show P i + ((0 : SignType) : ℤ) = P i; simp

/-- Write an emission on the yardstick tape and advance, or do nothing. -/

name: emitTo
header:
def emitTo : Option Bool → Option (Option Bool) × SignType
  | some e => (some (some e), 1)
  | none => (none, 0)

/-- The transition table of the clocked restart host. -/
chunk:
/-- Write an emission on the yardstick tape and advance, or do nothing. -/
def emitTo : Option Bool → Option (Option Bool) × SignType
  | some e => (some (some e), 1)
  | none => (none, 0)

/-- The transition table of the clocked restart host. -/

name: clockTr
chunk:
/-- The transition table of the clocked restart host. -/
def clockTr (b : Bool) (q : ClockPhase S.State A.State) (inp : Option Bool)
    (w : Fin (S.k + A.k + 1) → Option Bool) :
    Action (S.k + A.k + 1) Bool (ClockPhase S.State A.State) :=
  match q with
  | .boot q =>
    let act := S.tm.tr q inp fun i => w (sI i)
    ⟨act.inputTape, slots act.workTapes (fun _ => idle) (emitTo act.output), none,
      some ((act.state.map ClockPhase.boot).getD ClockPhase.rew)⟩
  | .rew => ⟨-1, slots (fun _ => idle) (fun _ => idle) (none, -1), none, some .rew2⟩
  | .rew2 => match w yI with
    | some _ => ⟨-1, slots (fun _ => idle) (fun _ => idle) (none, -1), none, some .rew2⟩
    | none => ⟨1, slots (fun _ => idle) (fun _ => idle) (none, 1), none,
        some (.run (some A.tm.q₀) none)⟩
  | .run q c => match w yI with
    | some _ => match q with
      | some qa =>
        let act := A.tm.tr b qa inp fun i => w (aI i)
        ⟨act.inputTape, slots (fun _ => idle) act.workTapes (none, 1), none,
          some (.run act.state (capPush c act.output))⟩
      | none => ⟨0, slots (fun _ => idle) (fun _ => idle) (none, 1), none, some (.run none c)⟩
    | none => match q, c with
      | none, some (some v) => ⟨0, slots (fun _ => idle) (fun _ => idle) idle, some v, none⟩
      | _, _ =>
        if loop then ⟨0, slots (fun _ => idle) (fun _ => idle) (none, -1), none, some .p0⟩
        else ⟨0, slots (fun _ => idle) (fun _ => idle) idle, none, none⟩
  | .p0 => match w yI with
    | some _ => ⟨-1, slots (fun _ => idle) (fun _ => (none, 1)) (none, -1), none, some .p0⟩
    | none => ⟨-1, slots (fun _ => idle) (fun _ => (none, 1)) (none, 1), none, some .p1⟩
  | .p1 => match w yI with
    | some _ => ⟨0, slots (fun _ => idle) (fun _ => (none, 1)) (none, 1), none, some .p1⟩
    | none => ⟨0, slots (fun _ => idle) (fun _ => (none, 1)) (none, -1), none, some .p2⟩
  | .p2 => match w yI with
    | some _ => ⟨0, slots (fun _ => idle) (fun _ => (none, 1)) (none, -1), none, some .p2⟩
    | none => ⟨1, slots (fun _ => idle) (fun _ => (none, 1)) (none, 1), none,
        some (.run (some A.tm.q₀) none)⟩

/-- The host as a raw binary-choice machine. -/

name: hostTM
header: def hostTM : NDTM (S.k + A.k + 1) Bool (ClockPhase S.State A.State)
chunk:
/-- The host as a raw binary-choice machine. -/
def hostTM : NDTM (S.k + A.k + 1) Bool (ClockPhase S.State A.State) :=
  ⟨.boot S.tm.q₀, clockTr S A loop⟩

end ClockHost

/-- **The clocked restart host** [AB09, §7.4.2 and Exercise 7.6(a)]: run the yardstick machine
`S` (meant to emit `1^m`), then run `A` for `m` coins; emit `A`'s one-bit output if it has
halted with one, else halt silently (`loop = false`) or reset and retry (`loop = true`). -/

name: FinNDTM.clockHost
header: def FinNDTM.clockHost (S : FinTM Bool) (A : FinNDTM Bool) (loop : Bool) : FinNDTM Bool
chunk:
/-- **The clocked restart host** [AB09, §7.4.2 and Exercise 7.6(a)]: run the yardstick machine
`S` (meant to emit `1^m`), then run `A` for `m` coins; emit `A`'s one-bit output if it has
halted with one, else halt silently (`loop = false`) or reset and retry (`loop = true`). -/
def FinNDTM.clockHost (S : FinTM Bool) (A : FinNDTM Bool) (loop : Bool) : FinNDTM Bool :=
  @FinNDTM.mk Bool (S.k + A.k + 1) (ClockPhase S.State A.State) inferInstance inferInstance
    (ClockHost.hostTM S A loop)

/-- Close the slot-by-slot equations left by `apply_hostCfg`. -/
scoped macro "host_congr" : tactic =>
  `(tactic| (congr 1 <;> (try rfl) <;> (try exact Turing.moveInputPos_zero _)
    <;> (try exact Turing.ClockHost.heads_idle _)
    <;> (try (funext i; (simp [Turing.ClockHost.tapeAfter, Turing.ClockHost.idle]); done))
    <;> (try ((simp [Turing.ClockHost.tapeAfter, Turing.capOf_append]); done))
    <;> (try ((simp [Turing.ClockHost.tapeAfter]); omega))))

    (hostTM S A loop).stepWith b (hostCfg (some q) ip sT sP aT aP yT yP out) =

name: bootCfg
header:

/-- The boot-phase configuration: `S` on its bank, its output on the yardstick tape. -/
def bootCfg (c : Cfg S.k Bool S.State x) :
    Cfg (S.k + A.k + 1) Bool (ClockPhase S.State A.State) x :=
  hostCfg (some ((c.state.map ClockPhase.boot).getD ClockPhase.rew)) c.inputPos c.workTapes

/-- A boot step is a step of `S`, its emission appended to the yardstick tape.

**Proof sketch.** The boot action is `S`'s action on its bank with its emission written on `Y`
(`apply_hostCfg`); the appended cell is `FinTM.bufferTape_append`. -/

name: boot_step
chunk:
/-- A boot step is a step of `S`, its emission appended to the yardstick tape.

**Proof sketch.** The boot action is `S`'s action on its bank with its emission written on `Y`
(`apply_hostCfg`); the appended cell is `FinTM.bufferTape_append`. -/
theorem boot_step (b : Bool) (c : Cfg S.k Bool S.State x) {q : S.State}
    (hq : c.state = some q) :
    (hostTM S A loop).stepWith b (bootCfg (A := A) c) = bootCfg (S.tm.step c) := by
  have hst : (bootCfg (A := A) c).state = some (.boot q) := by simp [bootCfg, hostCfg, hq]
  rw [NDTM.stepWith_of_state _ b hst]
  have hsym : ∀ i, (bootCfg (A := A) c).workTapeSymbols (sI i) = c.workTapeSymbols i :=
    fun i => by simp [bootCfg, hostCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols]
  have hin : (bootCfg (A := A) c).inputSymbol = c.inputSymbol := rfl
  simp only [hostTM, clockTr, hsym, hin]
  have hS : S.tm.step c = (S.tm.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).apply c := by
    simp [MultiTapeTM.step, hq]
  rw [hS]
  unfold bootCfg
  rw [apply_hostCfg]
  rcases ho : (S.tm.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).output with _ | e
  · congr 1 <;> first
      | rfl
      | (funext i; simp; done)
      | simp [tapeAfter, emitTo, Action.apply, ho]
  · congr 1 <;> first
      | rfl
      | (funext i; simp; done)
      | simp [tapeAfter, emitTo, Action.apply, ho, FinTM.bufferTape_append]

name: boot_run
header:
theorem boot_run (c : Cfg S.k Bool S.State x) (w : List Bool)
    (hlive : ∀ t < w.length, (S.tm.runFrom c t).state ≠ none) :
    (hostTM S A loop).runWith w (bootCfg (A
chunk:
/-- **Boot run**: while `S` is live, the host simulates it step for step. -/
theorem boot_run (c : Cfg S.k Bool S.State x) (w : List Bool)
    (hlive : ∀ t < w.length, (S.tm.runFrom c t).state ≠ none) :
    (hostTM S A loop).runWith w (bootCfg (A := A) c) = bootCfg (S.tm.runFrom c w.length) := by
  induction w generalizing c with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b w ih =>
    have h0 := hlive 0 (by simp)
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero] at h0
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp h0
    rw [NDTM.runWith_cons, boot_step b c hq, ih, List.length_cons,
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step]
    intro t ht
    rw [← MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step]
    exact hlive (t + 1) (by simp; omega)

def inLeft {n : ℕ} : Fin (n + 2) → ℕ → Fin (n + 2)
  | ip, 0 => ip
  | ip, j + 1 => inLeft (moveInputPos ip (-1)) j

/-- `j` left moves subtract `j`, clamped at `0`. -/

name: inLeft_val
header: theorem inLeft_val {n : ℕ} (ip : Fin (n + 2)) (j : ℕ) : (inLeft ip j).val = ip.val - j
chunk:
/-- `j` left moves subtract `j`, clamped at `0`. -/
theorem inLeft_val {n : ℕ} (ip : Fin (n + 2)) (j : ℕ) : (inLeft ip j).val = ip.val - j := by
  induction j generalizing ip with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [inLeft, ih]
    by_cases h : ip = 0
    · subst h; simp
    · have hv : ip.val ≠ 0 := fun h' => h (Fin.ext h')
      rw [show (-1 : SignType) = .neg from rfl, moveInputPos_neg_of_ne_left ip h]
      simp only
      omega

/-- After at least `ip` left moves, one right move puts the input head on its start cell. -/

name: moveInputPos_inLeft
header:
theorem moveInputPos_inLeft {n : ℕ} (ip : Fin (n + 2)) {j : ℕ} (hj : ip.val ≤ j) :
    moveInputPos (inLeft ip j) 1 = 1
chunk:
/-- After at least `ip` left moves, one right move puts the input head on its start cell. -/
theorem moveInputPos_inLeft {n : ℕ} (ip : Fin (n + 2)) {j : ℕ} (hj : ip.val ≤ j) :
    moveInputPos (inLeft ip j) 1 = 1 := by
  have h0 : inLeft ip j = 0 := Fin.ext (by rw [inLeft_val, Fin.val_zero]; omega)
  rw [h0, show (1 : SignType) = .pos from rfl, moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp)]
  exact Fin.ext (by simp)

    (hj : w.length ≤ m) :
    (hostTM S A loop).runWith w
        (hostCfg (some .rew2) ip sT sP aT aP (yard m) ((w.length : ℤ) - 1) []) =
      hostCfg (some .rew2) (inLeft ip w.length) sT sP aT aP (yard m) (-1) []
chunk:
/-- Rewinding over `j` marks. -/
theorem rew2_marks (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (sT : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (sP : Fin S.k → ℤ) (aT : Fin A.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (aP : Fin A.k → ℤ) (w : List Bool)
    (hj : w.length ≤ m) :
    (hostTM S A loop).runWith w
        (hostCfg (some .rew2) ip sT sP aT aP (yard m) ((w.length : ℤ) - 1) []) =
      hostCfg (some .rew2) (inLeft ip w.length) sT sP aT aP (yard m) (-1) [] := by
  induction w generalizing ip with
  | nil => simp [inLeft]
  | cons b w ih =>
    simp only [List.length_cons] at hj ⊢
    rw [NDTM.runWith_cons, rew2_step m b ip sT sP aT aP (((w.length + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1)
      (yard_of_lt (by omega) (by push_cast; omega))]
    have h : ((w.length + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1 - 1 = (w.length : ℤ) - 1 := by push_cast; omega
    rw [h, ih _ (by omega)]
    rfl

/-- **Rewind run**: from the end of the yardstick, `m + 2` steps bring the yardstick head to
its first mark, move the input head `m + 1` cells left and one right, and start the attempt.

**Proof sketch.** One step left, `m` steps over the marks (`rew2_marks`), and the turnaround
(`rew2_turn`). -/

name: rewind_run
header:
theorem rewind_run (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (sT : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (sP : Fin S.k → ℤ) (aT : Fin A.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (aP : Fin A.k → ℤ) (w : List Bool)
    (hw : w.length = m + 2) :
    (hostTM S A loop).runWith w (hostCfg (some .rew) ip sT sP aT aP (yard m) m []) =
      hostCfg (some (.run (some A.tm.q₀) none)) (moveInputPos (inLeft ip (m + 1)) 1) sT sP aT aP
        (yard m) 0 []
chunk:
/-- **Rewind run**: from the end of the yardstick, `m + 2` steps bring the yardstick head to
its first mark, move the input head `m + 1` cells left and one right, and start the attempt.

**Proof sketch.** One step left, `m` steps over the marks (`rew2_marks`), and the turnaround
(`rew2_turn`). -/
theorem rewind_run (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (sT : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (sP : Fin S.k → ℤ) (aT : Fin A.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (aP : Fin A.k → ℤ) (w : List Bool)
    (hw : w.length = m + 2) :
    (hostTM S A loop).runWith w (hostCfg (some .rew) ip sT sP aT aP (yard m) m []) =
      hostCfg (some (.run (some A.tm.q₀) none)) (moveInputPos (inLeft ip (m + 1)) 1) sT sP aT aP
        (yard m) 0 [] := by
  rcases w with _ | ⟨b, w⟩
  · simp at hw
  rw [NDTM.runWith_cons, rew_step, ← List.take_append_drop m w, NDTM.runWith_append]
  have ht : (w.take m).length = m := List.length_take_of_le (by simp at hw; omega)
  have hrw := rew2_marks (S := S) (A := A) (loop := loop) m (moveInputPos ip (-1)) sT sP aT aP
    (w.take m) (by omega)
  rw [ht] at hrw
  rw [hrw]
  have hd : (w.drop m).length = 1 := by simp at hw ⊢; omega
  rcases hdw : w.drop m with _ | ⟨b', _ | ⟨b'', r⟩⟩
  · simp [hdw] at hd
  · rw [NDTM.runWith_cons, rew2_turn, NDTM.runWith_nil]
    rfl
  · simp [hdw] at hd

/-- The attempt-phase configuration: `A`'s configuration on its bank, its output captured, and
the yardstick head at `j`. -/

name: runCfg
header:
def runCfg (a : Cfg A.k Bool A.State x) (j : ℤ) (sT : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (sP : Fin S.k → ℤ) : Cfg (S.k + A.k + 1) Bool (ClockPhase S.State A.State) x
chunk:
/-- The attempt-phase configuration: `A`'s configuration on its bank, its output captured, and
the yardstick head at `j`. -/
def runCfg (a : Cfg A.k Bool A.State x) (j : ℤ) (sT : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (sP : Fin S.k → ℤ) : Cfg (S.k + A.k + 1) Bool (ClockPhase S.State A.State) x :=
  hostCfg (some (.run a.state (capOf a.output))) a.inputPos sT sP a.workTapes a.workTapePos
    (yard m) j []

/-- Before the timeout, a host step is a step of `A` under the same coin.

**Proof sketch.** `Y` reads a mark. If `A` has halted, only `Y` moves; otherwise the host applies
`A`'s action on its bank, and the captured summary follows `capOf_append`. -/

name: run_step
header:
theorem run_step (b : Bool) (a : Cfg A.k Bool A.State x) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < m)
    (sT : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (sP : Fin S.k → ℤ) :
    (hostTM S A loop).stepWith b (runCfg m a j sT sP) =
      runCfg m (A.tm.stepWith b a) ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) sT sP
chunk:
/-- Before the timeout, a host step is a step of `A` under the same coin.

**Proof sketch.** `Y` reads a mark. If `A` has halted, only `Y` moves; otherwise the host applies
`A`'s action on its bank, and the captured summary follows `capOf_append`. -/
theorem run_step (b : Bool) (a : Cfg A.k Bool A.State x) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < m)
    (sT : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (sP : Fin S.k → ℤ) :
    (hostTM S A loop).stepWith b (runCfg m a j sT sP) =
      runCfg m (A.tm.stepWith b a) ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) sT sP := by
  have hY : (runCfg (S := S) (A := A) m a j sT sP).workTapeSymbols yI = some true := by
    simp only [runCfg, hostCfg_symbols_yI]
    exact yard_of_lt (by omega) (by omega)
  cases hq : a.state with
  | none =>
    have hst : (runCfg (S := S) m a j sT sP).state = some (.run none (capOf a.output)) := by
      simp [runCfg, hostCfg, hq]
    rw [NDTM.stepWith_of_state _ b hst, NDTM.stepWith_of_halt hq]
    simp only [hostTM, clockTr, hY]
    unfold runCfg
    rw [apply_hostCfg, hq]
    host_congr
  | some qa =>
    have hst : (runCfg (S := S) m a j sT sP).state = some (.run (some qa) (capOf a.output)) := by
      simp [runCfg, hostCfg, hq]
    rw [NDTM.stepWith_of_state _ b hst, NDTM.stepWith_of_state A.tm b hq]
    have hsym : (fun i => (runCfg (S := S) m a j sT sP).workTapeSymbols (aI i)) =
        a.workTapeSymbols := funext fun i => by simp [runCfg, hostCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols]
    have hin : (runCfg (S := S) m a j sT sP).inputSymbol = a.inputSymbol := rfl
    simp only [hostTM, clockTr, hY]
    rw [hsym, hin]
    unfold runCfg
    rw [apply_hostCfg]
    have hst' : ((A.tm.tr b qa a.inputSymbol a.workTapeSymbols).apply a).state =
        (A.tm.tr b qa a.inputSymbol a.workTapeSymbols).state := rfl
    rw [hst', show ((A.tm.tr b qa a.inputSymbol a.workTapeSymbols).apply a).output =
      a.output ++ (A.tm.tr b qa a.inputSymbol a.workTapeSymbols).output.toList from rfl,
      capOf_append]
    host_congr

/-- **Attempt run**: before the timeout, the host runs `A` under the same coins. -/

name: run_run
header:
theorem run_run (a : Cfg A.k Bool A.State x) (j : ℕ) (sT : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (sP : Fin S.k → ℤ) (u : List Bool) (hj : j + u.length ≤ m) :
    (hostTM S A loop).runWith u (runCfg m a j sT sP) =
      runCfg m (A.tm.runWith u a) ((j + u.length : ℕ) : ℤ) sT sP
chunk:
/-- **Attempt run**: before the timeout, the host runs `A` under the same coins. -/
theorem run_run (a : Cfg A.k Bool A.State x) (j : ℕ) (sT : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (sP : Fin S.k → ℤ) (u : List Bool) (hj : j + u.length ≤ m) :
    (hostTM S A loop).runWith u (runCfg m a j sT sP) =
      runCfg m (A.tm.runWith u a) ((j + u.length : ℕ) : ℤ) sT sP := by
  induction u generalizing a j with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b u ih =>
    simp only [List.length_cons] at hj ⊢
    rw [NDTM.runWith_cons, NDTM.runWith_cons, run_step m b a j (by omega), ih _ _ (by omega)]
    congr 2
    omega

/-- `run_run` from the yardstick's first mark. -/
theorem run_run_zero (a : Cfg A.k Bool A.State x) (sT : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool)

    (hostTM S A loop).runWith u (runCfg m a 0 sT sP) =
      runCfg m (A.tm.runWith u a) u.length sT sP := by
  have := run_run (loop := loop) m a 0 sT sP u (by omega)
  simpa using this

name: timeout_success
header:

    (sP : Fin S.k → ℤ) {v : Bool} (ha : a.state = none) (ho : a.output = [v]) :
    (hostTM S A loop).stepWith b (runCfg m a m sT sP) =
      hostCfg none a.inputPos sT sP a.workTapes a.workTapePos (yard m) m [v]
chunk:
/-- **Timeout, success**: an attempt that has halted with output `[v]` makes the host emit
`v` and halt. -/
theorem timeout_success (b : Bool) (a : Cfg A.k Bool A.State x) (sT : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (sP : Fin S.k → ℤ) {v : Bool} (ha : a.state = none) (ho : a.output = [v]) :
    (hostTM S A loop).stepWith b (runCfg m a m sT sP) =
      hostCfg none a.inputPos sT sP a.workTapes a.workTapePos (yard m) m [v] := by
  have hst : (runCfg (S := S) m a m sT sP).state = some (.run none (some (some v))) := by
    simp [runCfg, hostCfg, ha, ho, capOf]
  rw [NDTM.stepWith_of_state _ b hst]

/-- **Timeout, failure**: otherwise the host resets (`loop`) or halts silently.

**Proof sketch.** `Y` reads a blank; since `A` has not halted with a one-bit output
(`capOf_eq_some_some`), the transition takes its second branch. -/

name: timeout_fail
header:
theorem timeout_fail (b : Bool) (a : Cfg A.k Bool A.State x) (sT : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (sP : Fin S.k → ℤ) (hfail : ¬ (a.state = none ∧ ∃ v, a.output = [v])) :
    (hostTM S A loop).stepWith b (runCfg m a m sT sP) =
      if loop then hostCfg (some .p0) a.inputPos sT sP a.workTapes a.workTapePos (yard m)
        ((m : ℤ) - 1) []
      else hostCfg none a.inputPos sT sP a.workTapes a.workTapePos (yard m) m []
chunk:
/-- **Timeout, failure**: otherwise the host resets (`loop`) or halts silently.

**Proof sketch.** `Y` reads a blank; since `A` has not halted with a one-bit output
(`capOf_eq_some_some`), the transition takes its second branch. -/
theorem timeout_fail (b : Bool) (a : Cfg A.k Bool A.State x) (sT : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (sP : Fin S.k → ℤ) (hfail : ¬ (a.state = none ∧ ∃ v, a.output = [v])) :
    (hostTM S A loop).stepWith b (runCfg m a m sT sP) =
      if loop then hostCfg (some .p0) a.inputPos sT sP a.workTapes a.workTapePos (yard m)
        ((m : ℤ) - 1) []
      else hostCfg none a.inputPos sT sP a.workTapes a.workTapePos (yard m) m [] := by
  have hst : (runCfg (S := S) m a m sT sP).state = some (.run a.state (capOf a.output)) := by
    simp [runCfg, hostCfg]
  rw [NDTM.stepWith_of_state _ b hst]
  have hY : (runCfg (S := S) (A := A) m a m sT sP).workTapeSymbols yI = none := by
    simp [runCfg]
  have hnot : ∀ v, ¬ (a.state = none ∧ capOf a.output = some (some v)) := fun v h =>
    hfail ⟨h.1, v, capOf_eq_some_some.mp h.2⟩
  have hgo : clockTr S A loop b (.run a.state (capOf a.output))
      (runCfg (S := S) m a m sT sP).inputSymbol (runCfg (S := S) m a m sT sP).workTapeSymbols =
      if loop then ⟨0, slots (fun _ => idle) (fun _ => idle) (none, -1), none, some .p0⟩
      else ⟨0, slots (fun _ => idle) (fun _ => idle) idle, none, none⟩ := by
    simp only [clockTr, hY]
    rcases hq : a.state with _ | qa
    · rcases hc : capOf a.output with _ | _ | v
      · rfl
      · rfl
      · exact absurd ⟨hq, hc⟩ (hnot v)
    · rfl
  change (clockTr S A loop b _ _ _).apply _ = _
  rw [hgo]
  cases loop
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    unfold runCfg
    rw [apply_hostCfg]
    host_congr
  · simp only [if_true]
    unfold runCfg
    rw [apply_hostCfg]
    host_congr

theorem exists_split_block {w : List Bool} {r : ℕ} (hw : w.length = m + 1 + r) :

chunk:
/-- Split a word of length `m + 1 + r` at its `m`-th letter. -/
theorem exists_split_block {w : List Bool} {r : ℕ} (hw : w.length = m + 1 + r) :
    ∃ u b v, w = u ++ b :: v ∧ u.length = m ∧ v.length = r := by
  rcases hd : w.drop m with _ | ⟨b, v⟩
  · have := congrArg List.length hd; simp at this; omega
  · refine ⟨w.take m, b, v, by rw [← hd, List.take_append_drop],
      List.length_take_of_le (by omega), ?_⟩
    have := congrArg List.length hd; simp at this; omega

    (hj : w.length ≤ m) (z : ℤ) (hz : z = (w.length : ℤ) - 1) :
    (hostTM S A loop).runWith w (hostCfg (some .p0) ip sT sP aT aP (yard m) z []) =

chunk:
/-- The first sweep over `j ≤ m` marks.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the word, one `p0_mark` step at a time; `p1_marks` and `p2_marks`
are the same. -/
theorem p0_marks (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (sT : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (sP : Fin S.k → ℤ) (aT : Fin A.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (aP : Fin A.k → ℤ) (w : List Bool)
    (hj : w.length ≤ m) (z : ℤ) (hz : z = (w.length : ℤ) - 1) :
    (hostTM S A loop).runWith w (hostCfg (some .p0) ip sT sP aT aP (yard m) z []) =
      hostCfg (some .p0) (inLeft ip w.length) sT sP aT (fun i => aP i + w.length) (yard m) (-1)
        [] := by
  subst hz
  induction w generalizing ip aP with
  | nil => simp [inLeft]
  | cons b w ih =>
    simp only [List.length_cons] at hj ⊢
    rw [NDTM.runWith_cons, p0_mark m b ip sT sP aT aP (((w.length + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1)
      (yard_of_lt (by omega) (by push_cast; omega))]
    have h : ((w.length + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1 - 1 = (w.length : ℤ) - 1 := by push_cast; omega
    rw [h, ih]
    · congr 1
      funext i
      push_cast
      omega
    · omega
