/-- The copying loop of the unary-split leaf, framed: from `copy` with the unary word `1^q 0`
under the head of `src`, the leaf exits in exactly `q + 1` steps and not earlier, having
written `1^q 0` on `sm` from that head's cell on (that head ends on the terminator), blanked
the terminator's cell on `src`, and moved the head of `src` one cell past it. The output and
everything off the two heads' ranges are unchanged, at every time up to the exit.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on `q`. At `q = 0` the source head reads the terminator, and one exit
step (`sl_split_step_exit`) gives the endpoint. At `q + 1` one copying step
(`sl_split_step_true`) writes `true` on `sm` and advances both heads, leaving `1^q 0` under the
source head; the induction hypothesis gives the rest, and the written cells join the new one
cell by cell. The cut and silence follow by splitting off the first step. -/

name: sl_unarySplit_copy
header:
private theorem sl_unarySplit_copy {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src sm : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ sm)
    (q : ℕ) (d : Cfg k Bool sl_SplitPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .copy)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ q →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = some (decide (p < q))) :
    (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d (q + 1) =
        { d with
          state
chunk:
/-- The copying loop of the unary-split leaf, framed: from `copy` with the unary word `1^q 0`
under the head of `src`, the leaf exits in exactly `q + 1` steps and not earlier, having
written `1^q 0` on `sm` from that head's cell on (that head ends on the terminator), blanked
the terminator's cell on `src`, and moved the head of `src` one cell past it. The output and
everything off the two heads' ranges are unchanged, at every time up to the exit.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on `q`. At `q = 0` the source head reads the terminator, and one exit
step (`sl_split_step_exit`) gives the endpoint. At `q + 1` one copying step
(`sl_split_step_true`) writes `true` on `sm` and advances both heads, leaving `1^q 0` under the
source head; the induction hypothesis gives the rest, and the written cells join the new one
cell by cell. The cut and silence follow by splitting off the first step. -/
private theorem sl_unarySplit_copy {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src sm : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ sm)
    (q : ℕ) (d : Cfg k Bool sl_SplitPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .copy)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ q →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = some (decide (p < q))) :
    (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d (q + 1) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapes := Function.update (Function.update d.workTapes src
              (Function.update (d.workTapes src) (d.workTapePos src + q) none)) sm
            (fun z => if d.workTapePos sm ≤ z ∧ z ≤ d.workTapePos sm + q
              then some (decide (z < d.workTapePos sm + q)) else d.workTapes sm z)
          workTapePos := Function.update (Function.update d.workTapePos src
            (d.workTapePos src + q + 1)) sm (d.workTapePos sm + q) } ∧
      (∀ t < q + 1, ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      ∀ t ≤ q + 1, ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d t).output = d.output := by
  induction q generalizing d with
  | zero =>
    have h0 := hw 0 le_rfl
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, decide_eq_false (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)] at h0
    have hs := sl_split_step_exit src sm hne hstate
      (by rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]; exact h0)
    have hrun1 : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d 1 = (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d := by
      rw [show (1 : ℕ) = 0 + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step',
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [show ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 0 from by norm_num, hrun1, hs]
      apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only <;> try rfl
      · funext j
        rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
        · simp only [Function.update_self]
          funext z
          rcases eq_or_ne z (d.workTapePos j) with rfl | hz
          · rw [Function.update_self, if_pos (by omega)]
            congr 1
            symm
            rw [decide_eq_false_iff_not]
            omega
          · rw [Function.update_of_ne hz, if_neg (by omega)]
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
          rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
          · simp only [Function.update_self, add_zero]
          · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc]
      · funext j
        rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
        · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hne), add_zero]
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
          rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
          · simp only [Function.update_self, add_zero]
          · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc]
    · intro t ht
      rcases t with _ | t
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hstate]
        simp
      · omega
    · intro t ht
      rcases t with _ | t
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
      · rcases t with _ | t
        · rw [hrun1, hs]
        · omega
  | succ q ih =>
    have h0 := hw 0 (by omega)
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, decide_eq_true (by omega : 0 < q + 1)] at h0
    have hs := sl_split_step_true src sm hne hstate
      (by rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]; exact h0)
    have hw₁ : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ q →
        ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d).workTapes src
          (((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d).workTapePos src + p) =
          some (decide (p < q)) := by
      intro p hp
      rw [hs]
      dsimp only
      rw [Function.update_of_ne hne, Function.update_of_ne hne, Function.update_self]
      have h := hw (1 + p) (by omega)
      rw [show (d.workTapePos src + ((1 + p : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
          d.workTapePos src + 1 + (p : ℕ) from by
        push_cast; ring, show decide (1 + p < q + 1) = decide (p < q) from by
        rw [decide_eq_decide]; omega] at h
      exact h
    obtain ⟨ihrun, ihcut, ihout⟩ := ih ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d) (by rw [hs]) hw₁
    have hstep1 : ∀ t : ℕ, (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d (t + 1) =
        (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d) t := fun t =>
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hstep1 (q + 1), ihrun, hs]
      apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only <;> try rfl
      · funext j
        rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
        · simp only [Function.update_self]
          funext z
          by_cases hz1 : d.workTapePos j + 1 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ d.workTapePos j + 1 + (q : ℕ)
          · rw [if_pos hz1, if_pos (by omega)]
            congr 1
            rw [decide_eq_decide]
            omega
          · rw [if_neg hz1]
            by_cases hz0 : z = d.workTapePos j
            · subst hz0
              rw [Function.update_self, if_pos (by omega)]
              congr 1
              symm
              rw [decide_eq_true_eq]
              omega
            · rw [Function.update_of_ne hz0, if_neg (by omega)]
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
          rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
          · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
            congr 1
            push_cast
            ring
          · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
      · funext j
        rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
        · simp only [Function.update_self]
          push_cast
          ring
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
          rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
          · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
            push_cast
            ring
          · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
    · intro t ht
      rcases t with _ | t
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hstate]
        simp
      · rw [hstep1 t]
        exact ihcut t (by omega)
    · intro t ht
      rcases t with _ | t
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
      · rw [hstep1 t, ihout t (by omega), hs]

/-- **The unary-split leaf, framed.** From any configuration in `mv1` whose tape `src` holds the
unary word `1^q 0` from its head, the leaf reaches `done` at exactly `q + 3` and not earlier,
with the word written on `sm` from two cells right of that tape's head (that head ends on the
written terminator), the terminator's cell of `src` blanked and its head one cell past it, and
everything else — every other cell, every other head, the input position and the output —
unchanged. The output is unchanged at every time up to the exit.

**Proof sketch.** Two offset moves of the head of `sm` (`sl_step_move`), which leave `src`
untouched, then the copying loop (`sl_unarySplit_copy`) from the shifted summary head. Compose at
time `2` and collect the fields. -/

name: sl_unarySplitTM_run
header:
private theorem sl_unarySplitTM_run {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src sm : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ sm)
    (q : ℕ) (d : Cfg k Bool sl_SplitPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .mv1)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ q →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = some (decide (p < q))) :
    (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d (q + 3) =
        { d with
          state
chunk:
/-- **The unary-split leaf, framed.** From any configuration in `mv1` whose tape `src` holds the
unary word `1^q 0` from its head, the leaf reaches `done` at exactly `q + 3` and not earlier,
with the word written on `sm` from two cells right of that tape's head (that head ends on the
written terminator), the terminator's cell of `src` blanked and its head one cell past it, and
everything else — every other cell, every other head, the input position and the output —
unchanged. The output is unchanged at every time up to the exit.

**Proof sketch.** Two offset moves of the head of `sm` (`sl_step_move`), which leave `src`
untouched, then the copying loop (`sl_unarySplit_copy`) from the shifted summary head. Compose at
time `2` and collect the fields. -/
private theorem sl_unarySplitTM_run {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src sm : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ sm)
    (q : ℕ) (d : Cfg k Bool sl_SplitPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .mv1)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ q →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = some (decide (p < q))) :
    (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d (q + 3) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapes := Function.update (Function.update d.workTapes src
              (Function.update (d.workTapes src) (d.workTapePos src + q) none)) sm
            (fun z => if d.workTapePos sm + 2 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ d.workTapePos sm + 2 + q
              then some (decide (z < d.workTapePos sm + 2 + q)) else d.workTapes sm z)
          workTapePos := Function.update (Function.update d.workTapePos src
            (d.workTapePos src + q + 1)) sm (d.workTapePos sm + 2 + q) } ∧
      (∀ t < q + 3, ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      ∀ t ≤ q + 3, ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d t).output = d.output := by
  have hs1 : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d =
      { d with
        state := some .mv2
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 1) } :=
    sl_step_move _ sm hstate _ (by simp only [sl_unarySplitTM])
  have hs2 : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step { d with
      state := some sl_SplitPhase.mv2
      workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 1) } =
      { d with
        state := some .copy
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 2) } := by
    refine (sl_step_move (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm) sm
      (c := { d with
        state := some sl_SplitPhase.mv2
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 1) })
      rfl .copy (by simp only [sl_unarySplitTM])).trans ?_
    apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only
    rw [Function.update_idem, Function.update_self]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hrun1 : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d 1 =
      { d with
        state := some .mv2
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 1) } := by
    rw [show (1 : ℕ) = 0 + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step',
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hs1]
  have hrun2 : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d 2 =
      { d with
        state := some .copy
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 2) } := by
    rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', hrun1, hs2]
  have hw₂ : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ q →
      ({ d with
          state := some sl_SplitPhase.copy
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 2) } :
        Cfg k Bool sl_SplitPhase x).workTapes src
        (({ d with
            state := some sl_SplitPhase.copy
            workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 2) } :
          Cfg k Bool sl_SplitPhase x).workTapePos src + p) = some (decide (p < q)) := by
    intro p hp
    dsimp only
    rw [Function.update_of_ne hne]
    exact hw p hp
  obtain ⟨crun, ccut, cout⟩ := sl_unarySplit_copy src sm hne q _ rfl hw₂
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [show q + 3 = 2 + (q + 1) from by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun2, crun]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only <;> try rfl
    · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hne]
    · funext j
      rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
      · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hne]
      · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
        rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
        · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
  · intro t ht
    rcases t with _ | _ | t
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hstate]
      simp
    · rw [hrun1]
      simp
    · rw [show t + 1 + 1 = 2 + t from by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun2]
      exact ccut t (by omega)
  · intro t ht
    rcases t with _ | _ | t
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    · rw [hrun1]
    · rw [show t + 1 + 1 = 2 + t from by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun2]
      exact cout t (by omega)

/-! ### Private layer: the word identities

The source word `s = pairEncode a (1^q 0 ++ v)` splits as the header `pairEncode a []`, the
unary field and the table field; its cells are read through `Turing.pairEncode_eq` and the
published `Turing.FinTM.bufferTape` identities only. -/

/-- The unary word's cells at an integer index: `true` strictly below `q`, `false` at `q`. -/

name: sl_bufferTape_unary_int
header:
private lemma sl_bufferTape_unary_int (q : ℕ) {z : ℤ} (h0 : 0 ≤ z) (hq : z ≤ (q : ℕ)) :
    FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) z = some (decide (z < (q : ℕ)))
chunk:
/-- The unary word's cells at an integer index: `true` strictly below `q`, `false` at `q`. -/
private lemma sl_bufferTape_unary_int (q : ℕ) {z : ℤ} (h0 : 0 ≤ z) (hq : z ≤ (q : ℕ)) :
    FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) z = some (decide (z < (q : ℕ))) := by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r : ℕ, z = (r : ℤ) := ⟨z.toNat, (Int.toNat_of_nonneg h0).symm⟩
  rw [FinTM.bufferTape_unary q r (by exact_mod_cast hq)]
  congr 1
  rw [decide_eq_decide]
  omega

/-- The written summary cells, as the unary word's buffer two cells right: the interval
`[2, 2 + q]` filled with `1^q 0` over a blank tape reads `bufferTape (1^q 0) (z - 2)`. -/

name: sl_sm_word
chunk:
/-- The written summary cells, as the unary word's buffer two cells right: the interval
`[2, 2 + q]` filled with `1^q 0` over a blank tape reads `bufferTape (1^q 0) (z - 2)`. -/
private lemma sl_sm_word (q : ℕ) (z : ℤ) :
    (if 2 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 2 + (q : ℕ) then some (decide (z < 2 + (q : ℕ)))
      else (none : Option Bool))
      = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) (z - 2) := by
  by_cases hz : 2 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 2 + (q : ℕ)
  · rw [if_pos hz, sl_bufferTape_unary_int q (by omega) (by omega)]
    congr 1
    rw [decide_eq_decide]
    omega
  · rw [if_neg hz, FinTM.bufferTape_eq_none_of_not_mem]
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
    push_cast
    omega

/-- The unary word read backward: cell `q - p` of `1^q 0` is cell `p` of its reversal, for
every `p ≤ q + 1` (at `p = q + 1` both reads are the blanks off the word). -/

name: sl_reverse_read
chunk:
/-- The unary word read backward: cell `q - p` of `1^q 0` is cell `p` of its reversal, for
every `p ≤ q + 1` (at `p = q + 1` both reads are the blanks off the word). -/
private lemma sl_reverse_read (q : ℕ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ q + 1) :
    FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) ((q : ℕ) - (p : ℕ) : ℤ)
      = FinTM.bufferTape ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse) p := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p (q + 1) with hlt | hge
  · rw [show ((q : ℕ) : ℤ) - (p : ℕ) = ((q - p : ℕ) : ℤ) from by omega,
      FinTM.bufferTape_nat,
      FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_reverse (by simp; omega)]
    congr 1
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
    omega
  · obtain rfl : p = q + 1 := by omega
    rw [show ((q : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (-1 : ℤ) from by push_cast; ring,
      FinTM.bufferTape_left]
    symm
    apply FinTM.bufferTape_eq_none_of_not_mem
    simp only [List.length_reverse, List.length_append, List.length_replicate,
      List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
    push_cast
    omega

/-- The unary field's cells of the source word: in `pairEncode a (1^q 0 ++ v)`, the cell
`2|a| + 2 + p` holds `true` for `p < q` and `false` for `p = q`. -/

name: sl_read_unary
chunk:
/-- The unary field's cells of the source word: in `pairEncode a (1^q 0 ++ v)`, the cell
`2|a| + 2 + p` holds `true` for `p < q` and `false` for `p = q`. -/
private lemma sl_read_unary (a v : List Bool) (q : ℕ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ q) :
    FinTM.bufferTape (pairEncode a ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]) ++ v))
      ((2 * a.length + 2 + p : ℕ)) = some (decide (p < q)) := by
  rw [show pairEncode a ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]) ++ v) =
      pairEncode a [] ++ ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]) ++ v) from by
      rw [pairEncode_eq, pairEncode_eq]
      simp,
    show ((2 * a.length + 2 + p : ℕ) : ℤ) =
        ((pairEncode a [] : List Bool).length : ℤ) + (p : ℕ) from by
      rw [length_pairEncode, List.length_nil]
      push_cast
      ring,
    FinTM.bufferTape_append_shift _ _ (Int.natCast_nonneg p), FinTM.bufferTape_nat,
    List.getElem?_append_left (by simp; omega),
    ← FinTM.bufferTape_nat, FinTM.bufferTape_unary q p hp]

/-- The table field's cells of the source word: past the header and the unary field,
`pairEncode a (1^q 0 ++ v)` reads the table word's buffer, its right blank and every cell
beyond it included. -/

name: sl_read_table
chunk:
/-- The table field's cells of the source word: past the header and the unary field,
`pairEncode a (1^q 0 ++ v)` reads the table word's buffer, its right blank and every cell
beyond it included. -/
private lemma sl_read_table (a v : List Bool) (q : ℕ) {p : ℤ} (h0 : 0 ≤ p) :
    FinTM.bufferTape (pairEncode a ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]) ++ v))
      (((2 * a.length + 2 + q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + p) = FinTM.bufferTape v p := by
  rw [show pairEncode a ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]) ++ v) =
      (pairEncode a [] ++ (List.replicate q true ++ [false])) ++ v from by
      rw [pairEncode_eq, pairEncode_eq]
      simp,
    show ((2 * a.length + 2 + q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
        ((pairEncode a [] ++ (List.replicate q true ++ [false])).length : ℤ) from by
      simp only [List.length_append, length_pairEncode, List.length_replicate,
        List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
      push_cast
      ring,
    FinTM.bufferTape_append_shift _ _ h0]

/-! ### Private layer: the phase host

Eight phases on `Turing.phaseHostTM`: six catalog rows through their `_run_ofCfg` contracts and
the two leaves. The host's table is read only through `Turing.phaseHostTM_run`; the last
phase's `done` redirects to itself, so the lemma's lockstep window covers the clear to its
exact exit time, and the dispatch that the self-redirect would take lies strictly after the
contract's horizon. -/

/-- The eight phases of the seam layout, in route order. -/

name: sl_Key
header:
private inductive sl_Key where
  /-- phase 1: skip over the suffix `s.drop r` on the source tape -/
  | skipRest
  /-- phase 2: skip back over the whole source word -/
  | rewindAll
  /-- phase 3: the pair-skip leaf over the header -/
  | pairSkip
  /-- phase 4: the unary-split leaf -/
  | unarySplit
  /-- phase 5: the walk home on the summary tape -/
  | walkHome
  /-- phase 6: the transfer of the table word -/
  | moveTable
  /-- phase 7: skip back over the remaining prefix -/
  | rewindHead
  /-- phase 8: clear the remaining prefix; its `done` is the exit -/
  | clearHead
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- Each phase's control carrier. -/
chunk:
/-- The eight phases of the seam layout, in route order. -/
private inductive sl_Key where
  /-- phase 1: skip over the suffix `s.drop r` on the source tape -/
  | skipRest
  /-- phase 2: skip back over the whole source word -/
  | rewindAll
  /-- phase 3: the pair-skip leaf over the header -/
  | pairSkip
  /-- phase 4: the unary-split leaf -/
  | unarySplit
  /-- phase 5: the walk home on the summary tape -/
  | walkHome
  /-- phase 6: the transfer of the table word -/
  | moveTable
  /-- phase 7: skip back over the remaining prefix -/
  | rewindHead
  /-- phase 8: clear the remaining prefix; its `done` is the exit -/
  | clearHead
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- Each phase's control carrier. -/

name: sl_Ph
header:
private abbrev sl_Ph : sl_Key → Type
  | .skipRest | .rewindAll | .walkHome | .rewindHead => SeekPhase
  | .pairSkip => sl_PairPhase
  | .unarySplit => sl_SplitPhase
  | .moveTable | .clearHead => SweepPhase

/-- A phase guard from a row's first-visit cut: strictly before the exit, every live control
state of the phase leaves the dispatch table silent. -/
private lemma sl_guard {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src tbl sm : Fin k) (i : sl_Key)
    {c : Cfg k Bool (sl_Ph i) x} {T : ℕ} (done' : sl_Ph i)
    (hred : ∀ st : sl_Ph i, st ≠ done' → sl_red i st = none)
    (hcut : ∀ t < T, ((sl_part k src tbl sm i).runFrom c t).state ≠ some done') :
    ∀ u < T, ∀ st, ((sl_part k src tbl sm i).runFrom c u).state = some st →
      sl_red i st = none :=
  fun u hu st hst => hred st (fun hh => hcut u hu (hh ▸ hst))

cut (`sl_guard`), gives the lockstep window and the dispatch, and `sl_rewrap` identifies the
dispatched configuration with the next phase's, field by field. Every state of the window
carries this phase's tag, so none is the exit (`sl_tagged_ne_done`). -/
private lemma sl_phase1 {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src tbl sm : Fin k) (hst : src ≠ tbl)
    (hss : src ≠ sm) (d : Cfg k Bool ((i : sl_Key) × sl_Ph i) x)
    (s : List Bool) (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ s.length) (wt ws : ℤ → Option Bool) (pt ps : ℤ) :
    (phaseHostTM (sl_part k src tbl sm) ⟨.skipRest, .run⟩ sl_red).runFrom
        ((sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run (FinTM.bufferTape s) wt ws
          (r : ℤ) pt ps).mapState (Sigma.mk sl_Key.skipRest)) ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1) =
      (sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run (FinTM.bufferTape s) wt ws
        ((s.length : ℤ) + 1) pt ps).mapState (Sigma.mk sl_Key.rewindAll) ∧
    ∀ u ≤ (s.drop r).length + 1,
      (((phaseHostTM (sl_part k src tbl sm) ⟨.skipRest, .run⟩ sl_red).runFrom
        ((sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run (FinTM.bufferTape s) wt ws
          (r : ℤ) pt ps).mapState (Sigma.mk sl_Key.skipRest)) u).state) ≠
        some (⟨.clearHead, .done⟩ : (j : sl_Key) × sl_Ph j) := by
  have hw : ∀ p : ℤ, 0 ≤ p → p ≤ ((s.drop r).length : ℤ) →
      (sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run (FinTM.bufferTape s) wt ws
          (r : ℤ) pt ps).workTapes src
        ((sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run (FinTM.bufferTape s) wt ws
          (r : ℤ) pt ps).workTapePos src + p) = FinTM.bufferTape (s.drop r) p := by
    intro p h0 _
    dsimp only [sl_cfg]
    simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hss, Function.update_of_ne hst]
    exact (FinTM.bufferTape_drop s r h0).symm
  obtain ⟨row, cut, -⟩ := skipTM_run_ofCfg src (s.drop r)
    (sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run (FinTM.bufferTape s) wt ws (r : ℤ) pt ps) rfl hw
  have H := phaseHostTM_run (sl_part k src tbl sm) ⟨.skipRest, .run⟩ sl_red .skipRest
    _ _ ((s.drop r).length + 1) row SeekPhase.done rfl ⟨.rewindAll, .run⟩
    (by simp [sl_red])
    (sl_guard src tbl sm .skipRest SeekPhase.done
      (fun st h => by simp only [sl_red]; rw [if_neg h]) cut)
  refine ⟨H.2.trans ?_, fun u hu => ?_⟩
  · refine sl_rewrap _ _ _ SeekPhase.done ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · funext j
      dsimp only [sl_cfg]
      by_cases hjsrc : j = src
      · rw [hjsrc, Function.update_self]
        simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hss, Function.update_of_ne hst]
        rw [List.length_drop]
        omega
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc]
        by_cases hjsm : j = sm
        · rw [hjsm]
          simp only [Function.update_self]
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
          by_cases hjtbl : j = tbl
          · rw [hjtbl]
            simp only [Function.update_self]
          · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjtbl, Function.update_of_ne hjsrc]
    · rfl
  · rw [H.1 u hu]
    exact sl_tagged_ne_done .skipRest (by decide) _

/-- **The seam layout from a captured serialization.** For distinct work tapes `src`, `tbl` and
`sm` there is a machine with an entry state `entry`, a live exit `done` and a constant `C` with
the following property. Let `s = pairEncode a ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]) ++ v)` and let
`r ≤ |s|`. There is **one time** `T ≤ C·(|s| + 1)`, depending on `a`, `v`, `q` and `r` only
(chosen before the native input and every other tape), such that: started at `entry` with tape
`src` holding exactly `s` from cell `0` (blank elsewhere), its head at `r`, and tapes `tbl` and
`sm` blank with their heads at `0`, the machine reaches `done` at `T`, and not before, with
* tape `tbl` holding exactly `v` from cell `0`;
* tape `sm` holding exactly the unary word `List.replicate q true ++ [false]` from cell `2`
  (cells `0` and `1` blank);
* tape `src` blank;
* the heads of the three tapes at `0`, and every other tape, head, the input position and the
  output unchanged; it emits nothing.

**Why `T` comes before the configuration.** The universal startup (`Turing.exists_selfStartupTMK`)
must exit first at a time that does not depend on its input's suffix. Consumers that need only the
bound use the corollary with `T` chosen per configuration.

At `a = n.bits`, `q = M.q₀` and `v = tableBitsK M.tr`, the start word is `serializeK M`
(`Turing.serializeK_eq`, `Turing.unaryFin_eq`), and the end is the step block's table and summary
tapes for an empty output (`Turing.StepBlock.summaryCells_eq`,
`Turing.StepBlock.outputSummary_nil`, `Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_of_neg`). (A row of the
construction layer; [AB09, §1.4].)

**Proof sketch.** Write `m = List.replicate q true ++ [false]` and `h = 2|a| + 2` for the length
of the header `pairEncode a []`. So `s` is the header on `[0, h)`, `m` on `[h, h + q]` and `v`
from `h + q + 1`, and `n = |s| = h + q + 1 + |v|`. Eight phases are composed by
`Turing.phaseHostTM` (`Turing.phaseHostTM_run`: one silent stationary dispatch step between
consecutive phases). Each is a catalog row through its `_run_ofCfg` contract, whose hypothesis
the previous phase's endpoint meets, or one of two leaves:
1. `Turing.skipTM_run_ofCfg` on `src` at `w = s.drop r`: the cells `r, …, n` are `s.drop r` and
   its right blank. `n - r + 1` steps; the head ends at `n + 1`.
2. `Turing.skipBackTM_run_ofCfg` on `src` at `u = s`: the cells `-1, …, n` are `s` between two
   blanks, ending one blank before the head. `n + 3` steps; the head ends at `0`.
3. **Leaf `pairSkip`** (read-only on `src`): from cell `0` of `pairEncode a _`, read aligned pairs.
   An equal pair continues; `false, true` exits one cell past it. `h` steps; the head ends at `h`.
   No row serves it: the seek rows stop at blanks and none reads pairs.
4. **Leaf `unarySplit`** (on `src` and `sm`): move the head of `sm` right twice. Then, while `src`
   reads `true`, write `true` on `sm` and move both heads right. At the `false`, write `false` on
   `sm` (its head stays) and blank that cell of `src` (its head moves right). `q + 3` steps. Now
   `src` has its head at `h + q + 1` and a blank at `h + q`, and `sm` holds `m` from cell `2`,
   its head at `q + 2`. No row serves it: the copy row stops at a blank, not at a `false`.
5. `Turing.walkTM_run_ofCfg` with ruler `sm`, `moved = (· = sm)` and `dir = .neg`, at
   `w = m.reverse`: the cells `q + 2, …, 2` read leftward, then the blank cell `1`. `q + 2`
   steps; the head of `sm` ends at `0`.
6. `Turing.transferTM_run_ofCfg` from `src` to `tbl` at `w = v`: phase 4's blank at relative
   `-1`, then `v`, then the right blank at relative `|v|`. `2|v| + 2` steps. `tbl` becomes
   `bufferTape v` (it was blank), `v` is erased from `src`, and both heads return, to `h + q + 1`
   and `0`.
7. `Turing.skipBackTM_run_ofCfg` on `src` at `u = s.take (h + q)`: all that remains on `src`,
   ending one blank before the head. `h + q + 3` steps; the head ends at `0`.
8. `Turing.clearTM_run_ofCfg` on `src` at `w = s.take (h + q)`. `2(h + q) + 2` steps; `src` is
   blank and the row returns its head to `0`. This row's `done` is the exit `done`.

In all, with the seven dispatch steps, `T = 2n - r + 4h + 5q + 2|v| + 23 ≤ 7n + 18 ≤ 18(n + 1)`,
a function of `a`, `v`, `q` and `r`: no phase reads the native input or a tape other than `src`,
`tbl` and `sm`, so the run on those three tapes, and hence `T`, is the same for every frame.
Fill obligations, named: the two leaves' framed contracts; the word identities for `s.drop r`,
`s.take (h + q)` and the cells of `m` and `v` (from `Turing.pairEncode_eq`); the phase joins;
and the endpoint's frame. -/

   `sm` (its head stays) and blank that cell of `src` (its head moves right). `q + 3` steps. Now
   `src` has its head at `h + q + 1` and a blank at `h + q`, and `sm` holds `m` from cell `2`,
   its head at `q + 2`. No row serves it: the copy row stops at a blank, not at a `false`.
5. `Turing.walkTM_run_ofCfg` with ruler `sm`, `moved = (· = sm)` and `dir = .neg`, at
   `w = m.reverse`: the cells `q + 2, …, 2` read leftward, then the blank cell `1`. `q + 2`
   steps; the head of `sm` ends at `0`.
6. `Turing.transferTM_run_ofCfg` from `src` to `tbl` at `w = v`: phase 4's blank at relative
   `-1`, then `v`, then the right blank at relative `|v|`. `2|v| + 2` steps. `tbl` becomes
   `bufferTape v` (it was blank), `v` is erased from `src`, and both heads return, to `h + q + 1`
   and `0`.
7. `Turing.skipBackTM_run_ofCfg` on `src` at `u = s.take (h + q)`: all that remains on `src`,
   ending one blank before the head. `h + q + 3` steps; the head ends at `0`.
8. `Turing.clearTM_run_ofCfg` on `src` at `w = s.take (h + q)`. `2(h + q) + 2` steps; `src` is
   blank and the row returns its head to `0`. This row's `done` is the exit `done`.

In all, with the seven dispatch steps, `T = 2n - r + 4h + 5q + 2|v| + 23 ≤ 7n + 18 ≤ 18(n + 1)`,
a function of `a`, `v`, `q` and `r`: no phase reads the native input or a tape other than `src`,
`tbl` and `sm`, so the run on those three tapes, and hence `T`, is the same for every frame.
Fill obligations, named: the two leaves' framed contracts; the word identities for `s.drop r`,
`s.take (h + q)` and the cells of `m` and `v` (from `Turing.pairEncode_eq`); the phase joins;
and the endpoint's frame. -/
theorem exists_seamLayoutTM (k : ℕ) (src tbl sm : Fin k) (hst : src ≠ tbl) (hss : src ≠ sm)
    (hts : tbl ≠ sm) :
    ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (L : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q)
      (entry done : Q) (C : ℕ),
      ∀ (a v : List Bool) (q r : ℕ),
        let s := pairEncode a ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]) ++ v)
        r ≤ s.length →
        ∃ T ≤ C * (s.length + 1), ∀ {z : List Bool} (d : Cfg k Bool Q z),
          d.state = some entry →
          d.workTapes src = FinTM.bufferTape s → d.workTapePos src = r →
          d.workTapes tbl = (fun _ => none) → d.workTapePos tbl = 0 →
          d.workTapes sm = (fun _ => none) → d.workTapePos sm = 0 →
          (L.runFrom d T).state = some done ∧
          (L.runFrom d T).inputPos = d.inputPos ∧
          (L.runFrom d T).workTapes =
            Function.update (Function.update (Function.update d.workTapes src (fun _ => none))
              tbl (FinTM.bufferTape v))
              sm (fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) (p - 2)) ∧
          (L.runFrom d T).workTapePos =
            Function.update (Function.update (Function.update d.workTapePos src 0) tbl 0) sm 0 ∧
          (∀ u ≤ T, (L.runFrom d u).output = d.output) ∧
          ∀ u < T, (L.runFrom d u).state ≠ some done := by
  refine ⟨(i : sl_Key) × sl_Ph i, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    phaseHostTM (sl_part k src tbl sm) ⟨.skipRest, .run⟩ sl_red,
    ⟨.skipRest, .run⟩, ⟨.clearHead, .done⟩, 18, ?_⟩
  intro a v q r s hr
  have hsdef : s = pairEncode a ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]) ++ v) := rfl
  have hslen : s.length = 2 * a.length + 2 + q + 1 + v.length := by
    rw [hsdef, length_pairEncode, List.length_append, List.length_append,
      List.length_replicate, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
    omega
  have hdrop : (s.drop r).length = s.length - r := by simp
  have htake : (s.take (2 * a.length + 2 + q)).length = 2 * a.length + 2 + q := by
    rw [List.length_take]
    omega
  have hrevlen : ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse).length = q + 1 := by simp
  refine ⟨2 * s.length - r + 4 * (2 * a.length + 2) + 5 * q + 2 * v.length + 23,
    by omega, ?_⟩
  intro z d hstate hsrc hsrcpos htbl htblpos hsm hsmpos
  set L := phaseHostTM (sl_part k src tbl sm)
    (⟨sl_Key.skipRest, SeekPhase.run⟩ : (i : sl_Key) × sl_Ph i) sl_red with hLdef
  -- the start configuration, phase 1's entry
  have hstart : d = (sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run (FinTM.bufferTape s) (fun _ => none)
      (fun _ => none) (r : ℤ) 0 0).mapState (Sigma.mk sl_Key.skipRest) := by
    apply Cfg.ext
    · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, hstate]
      dsimp only [sl_cfg]
      rw [Option.map_some]
    · rw [Cfg.mapState_inputPos]
      dsimp only [sl_cfg]
    · funext j p
      rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes]
      dsimp only [sl_cfg]
      by_cases hjsm : j = sm
      · rw [hjsm, Function.update_self, hsm]
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
        by_cases hjtbl : j = tbl
        · rw [hjtbl, Function.update_self, htbl]
        · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjtbl]
          by_cases hjsrc : j = src
          · rw [hjsrc, Function.update_self, hsrc]
          · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc]
    · funext j
      rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
      dsimp only [sl_cfg]
      by_cases hjsm : j = sm
      · rw [hjsm, Function.update_self, hsmpos]
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
        by_cases hjtbl : j = tbl
        · rw [hjtbl, Function.update_self, htblpos]
        · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjtbl]
          by_cases hjsrc : j = src
          · rw [hjsrc, Function.update_self, hsrcpos]
          · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc]
    · rw [Cfg.mapState_output]
      dsimp only [sl_cfg]
  -- the eight hosted phases
  have P1 := sl_phase1 src tbl sm hst hss d s r hr (fun _ => none) (fun _ => none) 0 0
  have P2 := sl_phase2 src tbl sm hst hss d s (fun _ => none) (fun _ => none) 0 0
  have P3 := sl_phase3 src tbl sm hst hss d s a v q hsdef (fun _ => none) (fun _ => none) 0 0
  have P4 := sl_phase4 src tbl sm hst hss hts d s a v q hsdef (fun _ => none) 0
  have P5 := sl_phase5 src tbl sm d q
    (Function.update (FinTM.bufferTape s) ((2 * a.length + 2 + q : ℕ) : ℤ) none)
    (((2 * a.length + 2 + q : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1) (fun _ => none) 0
  have P6 := sl_phase6 src tbl sm hst hss hts d s a v q hsdef
    (fun z => FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) (z - 2)) 0
  have P7 := sl_phase7 src tbl sm hst hss d s (2 * a.length + 2 + q) (by omega)
    (FinTM.bufferTape v)
    (fun z => FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) (z - 2)) 0 0
  have P8 := sl_phase8 src tbl sm hst hss d s (2 * a.length + 2 + q) (by omega)
    (FinTM.bufferTape v)
    (fun z => FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) (z - 2)) 0 0
  -- the cumulative run equations
  have hc1 : L.runFrom d ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1) =
      (sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run (FinTM.bufferTape s) (fun _ => none)
        (fun _ => none) ((s.length : ℤ) + 1) 0 0).mapState (Sigma.mk sl_Key.rewindAll) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hstart]
    exact P1.1
  have hc2 : L.runFrom d ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1)) =
      (sl_cfg src tbl sm d sl_PairPhase.start (FinTM.bufferTape s) (fun _ => none)
        (fun _ => none) 0 0 0).mapState (Sigma.mk sl_Key.pairSkip) := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc1]
    exact P2.1
  have hc3 : L.runFrom d ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
      (2 * a.length + 2 + 1)) =
      (sl_cfg src tbl sm d sl_SplitPhase.mv1 (FinTM.bufferTape s) (fun _ => none)
        (fun _ => none) ((2 * a.length + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) 0 0).mapState
        (Sigma.mk sl_Key.unarySplit) := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc2]
    exact P3.1
  have hc4 : L.runFrom d ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
      (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1)) =
      (sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run
        (Function.update (FinTM.bufferTape s) ((2 * a.length + 2 + q : ℕ) : ℤ) none)
        (fun _ => none)
        (fun z => FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) (z - 2))
        (((2 * a.length + 2 + q : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1) 0 ((q : ℕ) + 2)).mapState
        (Sigma.mk sl_Key.walkHome) := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc3]
    exact P4.1
  have hc5 : L.runFrom d ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
      (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1) +
      ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse.length + 1 + 1)) =
      (sl_cfg src tbl sm d SweepPhase.sweep
        (Function.update (FinTM.bufferTape s) ((2 * a.length + 2 + q : ℕ) : ℤ) none)
        (fun _ => none)
        (fun z => FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) (z - 2))
        (((2 * a.length + 2 + q : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1) 0 0).mapState
        (Sigma.mk sl_Key.moveTable) := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc4]
    exact P5.1
  have hc6 : L.runFrom d ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
      (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1) +
      ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse.length + 1 + 1) +
      (2 * v.length + 2 + 1)) =
      (sl_cfg src tbl sm d SeekPhase.run
        (FinTM.bufferTape (s.take (2 * a.length + 2 + q))) (FinTM.bufferTape v)
        (fun z => FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) (z - 2))
        (((2 * a.length + 2 + q : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1) 0 0).mapState
        (Sigma.mk sl_Key.rewindHead) := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc5]
    exact P6.1
  have hc7 : L.runFrom d ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
      (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1) +
      ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse.length + 1 + 1) +
      (2 * v.length + 2 + 1) + ((s.take (2 * a.length + 2 + q)).length + 3 + 1)) =
      (sl_cfg src tbl sm d SweepPhase.sweep
        (FinTM.bufferTape (s.take (2 * a.length + 2 + q))) (FinTM.bufferTape v)
        (fun z => FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) (z - 2))
        0 0 0).mapState (Sigma.mk sl_Key.clearHead) := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc6]
    exact P7.1
  have hfin : L.runFrom d ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
      (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1) +
      ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse.length + 1 + 1) +
      (2 * v.length + 2 + 1) + ((s.take (2 * a.length + 2 + q)).length + 3 + 1) +
      (2 * (s.take (2 * a.length + 2 + q)).length + 2)) =
      (sl_cfg src tbl sm d SweepPhase.done (fun _ => none) (FinTM.bufferTape v)
        (fun z => FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate q true ++ [false]) (z - 2))
        0 0 0).mapState (Sigma.mk sl_Key.clearHead) := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc7]
    exact P8.1
  have hTsplit : 2 * s.length - r + 4 * (2 * a.length + 2) + 5 * q + 2 * v.length + 23 =
      (s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) + (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1) +
      ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse.length + 1 + 1) + (2 * v.length + 2 + 1) +
      ((s.take (2 * a.length + 2 + q)).length + 3 + 1) +
      (2 * (s.take (2 * a.length + 2 + q)).length + 2) := by
    rw [hdrop, htake, hrevlen]
    omega
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hTsplit, hfin, Cfg.mapState_state]
    dsimp only [sl_cfg]
    rw [Option.map_some]
  · rw [hTsplit, hfin, Cfg.mapState_inputPos]
    dsimp only [sl_cfg]
  · rw [hTsplit, hfin]
    funext j zz
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes]
    dsimp only [sl_cfg]
  · rw [hTsplit, hfin]
    funext j
    rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
    dsimp only [sl_cfg]
  · intro u hu
    rw [hTsplit] at hu
    have h1 : d.output <+: (L.runFrom d u).output := by
      have h := MultiTapeTM.output_prefix L d (Nat.zero_le u)
      rwa [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero] at h
    have h2 : (L.runFrom d u).output <+: d.output := by
      have h := MultiTapeTM.output_prefix L d hu
      rw [hfin, Cfg.mapState_output] at h
      dsimp only [sl_cfg] at h
      exact h
    exact h2.eq_of_length (le_antisymm h2.length_le h1.length_le)
  · intro u hu
    rw [hTsplit] at hu
    by_cases h1 : u ≤ (s.drop r).length + 1
    · rw [hstart]
      exact P1.2 u h1
    · by_cases h2 : u ≤ (s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3)
      · obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ : ∃ u', u = (s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + u' :=
          ⟨u - ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1), by omega⟩
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc1]
        exact P2.2 u' (by omega)
      · by_cases h3 : u ≤ (s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
            (2 * a.length + 2)
        · obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ : ∃ u',
              u = (s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) + u' :=
            ⟨u - ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1)), by omega⟩
          rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc2]
          exact P3.2 u' (by omega)
        · by_cases h4 : u ≤ (s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
              (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3)
          · obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ : ∃ u', u = (s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
                (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + u' :=
              ⟨u - ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
                (2 * a.length + 2 + 1)), by omega⟩
            rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc3]
            exact P4.2 u' (by omega)
          · by_cases h5 : u ≤ (s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
                (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1) +
                ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse.length + 1)
            · obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ : ∃ u', u = (s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
                  (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1) + u' :=
                ⟨u - ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
                  (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1)), by omega⟩
              rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc4]
              exact P5.2 u' (by omega)
            · by_cases h6 : u ≤ (s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
                  (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1) +
                  ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse.length + 1 + 1) +
                  (2 * v.length + 2)
              · obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ : ∃ u', u = (s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 +
                    (s.length + 3 + 1) + (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1) +
                    ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse.length + 1 + 1) + u' :=
                  ⟨u - ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
                    (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1) +
                    ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse.length + 1 + 1)), by omega⟩
                rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc5]
                exact P6.2 u' (by omega)
              · by_cases h7 : u ≤ (s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
                    (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1) +
                    ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse.length + 1 + 1) +
                    (2 * v.length + 2 + 1) + ((s.take (2 * a.length + 2 + q)).length + 3)
                · obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ : ∃ u', u = (s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 +
                      (s.length + 3 + 1) + (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1) +
                      ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse.length + 1 + 1) +
                      (2 * v.length + 2 + 1) + u' :=
                    ⟨u - ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
                      (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1) +
                      ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse.length + 1 + 1) +
                      (2 * v.length + 2 + 1)), by omega⟩
                  rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc6]
                  exact P7.2 u' (by omega)
                · obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ : ∃ u', u = (s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 +
                      (s.length + 3 + 1) + (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1) +
                      ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse.length + 1 + 1) +
                      (2 * v.length + 2 + 1) +
                      ((s.take (2 * a.length + 2 + q)).length + 3 + 1) + u' :=
                    ⟨u - ((s.drop r).length + 1 + 1 + (s.length + 3 + 1) +
                      (2 * a.length + 2 + 1) + (q + 3 + 1) +
                      ((List.replicate q true ++ [false]).reverse.length + 1 + 1) +
                      (2 * v.length + 2 + 1) +
                      ((s.take (2 * a.length + 2 + q)).length + 3 + 1)), by omega⟩
                  rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hc7]
                  exact P8.2 u' (by omega)

end Turing

  | 0 => [Fin.elim0]

/-- The fixed serialization of a `k`-work-tape transition table: states in `Fin`

chunk:
/-- The fixed enumeration of the work reads of `k` work tapes: tape `0`
outermost, each read over `none`, `some false`, `some true`. [AB09, §1.4] -/
def workReadsK : (k : ℕ) → List (Fin k → Option Bool)
  | 0 => [Fin.elim0]
  | k + 1 => ([none, some false, some true] : List (Option Bool)).flatMap fun w =>
      (workReadsK k).map fun r => (Fin.cons w r : Fin (k + 1) → Option Bool)

/-- The fixed serialization of a `k`-work-tape transition table: states in `Fin`
order, then the input read, then the work reads in `workReadsK` order,
one `Turing.actionBitsK` record each. [AB09, §1.4] -/

name: tableBitsK
chunk:
/-- The fixed serialization of a `k`-work-tape transition table: states in `Fin`
order, then the input read, then the work reads in `workReadsK` order,
one `Turing.actionBitsK` record each. [AB09, §1.4] -/
def tableBitsK {k n : ℕ}
    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) :
    List Bool :=
  (List.finRange (n + 1)).flatMap fun q =>
    ([none, some false, some true] : List (Option Bool)).flatMap fun inp =>
      (workReadsK k).flatMap fun w => actionBitsK (tr q inp w)

/-! ## The three-valued output summary -/

/-- **The output summary** of an output word, as the content of one tape cell: `none` for the
empty word, `some true` for exactly `[true]`, and `some false` for every other word. The
last class is irreversible. (Formerly private in `CodeSimulator`; it is the cell code of
`Turing.OutSummary` in `SpaceComplexity/ConfigGraph.lean`, see the design note, O4.) -/

name: outputSummary
header:
def outputSummary : List Bool → Option Bool
  | [] => none
  | [true] => some true
  | _ => some false

  | _, some _ => some false

**Proof sketch.** Case on the emission; for an emitted bit, case on the first two letters of

name: outputSummary_append
header:
lemma outputSummary_append (w : List Bool) (b : Option Bool) :
    outputSummary (w ++ b.toList) = summaryEmit (outputSummary w) b
chunk:
/-- Appending one transition's optional emission to an output word updates its summary by
`summaryEmit`, including on a halting transition. (Formerly private in
`CodeSimulator`.)

**Proof sketch.** Case on the emission; for an emitted bit, case on the first two letters of
the word. -/
lemma outputSummary_append (w : List Bool) (b : Option Bool) :
    outputSummary (w ++ b.toList) = summaryEmit (outputSummary w) b := by
  cases b with
  | none => simp [summaryEmit]
  | some b =>
    cases w with
    | nil => cases b <;> rfl
    | cons a w =>
      cases w with
      | nil => cases a <;> cases b <;> rfl
      | cons c w => cases a <;> cases b <;> rfl

/-- The summary's accepting value characterizes the exact singleton output. -/

name: outputSummary_true
header:
lemma outputSummary_true (w : List Bool) :
    outputSummary w = some true ↔ w = [true]
chunk:
/-- The summary's accepting value characterizes the exact singleton output. -/
lemma outputSummary_true (w : List Bool) :
    outputSummary w = some true ↔ w = [true] := by
  cases w with
  | nil => simp [outputSummary]
  | cons b w =>
    cases w with
    | nil => cases b <;> simp [outputSummary]
    | cons c w => cases b <;> simp [outputSummary]

/-- Once the summary is other, no subsequent emission can repair it. -/

name: summaryEmit_other
header:
lemma summaryEmit_other (b : Option Bool) :
    summaryEmit (some false) b = some false
chunk:
/-- Once the summary is other, no subsequent emission can repair it. -/
lemma summaryEmit_other (b : Option Bool) :
    summaryEmit (some false) b = some false := by
  cases b with
  | none => rfl
  | some b => cases b <;> rfl

/-- **A blank summary cell records one emission** (additive): updating the empty summary by an
emission gives that emission. Hence a host that blanks the summary cell before a round finds
the round's emission `a.output` there afterwards (the summary clause of `roundTM_effect`), and
can forward it verbatim or append it to a buffer, with the step block unchanged.

**Proof sketch.** Case on the emission. -/

name: summaryEmit_none
header: lemma summaryEmit_none (b : Option Bool) : summaryEmit none b = b
chunk:
/-- **A blank summary cell records one emission** (additive): updating the empty summary by an

lemma summaryEmit_none (b : Option Bool) : summaryEmit none b = b := by

/-! ## Layout of the auxiliary tapes and the fixed-field reader -/

/-- The number of fixed bits of a `k`-tape transition record before its variable-length
successor field: two for the input move, four per work tape, two for the emission.
(`h1RecordWidth`.) -/

name: recordWidth
header: abbrev recordWidth (k : ℕ) : ℕ
chunk:
/-- The number of fixed bits of a `k`-tape transition record before its variable-length
successor field: two for the input move, four per work tape, two for the emission.
(`h1RecordWidth`.) -/
abbrev recordWidth (k : ℕ) : ℕ := 4 * k + 4

/-- The finite control of the fixed-field reader: the number of bits read so far and a
fixed-size bit buffer; `none` is its live exit. It depends only on `k`, never on the coded
state count. (`h1RecordState`.) -/

name: RecordState
header: abbrev RecordState (k : ℕ)
chunk:
/-- The finite control of the fixed-field reader: the number of bits read so far and a
fixed-size bit buffer; `none` is its live exit. It depends only on `k`, never on the coded
state count. (`h1RecordState`.) -/
abbrev RecordState (k : ℕ) :=
  Option (Fin (recordWidth k + 1) × (Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool))

/-- Every mirrored work tape is distinct from the record tape. -/

name: mirror_ne_table
header:
private lemma mirror_ne_table (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) :
    Fin.castAdd 2 i ≠ tableTape k
chunk:
/-- Every mirrored work tape is distinct from the record tape. -/
private lemma mirror_ne_table (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) :
    Fin.castAdd 2 i ≠ tableTape k := by
  intro h
  have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
  have hi := i.isLt
  dsimp [tableTape] at hv
  omega

/-- The summary cell and the record head lie on distinct auxiliary tapes. -/

name: summary_ne_table
header: private lemma summary_ne_table (k : ℕ) : summaryTape k ≠ tableTape k
chunk:
/-- The summary cell and the record head lie on distinct auxiliary tapes. -/
private lemma summary_ne_table (k : ℕ) : summaryTape k ≠ tableTape k := by
  intro h
  have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
  dsimp [summaryTape, tableTape] at hv
  omega

/-- Interpret the fixed fields with the public record reader. A dummy halt
field makes the parsed successor irrelevant; the actual successor remains
on the record tape for the next component. Only canonized records are used. -/

name: payload
header:
private def payload (k : ℕ) (bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool) :
    Action k Bool (Fin 1)
chunk:
/-- Interpret the fixed fields with the public record reader. A dummy halt
field makes the parsed successor irrelevant; the actual successor remains
on the record tape for the next component. Only canonized records are used. -/
private def payload (k : ℕ) (bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool) :
    Action k Bool (Fin 1) :=
  ((codeReadActionK k 0 (List.ofFn bits ++ [false])).map Prod.fst).getD
    ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, none⟩

/-- Apply the fixed fields to the mirrored bank and native input head,
updating the summary cell instead of physically emitting. The record tape
and both auxiliary heads remain fixed, and the next control is a live exit. -/

name: applyPayload
header:
private def applyPayload {k : ℕ} (a : Action k Bool (Fin 1)) (s : Option Bool) :
    Action (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k)
chunk:
/-- Apply the fixed fields to the mirrored bank and native input head,
updating the summary cell instead of physically emitting. The record tape
and both auxiliary heads remain fixed, and the next control is a live exit. -/
private def applyPayload {k : ℕ} (a : Action k Bool (Fin 1)) (s : Option Bool) :
    Action (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) :=
  ⟨a.inputTape, Fin.addCases a.workTapes
    (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then (none, 0) else (some (summaryEmit s a.output), 0)),
    none, some none⟩

/-- **The fixed-field reader**: read the `4k + 4` fixed bits of the record under the table head
into finite control, then execute them on the mirrored bank and the native input head and
update the summary cell, exiting live with the table head at the successor field.
[AB09, §1.4.1, Theorem 1.9] (`h1RecordTM`.) No catalog row reads a fixed-length,
non-delimited prefix into finite control: the two-pass scan requires delimiters. -/

name: recordTM
header:
def recordTM (k : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) where
  q₀
chunk:
/-- **The fixed-field reader**: read the `4k + 4` fixed bits of the record under the table head
into finite control, then execute them on the mirrored bank and the native input head and
update the summary cell, exiting live with the table head at the successor field.
[AB09, §1.4.1, Theorem 1.9] (`h1RecordTM`.) No catalog row reads a fixed-length,
non-delimited prefix into finite control: the two-pass scan requires delimiters. -/
def recordTM (k : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) where
  q₀ := some (0, fun _ => false)
  tr := fun q _ w => match q with
    | none => inputMoveAction 0 none
    | some (p, bits) =>
      if h : p.val < recordWidth k then
        tapeAction (tableTape k) 0 none .pos
          (some (⟨p.val + 1, by omega⟩,
            Function.update bits ⟨p.val, h⟩ ((w (tableTape k)).getD false)))
      else applyPayload (payload k bits) (w (summaryTape k))

/-- Configuration during the fixed-prefix read, with the first `r` bits
installed in finite control and every tape content unchanged. -/

name: readCfg
header:
private def readCfg {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool) (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ recordWidth k) :
    Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x
chunk:
/-- Configuration during the fixed-prefix read, with the first `r` bits
installed in finite control and every tape content unchanged. -/
private def readCfg {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool) (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ recordWidth k) :
    Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x :=
  { d with
    state := some (some (⟨r, by omega⟩, fun i => if i.val < r then bits i else false))
    workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
      (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) }

/-- The public record reader recovers exactly the fixed action fields from
their finite buffer, regardless of the actual successor's state space.

**Proof sketch.** The movement, work actions and emission occupy exactly
`4k + 4` bits. Replace only the remaining successor field by the halt tag,
then invoke `codeReadActionK_append` at the one-state type. -/

name: payload_correct
header:
private lemma payload_correct {k n : ℕ} (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool)
    (hbits : List.ofFn bits = (actionBitsK a).take (recordWidth k)) :
    payload k bits = ⟨a.inputTape, a.workTapes, a.output, none⟩
chunk:
/-- The public record reader recovers exactly the fixed action fields from
their finite buffer, regardless of the actual successor's state space.

**Proof sketch.** The movement, work actions and emission occupy exactly
`4k + 4` bits. Replace only the remaining successor field by the halt tag,
then invoke `codeReadActionK_append` at the one-state type. -/
private lemma payload_correct {k n : ℕ} (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool)
    (hbits : List.ofFn bits = (actionBitsK a).take (recordWidth k)) :
    payload k bits = ⟨a.inputTape, a.workTapes, a.output, none⟩ := by
  have moves (s : SignType) : (signBits s).length = 2 := by cases s <;> rfl
  have writes (b : Option (Option Bool)) : (optOptBoolBits b).length = 2 := by
    cases b with
    | none => rfl
    | some b => cases b with
      | none => rfl
      | some b => cases b <;> rfl
  have emits (b : Option Bool) : (optBoolBits b).length = 2 := by
    cases b with
    | none => rfl
    | some b => cases b <;> rfl
  let fixed := signBits a.inputTape ++
    (List.finRange k).flatMap (fun i => optOptBoolBits (a.workTapes i).1 ++
      signBits (a.workTapes i).2) ++ optBoolBits a.output
  have plen : fixed.length = recordWidth k := by
    simp [fixed, recordWidth, List.length_flatMap, moves, writes, emits]
    omega
  have he : List.ofFn bits ++ [false] =
      actionBitsK (⟨a.inputTape, a.workTapes, a.output, none⟩ : Action k Bool (Fin 1)) := by
    rw [hbits]
    change (fixed ++ optStateBits a.state).take (recordWidth k) ++ [false] =
      fixed ++ [false]
    rw [← plen, List.take_left]
  have hp := codeReadActionK_append
    (⟨a.inputTape, a.workTapes, a.output, none⟩ : Action k Bool (Fin 1)) []
  simp only [List.append_nil] at hp
  simp only [payload, he, hp, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some]

/-- The physical reader consumes any permitted prefix in exactly its length,
without changing the native input, any work-tape cell, or the physical output.
Only the record head advances. This is a framed statement: all unmentioned
tape cells, mirrored tape positions, and the prior output may be arbitrary.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the number of consumed bits. The public single-tape
movement law advances the record head; updating the next finite buffer slot
extends precisely the prefix already read. There is no delimiter assumption. -/

name: recordTM_read
header:
private lemma recordTM_read {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ i : Fin (recordWidth k),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + i.val) = some (bits i))
    (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ recordWidth k) :
    (recordTM k).runFrom d r = readCfg d bits r hr
chunk:
/-- The physical reader consumes any permitted prefix in exactly its length,
without changing the native input, any work-tape cell, or the physical output.
Only the record head advances. This is a framed statement: all unmentioned
tape cells, mirrored tape positions, and the prior output may be arbitrary.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the number of consumed bits. The public single-tape
movement law advances the record head; updating the next finite buffer slot
extends precisely the prefix already read. There is no delimiter assumption. -/
private lemma recordTM_read {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ i : Fin (recordWidth k),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + i.val) = some (bits i))
    (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ recordWidth k) :
    (recordTM k).runFrom d r = readCfg d bits r hr := by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [readCfg, hq, recordTM]
  | succ r ih =>
    have hlt : r < recordWidth k := by omega
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega)]
    have hread : (readCfg d bits r (by omega)).workTapeSymbols (tableTape k) =
        some (bits ⟨r, hlt⟩) := by
      simpa [readCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols] using hw ⟨r, hlt⟩
    have hbuffer : Function.update (fun i : Fin (recordWidth k) =>
        if i.val < r then bits i else false) ⟨r, hlt⟩ (bits ⟨r, hlt⟩) =
        fun i => if i.val < r + 1 then bits i else false := by
      funext i
      by_cases he : i = ⟨r, hlt⟩
      · subst i
        simp
      · have hv : i.val ≠ r := fun h => he (Fin.ext h)
        rw [Function.update_of_ne he]
        by_cases hi : i.val < r <;> simp [hi, show (i.val < r + 1) ↔ (i.val < r) by omega]
    rw [step_of_tapeAction_move (recordTM k) (readCfg d bits r (by omega))
      (q' := some (⟨r + 1, by omega⟩,
        fun i => if i.val < r + 1 then bits i else false))
      (tableTape k) 0 .pos rfl (by
        simp only [recordTM, dif_pos hlt, hread, Option.getD_some, hbuffer])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · rfl
    · simp [readCfg]
    · rfl
    · funext i
      by_cases he : i = tableTape k
      · subst i
        simp [readCfg, Nat.cast_add, SignType.pos_eq_one, add_assoc]
      · simp [readCfg, he]
    · rfl

/-- A selected, canonized record executes its fixed action fields in exactly
`4k + 5` physical steps. The table head then points at its successor field.
The equality includes the native-input movement, all mirrored writes/moves,
the finite summary update, and preservation of the physical output prefix.

**Proof sketch.** Apply the prefix trace at its full width. Its finite buffer
is the record's fixed prefix, so `payload_correct` identifies the public
reader's result. The next transition executes that payload silently. -/

name: recordTM_execute
header:
private lemma recordTM_execute {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ i : Fin (recordWidth k),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + i.val) = some (bits i))
    (hbits : List.ofFn bits = (actionBitsK a).take (recordWidth k)) :
    (recordTM k).runFrom d (recordWidth k + 1) =
      (applyPayload (⟨a.inputTape, a.workTapes, a.output, none⟩ : Action k Bool (Fin 1))
        (d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k))).apply
        (readCfg d bits (recordWidth k) le_rfl)
chunk:
/-- A selected, canonized record executes its fixed action fields in exactly
`4k + 5` physical steps. The table head then points at its successor field.
The equality includes the native-input movement, all mirrored writes/moves,
the finite summary update, and preservation of the physical output prefix.

**Proof sketch.** Apply the prefix trace at its full width. Its finite buffer
is the record's fixed prefix, so `payload_correct` identifies the public
reader's result. The next transition executes that payload silently. -/
private lemma recordTM_execute {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ i : Fin (recordWidth k),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + i.val) = some (bits i))
    (hbits : List.ofFn bits = (actionBitsK a).take (recordWidth k)) :
    (recordTM k).runFrom d (recordWidth k + 1) =
      (applyPayload (⟨a.inputTape, a.workTapes, a.output, none⟩ : Action k Bool (Fin 1))
        (d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k))).apply
        (readCfg d bits (recordWidth k) le_rfl) := by
  rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', recordTM_read d bits hq hw _ le_rfl]
  have hbuf : (fun i : Fin (recordWidth k) =>
      if i.val < recordWidth k then bits i else false) = bits := by
    funext i
    exact if_pos i.isLt
  have hne := summary_ne_table k
  have hs : (readCfg d bits (recordWidth k) le_rfl).workTapeSymbols
      (summaryTape k) = d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) := by
    simp [readCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, hne]
  simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, readCfg, recordTM, lt_self_iff_false,
    hbuf, payload_correct a bits hbits]
  change (applyPayload _
    ((readCfg d bits (recordWidth k) le_rfl).workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k))).apply _ = _
  rw [hs]

heads and the native input head remain at their starting positions until the
single payload transition, then move exactly as the source action does. Thus
they stay between their start and end positions, with displacement at most
one. The table head advances by the consumed fixed prefix; the summary head
never moves. The table head is not yet restored to a round home.

**Proof sketch.** Before the payload, project `recordTM_read`; at the payload,
project `recordTM_execute`. Use the public one-action work-head bound. The
native input movement is clamped at either boundary. -/

      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + i.val) = some (bits i))

chunk:
/-- Addendum 1's head envelope for the selected-record component. Mirrored
heads and the native input head remain at their starting positions until the
single payload transition, then move exactly as the source action does. Thus
they stay between their start and end positions, with displacement at most
one. The table head advances by the consumed fixed prefix; the summary head
never moves. The table head is not yet restored to a round home.

**Proof sketch.** Before the payload, project `recordTM_read`; at the payload,
project `recordTM_execute`. Use the public one-action work-head bound. The
native input movement is clamped at either boundary. -/
private lemma recordTM_envelope {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ i : Fin (recordWidth k),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + i.val) = some (bits i))
    (hbits : List.ofFn bits = (actionBitsK a).take (recordWidth k)) :
    ∀ u ≤ recordWidth k + 1,
      let e := (recordTM k).runFrom d u
      (∀ i : Fin k, e.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) =
        d.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) +
          if u = recordWidth k + 1 then ((a.workTapes i).2 : ℤ) else 0) ∧
      e.inputPos = (if u = recordWidth k + 1 then moveInputPos d.inputPos a.inputTape
        else d.inputPos) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin (k + 2), |e.workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤
        if j.val < k then 1 else (recordWidth k : ℤ)) ∧
      |(e.inputPos.val : ℤ) - d.inputPos.val| ≤ 1 ∧
      e.workTapePos (tableTape k) = d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + min u (recordWidth k) ∧
      e.workTapePos (summaryTape k) = d.workTapePos (summaryTape k) := by
  intro u hu
  dsimp only
  by_cases hend : u = recordWidth k + 1
  · subst u
    rw [recordTM_execute d a bits hq hw hbits]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      simp [applyPayload, readCfg, mirror_ne_table k i]
    · simp [applyPayload, readCfg]
    · intro j
      refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
      · simpa [readCfg, mirror_ne_table k i, i.isLt] using
          workTapePos_apply_le
            (applyPayload (⟨a.inputTape, a.workTapes, a.output, none⟩ : Action k Bool (Fin 1))
              (d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k)))
            (readCfg d bits (recordWidth k) le_rfl) (Fin.castAdd 2 i)
      · fin_cases i <;>
          simp [applyPayload, readCfg, tableTape, recordWidth, abs_le] <;> omega
    · change |((moveInputPos d.inputPos a.inputTape).val : ℤ) - d.inputPos.val| ≤ 1
      have hp := d.inputPos.isLt
      cases a.inputTape <;> simp only [moveInputPos, SignType.cast] <;>
        split <;> simp_all [abs_le] <;> omega
    · simp [applyPayload, readCfg, tableTape]
    · simp [applyPayload, readCfg, summaryTape, tableTape]
  · have hread : u ≤ recordWidth k := by omega
    rw [recordTM_read d bits hq hw u hread]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      simp [readCfg, mirror_ne_table k i, hend]
    · simp [readCfg, hend]
    · intro j
      by_cases hj : j = tableTape k
      · subst j
        simpa [readCfg, tableTape, abs_of_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg u)] using
          (show (u : ℤ) ≤ recordWidth k by omega)
      · simp [readCfg, hj]
        split <;> omega
    · simp [readCfg]
    · simp [readCfg, min_eq_left hread]
    · simp [readCfg, summary_ne_table k]

name: recordFinTM
header:
def recordFinTM (k : ℕ) : FinTM Bool where
  k

/-- The fixed-field reader as a finite binary machine. (`h1RecordFinTM`.) -/
def recordFinTM (k : ℕ) : FinTM Bool where
  k := k + 2
  State := RecordState k
  tm := recordTM k

/-- **The fixed-field reader's contract** (`h1Record_effect`). Started on a
configuration whose first `k` work tapes and input head mirror a source configuration `c`,
whose summary cell holds the summary of `c`'s output, and whose table head is at a record of
`a` (fixed fields `bits`): after exactly `4k + 5` steps the reader is at its live exit, the
mirrored bank and input head are those of `a.apply c`, the summary cell is the summary of
`(a.apply c)`'s output, and the physical output is unchanged; the exit is not reached earlier;
the record is at least that long; and at every time each mirrored and input head is at its
start (or, at the last step, its action endpoint), every head moves at most one cell
(mirrored, input) or `4k + 4` cells (auxiliary), the table head has advanced `min u (4k + 4)`
cells and the summary head is fixed. [AB09, §1.4.1, Theorem 1.9]

**Proof sketch.** Project the proved execution equality onto the input, mirrored bank and
summary cell. The summary identity is `outputSummary_append`, including when the source
action halts. Before the last step the prefix trace has a reading state, never the live
exit. -/

name: recordTM_effect
header:
lemma recordTM_effect {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ i : Fin (recordWidth k),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + i.val) = some (bits i))
    (hbits : List.ofFn bits = (actionBitsK a).take (recordWidth k))
    (hin : d.inputPos = c.inputPos)
    (htapes : ∀ i : Fin k, d.workTapes (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = c.workTapes i)
    (hheads : ∀ i : Fin k, d.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = c.workTapePos i)
    (hsum : d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = outputSummary c.output) :
    let e

/-- **The fixed-field reader's contract** (`h1Record_effect`). Started on a
configuration whose first `k` work tapes and input head mirror a source configuration `c`,
whose summary cell holds the summary of `c`'s output, and whose table head is at a record of
`a` (fixed fields `bits`): after exactly `4k + 5` steps the reader is at its live exit, the
mirrored bank and input head are those of `a.apply c`, the summary cell is the summary of
`(a.apply c)`'s output, and the physical output is unchanged; the exit is not reached earlier;
the record is at least that long; and at every time each mirrored and input head is at its
start (or, at the last step, its action endpoint), every head moves at most one cell
(mirrored, input) or `4k + 4` cells (auxiliary), the table head has advanced `min u (4k + 4)`
cells and the summary head is fixed. [AB09, §1.4.1, Theorem 1.9]

**Proof sketch.** Project the proved execution equality onto the input, mirrored bank and
summary cell. The summary identity is `outputSummary_append`, including when the source
action halts. Before the last step the prefix trace has a reading state, never the live
exit. -/
lemma recordTM_effect {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (bits : Fin (recordWidth k) → Bool)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ i : Fin (recordWidth k),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + i.val) = some (bits i))
    (hbits : List.ofFn bits = (actionBitsK a).take (recordWidth k))
    (hin : d.inputPos = c.inputPos)
    (htapes : ∀ i : Fin k, d.workTapes (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = c.workTapes i)
    (hheads : ∀ i : Fin k, d.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = c.workTapePos i)
    (hsum : d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = outputSummary c.output) :
    let e := (recordTM k).runFrom d (recordWidth k + 1)
    e.state = some none ∧ e.inputPos = (a.apply c).inputPos ∧
      (∀ i : Fin k, e.workTapes (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = (a.apply c).workTapes i ∧
        e.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = (a.apply c).workTapePos i) ∧
      e.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = outputSummary (a.apply c).output ∧
      e.output = d.output ∧
      (∀ u < recordWidth k + 1, ((recordTM k).runFrom d u).state ≠ some none) ∧
      recordWidth k + 1 ≤ (actionBitsK a).length ∧
      (∀ u ≤ recordWidth k + 1,
        let f := (recordTM k).runFrom d u
        (∀ i : Fin k, f.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) =
          d.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) +
            if u = recordWidth k + 1 then ((a.workTapes i).2 : ℤ) else 0) ∧
        f.inputPos = (if u = recordWidth k + 1 then moveInputPos d.inputPos a.inputTape
          else d.inputPos) ∧
        (∀ j : Fin (k + 2), |f.workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤
          if j.val < k then 1 else (recordWidth k : ℤ)) ∧
        |(f.inputPos.val : ℤ) - d.inputPos.val| ≤ 1 ∧
        f.workTapePos (tableTape k) =
          d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + min u (recordWidth k) ∧
        f.workTapePos (summaryTape k) = d.workTapePos (summaryTape k)) := by
  dsimp only
  have he := recordTM_execute d a bits hq hw hbits
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, codeActionK_length a,
    recordTM_envelope d a bits hq hw hbits⟩
  · rw [he]
    rfl
  · rw [he]
    exact congrArg (fun p => moveInputPos p a.inputTape) hin
  · intro i
    rw [he]
    simp [applyPayload, readCfg, Fin.addCases_left, mirror_ne_table k i, htapes i, hheads i]
  · rw [he]
    simp [Cfg.workTapeSymbols, applyPayload, readCfg, summaryTape,
      ← hsum, outputSummary_append]
  · rw [he]
    simp [applyPayload, readCfg]
  · intro u hu
    rw [recordTM_read d bits hq hw u (by omega)]
    simp [readCfg]

/-- Every vector of `k` work reads occurs in the fixed enumeration `workReadsK k`.
(`h1WorkReads_mem`.)

**Proof sketch.** Induct on `k`, following the tape-zero-first recursion: the head read is one
of the three symbols, and the tail occurs by induction. -/

name: mem_workReadsK
header:
lemma mem_workReadsK (k : ℕ) (w : Fin k → Option Bool) :
    w ∈ workReadsK k
chunk:
/-- Every vector of `k` work reads occurs in the fixed enumeration `workReadsK k`.
(`h1WorkReads_mem`.)

**Proof sketch.** Induct on `k`, following the tape-zero-first recursion: the head read is one
of the three symbols, and the tail occurs by induction. -/
lemma mem_workReadsK (k : ℕ) (w : Fin k → Option Bool) :
    w ∈ workReadsK k := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have hw : w = Fin.elim0 := funext (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)
    simp [workReadsK, hw]
  | succ k ih =>
    apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
    refine ⟨w 0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · cases w 0 with
      | none => simp
      | some b => cases b <;> simp
    · apply List.mem_map.mpr
      refine ⟨Fin.tail w, ih (Fin.tail w), ?_⟩
      exact Fin.cons_self_tail w

lemma length_workReadsK (k : ℕ) : (workReadsK k).length = 3 ^ k := by

private def readRank {k : ℕ} (inp : Option Bool) (w : Fin k → Option Bool) :
