fixed two-cell move through the public phase host. All five segments preserve
the source action's final simulated heads and exclude both round anchors until
the last dispatch. The exact cost counts every delimiter and dispatch. -/
private lemma roundTM_restore {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (table before tail word pre : List Bool) (live : Bool) (ht : table = before ++ tail) :
    RoundSpan c a
      (atKey (roundData (a.apply c) table (outputSummary (a.apply c).output) word
        before.length (2 + word.length) pre) (.tableTail live) .run)
      ((roundData (a.apply c) table (outputSummary (a.apply c).output) word 0 0 pre).mapState
        (fun _ => exit k live))
      (tail.length + table.length + word.length + 15) := by
  let data := fun tp sp => roundData (a.apply c) table (outputSummary (a.apply c).output) word tp sp
    pre
  let d0 := data before.length (2 + word.length)
  let d1 := data (table.length + 1) (2 + word.length)
  let d2 := data 0 (2 + word.length)
  let d3 := data 0 (word.length + 3)
  let d4 := data 0 2

  let s2 := d2.mapState (fun _ => SeekPhase.run)

    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
    · simp [s0, d0, d1, data, roundData, Cfg.mapState, mirror_ne_table k i]
    · fin_cases i <;> simp [s0, d0, d1, data, roundData, Cfg.mapState, tableTape, tableLength,
      Nat.cast_add, add_assoc]

      simp [red, ne]) (by
      intro u hu
      apply roundWindow_frame c a (roundData_window c a table _ word before.length (2 + word.length)

      · intro i

          (Fin.castAdd 2 i) u hu)
  have tableBack := skipBackTM_run_ofCfg (tableTape k) table s1 rfl (by
    intro z _ _
    simp [s1, d1, data, roundData, Cfg.mapState, tableTape])
  have tableBackEnd : (skipBackTM (k + 2) (tableTape k)).runFrom s1 (table.length + 3) =

    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
    · simp [s1, d1, d2, data, roundData, Cfg.mapState, mirror_ne_table k i]
    · fin_cases i <;> simp [s1, d1, d2, data, roundData, Cfg.mapState, tableTape]
  have p1 := roundTM_phase c a (.tableHome live) (by intro h; cases h) (by intro h; cases h) s1
    (d2.mapState (fun _ => SeekPhase.done)) _ tableBackEnd .done rfl ⟨.stateGap live, .run⟩
    (by simp [red]) (by
      intro u hu r hr
      have ne : r ≠ .done := fun eq => (tableBack.2.1 u hu) (hr.trans (congrArg some eq))
      simp [red, ne]) (by
      intro u hu
      apply roundWindow_frame c a (roundData_window c a table _ word (table.length + 1) (2 +
        word.length) pre true)
      · exact MultiTapeTM.inputPos_runFrom_of_inputTape_eq_zero (skipBackTM (k + 2) (tableTape k))
          (by intro r inp work; cases r <;> cases h : work (tableTape k) <;> simp [skipBackTM,
            h, tapeAction, inputMoveAction]) s1 u
      · intro i
        simpa only [mirror_ne_table k i, ↓reduceIte, s1, Cfg.mapState] using tableBack.2.2
          (Fin.castAdd 2 i) u hu)
  have stateGap := skipTM_run_ofCfg (summaryTape k) [] s2 rfl (by
    intro z hz hz'
    have hz0 : z = 0 := by simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero] at hz'; omega
    subst z
    have cell := roundData_stateCell (a.apply c) table (outputSummary (a.apply c).output) word 0 (2
      + word.length) pre
      word.length (by omega)
    simpa [s2, d2, data, roundData, Cfg.mapState, summaryTape, FinTM.bufferTape_nat] using cell)
  have stateGapEnd : (skipTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)).runFrom s2 (([] : List Bool).length + 1) =
      d3.mapState (fun _ => SeekPhase.done) := by
    rw [stateGap.1]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> try rfl
    funext j
    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
    · simp [s2, d2, d3, data, roundData, Cfg.mapState, mirror_ne_summary k i]
    · fin_cases i <;> simp [s2, d2, d3, data, roundData, Cfg.mapState, summaryTape]; omega
  have p2 := roundTM_phase c a (.stateGap live) (by intro h; cases h) (by intro h; cases h) s2
    (d3.mapState (fun _ => SeekPhase.done)) _ stateGapEnd .done rfl ⟨.stateRestore live, .run⟩
    (by simp [red]) (by
      intro u hu r hr
      have ne : r ≠ .done := fun eq => (stateGap.2.1 u hu) (hr.trans (congrArg some eq))
      simp [red, ne]) (by
      intro u hu
      apply roundWindow_frame c a (roundData_window c a table _ word 0 (2 + word.length) pre true)
      · exact MultiTapeTM.inputPos_runFrom_of_inputTape_eq_zero (skipTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k))
          (by intro r inp work; cases r <;> cases h : work (summaryTape k) <;> simp [skipTM, h,
            tapeAction, inputMoveAction]) s2 u
      · intro i
        simpa only [mirror_ne_summary k i, ↓reduceIte, s2, Cfg.mapState] using stateGap.2.2
          (Fin.castAdd 2 i) u hu)
  have stateBack := skipBackTM_run_ofCfg (summaryTape k) word s3 rfl (by
    intro z hz _
    have cell := roundData_stateCell (a.apply c) table (outputSummary (a.apply c).output) word 0
      (word.length + 3) pre z hz
    convert cell using 1; simp [s3, d3, data, Cfg.mapState, roundData, summaryTape])
  have stateBackEnd : (skipBackTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)).runFrom s3 (word.length + 3) =
      d4.mapState (fun _ => SeekPhase.done) := by
    rw [stateBack.1]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> try rfl
    funext j
    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
    · simp [s3, d3, d4, data, roundData, Cfg.mapState, mirror_ne_summary k i]
    · fin_cases i <;> simp [s3, d3, d4, data, roundData, Cfg.mapState, summaryTape]
  have p3 := roundTM_phase c a (.stateRestore live) (by intro h; cases h) (by intro h; cases h) s3
    (d4.mapState (fun _ => SeekPhase.done)) _ stateBackEnd .done rfl ⟨.finish live, (0 : Fin 3)⟩
    (by simp [red]) (by
      intro u hu r hr
      have ne : r ≠ .done := fun eq => (stateBack.2.1 u hu) (hr.trans (congrArg some eq))
      simp [red, ne]) (by
      intro u hu
      apply roundWindow_frame c a (roundData_window c a table _ word 0 (word.length + 3) pre true)
      · exact MultiTapeTM.inputPos_runFrom_of_inputTape_eq_zero (skipBackTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k))
          (by intro r inp work; cases r <;> cases h : work (summaryTape k) <;> simp
            [skipBackTM, h, tapeAction, inputMoveAction]) s3 u
      · intro i
        simpa only [mirror_ne_summary k i, ↓reduceIte, s3, Cfg.mapState] using stateBack.2.2
          (Fin.castAdd 2 i) u hu)
  have moveEnd : (twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .neg).runFrom s4 2 = d5.mapState (fun _ => (2 :
    Fin 3)) := by
    rw [twoMoveTM_run _ _ s4 rfl 2 le_rfl]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> try rfl
    funext j
    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
    · simp [s4, d4, d5, data, roundData, Cfg.mapState, mirror_ne_summary k i]
    · fin_cases i <;> simp [s4, d4, d5, data, roundData, Cfg.mapState, summaryTape]
  have p4 := roundTM_phase c a (.finish live) (by intro h; cases h) (by intro h; cases h) s4
    (d5.mapState (fun _ => (2 : Fin 3))) 2 moveEnd 2 rfl (exit k live)
    (by simp [red]) (by
      intro u hu r hr
      rw [twoMoveTM_run _ _ s4 rfl u (by omega)] at hr
      have vr : r.val = u := congrArg Fin.val (Option.some.inj hr).symm
      have ne : r ≠ 2 := by intro bad; subst r; omega
      simp [red, ne]) (by
      intro u hu
      rw [twoMoveTM_run _ _ s4 rfl u hu]
      refine ⟨Or.inr rfl, fun i => Or.inr ?_⟩
      simp [s4, d4, data, roundData, Cfg.mapState, mirror_ne_summary k i])
  have combined := RoundSpan.add c a (RoundSpan.add c a (RoundSpan.add c a (RoundSpan.add
    c a p0 p1) p2) p3) p4
  have cost : (((tail.length + 1 + 1) + (table.length + 3 + 1) + (([] : List Bool).length + 1 +
    1)) +
      (word.length + 3 + 1)) + (2 + 1) = tail.length + table.length + word.length + 15 := by
        simp; omega
  simpa only [atKey, s0, d0, s1, s2, s3, s4, d1, d2, d3, d4, d5, data, Cfg.mapState, roundData,
    cost]
    using combined

/-- Lift the proved physical selector into the full round. The result names
its exact table cut, retaining both the state-size ledger and first-exit cut.

**Proof sketch.** Apply `seekTM_select` to the canonical frame with both auxiliary heads at
`0`. Its table decomposition, with the frame's input and mirrored reads rewritten to `c`'s,
is the claimed cut, and its bound plus the one dispatch gives `5·|tableBitsK tr| + 4`. Lift
the selector run by `roundTM_phase` at the `lookup` key: the guard is the selector's
first-exit cut, since `red` redirects only its `done` control, and the window follows
from its frame (input and mirrored heads fixed) by `roundWindow_frame`. Finally
`roundData_shift` rewrites the shifted endpoint as the canonical frame at `before.length`
and `q + 2`. -/

name: roundTM_lookup
header:
private lemma roundTM_lookup {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (pre : List Bool) :
    let a
chunk:
/-- Lift the proved physical selector into the full round. The result names
its exact table cut, retaining both the state-size ledger and first-exit cut.

**Proof sketch.** Apply `seekTM_select` to the canonical frame with both auxiliary heads at
`0`. Its table decomposition, with the frame's input and mirrored reads rewritten to `c`'s,
is the claimed cut, and its bound plus the one dispatch gives `5·|tableBitsK tr| + 4`. Lift
the selector run by `roundTM_phase` at the `lookup` key: the guard is the selector's
first-exit cut, since `red` redirects only its `done` control, and the window follows
from its frame (input and mirrored heads fixed) by `roundWindow_frame`. Finally
`roundData_shift` rewrites the shifted endpoint as the canonical frame at `before.length`
and `q + 2`. -/
private lemma roundTM_lookup {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (pre : List Bool) :
    let a := tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols
    ∃ (before tail : List Bool) (T : ℕ),
      tableBitsK tr = before ++ actionBitsK a ++ tail ∧ q.val ≤ before.length ∧
      T ≤ 5 * (tableBitsK tr).length + 4 ∧
      RoundSpan c a
        (atKey (roundData c (tableBitsK tr) (outputSummary c.output) (unaryFin q) 0 0 pre)
          .lookup (seekTM k).q₀)
        (atKey (roundData c (tableBitsK tr) (outputSummary c.output) (unaryFin q)
          before.length (q.val + 2) pre) .stateTail .run) T := by
  let a := tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols
  let d := roundData c (tableBitsK tr) (outputSummary c.output) (unaryFin q) 0 0 pre
  obtain ⟨before, tail, T, split, size, _, bound, run, cut, frame⟩ :=
    seekTM_select tr q (outputSummary c.output) d rfl
      (by simp [d, roundData, tableTape]) (by simp [d, roundData, tableTape])
      (by simp [d, roundData, summaryTape]) (by simp [d, roundData, summaryTape])
  refine ⟨before, tail, T + 1, ?_, size, by omega, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [d, roundData, Cfg.inputSymbol, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, Fin.addCases_left] using split
  · have lifted := roundTM_phase c a .lookup (by decide) (by decide)
      (seekCfg d .observe) (seekCfg (seekShift d before.length (q.val + 2)) .done)
      T run ⟨none, .done⟩ rfl ⟨.stateTail, .run⟩ (by simp [red]) (by
        intro u hu r hr
        have ne : r ≠ ⟨none, .done⟩ := fun eq => cut u hu (hr.trans (congrArg some eq))
        simp [red, ne]) (by
        intro u hu
        have hf := frame u hu
        exact roundWindow_frame c a (roundData_window c a (tableBitsK tr)
          (outputSummary c.output) (unaryFin q) 0 0 pre false) hf.1
          (fun i => hf.2.2.2 _ (mirror_ne_table k i) (mirror_ne_summary k i)))
    have shifted : seekShift d before.length (q.val + 2) =
        roundData c (tableBitsK tr) (outputSummary c.output) (unaryFin q) before.length (q.val + 2)
          pre := by
      simpa only [d, zero_add, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
        roundData_shift c (tableBitsK tr) (outputSummary c.output) (unaryFin q) 0 0 pre
          before.length (q.val + 2)
    rw [shifted] at lifted
    have hq0 : (seekTM k).q₀ = ⟨none, .observe⟩ := phaseHostTM_q₀ _ _ _
    simpa only [atKey, seekCfg, d, Cfg.mapState, roundData, hq0] using lifted

/-- Exact complete-round execution from a canonical data frame. The cost
is bounded by fifty times the table length plus one, uniformly in the state
count, input, and simulated time. Both continuation and halt use live exits.

**Proof sketch.** Join lookup, preparation, inherited payload execution,
successor copy, and restoration. The one entry dispatch is separate so the
strict interior excludes both round anchors. The serializer cut pays for the
old unary state, selected record, suffix scan, and new unary state; the
remaining constants count dispatches and delimiter cells. -/

name: roundTM_canonical
header:
private lemma roundTM_canonical {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (pre : List Bool) :
    let a
chunk:
/-- Exact complete-round execution from a canonical data frame. The cost
is bounded by fifty times the table length plus one, uniformly in the state
count, input, and simulated time. Both continuation and halt use live exits.

**Proof sketch.** Join lookup, preparation, inherited payload execution,
successor copy, and restoration. The one entry dispatch is separate so the
strict interior excludes both round anchors. The serializer cut pays for the
old unary state, selected record, suffix scan, and new unary state; the
remaining constants count dispatches and delimiter cells. -/
private lemma roundTM_canonical {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (pre : List Bool) :
    let a := tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols
    let start :=
      atKey (roundData c (tableBitsK tr) (outputSummary c.output) (unaryFin q) 0 0 pre) .entry ()
    let finish := (roundData (a.apply c) (tableBitsK tr) (outputSummary (a.apply c).output)
      ((a.state.map unaryFin).getD []) 0 0 pre).mapState (fun _ => exit k a.state.isSome)
    ∃ T, 0 < T ∧ T ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK tr).length + 1) ∧
      (roundTM k).runFrom start T = finish ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ∃ s, ((roundTM k).runFrom start u).state = some s ∧
        s ≠ ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∧ s ≠ ⟨.halt, ()⟩) ∧
      ∀ u ≤ T, RoundWindow c a ((roundTM k).runFrom start u) := by
  let a := tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols
  let d := roundData c (tableBitsK tr) (outputSummary c.output) (unaryFin q) 0 0 pre
  let word := (a.state.map unaryFin).getD []
  obtain ⟨before, tail, L, split, stateSize, lookupBound, lookup⟩ := roundTM_lookup tr c q pre
  change tableBitsK tr = before ++ actionBitsK a ++ tail at split
  have prepare := roundTM_prepare c a q (tableBitsK tr) (outputSummary c.output) before.length pre
  have payload := roundTM_payload c a (tableBitsK tr) before tail pre split
  have restore := roundTM_restore c a (tableBitsK tr) (before ++ actionBitsK a) tail word pre
    a.state.isSome (by simpa only [List.append_assoc] using split)
  simp only [List.length_append, Nat.cast_add] at restore
  have joined := RoundSpan.add c a (RoundSpan.add c a (RoundSpan.add c a lookup prepare)
    payload) restore
  let U := L + (3 * q.val + 16) + ((actionBitsK a).length + 6) +
    (tail.length + (tableBitsK tr).length + word.length + 15)
  have entry : (roundTM k).step (atKey d .entry ()) = atKey d .lookup (seekTM k).q₀ := by
    have one := step_of_inputMoveAction (roundTM k) (atKey d .entry ())
      (q := ⟨.entry, ()⟩) (q' := ⟨.lookup, (seekTM k).q₀⟩) 0 rfl (by
        rw [roundTM, phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_some (part k) _ (red k) .entry () rfl]
        rfl)
    simpa only [moveInputPos_zero, atKey, d, roundData, Cfg.mapState] using one
  have advance (u : ℕ) := MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step (tm := roundTM k) (cfg := atKey d
    .entry ()) (t := u)
  simp only [entry] at advance
  have run : (roundTM k).runFrom (atKey d .entry ()) (U + 1) =
      (roundData (a.apply c) (tableBitsK tr) (outputSummary (a.apply c).output) word 0 0
        pre).mapState
        (fun _ => exit k a.state.isSome) := by
    rw [advance]
    exact joined.1
  refine ⟨U + 1, by omega, ?_, run, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have recordSize : (actionBitsK a).length ≤ (tableBitsK tr).length := by
      have hs := congrArg List.length split
      simp only [List.length_append] at hs
      omega
    have prefixSize : before.length ≤ (tableBitsK tr).length := by
      have hs := congrArg List.length split
      simp only [List.length_append] at hs
      omega
    have suffixSize : tail.length ≤ (tableBitsK tr).length := by
      have hs := congrArg List.length split
      simp only [List.length_append] at hs
      omega
    have wordSize : word.length ≤ (actionBitsK a).length := by
      obtain ⟨bits, hs⟩ := actionBitsK_split a
      have hl := congrArg List.length hs
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_ofFn] at hl
      have tailLen : (optStateBits a.state).length = word.length + 1 := by
        dsimp only [word]
        cases a.state <;> simp [optStateBits, unaryFin]
      omega
    dsimp only [U]
    omega
  · intro u hu ht
    rw [show u = (u - 1) + 1 by omega, advance]
    obtain ⟨s, hs, he, hh, _⟩ := joined.2 (u - 1) (by dsimp only [U] at ht; omega)
    exact ⟨s, hs, he, hh⟩
  · intro u hu
    by_cases hz : u = 0
    · subst u
      exact roundData_window c a (tableBitsK tr) (outputSummary c.output) (unaryFin q) 0 0 pre false
    · by_cases hend : u = U + 1
      · rw [hend, run]
        exact roundData_window c a (tableBitsK tr) (outputSummary (a.apply c).output) word 0 0
          pre true
      · rw [show u = (u - 1) + 1 by omega, advance]
        exact (joined.2 (u - 1) (by dsimp only [U] at hu; omega)).choose_spec.2.2.2

/-! ## The seam and the contract -/

/-- **The seam relation** (`h1RoundRep`): the step block's configuration `d` represents the
source configuration `c` of the table `tr` when the native input position is `c`'s, the first
`k` work tapes and their heads are `c`'s, tape `k` holds `tableBitsK tr`, tape `k + 1` holds
`summaryCells (outputSummary c.output) word` with `word` the unary state of `c` (empty when
`c` is halted), and both auxiliary heads are at `0`. Control and the physical output are left
free. -/

name: Rep
header:
def Rep {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x)
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) : Prop
chunk:
/-- **The seam relation** (`h1RoundRep`): the step block's configuration `d` represents the
source configuration `c` of the table `tr` when the native input position is `c`'s, the first
`k` work tapes and their heads are `c`'s, tape `k` holds `tableBitsK tr`, tape `k + 1` holds
`summaryCells (outputSummary c.output) word` with `word` the unary state of `c` (empty when
`c` is halted), and both auxiliary heads are at `0`. Control and the physical output are left
free. -/
def Rep {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x)
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) : Prop :=
  d.inputPos = c.inputPos ∧
  (∀ i : Fin k, d.workTapes (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = c.workTapes i ∧
    d.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = c.workTapePos i) ∧
  d.workTapes (tableTape k) = FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK tr) ∧
  d.workTapes (summaryTape k) =
    summaryCells (outputSummary c.output) ((c.state.map unaryFin).getD []) ∧
  d.workTapePos (tableTape k) = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos (summaryTape k) = 0

/-- **The step block's representation, unfolded** (the ND inventory API, 2026-10-17): `Rep tr c d`
holds iff `d` has `c`'s input head and its `k` work tapes and heads, the table `tableBitsK tr` on
the table tape, the summary cells of `c` on the summary tape, and both auxiliary heads at `0`. -/

name: Rep_iff
header:
theorem Rep_iff {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    {tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))}
    {c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x} {d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x} :
    Rep tr c d ↔
      d.inputPos = c.inputPos ∧
      (∀ i : Fin k, d.workTapes (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = c.workTapes i ∧
        d.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = c.workTapePos i) ∧
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) = FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK tr) ∧
      d.workTapes (summaryTape k) =
        summaryCells (outputSummary c.output) ((c.state.map unaryFin).getD []) ∧
      d.workTapePos (tableTape k) = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos (summaryTape k) = 0
chunk:
/-- **The step block's representation, unfolded** (the ND inventory API, 2026-10-17): `Rep tr c d`
holds iff `d` has `c`'s input head and its `k` work tapes and heads, the table `tableBitsK tr` on
the table tape, the summary cells of `c` on the summary tape, and both auxiliary heads at `0`. -/
theorem Rep_iff {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    {tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))}
    {c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x} {d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x} :
    Rep tr c d ↔
      d.inputPos = c.inputPos ∧
      (∀ i : Fin k, d.workTapes (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = c.workTapes i ∧
        d.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = c.workTapePos i) ∧
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) = FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK tr) ∧
      d.workTapes (summaryTape k) =
        summaryCells (outputSummary c.output) ((c.state.map unaryFin).getD []) ∧
      d.workTapePos (tableTape k) = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos (summaryTape k) = 0 :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- A related entry configuration is exactly the canonical round frame,
with its arbitrary physical output prefix retained. This only unpacks the
seam relation; it makes no assumption about the mirrored source tapes.

**Proof sketch.** Destructure `Rep` into its six fields, and use `c.state = some q` to make
the state word `unaryFin q`. Compare the configurations field by field: the control is the
`entry` hypothesis and the input head is `Rep`'s; on the work tapes, split by
`Fin.addCases` into the mirrored bank and the two auxiliary tapes, each content and head
is the corresponding field of `Rep`; the output is `d.output` on both sides. -/

name: rep_entry
header:
private lemma rep_entry {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (hq : c.state = some q)
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩) (rel : Rep tr c d) :
    d = atKey (roundData c (tableBitsK tr) (outputSummary c.output) (unaryFin q) 0 0 d.output)
      .entry ()
chunk:
/-- A related entry configuration is exactly the canonical round frame,
with its arbitrary physical output prefix retained. This only unpacks the
seam relation; it makes no assumption about the mirrored source tapes.

**Proof sketch.** Destructure `Rep` into its six fields, and use `c.state = some q` to make
the state word `unaryFin q`. Compare the configurations field by field: the control is the
`entry` hypothesis and the input head is `Rep`'s; on the work tapes, split by
`Fin.addCases` into the mirrored bank and the two auxiliary tapes, each content and head
is the corresponding field of `Rep`; the output is `d.output` on both sides. -/
private lemma rep_entry {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (hq : c.state = some q)
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩) (rel : Rep tr c d) :
    d = atKey (roundData c (tableBitsK tr) (outputSummary c.output) (unaryFin q) 0 0 d.output)
      .entry () := by
  obtain ⟨input, bank, table, summary, tableHome, stateHome⟩ := rel
  simp only [hq, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some] at summary
  apply Cfg.ext
  · exact entry
  · exact input
  · funext j
    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
    · simpa only [atKey, Cfg.mapState, roundData, Fin.addCases_left] using (bank i).1
    · fin_cases i
      · simpa [atKey, Cfg.mapState, roundData, tableTape] using table
      · simpa [atKey, Cfg.mapState, roundData, summaryTape] using summary
  · funext j
    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
    · simpa only [atKey, Cfg.mapState, roundData, Fin.addCases_left] using (bank i).2
    · fin_cases i

live configuration (state `q`) of a `k`-work-tape binary machine with transition table `tr` and
`n + 1` states, on the same input `x`, and let `a` be the action `tr` takes at `c`. If the step
block is at `entry` in a configuration `d` that represents `c`, then for some time `T` with
`0 < T ≤ 50·(|tableBitsK tr| + 1)`, writing `e` for the configuration reached at `T`:
* `e` is at `exit k a.state.isSome` (back at `entry` when `a` has a successor, at `halt`
  otherwise) and represents `a.apply c`, the source's next configuration; its summary cell is
  `summaryEmit` of `d`'s and `a`'s emission;
* strictly between `0` and `T` the block is live and visits neither `entry` nor `halt`;
* the physical output is `d`'s at every time up to `T` (the block is silent);
* at every time up to `T`, the input head is at its start or its end position and has moved
  at most one cell; each mirrored head is at its start or its end position; mirrored heads
  move at most one cell and auxiliary heads at most `50·(|tableBitsK tr| + 1)` cells;
* both auxiliary heads are at `0` at the start and at `T`.
The bound depends on the table only, through its serialized length `|tableBitsK tr|` (and so
indirectly on `k`, `n` and the table's actions); only the coefficient `50` is uniform. It does
not depend on the input `x`, the tape contents or the simulated time.
[AB09, §1.4.1, proof of Theorem 1.9, Figure 1.6: one step of the universal machine]

Not stated: the exact value of `T` (it is the unique first time after `0` at `entry` or
`halt`, by the cut: `roundTM_firstExit_unique`), though the endpoint itself is determined
(`Rep` fixes every tape and head, the exit the control, silence the output); a space bound
(derived from the envelope, `roundTM_visited`); an input device other than the native one
(the simulated input is the block's own input `x`).

complete canonical round: the selector skips `q` whole state groups and the read-rank suffix
(the serializer cut pays for it), the old state word is cleared, the fixed fields execute,
the successor is installed, and the catalog scans return both auxiliary heads. Output-prefix
monotonicity gives silence throughout. The phase window and the action head bound give the
mirrored envelope; summing the unit step bound gives the auxiliary envelope; the input clamp
handles both boundary blanks. -/

theorem roundTM_effect {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (hq : c.state = some q)
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩) (rel : Rep tr c d) :
    let a := tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols
    ∃ T, 0 < T ∧ T ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK tr).length + 1) ∧
      let e := (roundTM k).runFrom d T
      e.state = some (exit k a.state.isSome) ∧ Rep tr (a.apply c) e ∧
      e.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = summaryEmit (d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k)) a.output ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ∃ s, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some s ∧
        s ≠ ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∧ s ≠ ⟨.halt, ()⟩) ∧
      (∀ u ≤ T, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).output = d.output) ∧
      (∀ u ≤ T,
        let f := (roundTM k).runFrom d u
        (f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∨ f.inputPos = e.inputPos) ∧
        |(f.inputPos.val : ℤ) - d.inputPos.val| ≤ 1 ∧
        (∀ i : Fin k, f.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = d.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ∨
          f.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = e.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i)) ∧
        ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), |f.workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤
          if j.val < k then 1 else (50 * ((tableBitsK tr).length + 1) : ℕ)) ∧
      ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val → d.workTapePos j = 0 ∧ e.workTapePos j = 0 := by
  let a := tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols
  have canonical := rep_entry tr c q hq d entry rel
  obtain ⟨T, positive, bound, run, cut, window⟩ := roundTM_canonical tr c q d.output
  rw [← canonical] at run cut window
  refine ⟨T, positive, bound, ?_, ?_, ?_, cut, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [run]
    rfl
  · rw [run]
    simp [Rep, roundData, Cfg.mapState, Action.apply, tableTape, summaryTape]
  · have old : d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = outputSummary c.output := by
      rw [canonical]
      simp [atKey, roundData, Cfg.mapState, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, summaryTape, summaryCells]
    rw [run, old]
    simpa only [roundData, Cfg.mapState, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, summaryTape,
      Fin.addCases_right, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 from by decide, ↓reduceIte, summaryCells] using
      (outputSummary_append c.output a.output)

    have lo := (roundTM k).output_prefix d (Nat.zero_le u)
    have hi := (roundTM k).output_prefix d hu
    rw [run] at hi

  · intro u hu
    have frame := window u hu
    have finalInput : ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).inputPos = (a.apply c).inputPos := by
      rw [run]
      rfl
    have finalHead (i : Fin k) : ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).workTapePos (Fin.castAdd 2 i) =
        (a.apply c).workTapePos i := by
      rw [run]
      simp only [roundData, Cfg.mapState, Fin.addCases_left]
      rfl
    have inputStep : |((a.apply c).inputPos.val : ℤ) - c.inputPos.val| ≤ 1 := by
      change |((moveInputPos c.inputPos a.inputTape).val : ℤ) - c.inputPos.val| ≤ 1
      apply abs_le.mpr
      have hp := c.inputPos.isLt
      cases h : a.inputTape <;> simp only [moveInputPos, SignType.cast] <;>
        split <;> simp <;> omega
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [rel.1, finalInput] using frame.1
    · rw [rel.1]
      rcases frame.1 with start | finish
      · rw [start]; simp
      · rw [finish]; exact inputStep
    · intro i
      simpa only [(rel.2.1 i).2, finalHead i] using frame.2 i
    · intro j

      · let i : Fin k := ⟨j.val, hj⟩

        rw [if_pos hj, ji, (rel.2.1 i).2]
        rcases frame.2 i with start | finish
        · rw [start]; simp
        · rw [finish]; exact workTapePos_apply_le a c i
      · rw [if_neg hj]
        exact (MultiTapeTM.abs_workTapePos_runFrom_sub_le (roundTM k) d u j).trans (by omega)

    have home (e : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
        (ht : e.workTapePos (tableTape k) = 0) (hs : e.workTapePos (summaryTape k) = 0) :

        have limit := j.isLt
        have indices : j.val = k ∨ j.val = k + 1 := by omega
        rcases indices with h | h
        · left; apply Fin.ext; simpa [tableTape] using h
        · right; apply Fin.ext; simpa [summaryTape] using h
      rcases casesAux with rfl | rfl
      · exact ht
      · exact hs

    apply home

    · rw [run]; simp [roundData, Cfg.mapState, summaryTape]

/-! ## Additive results (gated at H2-S; no counterpart in `CodeSimulator`)

These five results were not part of the moved code (the sixth additive result,
`summaryEmit_none`, sits with the summary above). They are new, small proofs: two generic
visited-set lemmas, and three corollaries of `roundTM_effect`, written to test that its shape
serves the unclocked consumers (B6's `U₀`, backlog U-1) and their space ledger. They concern
the silent block only. A host that blanks and forwards the summary cell around each round
needs its own simulation invariant (the design note's consumer obligation CO-RF). -/

/-- **The per-round space ledger** (additive): under the contract's hypotheses, with `a` the
action of `tr` at `c` and `B = 50·(|tableBitsK tr| + 1)`, some time `T` with `0 < T ≤ B` ends
the round at `exit k a.state.isSome` in a configuration representing `a.apply c`, with the
contract's cut and silence, and during the round each mirrored head visits only the source
head's cells before and after the step, and each auxiliary head only cells in `[-B, B]`. In
particular a round visits at most `2` cells of a mirrored tape and `2B + 1` of an auxiliary
one.

**Proof sketch.** Take the contract's `T`. The envelope puts each mirrored head at its start
or end position, which the two representations identify with the source's head before and
after the step; each auxiliary head starts at `0` and stays within `B` of it. -/

theorem roundTM_visited {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (hq : c.state = some q)
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩) (rel : Rep tr c d) :
    let a := tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols
    ∃ T, 0 < T ∧ T ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK tr).length + 1) ∧
      ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some (exit k a.state.isSome) ∧
      Rep tr (a.apply c) ((roundTM k).runFrom d T) ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ∃ s, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some s ∧
        s ≠ ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∧ s ≠ ⟨.halt, ()⟩) ∧
      (∀ u ≤ T, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).output = d.output) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin k, (roundTM k).visitedByTapeHead d T (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ⊆
        {c.workTapePos i, (a.apply c).workTapePos i}) ∧
      ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val → (roundTM k).visitedByTapeHead d T j ⊆
        Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK tr).length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ))
          ((50 * ((tableBitsK tr).length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) := by

  obtain ⟨T, hpos, hT, hexit, hrel, -, hcut, hsil, henv, hhome⟩ :=
    roundTM_effect tr c q hq d entry rel
  refine ⟨T, hpos, hT, hexit, hrel, hcut, hsil, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i p hp
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range] at hp
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hp
    have h := (henv u (by omega)).2.2.1 i
    rw [(rel.2.1 i).2, (hrel.2.1 i).2] at h
    rcases h with h | h <;> rw [h]
    · exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
    · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)
  · intro j hj p hp
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range] at hp
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hp
    have h := (henv u (by omega)).2.2.2 j
    rw [if_neg (by omega), (hhome j hj).1, sub_zero] at h
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    exact abs_le.mp h

/-- **Rounds compose into a run of the source** (additive, for unclocked hosts: B6's `U₀`,
backlog U-1). Let `M` be a `k`-work-tape binary machine with `n + 1` states and `c` a
configuration of it on `x` that stays live for `t` steps (the `t`-th configuration
included), and let `B = 50·(|tableBitsK M.tr| + 1)`. If the step block is at `entry` in a
configuration `d` representing `c` for `M`'s table, then at some time `T` with
`t ≤ T ≤ t·B` it is back at `entry`, representing `M`'s configuration after `t` steps; up to
`T` it has emitted nothing and never visited `halt`; each mirrored head has visited only cells
that `M`'s head visited in those `t` steps; and each auxiliary head only cells in `[-B, B]`.
[AB09, §1.4.1, proof of Theorem 1.9]

The lower bound `t ≤ T` makes the block's time cofinal with the source's: if the source never
halts, then for every physical horizon `u` the theorem at `t = u` gives `T ≥ u` with no visit
to `halt` up to `T`, so the block never reaches `halt` (H2-S round 1, finding 1; the
stationary silent self-loop no longer admits the witness `T = 0`). This is the silent block:
the emitting wrapper that forwards the summary cell is the consumer obligation CO-RF of the
design note, not a consequence of this theorem.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on `t`. At `t + 1`, apply the per-round ledger at the live `c`: the
source's step at `c` is the record's action, and its successor is live, so the round ends at
`entry` representing `M.step c`, after a positive time at most `B`. The induction hypothesis at
`M.step c` continues from there, by run additivity; the positive round time and the inductive
lower bound give `t + 1 ≤ T`. Silence and the absence of `halt` hold round by round: a round's
interior avoids `halt` by the cut, its endpoint is `entry`. The visited cells split at the
round boundary; the first round's are the source's cells at times `0` and `1`, the rest are
covered by induction and the shift by one step. -/

    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero] at hc
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hc
    have hstep : M.step c = (M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).apply c := by
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hq]
    obtain ⟨T₁, hpos, hT₁, hexit, hrel, hcut, hsil, hvis, haux⟩ :=
      roundTM_visited M.tr c q hq d hd rel
    have hlive' : ∀ u ≤ t, (M.runFrom (M.step c) u).state.isSome := by
      intro u hu
      rw [← MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step]
      exact hlive (u + 1) (by omega)
    have hsucc : (M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).state.isSome := by
      have h1 := hlive' 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
      rwa [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hstep] at h1
    rw [hsucc] at hexit
    rw [← hstep] at hrel hvis
    obtain ⟨T₂, hlow, hT₂, hent, hrel₂, hrest, hvis₂, haux₂⟩ :=
      ih (M.step c) hlive' _ hexit hrel
    refine ⟨T₁ + T₂, by omega, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Nat.succ_mul]; omega
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add]; exact hent
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add (tm := roundTM k) d T₁ T₂,
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step (tm := M)]
      exact hrel₂
    · intro u hu
      by_cases hle : u ≤ T₁
      · refine ⟨hsil u hle, ?_⟩
        by_cases h0 : u = 0
        · subst h0
          rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hd]
          exact entry_ne_halt
        · by_cases hT : u = T₁
          · subst hT
            rw [hexit]
            exact entry_ne_halt
          · obtain ⟨s, hs, -, hh⟩ := hcut u (by omega) (by omega)
            rw [hs]
            exact fun h => hh (Option.some.inj h)
      · obtain ⟨hout, hhalt⟩ := hrest (u - T₁) (by omega)
        have hu' : u = T₁ + (u - T₁) := by omega
        rw [hu', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add]
        refine ⟨?_, hhalt⟩
        rw [hout]
        exact hsil T₁ le_rfl
    · intro i p hp
      have hsplit :=
        MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead_add_subset (roundTM k) d T₁ T₂ (Fin.castAdd 2 i) hp
      have hshift := MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead_step_subset M c t i
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hsplit with h | h
      · have h' := hvis i h
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h'
        rcases h' with rfl | rfl
        · exact hshift (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
        · apply hshift
          apply Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
          simp only [MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
          exact ⟨0, by omega, by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]⟩
      · exact hshift (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (hvis₂ i h))
    · intro j hj p hp
      have hsplit := MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead_add_subset (roundTM k) d T₁ T₂ j hp
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hsplit with h | h
      · exact haux j hj h
      · exact haux₂ j hj h

/-- **The round time is the unique first positive exit** (additive). Under the contract's
hypotheses there is exactly one time `T` such that `0 < T`, the block is at `entry` or at
`halt` at time `T`, and it is at neither exit at any time strictly between `0` and `T`. Hence
the existential time of `roundTM_effect` is this `T`, whichever witness is chosen, and a host
may define its round-time function by choice or by `Nat.find` without ambiguity (design note
O7; counter-loop round functions; MIG-0b's round time).

**Proof sketch.** Existence: the contract's time is positive, its endpoint is at
`exit k a.state.isSome`, which is `entry` or `halt`, and its cut keeps every strictly earlier
positive time off both exits. Uniqueness: of two such times, the smaller would lie strictly
between `0` and the larger, where the larger one's cut forbids both exits. -/

name: roundTM_firstExit_unique
header:
theorem roundTM_firstExit_unique {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (hq : c.state = some q)
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩) (rel : Rep tr c d) :
    ∃! T, 0 < T ∧
      (((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∨
        ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some ⟨.halt, ()⟩) ∧
      ∀ u, 0 < u → u < T →
        ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state ≠ some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∧
          ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state ≠ some ⟨.halt, ()⟩
chunk:
/-- **The round time is the unique first positive exit** (additive). Under the contract's
hypotheses there is exactly one time `T` such that `0 < T`, the block is at `entry` or at
`halt` at time `T`, and it is at neither exit at any time strictly between `0` and `T`. Hence
the existential time of `roundTM_effect` is this `T`, whichever witness is chosen, and a host
may define its round-time function by choice or by `Nat.find` without ambiguity (design note
O7; counter-loop round functions; MIG-0b's round time).

**Proof sketch.** Existence: the contract's time is positive, its endpoint is at
`exit k a.state.isSome`, which is `entry` or `halt`, and its cut keeps every strictly earlier
positive time off both exits. Uniqueness: of two such times, the smaller would lie strictly
between `0` and the larger, where the larger one's cut forbids both exits. -/
theorem roundTM_firstExit_unique {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (hq : c.state = some q)
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩) (rel : Rep tr c d) :
    ∃! T, 0 < T ∧
      (((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∨
        ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some ⟨.halt, ()⟩) ∧
      ∀ u, 0 < u → u < T →
        ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state ≠ some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∧
          ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state ≠ some ⟨.halt, ()⟩ := by
  obtain ⟨T, hpos, -, hexit, -, -, hcut, -⟩ := roundTM_effect tr c q hq d entry rel
  refine ⟨T, ⟨hpos, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hexit]
    unfold exit
    split
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr rfl
  · intro u hu huT
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hse, hsh⟩ := hcut u hu huT
    rw [hs]
    exact ⟨fun h => hse (Option.some.inj h), fun h => hsh (Option.some.inj h)⟩
  · rintro T' ⟨hpos', hexit', hcut'⟩
    rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy T' T with hlt | heq | hgt
    · obtain ⟨s, hs, hse, hsh⟩ := hcut T' hpos' hlt
      rw [hs] at hexit'
      rcases hexit' with h | h
      · exact absurd (Option.some.inj h) hse
      · exact absurd (Option.some.inj h) hsh
    · exact heq
    · have h := hcut' T hpos hgt
      rw [hexit] at h
      unfold exit at h
      split at h
      · exact absurd rfl h.1
      · exact absurd rfl h.2

name: forwardLoopCfg
header:
def forwardLoopCfg {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (entry : Q)
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) :
    Cfg (k + 2) Bool Q x where
  state
chunk:
/-- **The forwarding round loop's configuration for a source configuration** (H2-F's encoding):
for a `k`-work-tape binary machine `M` with `n + 1` states and a configuration `c` of `M` on the
input `x`, the `(k + 2)`-tape configuration whose input head and mirrored tapes `0, …, k - 1`
(contents and heads) are `c`'s, whose tape `k` holds the table `tableBitsK M.tr` and tape
`k + 1` the blank summary cell followed by the unary current state (empty when `c` is halted),
both auxiliary heads at `0`, whose output is `c`'s output, and whose control is `entry` while
`c` is live and halted once `c` is. It is the step block's seam relation `Turing.StepBlock.Rep`
for `c` with its output erased (so the summary cell is blank), with the physical output
restored: the reset invariant of `Turing.exists_selfUniversal`'s sketch (the H2-S gate's
finding 4). [AB09, §1.4.1, proof of Theorem 1.9] -/
def forwardLoopCfg {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (entry : Q)
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) :
    Cfg (k + 2) Bool Q x where
  state := c.state.map fun _ => entry
  inputPos := c.inputPos
  workTapes := Fin.addCases (motive := fun _ => ℤ → Option Bool) c.workTapes fun j =>
    if j = 0 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr)
    else summaryCells none ((c.state.map unaryFin).getD [])
  workTapePos := Fin.addCases (motive := fun _ => ℤ) c.workTapePos fun _ => 0
  output := c.output

/-! The forwarding configuration's fields as equations, generated by `simps` without the `simp`
attribute: `Turing.StepBlock.forwardLoopCfg_state`, `_inputPos`, `_workTapes` (pointwise in the
tape and the cell), `_workTapePos` and `_output`. -/
attribute [simps (config := { isSimp := false }) state inputPos workTapes workTapePos output]
  forwardLoopCfg

/-- Erasing only the simulated output gives the block's reset invariant; the physical
output prefix of the forwarding configuration is retained. -/

name: fl_reset
chunk:
/-- Erasing only the simulated output gives the block's reset invariant; the physical
output prefix of the forwarding configuration is retained. -/
private lemma fl_reset {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) :
    Rep M.tr {c with output := []} (forwardLoopCfg (exit k true) M c) := by
  simp [Rep, forwardLoopCfg, tableTape, summaryTape, outputSummary]

/-- The data change of a forwarding leaf: clear the scanned summary cell and append its
optional bit to the physical output, with the supplied successor control. -/

name: fl_flush
chunk:
/-- The data change of a forwarding leaf: clear the scanned summary cell and append its
optional bit to the physical output, with the supplied successor control. -/
private def fl_flush {k : ℕ} {S Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (next : Option Q)
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool S x) : Cfg (k + 2) Bool Q x where
  state := next
  inputPos := d.inputPos
  workTapes := Function.update d.workTapes (summaryTape k)
    (Function.update (d.workTapes (summaryTape k)) (d.workTapePos (summaryTape k)) none)
  workTapePos := d.workTapePos
  output := d.output ++ (d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k)).toList

/-- The forwarding leaf. `some live` reads, emits and clears; `none` is the live return
anchor. There is no public row for this atomic emission and clearing: the step block and
its clocked loop are silent, and `tapeAction` itself emits nothing. The leaf changes only
that action's emission and successor fields and moves no head. -/

name: fl_leafTM
header:
private def fl_leafTM (k : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool (Option Bool) where
  q₀
chunk:
/-- The forwarding leaf. `some live` reads, emits and clears; `none` is the live return
anchor. There is no public row for this atomic emission and clearing: the step block and
its clocked loop are silent, and `tapeAction` itself emits nothing. The leaf changes only
that action's emission and successor fields and moves no head. -/
private def fl_leafTM (k : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool (Option Bool) where
  q₀ := some true
  tr q _ w := match q with
    | some live => { tapeAction (summaryTape k) 0 (some none) 0 (none : Option Bool) with
        output := w (summaryTape k)
        state := if live then some none else none }
    | none => inputMoveAction 0 none

/-- The leaf's single step has exactly the clearing and emission effect, including when
it halts. All input and work heads keep their positions.

**Proof sketch.** Apply the one-tape action with its emission and successor fields replaced.
Only the selected work tape is written; its head displacement and every other displacement
are zero. -/

name: fl_leaf_step
chunk:
/-- The leaf's single step has exactly the clearing and emission effect, including when
it halts. All input and work heads keep their positions.

**Proof sketch.** Apply the one-tape action with its emission and successor fields replaced.
Only the selected work tape is written; its head displacement and every other displacement
are zero. -/
private lemma fl_leaf_step {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Option Bool) x)
    (live : Bool) (hd : d.state = some (some live)) :
    (fl_leafTM k).step d = fl_flush (if live then some none else none) d := by
  simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hd, fl_leafTM]
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rfl
  · simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, fl_flush]
  · funext j
    by_cases hj : j = summaryTape k <;> simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, fl_flush, hj]
  · funext j
    by_cases hj : j = summaryTape k <;> simp [Action.apply, tapeAction, fl_flush, hj]
  · rfl

/-- A full leaf run takes one step. -/

name: fl_leaf_run
chunk:
/-- A full leaf run takes one step. -/
private lemma fl_leaf_run {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Option Bool) x)
    (live : Bool) (hd : d.state = some (some live)) :
    (fl_leafTM k).runFrom d 1 = fl_flush (if live then some none else none) d :=
  fl_leaf_step d live hd

name: fl_encode_map

    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) :

name: fl_TM
header: private def fl_TM (k : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool (Σ b, fl_Ph k b)
chunk:

its forwarding leaf. Its finite control depends only on the tape count. -/
private def fl_TM (k : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool (Σ b, fl_Ph k b) :=

/-- The released block runs unchanged until its positive exit and then dispatches to the
appropriate forwarding leaf.

**Proof sketch.** The release adapter agrees with the block at positive times. At time zero
its fresh control cannot dispatch; at interior positive times the block's strict cut excludes
both redirect states. Apply the public phase lemma to this guard. -/

name: fl_block_phase
header:
private lemma fl_block_phase {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (T : ℕ) (live : Bool)
    (hd : d.state = some (exit k true)) (hT : 0 < T)
    (he : ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some (exit k live))
    (hc : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ∃ s, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some s ∧
      s ≠ exit k true ∧ s ≠ exit k false) :
    (∀ u ≤ T, (fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) u =
      ((fl_part k false).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => Sum.inl ()) u).mapState
        (Sigma.mk false)) ∧
    (fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) (T + 1) =
      ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).mapState (fun _ => ⟨true, some live⟩)
chunk:
/-- The released block runs unchanged until its positive exit and then dispatches to the
appropriate forwarding leaf.

**Proof sketch.** The release adapter agrees with the block at positive times. At time zero
its fresh control cannot dispatch; at interior positive times the block's strict cut excludes
both redirect states. Apply the public phase lemma to this guard. -/
private lemma fl_block_phase {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (T : ℕ) (live : Bool)
    (hd : d.state = some (exit k true)) (hT : 0 < T)
    (he : ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some (exit k live))
    (hc : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ∃ s, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some s ∧
      s ≠ exit k true ∧ s ≠ exit k false) :
    (∀ u ≤ T, (fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) u =
      ((fl_part k false).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => Sum.inl ()) u).mapState
        (Sigma.mk false)) ∧
    (fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) (T + 1) =
      ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).mapState (fun _ => ⟨true, some live⟩) := by
  have released := seamReleaseTM_runFrom_pos (roundTM k) (exit k true) d hd T hT
  have dispatched := phaseHostTM_run (fl_part k) (fl_entry k) (fl_red k) false
    (d.mapState fun _ => Sum.inl ()) (((roundTM k).runFrom d T).mapState Sum.inr)
    T released (Sum.inr (exit k live))
    (by simp [Cfg.mapState, he]) ⟨true, some live⟩
    (by cases live <;> simp [fl_red, exit]) (by
      intro u hu s hs
      by_cases hz : u = 0
      · subst u
        simp only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, Cfg.mapState, hd, Option.map_some,
          Option.some.injEq] at hs
        subst s
        rfl
      · have hp : 0 < u := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz
        change ((seamReleaseTM (roundTM k) (exit k true)).runFrom _ u).state = _ at hs
        rw [seamReleaseTM_runFrom_pos (roundTM k) (exit k true) d hd u hp] at hs
        obtain ⟨r, hr, hn, hh⟩ := hc u hp hu
        simp only [Cfg.mapState, hr, Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hs
        subst s
        simp [fl_red, hn, hh])
  simpa only [fl_TM, Cfg.mapState, Option.map_map, Function.comp_def] using dispatched

name: fl_hosted_leaf
header:
private lemma fl_hosted_leaf {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool S x) (live : Bool) (hd : d.state ≠ none) :
    (fl_TM k).step (d.mapState fun _ => ⟨true, some live⟩) =
      fl_flush (if live then some ⟨true, none⟩ else none) d
chunk:
/-- The leaf keeps its one-step effect inside the public phase host. -/
private lemma fl_hosted_leaf {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool S x) (live : Bool) (hd : d.state ≠ none) :
    (fl_TM k).step (d.mapState fun _ => ⟨true, some live⟩) =
      fl_flush (if live then some ⟨true, none⟩ else none) d := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hd
  have lifted : (fl_TM k).step (d.mapState fun _ => ⟨true, some live⟩) =
      ((fl_leafTM k).step (d.mapState fun _ => some live)).mapState (Sigma.mk true) := by
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, Cfg.mapState, hq, Option.map_some]
    rw [fl_TM, phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_none (fl_part k) (fl_entry k) (fl_red k) true (some live) rfl]
    rfl
  rw [lifted, fl_leaf_step _ live (by simp [Cfg.mapState, hq])]
  cases live <;> rfl

chunk:
/-- Clearing a represented summary recovers the forwarding encoding, with exactly the
physical prefix and the one summary emission in its output.

**Proof sketch.** The mirrored bank and table are unchanged. At the summary head, which is
home, `summaryCells_update` removes only cell zero. The state word is already the word of
the represented source, even at a halt. -/
private lemma fl_restore {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (entry : Q)
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x)
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (hr : Rep M.tr c d) :
    fl_flush (c.state.map fun _ => entry) d =
      forwardLoopCfg entry M {c with output := d.output ++ (outputSummary c.output).toList} := by
  obtain ⟨hin, hbank, htable, hsummary, ht, hs⟩ := hr
  have read : d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = outputSummary c.output := by
    simp only [Cfg.workTapeSymbols, hs, hsummary, summaryCells, ↓reduceIte]
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rfl
  · exact hin
  · funext j
    induction j using Fin.addCases with
    | left i =>
      have hne : Fin.castAdd 2 i ≠ summaryTape k := by
        intro he
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val he
        change i.val = k + 1 at hv
        have hi := i.isLt
        omega
      simpa only [fl_flush, forwardLoopCfg, Fin.addCases_left,
        Function.update_of_ne hne] using (hbank i).1
    | right j =>
      fin_cases j
      · have hne : tableTape k ≠ summaryTape k := by
          simp [tableTape, summaryTape, Fin.ext_iff]
        change Function.update d.workTapes (summaryTape k) _ (tableTape k) = _
        rw [Function.update_of_ne hne, htable]
        simp [forwardLoopCfg]
      · change Function.update d.workTapes (summaryTape k) _ (summaryTape k) = _
        rw [Function.update_self, hs, hsummary, summaryCells_update]
        simp [forwardLoopCfg]
  · funext j
    induction j using Fin.addCases with
    | left i =>
      simpa only [fl_flush, forwardLoopCfg, Fin.addCases_left] using (hbank i).2
    | right j =>
      fin_cases j
      · simpa only [fl_flush, forwardLoopCfg, Fin.addCases_right] using ht
      · simpa only [fl_flush, forwardLoopCfg, Fin.addCases_right] using hs
  · simp only [fl_flush, forwardLoopCfg, read]

/-- One released block followed by its leaf returns or halts with the summary forwarded,
never halts early, and visits no work-head position beyond the block's visited sets.

**Proof sketch.** The phase lemma supplies the block prefix and its one-step dispatch.
The leaf takes one stationary step; a live leaf takes one more stationary dispatch. Split
interior and visiting times at the block exit; all later head positions are its final ones.
This composes the public hosts and does not iterate rounds. -/

name: fl_round
header:
private lemma fl_round {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (T : ℕ) (live : Bool)
    (hd : d.state = some (exit k true)) (hT : 0 < T)
    (he : ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some (exit k live))
    (hc : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ∃ s, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some s ∧
      s ≠ exit k true ∧ s ≠ exit k false) :
    (fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) (T + if live then 3 else 2) =
        fl_flush (if live then some (fl_entry k) else none) ((roundTM k).runFrom d T) ∧
    (∀ u < T + if live then 3 else 2,
      ((fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) u).state ≠ none) ∧
    ∀ j, (fl_TM k).visitedByTapeHead (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k)
        (T + if live then 3 else 2) j ⊆ (roundTM k).visitedByTapeHead d T j

/-- One released block followed by its leaf returns or halts with the summary forwarded,
never halts early, and visits no work-head position beyond the block's visited sets.

**Proof sketch.** The phase lemma supplies the block prefix and its one-step dispatch.
The leaf takes one stationary step; a live leaf takes one more stationary dispatch. Split
interior and visiting times at the block exit; all later head positions are its final ones.
This composes the public hosts and does not iterate rounds. -/
private lemma fl_round {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) (T : ℕ) (live : Bool)
    (hd : d.state = some (exit k true)) (hT : 0 < T)
    (he : ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some (exit k live))
    (hc : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < T → ∃ s, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some s ∧
      s ≠ exit k true ∧ s ≠ exit k false) :
    (fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) (T + if live then 3 else 2) =
        fl_flush (if live then some (fl_entry k) else none) ((roundTM k).runFrom d T) ∧
    (∀ u < T + if live then 3 else 2,
      ((fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) u).state ≠ none) ∧
    ∀ j, (fl_TM k).visitedByTapeHead (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k)
        (T + if live then 3 else 2) j ⊆ (roundTM k).visitedByTapeHead d T j := by
  obtain ⟨hprefix, dispatch⟩ := fl_block_phase d T live hd hT he hc
  have emitted : (fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) (T + 2) =
      fl_flush (if live then some ⟨true, none⟩ else none) ((roundTM k).runFrom d T) := by
    rw [show T + 2 = (T + 1) + 1 by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', dispatch,
      fl_hosted_leaf _ live (by rw [he]; exact Option.some_ne_none _)]
  have finish : (fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k)
      (T + if live then 3 else 2) =
      fl_flush (if live then some (fl_entry k) else none) ((roundTM k).runFrom d T) := by
    cases live
    · exact emitted
    · change (fl_TM k).runFrom _ (T + 3) = _
      rw [show T + 3 = (T + 2) + 1 by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', emitted]
      exact fl_return _
  refine ⟨finish, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu
    by_cases hb : u ≤ T
    · rw [hprefix u hb]
      by_cases hz : u = 0
      · simp [hz, Cfg.mapState, hd]
      · change (((seamReleaseTM (roundTM k) (exit k true)).runFrom _ u).mapState _).state ≠ _
        rw [seamReleaseTM_runFrom_pos (roundTM k) (exit k true) d hd u
          (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz)]
        by_cases hend : u = T
        · simp [hend, Cfg.mapState, he]
        · obtain ⟨s, hs, _, _⟩ := hc u (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz) (by omega)
          simp [Cfg.mapState, hs]
    · have ht : u = T + 1 ∨ (live = true ∧ u = T + 2) := by
        cases live <;> simp at hu ⊢ <;> omega
      rcases ht with rfl | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · rw [dispatch]
        simp [Cfg.mapState, he]
      · rw [emitted]
        simp [fl_flush]
  · intro j p hp
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hpos⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
    have hu' : u ≤ T + if live then 3 else 2 := by
      simpa only [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hu
    have heads : ((fl_TM k).runFrom (d.mapState fun _ => fl_entry k) u).workTapePos j =
        ((roundTM k).runFrom d (min u T)).workTapePos j := by
      by_cases hb : u ≤ T
      · rw [min_eq_left hb, hprefix u hb]
        by_cases hz : u = 0
        · simp [hz, Cfg.mapState]
        · rw [show (fl_part k false) = seamReleaseTM (roundTM k) (exit k true) from rfl,
            seamReleaseTM_runFrom_pos (roundTM k) (exit k true) d hd u
              (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz)]
          rfl
      · rw [min_eq_right (by omega)]
        have ht : u = T + 1 ∨ u = T + 2 ∨ (live = true ∧ u = T + 3) := by
          cases live <;> simp at hu' ⊢ <;> omega
        rcases ht with rfl | rfl | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        · rw [dispatch]; rfl
        · rw [emitted]; rfl
        · rw [show T + 3 = T + if true then 3 else 2 from rfl, finish]; rfl
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨min u T, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), ?_⟩
    exact heads.symm.trans hpos

/-- A live source step has a positive bounded forwarding simulation, its exact successor,
a strict live interior, and the mirrored and auxiliary visited-set bounds.

**Proof sketch.** Apply the block's visited-set contract to the source with erased output,
using the reset invariant but retaining the physical output. Compose its exit with the leaf.
The summary is the single current emission; restoring the blank summary therefore gives
exactly the actual successor, including its original output prefix. -/

name: fl_step_exists
header:
private lemma fl_step_exists {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x)
    (hl : c.state ≠ none) :
    ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + 3 ∧
      (fl_TM k).runFrom (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c) t =
        forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M (M.step c) ∧
      (∀ u < t, ((fl_TM k).runFrom (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c) u).state ≠ none) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin k, (fl_TM k).visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c) t
        (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ⊆ {c.workTapePos i, (M.step c).workTapePos i}) ∧
      ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val →
        (fl_TM k).visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c) t j ⊆
          Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ))
            ((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ)
chunk:
/-- A live source step has a positive bounded forwarding simulation, its exact successor,
a strict live interior, and the mirrored and auxiliary visited-set bounds.

**Proof sketch.** Apply the block's visited-set contract to the source with erased output,
using the reset invariant but retaining the physical output. Compose its exit with the leaf.
The summary is the single current emission; restoring the blank summary therefore gives
exactly the actual successor, including its original output prefix. -/
private lemma fl_step_exists {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x)
    (hl : c.state ≠ none) :
    ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + 3 ∧
      (fl_TM k).runFrom (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c) t =
        forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M (M.step c) ∧
      (∀ u < t, ((fl_TM k).runFrom (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c) u).state ≠ none) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin k, (fl_TM k).visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c) t
        (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ⊆ {c.workTapePos i, (M.step c).workTapePos i}) ∧
      ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val →
        (fl_TM k).visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c) t j ⊆
          Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ))
            ((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hl
  let a := M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols
  let d := forwardLoopCfg (exit k true) M c
  have hd : d.state = some (exit k true) := by simp [d, forwardLoopCfg, hq]
  obtain ⟨T, hpos, hbound, he, hr, hc, ho, hm, ha⟩ :=
    roundTM_visited M.tr {c with output := []} q hq d hd (fl_reset M c)
  have joined := fl_round d T a.state.isSome hd hpos he hc
  have start : d.mapState (fun _ => fl_entry k) = forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c :=
    fl_encode_map (exit k true) (fun _ => fl_entry k) M c
  rw [start] at joined
  have emission : outputSummary (a.apply {c with output := []}).output = a.output := by
    simpa only [Action.apply, outputSummary, summaryEmit_none] using
      outputSummary_append [] a.output
  have out : ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).output = c.output := ho T le_rfl
  have source :
      {a.apply {c with output := []} with
        output := ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).output ++
          (outputSummary (a.apply {c with output := []}).output).toList} = M.step c := by
    rw [emission, out]
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hq]
    rfl
  have control : (a.apply {c with output := []}).state.map (fun _ => fl_entry k) =
      if a.state.isSome then some (fl_entry k) else none := by
    cases hs : a.state <;> simp [Action.apply, hs]
  have restored := fl_restore (fl_entry k) M (a.apply {c with output := []})
    ((roundTM k).runFrom d T) hr
  rw [source, control] at restored
  refine ⟨T + if a.state.isSome then 3 else 2, ?_, ?_, joined.1.trans restored,
    joined.2.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · split <;> omega
  · split <;> omega
  · intro i p hp
    have h := hm i (joined.2.2 (Fin.castAdd 2 i) hp)
    simpa only [MultiTapeTM.step, hq, Action.apply] using h
  · intro j hj p hp
    have h := ha j hj (joined.2.2 j hp)
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at h ⊢
    push_cast
    omega

/-- Both auxiliary heads of every encoding are home, including for halted sources and
zero work tapes. -/

name: fl_home
chunk:
/-- Both auxiliary heads of every encoding are home, including for halted sources and
zero work tapes. -/
private lemma fl_home {k n : ℕ} {Q : Type} {x : List Bool} (entry : Q)
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x)
    (j : Fin (k + 2)) (hj : k ≤ j.val) : (forwardLoopCfg entry M c).workTapePos j = 0 := by
  induction j using Fin.addCases with
  | left i => have hi := i.isLt; simp only [Fin.coe_castAdd] at hj; omega
  | right j => simp only [forwardLoopCfg, Fin.addCases_right]

/-- **H2-F, the forwarding round loop** (host H2's unclocked loop form; `machine-library-design.md`
§14; U2 design note `audits/evidence/u2/U2-design.md` §2.2). For each work-tape count `k` there
is one finite `(k + 2)`-tape binary machine `L`, with an entry state and a constant `C`, such
that for every `k`-work-tape binary machine `M` with `n + 1` states and every input `x`, `L`
simulates `M` step by step through `forwardLoopCfg`: there is a cost function on `M`'s
configurations with
* **a macro-step lockstep** (`Turing.Lockstep`, exits `{none}` on both sides): from the encoding
  of a live configuration `c`, `L` reaches the encoding of `M.step c` after exactly `cost c`
  steps, without halting before; the encoding of a halted configuration is halted. So `L` halts
  exactly when `M` does, with `M`'s output, which it emits step by step
  (`Turing.Lockstep.runFrom`, `Turing.Lockstep.cut`);
* **a per-step bound**: `0 < cost c ≤ 50 · (|tableBitsK M.tr| + 1) + C` for live `c`, a constant
  for a fixed table (the step block's bound plus the leaf's);
* **a space ledger**: over `t` source steps that are live before `t`, each mirrored head visits
  only cells that `M`'s head visits, and the two auxiliary heads stay within
  `50 · (|tableBitsK M.tr| + 1) + C` of their home.

The control of `L` does not depend on `M`, `n` or `x`. [AB09, §1.4.1, proof of Theorem 1.9:
each step of `M` is simulated in a number of steps depending only on `M`'s table]

**Proof sketch.** `L` is the step block `roundTM k` followed, at either of its exits, by a
forwarding leaf on the summary tape: read the summary cell, emit its bit if it holds one, blank
it, then return to the block's entry (exit `entry`) or halt (exit `halt`). For a live `c`, the
block-control part of `forwardLoopCfg entry M c` represents `{c with output := []}` (`Rep`: a blank
summary, the unary state word, both auxiliary heads home), so `roundTM_effect` gives a first exit
after `T ≤ 50 · (|tableBitsK M.tr| + 1)` steps at the representation of
`a.apply {c with output := []}`, silent before, with summary cell
`summaryEmit none a.output = a.output` (`summaryEmit_none`); the exit time is unique
(`roundTM_firstExit_unique`). The leaf emits `a.output`, making the physical output
`(a.apply c).output`, blanks the cell, and enters `entry` or halts according to the exit: the
result is exactly `forwardLoopCfg entry M (M.step c)`. Take `cost c` the block's exit time plus the
leaf's length (at most `C`); the inner times are live by the block's cut and the leaf's. The space
ledger is `roundTM_visited` per round, summed by `MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead_add_subset`; the
leaf moves no head.

**Fill appendix (H2-F).** The two phases are the released block and the forwarding leaf;
`fl_round` proves their composition from the public phase lemma and the block's cut. The
leaf alone emits and clears, and all its heads are stationary. One exit-time witness is chosen
once per live source configuration, together with all its run and visited-set properties.
The cost is that block time plus three for a live successor, or plus two for a halt, so
`C = 3`. `Lockstep.runFrom` supplies iteration; the mirrored ledger uses visited-set addition,
and the auxiliary ledger uses `Lockstep.locate`. -/

name: exists_forwardLoopTM
header:
theorem exists_forwardLoopTM (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q)
      (entry : Q) (C : ℕ),
      ∀ {n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))),
        ∃ cost : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x → ℕ,
          Lockstep M L (forwardLoopCfg entry M) cost {none} {none} ∧
          (∀ c, c.state ≠ none → 0 < cost c ∧
            cost c ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C) ∧
          ∀ (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (t : ℕ), (∀ u < t, (M.runFrom c u).state ≠ none) →
            (∀ i : Fin k, L.visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg entry M c)
                (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, cost (M.runFrom c u)) (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ⊆
              M.visitedByTapeHead c t i) ∧
            ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val →
              L.visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg entry M c)
                  (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, cost (M.runFrom c u)) j ⊆
                Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C : ℕ) : ℤ))
                  ((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C : ℕ) : ℤ)

              M.visitedByTapeHead c t i) ∧
            ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val →
              L.visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg entry M c)
                  (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, cost (M.runFrom c u)) j ⊆
                Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C : ℕ) : ℤ))
                  ((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
  classical
  refine ⟨(Σ b, fl_Ph k b), inferInstance, inferInstance, fl_TM k, fl_entry k, 3, ?_⟩
  intro n x M
  let cost (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) : ℕ :=
    if h : c.state ≠ none then (fl_step_exists M c h).choose else 1
  have chosen (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (h : c.state ≠ none) :
      cost c = (fl_step_exists M c h).choose := dif_pos h
  have one (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (h : c.state ≠ none) :=
    (fl_step_exists M c h).choose_spec
  have lock : Lockstep M (fl_TM k) (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M) cost {none} {none} := by
    constructor
    · intro c h
      have alive : c.state ≠ none := by simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using h
      rw [chosen c alive]
      exact (one c alive).2.2.1
    · intro c h
      simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h ⊢
      simp [forwardLoopCfg, h]
    · intro c h u hu
      have alive : c.state ≠ none := by simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using h
      rw [chosen c alive] at hu
      exact (one c alive).2.2.2.1 u hu
  refine ⟨cost, lock, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro c h
    rw [chosen c h]
    exact ⟨(one c h).1, (one c h).2.1⟩
  · intro c t ht
    constructor
    · -- Split visited sets at each completed round; the lockstep supplies its start.
      induction t with
      | zero => simp [MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead, forwardLoopCfg]
      | succ t ih =>
        have ht' : ∀ u < t, (M.runFrom c u).state ≠ none := fun u hu => ht u (by omega)
        have alive := ht t (by omega)
        have atRound := lock.runFrom c t ht'
        intro i p hp
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ] at hp
        have split := MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead_add_subset (fl_TM k)
          (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c)
          (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, cost (M.runFrom c u)) (cost (M.runFrom c t))
          (Fin.castAdd 2 i) hp
        rcases Finset.mem_union.mp split with before | current
        · have old := ih ht' i before
          exact (Finset.image_subset_image (Finset.range_mono (Nat.le_succ (t + 1)))) old
        · rw [atRound, chosen (M.runFrom c t) alive] at current
          have h := (one (M.runFrom c t) alive).2.2.2.2.1 i current
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp h with rfl | hend
          · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨t, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), rfl⟩
          · have heq := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hend
            apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
            refine ⟨t + 1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), ?_⟩
            simpa only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step'] using heq.symm
    · -- Locate an auxiliary-head visit in one round, or at an encoded start.
      intro j hj p hp
      obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      obtain ⟨u, _, w, hw, run⟩ := lock.locate c t ht v
        (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hv))
      rw [run]
      rcases hw with rfl | ⟨alive, hw⟩
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, fl_home (fl_entry k) M (M.runFrom c u) j hj]
        exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _), Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩
      · rw [chosen (M.runFrom c u) alive] at hw
        exact (one (M.runFrom c u) alive).2.2.2.2.2 j hj
          (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨w, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr hw), rfl⟩)

end StepBlock

end Turing

name: loopTM
header: def loopTM (k : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM (k + 2 + 1) Bool (CounterLoopState (Σ key, Ph k key))
chunk:
/-- **The step block's counter loop** (H2's loop form; formerly the private `h1ClockTM` of
`CodeSimulator`): the counter-driven loop host `Turing.counterLoopTM` whose body is the step
block `roundTM k`, whose round anchor is the block's entry `exit k true`, and whose designated
body exit is the block's live halting exit `exit k false`. Its `k + 3` work tapes are the
block's `k + 2` and the binary counter last. It starts with a decrement; each successful
decrement runs one round of the block, that is, one simulated transition; an underflow leaves
through the live anchor `done`, and a simulated halt through the live anchor `escape`. Its
control does not depend on the simulated table. [AB09, §1.4.1, proof of Theorem 1.9; §3.1,
proof of Theorem 3.1: the simulation run for a bounded number of steps] -/
def loopTM (k : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM (k + 2 + 1) Bool (CounterLoopState (Σ key, Ph k key)) :=
  counterLoopTM (roundTM k) (exit k true) (some (exit k false))

/-- **The step block's counter loop on a buffered input** (formerly `h1HostedClockTM`): the
loop `loopTM k` hosted by the forwarding virtual-input transformer `Turing.vhostEmitTM` (Z1).
Its `1 + (k + 3)` work tapes are the buffer, which holds the simulated input, and then the
loop's tapes; its control is the loop's paired with Z1's boundary tag; it never moves the native
input head, and it forwards the loop's (empty) emissions. [AB09, §1.4.1] -/

/-- The first positive return of the step block to either of its exits (`0` if there is none),
the round index of the loop's proofs (formerly `h1RoundTime`, moved unchanged). It is a proof

header:

chunk:
/-- The first positive return of the step block to either of its exits (`0` if there is none),
the round index of the loop's proofs (formerly `h1RoundTime`, moved unchanged). It is a proof
index, not a machine that computes a time, and it stays private until MIG-0b's round adapter

private noncomputable def loopRoundTime {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x) : ℕ := by

chunk:
/-- The round index inherits the step block's endpoint, cut, silence and bound at a live
represented entry (formerly `h1RoundTime_spec`; the same statement).

**Proof sketch.** The block's contract `roundTM_effect` supplies a positive exit time `T` with
its endpoint, cut, silence and bound. The least positive exit time and `T` are both first
positive exits, so they are equal by `roundTM_firstExit_unique`; this replaces the private
proof's own uniqueness argument (H2 design O7). -/
private lemma loopRoundTime_spec {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x)
    (live : c.state ≠ none) (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some (exit k true)) (rel : Rep M.tr c d) :
    0 < loopRoundTime d ∧ loopRoundTime d ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) ∧
      let e := (roundTM k).runFrom d (loopRoundTime d)
      e.state = some (exit k (M.step c).state.isSome) ∧
      Rep M.tr (M.step c) e ∧ e.output = d.output ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u → u < loopRoundTime d → ∃ s,
        ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some s ∧
          s ≠ exit k true ∧ s ≠ exit k false) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp live
  obtain ⟨T, positive, bound, state, related, _, cut, silent, _⟩ :=
    roundTM_effect M.tr c q hq d entry rel
  have step : M.step c = (M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).apply c := by
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hq]
  have existsExit : ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ ∃ b,
      ((roundTM k).runFrom d t).state = some (exit k b) :=
    ⟨T, positive, _, state⟩
  have exits (u : ℕ) : (∃ b, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some (exit k b)) ↔
      (((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∨
        ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some ⟨.halt, ()⟩) := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
      cases b
      · exact Or.inr hb
      · exact Or.inl hb
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact ⟨true, h⟩
      · exact ⟨false, h⟩
  obtain ⟨T', -, unique⟩ := roundTM_firstExit_unique M.tr c q hq d entry rel
  have first (V : ℕ) (hV : 0 < V ∧ ∃ b, ((roundTM k).runFrom d V).state = some (exit k b))
      (before : ∀ u, 0 < u → u < V →
        ¬∃ b, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state = some (exit k b)) : V = T' :=
    unique V ⟨hV.1, (exits V).mp hV.2, fun u hu huV => by
      have h := before u hu huV
      rw [exits u] at h
      exact ⟨fun e => h (Or.inl e), fun e => h (Or.inr e)⟩⟩
  have least : Nat.find existsExit = T := by
    rw [first (Nat.find existsExit) (Nat.find_spec existsExit)
      (fun u hu hlt h => Nat.find_min existsExit hlt ⟨hu, h⟩)]
    refine (first T ⟨positive, _, state⟩ (fun u hu huT => ?_)).symm
    obtain ⟨s, hs, he, hh⟩ := cut u hu huT
    rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    have equal : s = exit k b := Option.some.inj (hs.symm.trans hb)
    cases b
    · exact hh equal
    · exact he equal
  have duration : loopRoundTime d = T := by
    simp only [loopRoundTime, dif_pos existsExit, least]
  rw [duration]
  exact ⟨positive, bound, by simpa only [step] using state,
    by simpa only [step] using related, silent T le_rfl, cut⟩

/-- **The orbit invariant** (formerly `h1Clock_orbit`, generalized from the initial
configuration to any live start `c`): while the source run from `c` is live before round `r`,
the block's orbit after `r` rounds is at the exit that records whether the source is still live
after `r` steps, represents the source's configuration after `r` steps, and has emitted nothing.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on `r`. Each live source configuration uses the block's contract at
its round index (`loopRoundTime_spec`); the successor equation of the orbit and the source's
run-addition law identify the next configuration; each round keeps the output. -/
