name: zr_scanPin_pre
chunk:
/-- A row start pinned at its scratch start meets the scan's precondition. -/
private lemma zr_scanPin_pre {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) (I : ZoneData k × ℤ)
    (d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) (SeekPhase ⊕ Σ b, zr_hostPh zr_scanSt b) x)
    (hp : True ∧ zr_pinned (zr_rowT0 I) (zr_heads 0 I.2) d) : (zr_scanContract t x).pre I.1 d := by
  obtain ⟨-, h1, h2⟩ := hp
  rw [zr_scanContract, Contract.seq_pre, zr_homeSkipContract, zr_reindexContract,
    Contract.ofSegment_pre]
  refine ⟨funext fun q => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes, h1]
    rfl
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, h2]
    rfl

/-- **The scan as a pinned test**, at an index of the data and the scratch start: from the row's
start pin to the found path's start pin, its two exits the found and the short escapes. -/

name: zr_scanPin
header: private def zr_scanPin {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k))
chunk:
/-- **The scan as a pinned test**, at an index of the data and the scratch start: from the row's
start pin to the found path's start pin, its two exits the found and the short escapes. -/
private def zr_scanPin {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :=
  zr_reindexContract (zr_exitsContract (zr_scanContract t x) _ zr_scan_exits) Prod.fst
    (fun (I : ZoneData k × ℤ) d => True ∧ zr_pinned (zr_rowT0 I) (zr_heads 0 I.2) d)
    fun I d hp => by
      rw [zr_exitsContract, Contract.ofSegment_pre]
      exact zr_scanPin_pre t x I d hp

/-- **The scan's pinned step**: from the row's start to the scan's count of `i₀ + 1` marks, the
zoned head at zone `i₀`'s start, in the row's box.

**Proof sketch.** The scan's pinned step from its contract (`zr_pinRe_ofSeg`). At the row's start
the zoned head is at home and scratch is blank, which is the scan's precondition; its fields
(`zr_scan_fields`) give the endpoint, the count of `i₀ + 1` marks on scratch and the zoned head at
zone `i₀`'s start, which is the stage-zero pin, and the time. The heads stay in the row's box since
zone starts are at least `2` (`two_le_zoneStart`). -/

name: zr_scanPin_step
header:
private lemma zr_scanPin_step {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    zr_PinStep (zr_scanPin t x) (fun _ => True) zr_rowT0 (fun I => zr_pT (zr_rowP0 t I))
      (fun I => zr_heads 0 I.2)
      (fun I => zr_heads (zr_rstart (zr_rowP0 t I).i) ((zr_rowP0 t I).b - 1))
      (fun I => zoneStart (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1) + 8 * zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 +
        (if zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1 then 9 else 7)) (zr_rowL t) (zr_rowU t)
chunk:
/-- **The scan's pinned step**: from the row's start to the scan's count of `i₀ + 1` marks, the
zoned head at zone `i₀`'s start, in the row's box.

**Proof sketch.** The scan's pinned step from its contract (`zr_pinRe_ofSeg`). At the row's start
the zoned head is at home and scratch is blank, which is the scan's precondition; its fields
(`zr_scan_fields`) give the endpoint, the count of `i₀ + 1` marks on scratch and the zoned head at
zone `i₀`'s start, which is the stage-zero pin, and the time. The heads stay in the row's box since
zone starts are at least `2` (`two_le_zoneStart`). -/
private lemma zr_scanPin_step {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    zr_PinStep (zr_scanPin t x) (fun _ => True) zr_rowT0 (fun I => zr_pT (zr_rowP0 t I))
      (fun I => zr_heads 0 I.2)
      (fun I => zr_heads (zr_rstart (zr_rowP0 t I).i) ((zr_rowP0 t I).b - 1))
      (fun I => zoneStart (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1) + 8 * zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 +
        (if zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1 then 9 else 7)) (zr_rowL t) (zr_rowU t) :=
  zr_pinRe_ofSeg _ _ _ _ (zr_scanPin_pre t x) fun I d _ hd => by
    obtain ⟨ht, hpost, hl0, hh0, hl1, hh1⟩ := zr_scan_fields t I.1 d
    have h0 : d.workTapePos 0 = 0 := by rw [hd.2]; rfl
    have h1 : d.workTapePos 1 = I.2 := by rw [hd.2]; rfl
    have hb : ∀ r, d.workTapes 1 r = none := fun r => by rw [hd.1]; rfl
    have hz : d.workTapes 0 = zonedTape I.1.2 := by rw [hd.1]; rfl
    have hL := two_le_zoneStart (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1)
    have hs0 : zoneStart 0 = 2 := by norm_num [zoneStart_eq]
    have hp := Nat.two_pow_pos (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1)
    rw [hpost]
    refine ⟨⟨funext fun j => funext fun r => ?_, funext fun j => ?_⟩, rfl, rfl, ht,
      Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩⟩
    · by_cases hj : j = 0
      · subst hj
        simp only [zr_scanCfg, Function.update_of_ne (show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 by decide), hz,
          zr_pT, zr_tapes, if_true]
      · obtain rfl : j = 1 := by omega
        simp only [zr_scanCfg, Function.update_self, h1, hb, zr_pT, zr_tapes, zr_pσ, zr_stk,
          show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, if_false, zr_rulerTape]
        split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
    · simp only [zr_scanCfg, zr_heads, zr_rstart, h1, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.succ_ne_zero,
        if_false]
      split_ifs <;> push_cast <;> ring
    · rw [hl0, h0, hs0]
      simp only [zr_rowL, zr_heads, if_true]
      omega
    · rw [hh0, h0]
      simp only [zr_rowU, zr_heads, if_true]
      omega
    · rw [hl1, h1]
      simp only [zr_rowL, zr_heads, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, if_false]
      omega
    · rw [hh1, h1]
      simp only [zr_rowU, zr_heads, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, if_false]
      omega

/-- The found path from the scan's end, at a found scan, in the rightward row's box. -/

name: zr_fpRow
header: private noncomputable def zr_fpRow {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k))
chunk:
/-- The found path from the scan's end, at a found scan, in the rightward row's box. -/
private noncomputable def zr_fpRow {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :=
  show zr_PinSeg x _ _ _ (fun I => True ∧ decide (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1) = true)
    (fun I => zr_pT (zr_rowP0 t I)) (fun I => zr_pT (zr_fpS9 t (zr_rowP0 t I)))
    (fun I => zr_heads (zr_rstart (zr_rowP0 t I).i) ((zr_rowP0 t I).b - 1))
    (fun I => zr_heads 0 ((zr_rowP0 t I).b - 1)) _ (zr_rowL t) (zr_rowU t) from
  zr_seg (zr_segRe (zr_fpSeg t x) (zr_rowP0 t) _ fun _ h =>
      zr_rowP0_valid t (of_decide_eq_true h.2)).step (fun _ _ => rfl) fun I _ => by
    have hp := Nat.two_pow_pos (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1)
    refine ⟨rfl, zr_heads_le ?_ ?_, zr_heads_le ?_ ?_⟩
    · exact le_rfl
    · show I.2 - 1 ≤ I.2 + zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 2 - 2
      omega
    · exact le_rfl
    · show I.2 + zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 2 +
          9 * ((2 ^ (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) + 11 ≤
        I.2 + zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 13 +
          18 * ((2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
      rw [pow_succ]
      push_cast
      omega

/-- At the found path's end the scan's count is all of scratch, its head just past the count. -/

name: zr_cc_scratch
header:
private lemma zr_cc_scratch {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} (t : Fin k)
    (I : ZoneData k × ℤ) (d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x)
    (hd : zr_pinned (zr_pT (zr_fpS9 t (zr_rowP0 t I))) (zr_heads 0 ((zr_rowP0 t I).b - 1)) d) :
    zr_scratchAt ((zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
      (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1) d
chunk:
/-- At the found path's end the scan's count is all of scratch, its head just past the count. -/
private lemma zr_cc_scratch {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} (t : Fin k)
    (I : ZoneData k × ℤ) (d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x)
    (hd : zr_pinned (zr_pT (zr_fpS9 t (zr_rowP0 t I))) (zr_heads 0 ((zr_rowP0 t I).b - 1)) d) :
    zr_scratchAt ((zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
      (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1) d :=
  ⟨Nat.succ_pos _, fun r => by
    rw [hd.1, hd.2]
    show zr_stk (zr_rowP0 t I).β (zr_rowP0 t I).b (zr_rowP0 t I).b r =
      zr_rulerTape _ (I.2 + zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 2 - 1 - _) r
    rw [zr_stk, if_neg (by omega)]
    show zr_rulerTape _ I.2 r = _
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring⟩

/-- **The count's clear at the found path's end**, at an index of the data and the scratch
start. -/

name: zr_ccPin
header: private def zr_ccPin {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k))
chunk:
/-- **The count's clear at the found path's end**, at an index of the data and the scratch
start. -/
private def zr_ccPin {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :=
  zr_singletonContract (zr_reindexContract (zr_countClearContract x)
    (fun I : ZoneData k × ℤ => zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1)
    (fun I d => (True ∧ decide (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1) = true) ∧
      zr_pinned (zr_pT (zr_fpS9 t (zr_rowP0 t I))) (zr_heads 0 ((zr_rowP0 t I).b - 1)) d)
    fun I d hp => by
      rw [zr_countClearContract, Contract.seq_pre, zr_stepContract, Contract.ofSegment_pre]
      exact zr_scratchAt_move _ _ (zr_cc_scratch t I d hp.2)
        (fun r => by rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes]) (by rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]))
    (Sum.inr (Sum.inr SweepPhase.done))

/-- **The count clear's pinned step**: from the found path's end to the row's endpoint, scratch
blank again and its head back at its start.

**Proof sketch.** The count clear's pinned step at the found path's end (`zr_pinRe_step`). There
scratch holds exactly the count of `i₀ + 1` marks (`zr_cc_scratch`), so the count clear's fields
(`zr_countClear_fields`) blank it and return its head to the start, in `3 (i₀ + 1) + 8` steps. Tape
`0` is the found path's data, which is the rebalanced data (`zr_fp_data`, `zoneRebalance_of_lt`,
`zoneCascade_true`): the row's endpoint. -/

name: zr_ccPin_step
header:
private lemma zr_ccPin_step {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    zr_PinStep (zr_ccPin t x)
      (fun I => True ∧ decide (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1) = true)
      (fun I => zr_pT (zr_fpS9 t (zr_rowP0 t I))) (zr_rowT2 t)
      (fun I => zr_heads 0 ((zr_rowP0 t I).b - 1)) (fun I => zr_heads 0 I.2)
      (fun I => 3 * (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1) + 8) (zr_rowL t) (zr_rowU t)
chunk:
/-- **The count clear's pinned step**: from the found path's end to the row's endpoint, scratch
blank again and its head back at its start.

**Proof sketch.** The count clear's pinned step at the found path's end (`zr_pinRe_step`). There
scratch holds exactly the count of `i₀ + 1` marks (`zr_cc_scratch`), so the count clear's fields
(`zr_countClear_fields`) blank it and return its head to the start, in `3 (i₀ + 1) + 8` steps. Tape
`0` is the found path's data, which is the rebalanced data (`zr_fp_data`, `zoneRebalance_of_lt`,
`zoneCascade_true`): the row's endpoint. -/
private lemma zr_ccPin_step {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    zr_PinStep (zr_ccPin t x)
      (fun I => True ∧ decide (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1) = true)
      (fun I => zr_pT (zr_fpS9 t (zr_rowP0 t I))) (zr_rowT2 t)
      (fun I => zr_heads 0 ((zr_rowP0 t I).b - 1)) (fun I => zr_heads 0 I.2)
      (fun I => 3 * (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1) + 8) (zr_rowL t) (zr_rowU t) :=
  zr_PinStep_exits (hX := by simp only [Set.image_singleton, Option.map_some])
    (zr_pinRe_step _ _ _ _ _ _ fun I d hV hd => by
    obtain ⟨ht, hpost, hl0, hh0, hl1, hh1⟩ :=
      zr_countClear_fields (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1) d (zr_cc_scratch t I d hd)
    have hi : zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1 := of_decide_eq_true hV.2
    have h0 : d.workTapePos 0 = 0 := by rw [hd.2]; rfl
    have h1 : d.workTapePos 1 = I.2 + zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 2 - 1 := by rw [hd.2]; rfl
    have hL := two_le_zoneStart (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1)
    have hp := Nat.two_pow_pos (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1)
    rw [hpost]
    refine ⟨⟨funext fun j => funext fun r => ?_, ?_⟩, rfl, rfl, ht,
      Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩⟩
    · by_cases hj : j = 0
      · subst hj
        show Function.update d.workTapes 1 (fun _ => none) 0 r = _
        rw [Function.update_of_ne (show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 by decide), hd.1]
        show zonedTape (zr_fpS9 t (zr_rowP0 t I)).D.2 r =
          zonedTape (Function.update I.1.2 t (zoneRebalance true (I.1.2 t))) r
        rw [zr_fp_data, zoneRebalance_of_lt _ _ hi, zoneCascade_true]
        rfl
      · obtain rfl : j = 1 := by omega
        show Function.update d.workTapes 1 (fun _ => none) 1 r = _
        rw [Function.update_self]
        rfl
    · show Function.update d.workTapePos 1 (d.workTapePos 1 - _) = zr_heads 0 I.2
      rw [hd.2, zr_heads_set1, zr_heads_one]
      congr 1
      show I.2 + zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 2 - 1 -
        ((zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = I.2
      push_cast
      ring
    · rw [hl0, h0]
      simp only [zr_rowL, zr_heads, if_true]
      omega
    · rw [hh0, h0]
      simp only [zr_rowU, zr_heads, if_true]
      omega
    · rw [hl1, h1]
      simp only [zr_rowL, zr_heads, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, if_false]
      push_cast
      omega
    · rw [hh1, h1]
      simp only [zr_rowU, zr_heads, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, if_false]
      omega)

/-- Decidable equality of the scan's and the found path's states. -/

name: zr_short_eq
header:
private lemma zr_short_eq {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) {I : ZoneData k × ℤ}

/-- A short scan's index is the level count. -/
private lemma zr_short_eq {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) {I : ZoneData k × ℤ}
    (h : ¬ zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1) : zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 = I.1.1 := by

/-- **A short scan's end is the short path's start**: past the layout, the scan's count of
`ℓ + 1` marks all of scratch. -/

name: zr_shortPin_pre
header:
private lemma zr_shortPin_pre {k : ℕ} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} (t : Fin k) (I : ZoneData k × ℤ)
    (d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) ((Σ b, zr_loopPh b) ⊕ Option Bool ⊕ SeekPhase ⊕ SweepPhase) x)
    (h : ¬ zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1)
    (hd : zr_pinned (zr_pT (zr_rowP0 t I))
      (zr_heads (zr_rstart (zr_rowP0 t I).i) ((zr_rowP0 t I).b - 1)) d) :
    (zr_shortContract x).pre I.1 d
chunk:
/-- **A short scan's end is the short path's start**: past the layout, the scan's count of
`ℓ + 1` marks all of scratch. -/
private lemma zr_shortPin_pre {k : ℕ} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} (t : Fin k) (I : ZoneData k × ℤ)
    (d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) ((Σ b, zr_loopPh b) ⊕ Option Bool ⊕ SeekPhase ⊕ SweepPhase) x)
    (h : ¬ zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1)
    (hd : zr_pinned (zr_pT (zr_rowP0 t I))
      (zr_heads (zr_rstart (zr_rowP0 t I).i) ((zr_rowP0 t I).b - 1)) d) :
    (zr_shortContract x).pre I.1 d := by
  letI := zr_decEqLoopPh
  have hs := zr_short_eq t h
  rw [zr_shortContract, Contract.seq_pre, zr_shortLoopContract, zr_reindexContract,
    Contract.ofSegment_pre]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, fun q _ _ => ?_⟩, Nat.succ_pos _, fun r => ?_⟩
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, hd.2]
    show zr_rstart (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1) = zoneStart I.1.1
    rw [hs, zr_rstart, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero _), Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes, hd.1]
    rfl
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes, Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, hd.1, hd.2]
    show zr_stk (zr_rowP0 t I).β (zr_rowP0 t I).b (zr_rowP0 t I).b r =
      zr_rulerTape _ (I.2 + zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 2 - 1 - _) r
    rw [zr_stk, if_neg (by omega)]
    show zr_rulerTape (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1) I.2 r = _
    rw [hs]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring

/-- **The short path at a short scan**, at an index of the data and the scratch start. -/

name: zr_shortPin
header: private def zr_shortPin {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k))
chunk:
/-- **The short path at a short scan**, at an index of the data and the scratch start. -/
private def zr_shortPin {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :=
  zr_singletonContract (zr_reindexContract (zr_shortContract x) Prod.fst
    (fun (I : ZoneData k × ℤ) d =>
      (True ∧ decide (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1) = false) ∧
        zr_pinned (zr_pT (zr_rowP0 t I))
          (zr_heads (zr_rstart (zr_rowP0 t I).i) ((zr_rowP0 t I).b - 1)) d)
    fun I d hp => zr_shortPin_pre t I d (of_decide_eq_false hp.1.2) hp.2)
    (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr SweepPhase.done)))

/-- **The short path's pinned step**: from a short scan's end to the row's endpoint, the data
unchanged.

**Proof sketch.** The short path's pinned step at a short scan's end (`zr_pinRe_step`). On a short
scan the scanned index is `ℓ` (`zr_short_eq`), so the short path's fields (`zr_short_fields`) return
the zoned head home and clear the count; tape `0` is unchanged, and the rebalance at an index `≥ ℓ`
is the identity (`zoneRebalance_of_le`), so this is the row's endpoint. The heads stay in the row's
box by zone starts' monotonicity. -/

name: zr_shortPin_step
header:
private lemma zr_shortPin_step {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    zr_PinStep (zr_shortPin t x)
      (fun I => True ∧ decide (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1) = false)
      (fun I => zr_pT (zr_rowP0 t I)) (zr_rowT2 t)
      (fun I => zr_heads (zr_rstart (zr_rowP0 t I).i) ((zr_rowP0 t I).b - 1))
      (fun I => zr_heads 0 I.2) (fun I => zoneStart I.1.1 + 11 * I.1.1 + 20)
      (zr_rowL t) (zr_rowU t)
chunk:
/-- **The short path's pinned step**: from a short scan's end to the row's endpoint, the data
unchanged.

**Proof sketch.** The short path's pinned step at a short scan's end (`zr_pinRe_step`). On a short
scan the scanned index is `ℓ` (`zr_short_eq`), so the short path's fields (`zr_short_fields`) return
the zoned head home and clear the count; tape `0` is unchanged, and the rebalance at an index `≥ ℓ`
is the identity (`zoneRebalance_of_le`), so this is the row's endpoint. The heads stay in the row's
box by zone starts' monotonicity. -/
private lemma zr_shortPin_step {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    zr_PinStep (zr_shortPin t x)
      (fun I => True ∧ decide (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1) = false)
      (fun I => zr_pT (zr_rowP0 t I)) (zr_rowT2 t)
      (fun I => zr_heads (zr_rstart (zr_rowP0 t I).i) ((zr_rowP0 t I).b - 1))
      (fun I => zr_heads 0 I.2) (fun I => zoneStart I.1.1 + 11 * I.1.1 + 20)
      (zr_rowL t) (zr_rowU t) :=
  zr_PinStep_exits (hX := by simp only [Set.image_singleton, Option.map_some])
    (zr_pinRe_step _ _ _ _ _ _ fun I d hV hd => by
    have hn : ¬ zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1 := of_decide_eq_false hV.2
    have hs := zr_short_eq t hn
    obtain ⟨ht, hpost, hl0, hh0, hl1, hh1⟩ := zr_short_fields I.1 d (zr_shortPin_pre t I d hn hd)
    have h1 : d.workTapePos 1 = I.2 + zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 2 - 1 := by rw [hd.2]; rfl
    have hm : zoneStart I.1.1 ≤ zoneStart (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1) := by
      rw [hs]
      exact zoneStart_mono (Nat.le_add_right _ 1)
    have hL := two_le_zoneStart (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1)
    have hp := Nat.two_pow_pos (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1)
    rw [hpost]
    refine ⟨⟨funext fun j => funext fun r => ?_, funext fun j => ?_⟩, rfl, rfl, ht,
      Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩⟩
    · by_cases hj : j = 0
      · subst hj
        show Function.update d.workTapes 1 (fun _ => none) 0 r = _
        rw [Function.update_of_ne (show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 by decide), hd.1]
        show zonedTape I.1.2 r =
          zonedTape (Function.update I.1.2 t (zoneRebalance true (I.1.2 t))) r
        rw [zoneRebalance_of_le _ _ (show I.1.1 ≤ zoneShiftIndex true (I.1.2 t) from hs.ge),
          Function.update_eq_self]
      · obtain rfl : j = 1 := by omega
        show Function.update d.workTapes 1 (fun _ => none) 1 r = _
        rw [Function.update_self]
        rfl
    · show (if j = 0 then 0 else d.workTapePos 1 - (I.1.1 + 1)) = zr_heads 0 I.2 j
      rw [h1]
      simp only [zr_heads]
      split_ifs
      · rfl
      · rw [hs]
        ring
    · rw [hl0]
      simp only [zr_rowL, zr_heads, if_true]
      omega
    · rw [hh0]
      simp only [zr_rowU, zr_heads, if_true]
      exact_mod_cast hm
    · rw [hl1, h1]
      simp only [zr_rowL, zr_heads, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, if_false]
      rw [hs]
      omega
    · rw [hh1, h1]
      simp only [zr_rowU, zr_heads, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, if_false]
      omega)

/-- The scan's two escapes are distinct. -/

name: zr_scanNe
chunk:
/-- The scan's two escapes are distinct. -/
private lemma zr_scanNe :
    (Sum.inr ⟨false, none⟩ : SeekPhase ⊕ Σ b, zr_hostPh zr_scanSt b) ≠
      Sum.inr ⟨false, some true⟩ := by
  simp

/-- **The scan's verdict**: the found escape exactly when the scanned index is below `ℓ`. -/

name: zr_scan_verdict
chunk:
/-- **The scan's verdict**: the found escape exactly when the scanned index is below `ℓ`. -/
private lemma zr_scan_verdict {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    ∀ (I : ZoneData k × ℤ) d, True → zr_pinned (zr_rowT0 I) (zr_heads 0 I.2) d →
      ((zr_scanPin t x).post I d).state =
        some (if decide (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1) then Sum.inr ⟨false, none⟩
          else Sum.inr ⟨false, some true⟩) := fun I d _ _ => by
  rw [zr_scanPin, zr_reindexContract, Contract.ofSegment_post, zr_exitsContract,
    Contract.ofSegment_post, (zr_scan_fields t I.1 d).2.1, (zr_scanCfg_fields _ _ _ _).1]
  by_cases h : zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1 <;> simp [h]

/-- **The rightward row**: the scan, then at a found scan the found arm, at a short scan the
short path. -/

name: zr_rowC
header: private noncomputable def zr_rowC {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k))
chunk:
/-- **The rightward row**: the scan, then at a found scan the found arm, at a short scan the
short path. -/
private noncomputable def zr_rowC {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :=
  letI := (zr_rowDec t x).1
  letI := (zr_rowDec t x).2
  Contract.branch zr_scanNe (zr_scanPin t x) (zr_foundSeg t x).C (zr_shortPin t x) (fun I => I)
    (fun I => I)
    (zr_pin_blink true zr_scanNe (zr_scanPin_step t x) (zr_scan_verdict t x) rfl
      (zr_foundSeg t x).step)
    (zr_pin_blink false zr_scanNe (zr_scanPin_step t x) (zr_scan_verdict t x) rfl
      (zr_shortPin_step t x))

/-- **The rightward row's pinned step**: from the zoned tape of the data and a blank scratch to
the zoned tape of the rebalanced data and a blank scratch, the heads back, in the row's box. -/

name: zr_rowC_step
header:
private lemma zr_rowC_step {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    zr_PinStep (zr_rowC t x) (fun _ => True) zr_rowT0 (zr_rowT2 t) (fun I => zr_heads 0 I.2)
      (fun I => zr_heads 0 I.2)
      (fun I => zoneStart (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1) + 8 * zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 +
        (if zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1 then 9 else 7) + 1 +
        if decide (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1) then
          zr_tauOf (zr_fpSeg t x) (zr_rowP0 t I) + 1 + (3 * (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1) + 8)
        else zoneStart I.1.1 + 11 * I.1.1 + 20) (zr_rowL t) (zr_rowU t)
chunk:
/-- **The rightward row's pinned step**: from the zoned tape of the data and a blank scratch to
the zoned tape of the rebalanced data and a blank scratch, the heads back, in the row's box. -/
private lemma zr_rowC_step {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    zr_PinStep (zr_rowC t x) (fun _ => True) zr_rowT0 (zr_rowT2 t) (fun I => zr_heads 0 I.2)
      (fun I => zr_heads 0 I.2)
      (fun I => zoneStart (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1) + 8 * zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 +
        (if zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1 then 9 else 7) + 1 +
        if decide (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1) then
          zr_tauOf (zr_fpSeg t x) (zr_rowP0 t I) + 1 + (3 * (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1) + 8)
        else zoneStart I.1.1 + 11 * I.1.1 + 20) (zr_rowL t) (zr_rowU t) :=
  letI := (zr_rowDec t x).1
  letI := (zr_rowDec t x).2
  zr_PinStep_branch zr_scanNe (zr_scanPin_step t x) (zr_scan_verdict t x) (zr_foundSeg t x).step
    (zr_shortPin_step t x) _ _

/-- **The rightward row's exits**: the found arm's at a found scan, the short path's
otherwise. -/

name: zr_rowC_back
header:
private lemma zr_rowC_back {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    zr_BackIs (zr_rowC t x)
      (zr_branchBack (zr_oneBack (zr_exitOf (zr_foundSeg t x).C) true)
        (zr_oneBack (zr_exitOf (zr_shortPin t x)) false))
      fun I => if decide (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1) then true else false
chunk:
/-- **The rightward row's exits**: the found arm's at a found scan, the short path's
otherwise. -/
private lemma zr_rowC_back {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    zr_BackIs (zr_rowC t x)
      (zr_branchBack (zr_oneBack (zr_exitOf (zr_foundSeg t x).C) true)
        (zr_oneBack (zr_exitOf (zr_shortPin t x)) false))
      fun I => if decide (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1) then true else false :=
  letI := (zr_rowDec t x).1
  letI := (zr_rowDec t x).2
  zr_BackIs_branch zr_scanNe (zr_scanPin_step t x) (zr_scan_verdict t x)
    (zr_BackIs_one _ true) (zr_BackIs_one _ false)

/-- The rightward row's exit state.

**Proof sketch.** The row's exit state is read through its way back (`zr_rowC_back`): it is some
state `s` whose verdict is the branch's. By cases on whether the scanned index is below `ℓ`: on a
found scan only the found arm's exit has the found verdict, and on a short scan only the short arm's
exit has the short verdict; the other cases contradict the verdict (`zr_branchBack`, `zr_oneBack`).
-/

name: zr_rowC_state
header:
private lemma zr_rowC_state {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) (I : ZoneData k × ℤ)
    (d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) (zr_stOf (zr_rowC t x)) x)
    (hd : d.state = some (zr_entryOf (zr_rowC t x))) (hp : (zr_rowC t x).pre I d) :
    ((zr_rowC t x).post I d).state = some (if zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1 then
      Sum.inl (Sum.inr (zr_exitOf (zr_foundSeg t x).C)) else
      Sum.inr (zr_exitOf (zr_shortPin t x)))
chunk:
/-- The rightward row's exit state.

**Proof sketch.** The row's exit state is read through its way back (`zr_rowC_back`): it is some
state `s` whose verdict is the branch's. By cases on whether the scanned index is below `ℓ`: on a
found scan only the found arm's exit has the found verdict, and on a short scan only the short arm's
exit has the short verdict; the other cases contradict the verdict (`zr_branchBack`, `zr_oneBack`).
-/
private lemma zr_rowC_state {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) (I : ZoneData k × ℤ)
    (d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) (zr_stOf (zr_rowC t x)) x)
    (hd : d.state = some (zr_entryOf (zr_rowC t x))) (hp : (zr_rowC t x).pre I d) :
    ((zr_rowC t x).post I d).state = some (if zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1 then
      Sum.inl (Sum.inr (zr_exitOf (zr_foundSeg t x).C)) else
      Sum.inr (zr_exitOf (zr_shortPin t x))) := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hb⟩ := zr_rowC_back t x I d hd hp
  rw [hs]
  by_cases h : zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1
  · rw [if_pos h]
    beta_reduce at hb
    rw [if_pos (decide_eq_true h)] at hb
    rcases s with (s | s) | s
    · exact absurd hb (by simp [zr_branchBack])
    · dsimp only [zr_branchBack] at hb
      unfold zr_oneBack at hb
      split_ifs at hb with h1
      rw [h1]
    · dsimp only [zr_branchBack] at hb
      unfold zr_oneBack at hb
      split_ifs at hb
      exact absurd hb (by simp)
  · rw [if_neg h]
    beta_reduce at hb
    rw [if_neg (by rwa [decide_eq_true_iff])] at hb
    rcases s with (s | s) | s
    · exact absurd hb (by simp [zr_branchBack])
    · dsimp only [zr_branchBack] at hb
      unfold zr_oneBack at hb
      split_ifs at hb
      exact absurd hb (by simp)
    · dsimp only [zr_branchBack] at hb
      unfold zr_oneBack at hb
      split_ifs at hb with h1
      rw [h1]

/-- A zone-row start is pinned at the rightward row's start pin, at its own scratch start. -/

name: zr_rowPre_pin
chunk:
/-- A zone-row start is pinned at the rightward row's start pin, at its own scratch start. -/
private lemma zr_rowPre_pin {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} {D : ZoneData k}
    {d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x} (hp : zoneRowPre D d) :
    zr_pinned (zr_rowT0 (D, d.workTapePos 1)) (zr_heads 0 (D, d.workTapePos 1).2) d := by
  refine ⟨funext fun j => funext fun r => ?_, funext fun j => ?_⟩
  · by_cases hj : j = 0
    · subst hj
      rw [hp.1]
      rfl
    · obtain rfl : j = 1 := by omega
      rw [hp.2.2 r]
      rfl
  · by_cases hj : j = 0
    · subst hj
      rw [hp.2.1]
      rfl
    · obtain rfl : j = 1 := by omega
      rfl

/-- **The rightward row's time** is at most `2300 · (2^i₀ + 1)`. -/

name: zr_rowC_time
header:
private lemma zr_rowC_time {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) (I : ZoneData k × ℤ) :
    zoneStart (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1) + 8 * zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 +
        (if zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1 then 9 else 7) + 1 +
        (if decide (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1) then
          zr_tauOf (zr_fpSeg t x) (zr_rowP0 t I) + 1 + (3 * (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1) + 8)
        else zoneStart I.1.1 + 11 * I.1.1 + 20) ≤
      2300 * (2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1)
chunk:
/-- **The rightward row's time** is at most `2300 · (2^i₀ + 1)`. -/
private lemma zr_rowC_time {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) (I : ZoneData k × ℤ) :
    zoneStart (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1) + 8 * zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 +
        (if zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1 then 9 else 7) + 1 +
        (if decide (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1) then
          zr_tauOf (zr_fpSeg t x) (zr_rowP0 t I) + 1 + (3 * (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1) + 8)
        else zoneStart I.1.1 + 11 * I.1.1 + 20) ≤
      2300 * (2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1) := by
  have hz := zoneStart_eq (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1)
  have hi : zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < 2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 :=
    Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  rw [pow_succ] at hz
  by_cases h : zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 < I.1.1
  · have hf := zr_fpSeg_time t x (zr_rowP0_valid t h)
    have hp : 2 ^ (zr_rowP0 t I).i = 2 * 2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 := by
      show 2 ^ (zoneRebalanceIndex true t I.1 + 1) = _
      rw [pow_succ]
      ring
    rw [hp] at hf
    rw [if_pos h, if_pos (decide_eq_true h)]
    omega
  · have hs := zr_short_eq t h
    rw [if_neg h, if_neg (by rwa [decide_eq_true_iff])]
    rw [← hs]
    omega

/-- The rightward row's found and short exits. -/

name: zr_rowDone
header: private noncomputable abbrev zr_rowDone {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k)
chunk:
/-- The rightward row's found and short exits. -/
private noncomputable abbrev zr_rowDone {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) :=
  (Sum.inl (Sum.inr (zr_exitOf (zr_foundSeg t ([] : List (ZoneSym k))).C)) :
    zr_stOf (zr_rowC t ([] : List (ZoneSym k))))

/-- The rightward row's short exit. -/

name: zr_rowShort
header: private noncomputable abbrev zr_rowShort {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k)
chunk:
/-- The rightward row's short exit. -/
private noncomputable abbrev zr_rowShort {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) :=

    zr_stOf (zr_rowC t ([] : List (ZoneSym k))))

/-- **The rightward rebalance row** on the data, its envelopes at the constant `C ≥ 2300`: the
rightward row at the start's own scratch start.

**Proof sketch.** The segment obligation. At the row's precondition the start is the row's start pin
(`zr_rowPre_pin`), so the branch's pinned step (`zr_rowC_step`) gives its endpoint pin, input head
and output, and the branch contract gives a segment to its endpoint. That endpoint is
`zoneRebalancePost` (its state by `zr_rowC_state`, its tapes and heads from the pin and the
precondition's blank scratch). The pinned box lies in the envelopes `zoneRowLo`/`zoneRowHi` at any
`C ≥ 2300`, since the row's box is within `2300 · (2^(i₀) + 1)` of its start and `i₀ < 2^(i₀)`; the
exit is `done` or `short`. -/

name: zr_rowR
chunk:
/-- **The rightward rebalance row** on the data, its envelopes at the constant `C ≥ 2300`: the
rightward row at the start's own scratch start.

**Proof sketch.** The segment obligation. At the row's precondition the start is the row's start pin
(`zr_rowPre_pin`), so the branch's pinned step (`zr_rowC_step`) gives its endpoint pin, input head
and output, and the branch contract gives a segment to its endpoint. That endpoint is
`zoneRebalancePost` (its state by `zr_rowC_state`, its tapes and heads from the pin and the
precondition's blank scratch). The pinned box lies in the envelopes `zoneRowLo`/`zoneRowHi` at any
`C ≥ 2300`, since the row's box is within `2300 · (2^(i₀) + 1)` of its start and `i₀ < 2^(i₀)`; the
exit is `done` or `short`. -/
private noncomputable def zr_rowR {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (C : ℕ) (hC : 2300 ≤ C)
    (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    Contract (zr_machineOf (zr_rowC t ([] : List (ZoneSym k))))
      (zr_entryOf (zr_rowC t ([] : List (ZoneSym k)))) {some (zr_rowDone t), some (zr_rowShort t)}
      (ZoneData k) x :=
  Contract.ofSegment zoneRowPre (fun D d => (zr_rowC t x).time (D, d.workTapePos 1) d)
    (zoneRebalancePost true t (zr_rowDone t) (zr_rowShort t))
    (zoneRowLo (zoneRebalanceIndex true t) C) (zoneRowHi (zoneRebalanceIndex true t) C)
    (fun D d hd hp => by
      have hpin := zr_rowPre_pin hp
      obtain ⟨hpre, ⟨hT, hP⟩, hin, hout, -, hbox⟩ := (zr_rowC_step t x).2 _ d trivial hpin
      have hseg := (zr_rowC t x).segment (D, d.workTapePos 1) d hd hpre
      have hpost : (zr_rowC t x).post (D, d.workTapePos 1) d =
          zoneRebalancePost true t (zr_rowDone t) (zr_rowShort t) D d := by
        refine Cfg.ext ?_ hin (funext fun j => funext fun r => ?_) (funext fun j => ?_) hout
        · rw [zr_rowC_state t x _ d hd hpre]
          simp only [zoneRebalancePost]
        · rw [hT]
          by_cases hj : j = 0
          · subst hj
            simp only [zoneRebalancePost, if_true]
            rfl
          · obtain rfl : j = 1 := by omega
            simp only [zoneRebalancePost, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, if_false, hp.2.2 r]
            rfl
        · rw [hP]
          simp only [zoneRebalancePost]
          by_cases hj : j = 0
          · subst hj
            rw [hp.2.1]
            rfl
          · obtain rfl : j = 1 := by omega
            rfl
      rw [hpost] at hseg
      refine hseg.mono (fun s hs => ?_) fun p hb => ?_
      · rcases hs with rfl | rfl
        · exact Or.inl ⟨_, rfl, rfl⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, rfl⟩
      · have hpos : (0 : ℤ) < 2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex true t D := by positivity
        have hi : (zoneRebalanceIndex true t D : ℤ) < 2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex true t D := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_two_pow_self
        rw [headBox_iff] at hb ⊢
        intro j
        have h := Finset.mem_Icc.mp (hb j)
        obtain ⟨hl, hh⟩ := hbox j
        rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
        simp only [zoneRowLo, zoneRowHi]
        by_cases hj : j = 0
        · subst hj
          simp only [zr_rowL, zr_rowU, zr_heads, if_true] at hl hh
          simp only [if_true]
          omega
        · obtain rfl : j = 1 := by omega
          simp only [zr_rowL, zr_rowU, zr_heads, show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide,
            if_false] at hl hh
          simp only [show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, if_false]
          have hC' : (2300 : ℤ) ≤ C := by exact_mod_cast hC
          have hm : (2300 : ℤ) * (2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex true t D + 1) ≤
              C * (2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex true t D + 1) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC' (by positivity)
          push_cast at hh ⊢
          constructor <;> linarith)
    (fun D d _ _ => by
      simp only [zoneRebalancePost]
      split_ifs
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr rfl)

/-- **The rightward rebalance row's fields**: its precondition, endpoint and envelopes are the
target's, and its time is at most `C · (2^i₀ + 1)`. -/

name: zr_rowR_spec
header:
private lemma zr_rowR_spec {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (C : ℕ) (hC : 2300 ≤ C) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    (zr_rowR t C hC x).pre = zoneRowPre ∧
      (zr_rowR t C hC x).post = zoneRebalancePost true t (zr_rowDone t) (zr_rowShort t) ∧
      (zr_rowR t C hC x).lo = zoneRowLo (zoneRebalanceIndex true t) C ∧
      (zr_rowR t C hC x).hi = zoneRowHi (zoneRebalanceIndex true t) C ∧
      ∀ D d, d.state = some (zr_entryOf (zr_rowC t ([] : List (ZoneSym k)))) →
        (zr_rowR t C hC x).pre D d →
          (zr_rowR t C hC x).time D d ≤ C * (2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex true t D + 1)
chunk:
/-- **The rightward rebalance row's fields**: its precondition, endpoint and envelopes are the
target's, and its time is at most `C · (2^i₀ + 1)`. -/
private lemma zr_rowR_spec {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (C : ℕ) (hC : 2300 ≤ C) (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    (zr_rowR t C hC x).pre = zoneRowPre ∧
      (zr_rowR t C hC x).post = zoneRebalancePost true t (zr_rowDone t) (zr_rowShort t) ∧
      (zr_rowR t C hC x).lo = zoneRowLo (zoneRebalanceIndex true t) C ∧
      (zr_rowR t C hC x).hi = zoneRowHi (zoneRebalanceIndex true t) C ∧
      ∀ D d, d.state = some (zr_entryOf (zr_rowC t ([] : List (ZoneSym k)))) →
        (zr_rowR t C hC x).pre D d →
          (zr_rowR t C hC x).time D d ≤ C * (2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex true t D + 1) := by
  refine ⟨funext fun D => funext fun d => by rw [zr_rowR, Contract.ofSegment_pre],
    funext fun D => funext fun d => by rw [zr_rowR, Contract.ofSegment_post],
    funext fun D => funext fun d => funext fun j => by rw [zr_rowR, Contract.ofSegment_lo],
    funext fun D => funext fun d => funext fun j => by rw [zr_rowR, Contract.ofSegment_hi],
    fun D d hd hp => ?_⟩
  rw [zr_rowR, Contract.ofSegment_pre] at hp
  rw [zr_rowR, Contract.ofSegment_time]
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, ht, -⟩ := (zr_rowC_step t x).2 _ d trivial (zr_rowPre_pin hp)
  rw [ht]
  have := zr_rowC_time t x (D, d.workTapePos 1)
  have h2 : 2300 * (2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex true t D + 1) ≤
      C * (2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex true t D + 1) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hC
  exact this.trans h2

/-- **The mirror** of a two-tape configuration: tape `0` and its head reflected about home. -/

name: zr_mir
header:
private def zr_mir {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} (c : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x) :
    Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x
chunk:
/-- **The mirror** of a two-tape configuration: tape `0` and its head reflected about home. -/
private def zr_mir {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} (c : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x) :
    Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x :=
  { c with
    workTapes := fun j r => if j = 0 then c.workTapes 0 (-r) else c.workTapes j r
    workTapePos := fun j => if j = 0 then -c.workTapePos 0 else c.workTapePos j }

/-- The mirror is an involution. -/

name: zr_mir_mir
header:
private lemma zr_mir_mir {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} (c : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x) :
    zr_mir (zr_mir c) = c
chunk:
/-- The mirror is an involution. -/
private lemma zr_mir_mir {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} (c : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x) :
    zr_mir (zr_mir c) = c := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl (funext fun j => funext fun r => ?_) (funext fun j => ?_) rfl
  · by_cases hj : j = 0
    · subst hj
      simp only [zr_mir, if_true, neg_neg]
    · simp only [zr_mir, hj, if_false]
  · by_cases hj : j = 0
    · subst hj
      simp only [zr_mir, if_true, neg_neg]
    · simp only [zr_mir, hj, if_false]

/-- **The mirrored machine**: tape `0`'s moves reversed, everything else as `M`'s. -/

name: zr_mirTM
chunk:
/-- **The mirrored machine**: tape `0`'s moves reversed, everything else as `M`'s. -/
private def zr_mirTM {k : ℕ} {S : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM 2 (ZoneSym k) S) :
    MultiTapeTM 2 (ZoneSym k) S where
  q₀ := M.q₀
  tr q inp work :=
    { M.tr q inp work with
      workTapes := fun j => if j = 0 then (((M.tr q inp work).workTapes 0).1,
        -((M.tr q inp work).workTapes 0).2) else (M.tr q inp work).workTapes j }

/-- **The mirrored machine's step is the mirrored step.**

**Proof sketch.** By the control state. A halted configuration is fixed by both machines. Otherwise
the mirrored configuration reads the same input cell (`Turing.Cfg.inputSymbol_congr`) and the same work-tape
symbols, since tape `0` and its head are both reflected, so both machines take the same transition.
Applying it, field by field (`Action.apply_*`): the state, input head and output agree, the other
tape is unchanged by the mirror, and on tape `0` the reversed move of the reflected head lands on
the reflection of the new head, with the write at the reflected cell. -/

name: zr_mir_step
chunk:
/-- **The mirrored machine's step is the mirrored step.**

**Proof sketch.** By the control state. A halted configuration is fixed by both machines. Otherwise
the mirrored configuration reads the same input cell (`Turing.Cfg.inputSymbol_congr`) and the same work-tape
symbols, since tape `0` and its head are both reflected, so both machines take the same transition.
Applying it, field by field (`Action.apply_*`): the state, input head and output agree, the other
tape is unchanged by the mirror, and on tape `0` the reversed move of the reflected head lands on
the reflection of the new head, with the write at the reflected cell. -/
private lemma zr_mir_step {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)}
    (M : MultiTapeTM 2 (ZoneSym k) S) (c : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x) :
    (zr_mirTM M).step (zr_mir c) = zr_mir (M.step c) := by
  cases hq : c.state with
  | none =>
    have hq' : (zr_mir c).state = none := hq
    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_halt hq', MultiTapeTM.step_of_halt hq]
  | some q =>
    have hq' : (zr_mir c).state = some q := hq
    have hin : (zr_mir c).inputSymbol = c.inputSymbol := Cfg.inputSymbol_congr _ _ rfl
    have hw : (zr_mir c).workTapeSymbols = c.workTapeSymbols := by
      funext j
      rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq, Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
      by_cases hj : j = 0
      · subst hj
        simp only [zr_mir, if_true, neg_neg]
      · simp only [zr_mir, hj, if_false]
    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hq', MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hq, hin, hw]
    refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ (funext fun j => funext fun r => ?_) (funext fun j => ?_) ?_
    · rw [Action.apply_state]
      show _ = (Action.apply _ c).state
      rw [Action.apply_state]
      rfl
    · rw [Action.apply_inputPos]
      show _ = (Action.apply _ c).inputPos
      rw [Action.apply_inputPos]
      rfl
    · rw [Action.apply_workTapes]
      by_cases hj : j = 0
      · subst hj
        show _ = (Action.apply _ c).workTapes 0 (-r)
        rw [Action.apply_workTapes]
        simp only [zr_mir, zr_mirTM, if_true, Function.update_apply, Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq,
          neg_neg]
        split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
      · have e : (zr_mir (Action.apply (M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols) c)).workTapes j r =
            (Action.apply (M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols) c).workTapes j r := by
          simp only [zr_mir, hj, if_false]
        rw [e, Action.apply_workTapes]
        simp only [zr_mir, zr_mirTM, hj, if_false, Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
        rw [if_neg hj]
    · rw [Action.apply_workTapePos]
      by_cases hj : j = 0
      · subst hj
        show _ = -(Action.apply _ c).workTapePos 0
        rw [Action.apply_workTapePos]
        simp only [zr_mir, zr_mirTM, if_true, SignType.coe_neg]
        ring
      · have e : (zr_mir (Action.apply (M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols) c)).workTapePos j =
            (Action.apply (M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols) c).workTapePos j := by
          simp only [zr_mir, hj, if_false]
        rw [e, Action.apply_workTapePos]
        simp only [zr_mir, zr_mirTM, hj, if_false]
    · rw [Action.apply_output]
      show _ = (Action.apply _ c).output
      rw [Action.apply_output]
      rfl

/-- **The mirror lockstep**: each step of `M` is one step of the mirrored machine on the mirrored
configuration. -/

name: zr_mir_lockstep
chunk:
/-- **The mirror lockstep**: each step of `M` is one step of the mirrored machine on the mirrored
configuration. -/
private lemma zr_mir_lockstep {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)}
    (M : MultiTapeTM 2 (ZoneSym k) S) (X : Set (Option S)) :
    Lockstep (x := x) (x' := x) M (zr_mirTM M) zr_mir (fun _ => 1) X X :=
  ⟨fun c _ => by
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, zr_mir_step],
    fun _ h => h, fun c h v hv => by
      obtain rfl : v = 0 := by omega
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
      exact h⟩

open Classical in
/-- The mirror lockstep's per-step box, its ends by `op` (`min` the lower, `max` the upper): the
mirrored heads, and at a live step the mirrored next heads too. -/

name: zr_mirB
chunk:
/-- The mirror lockstep's per-step box, its ends by `op` (`min` the lower, `max` the upper): the
mirrored heads, and at a live step the mirrored next heads too. -/
private noncomputable def zr_mirB {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} (op : ℤ → ℤ → ℤ)
    (M : MultiTapeTM 2 (ZoneSym k) S) (X : Set (Option S)) (c : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x)
    (j : Fin 2) : ℤ :=
  if c.state ∈ X then (zr_mir c).workTapePos j
  else op ((zr_mir c).workTapePos j) ((zr_mir (M.step c)).workTapePos j)

/-- The mirrored heads stay in the per-step box. -/

name: zr_mir_box
header:
private lemma zr_mir_box {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)}
    (M : MultiTapeTM 2 (ZoneSym k) S) (X : Set (Option S)) :
    ∀ (c : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x) v, (v = 0 ∨ (c.state ∉ X ∧ v ≤ 1)) → ∀ j,
      ((zr_mirTM M).runFrom (zr_mir c) v).workTapePos j ∈
        Finset.Icc (zr_mirB min M X c j) (zr_mirB max M X c j)
chunk:
/-- The mirrored heads stay in the per-step box. -/
private lemma zr_mir_box {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)}
    (M : MultiTapeTM 2 (ZoneSym k) S) (X : Set (Option S)) :
    ∀ (c : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x) v, (v = 0 ∨ (c.state ∉ X ∧ v ≤ 1)) → ∀ j,
      ((zr_mirTM M).runFrom (zr_mir c) v).workTapePos j ∈
        Finset.Icc (zr_mirB min M X c j) (zr_mirB max M X c j) := by
  intro c v hv j
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc, zr_mirB, zr_mirB]
  rcases hv with rfl | ⟨hX, hv⟩
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    split_ifs
    · exact ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨min_le_left _ _, le_max_left _ _⟩
  · rw [if_neg hX, if_neg hX]
    rcases (by omega : v = 0 ∨ v = 1) with rfl | rfl
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
      exact ⟨min_le_left _ _, le_max_left _ _⟩
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, zr_mir_step]
      exact ⟨min_le_right _ _, le_max_right _ _⟩

/-- The data with every track's two sides exchanged. -/

name: zr_swapD
header: private abbrev zr_swapD {k : ℕ} (D : ZoneData k) : ZoneData k
chunk:
/-- The data with every track's two sides exchanged. -/
private abbrev zr_swapD {k : ℕ} (D : ZoneData k) : ZoneData k := ⟨D.1, fun t => (D.2 t).swap⟩

/-- The leftward scanned index is the rightward one of the exchanged data. -/

name: zr_index_swap
header:
private lemma zr_index_swap {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (D : ZoneData k) :
    zoneRebalanceIndex true t (zr_swapD D) = zoneRebalanceIndex false t D
chunk:
/-- The leftward scanned index is the rightward one of the exchanged data. -/
private lemma zr_index_swap {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (D : ZoneData k) :
    zoneRebalanceIndex true t (zr_swapD D) = zoneRebalanceIndex false t D := by
  show zoneShiftIndex true (D.2 t).swap = zoneShiftIndex false (D.2 t)
  simp only [zoneShiftIndex_eq_findIdx, ZoneContents.words_true, ZoneContents.words_false,
    ZoneContents.swap_right]

/-- A zone-row start, mirrored, is a zone-row start at the exchanged data. -/

name: zr_mir_pre
header:
private lemma zr_mir_pre {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} {D : ZoneData k}
    {d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x} (hp : zoneRowPre D d) : zoneRowPre (zr_swapD D) (zr_mir d)
chunk:
/-- A zone-row start, mirrored, is a zone-row start at the exchanged data. -/
private lemma zr_mir_pre {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} {D : ZoneData k}
    {d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x} (hp : zoneRowPre D d) : zoneRowPre (zr_swapD D) (zr_mir d) := by
  refine ⟨funext fun r => ?_, ?_, fun r => ?_⟩
  · show d.workTapes 0 (-r) = zonedTape (fun t => (D.2 t).swap) r
    rw [hp.1, zr_mirror_tape]
  · show -d.workTapePos 0 = 0
    rw [hp.2.1, neg_zero]
  · exact hp.2.2 r

/-- **The mirrored rightward endpoint is the leftward endpoint**: reflecting the rightward row's
endpoint at the exchanged data and the mirrored start gives the leftward row's.

**Proof sketch.** Field by field. The mirror reflects tape `0` and its head and keeps the rest.
Exchanging every track's sides commutes with the rebalance: at track `t` the rightward rebalance of
the exchanged contents is the exchange of the leftward rebalance (`zoneRebalance_false`,
`ZoneContents.swap_swap`), and the scanned index is the same (`zr_index_swap`). The reflected zoned
tape of exchanged contents is the zoned tape of the contents (`zr_mirror_tape`), so the reflected
rightward endpoint is the leftward one. -/

name: zr_mir_post
header:
private lemma zr_mir_post {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} (t : Fin k) (done short : S)
    (D : ZoneData k) (d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x) :
    zr_mir (zoneRebalancePost true t done short (zr_swapD D) (zr_mir d)) =
      zoneRebalancePost false t done short D d
chunk:
/-- **The mirrored rightward endpoint is the leftward endpoint**: reflecting the rightward row's
endpoint at the exchanged data and the mirrored start gives the leftward row's.

**Proof sketch.** Field by field. The mirror reflects tape `0` and its head and keeps the rest.
Exchanging every track's sides commutes with the rebalance: at track `t` the rightward rebalance of
the exchanged contents is the exchange of the leftward rebalance (`zoneRebalance_false`,
`ZoneContents.swap_swap`), and the scanned index is the same (`zr_index_swap`). The reflected zoned
tape of exchanged contents is the zoned tape of the contents (`zr_mirror_tape`), so the reflected
rightward endpoint is the leftward one. -/
private lemma zr_mir_post {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} (t : Fin k) (done short : S)
    (D : ZoneData k) (d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x) :
    zr_mir (zoneRebalancePost true t done short (zr_swapD D) (zr_mir d)) =
      zoneRebalancePost false t done short D d := by
  have hz : (zoneRebalanceData true t (zr_swapD D)).2 =
      fun t' => ((zoneRebalanceData false t D).2 t').swap := by
    funext t'
    show Function.update (fun t => (D.2 t).swap) t (zoneRebalance true (D.2 t).swap) t' =
      (Function.update D.2 t (zoneRebalance false (D.2 t)) t').swap
    by_cases ht : t' = t
    · subst ht
      rw [Function.update_self, Function.update_self, zoneRebalance_false,
        ZoneContents.swap_swap]
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne ht, Function.update_of_ne ht]
  refine Cfg.ext ?_ rfl (funext fun j => funext fun r => ?_) (funext fun j => ?_) rfl
  · simp only [zr_mir, zoneRebalancePost, zr_index_swap]
  · by_cases hj : j = 0
    · subst hj
      simp only [zr_mir, zoneRebalancePost, if_true]
      rw [hz, zr_mirror_tape, neg_neg]
    · simp only [zr_mir, zoneRebalancePost, hj, if_false]
  · by_cases hj : j = 0
    · subst hj
      simp only [zr_mir, zoneRebalancePost, if_true, neg_neg]
    · simp only [zr_mir, zoneRebalancePost, hj, if_false]

/-- **The mirrored per-step box lies in the mirrored envelope**: along an admissible run, each
step's mirrored heads, and at a live step the next ones, stay in the source envelope reflected on
tape `0`.

**Proof sketch.** Along the run every head stays in the contract's envelope (`Contract.env`); after
the mirror, tape `0`'s head is reflected, so it stays in the reflected envelope `[-hi, -lo]`, and
the other head is unchanged. At an exit step the box is the current heads only; at a live step,
which is before the contract's time, it also contains the next step's heads, which are again in the
envelope. -/

name: zr_mir_env
header:
private lemma zr_mir_env {k : ℕ} {S I : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)}
    {M : MultiTapeTM 2 (ZoneSym k) S} {e : S} {X : Set (Option S)} (R : Contract M e X I x)
    (i : I) (c : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x) (hc : c.state = some e) (hp : R.pre i c) (u : ℕ)
    (hu : u ≤ R.time i c) (j : Fin 2) :
    (if j = 0 then -R.hi i c 0 else R.lo i c j) ≤ zr_mirB min M X (M.runFrom c u) j ∧
      zr_mirB max M X (M.runFrom c u) j ≤ (if j = 0 then -R.lo i c 0 else R.hi i c j)
chunk:
/-- **The mirrored per-step box lies in the mirrored envelope**: along an admissible run, each
step's mirrored heads, and at a live step the next ones, stay in the source envelope reflected on
tape `0`.

**Proof sketch.** Along the run every head stays in the contract's envelope (`Contract.env`); after
the mirror, tape `0`'s head is reflected, so it stays in the reflected envelope `[-hi, -lo]`, and
the other head is unchanged. At an exit step the box is the current heads only; at a live step,
which is before the contract's time, it also contains the next step's heads, which are again in the
envelope. -/
private lemma zr_mir_env {k : ℕ} {S I : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)}
    {M : MultiTapeTM 2 (ZoneSym k) S} {e : S} {X : Set (Option S)} (R : Contract M e X I x)
    (i : I) (c : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x) (hc : c.state = some e) (hp : R.pre i c) (u : ℕ)
    (hu : u ≤ R.time i c) (j : Fin 2) :
    (if j = 0 then -R.hi i c 0 else R.lo i c j) ≤ zr_mirB min M X (M.runFrom c u) j ∧
      zr_mirB max M X (M.runFrom c u) j ≤ (if j = 0 then -R.lo i c 0 else R.hi i c j) := by
  have hm : ∀ u' ≤ R.time i c, (if j = 0 then -R.hi i c 0 else R.lo i c j) ≤
      (zr_mir (M.runFrom c u')).workTapePos j ∧
        (zr_mir (M.runFrom c u')).workTapePos j ≤ (if j = 0 then -R.lo i c 0 else R.hi i c j) := by
    intro u' hu'
    have h := Finset.mem_Icc.mp (R.env i c hc hp u' hu' j)
    by_cases hj : j = 0
    · subst hj
      simp only [zr_mir, if_true]
      constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]
    · simp only [zr_mir, hj, if_false]
      exact h
  rw [zr_mirB, zr_mirB]
  by_cases hs : (M.runFrom c u).state ∈ X
  · rw [if_pos hs, if_pos hs]
    exact hm u hu
  · rw [if_neg hs, if_neg hs]
    have hlt : u < R.time i c := by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u (R.time i c) with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        apply hs
        rw [show u = R.time i c by omega, R.run i c hc hp]
        exact R.exit_mem i c hc hp
    have h1 := hm u hu
    have h2 := hm (u + 1) hlt
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step'] at h2
    exact ⟨le_min h1.1 h2.1, max_le h1.2 h2.2⟩

/-- The rightward row's envelope at the exchanged data and the mirrored start, reflected on tape
`0`, is the leftward row's envelope. -/

name: zr_mir_lohi
header:
private lemma zr_mir_lohi {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} (t : Fin k) (C : ℕ)
    (D : ZoneData k) (d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x) (j : Fin 2) :
    (if j = 0 then -zoneRowHi (zoneRebalanceIndex true t) C (zr_swapD D) (zr_mir d) 0 else
        zoneRowLo (zoneRebalanceIndex true t) C (zr_swapD D) (zr_mir d) j) =
        zoneRowLo (zoneRebalanceIndex false t) C D d j ∧
      (if j = 0 then -zoneRowLo (zoneRebalanceIndex true t) C (zr_swapD D) (zr_mir d) 0 else
        zoneRowHi (zoneRebalanceIndex true t) C (zr_swapD D) (zr_mir d) j) =
        zoneRowHi (zoneRebalanceIndex false t) C D d j
chunk:
/-- The rightward row's envelope at the exchanged data and the mirrored start, reflected on tape
`0`, is the leftward row's envelope. -/
private lemma zr_mir_lohi {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} (t : Fin k) (C : ℕ)
    (D : ZoneData k) (d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x) (j : Fin 2) :
    (if j = 0 then -zoneRowHi (zoneRebalanceIndex true t) C (zr_swapD D) (zr_mir d) 0 else
        zoneRowLo (zoneRebalanceIndex true t) C (zr_swapD D) (zr_mir d) j) =
        zoneRowLo (zoneRebalanceIndex false t) C D d j ∧
      (if j = 0 then -zoneRowLo (zoneRebalanceIndex true t) C (zr_swapD D) (zr_mir d) 0 else
        zoneRowHi (zoneRebalanceIndex true t) C (zr_swapD D) (zr_mir d) j) =
        zoneRowHi (zoneRebalanceIndex false t) C D d j := by
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  · subst hj
    simp [zoneRowLo, zoneRowHi, zr_index_swap]
  · simp [zoneRowLo, zoneRowHi, hj, zr_index_swap, zr_mir]

/-- **The leftward rebalance row** on the data: the rightward row transported along the mirror
lockstep, at the exchanged data and the mirrored start.

**Proof sketch.** The segment obligation. At the leftward precondition the mirrored start at the
exchanged data satisfies the rightward row's precondition (`zr_mir_pre`). Transport the rightward
row along the mirror lockstep (`Contract.lockstep`, `zr_mir_lockstep`, with the per-step box
`zr_mirB`): its segment runs the mirrored machine from the start, with the rightward row's time
since each lockstep step costs one step. Its endpoint, mirrored back, is the leftward endpoint
(`zr_mir_post`), and its box lies in the leftward envelopes, which are the rightward ones reflected
on tape `0` (`zr_mir_env`, `zr_mir_lohi`). -/

name: zr_rowLeft
chunk:
/-- **The leftward rebalance row** on the data: the rightward row transported along the mirror
lockstep, at the exchanged data and the mirrored start.

**Proof sketch.** The segment obligation. At the leftward precondition the mirrored start at the
exchanged data satisfies the rightward row's precondition (`zr_mir_pre`). Transport the rightward
row along the mirror lockstep (`Contract.lockstep`, `zr_mir_lockstep`, with the per-step box
`zr_mirB`): its segment runs the mirrored machine from the start, with the rightward row's time
since each lockstep step costs one step. Its endpoint, mirrored back, is the leftward endpoint
(`zr_mir_post`), and its box lies in the leftward envelopes, which are the rightward ones reflected
on tape `0` (`zr_mir_env`, `zr_mir_lohi`). -/
private noncomputable def zr_rowLeft {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (C : ℕ) (hC : 2300 ≤ C)
    (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    Contract (zr_mirTM (zr_machineOf (zr_rowC t ([] : List (ZoneSym k)))))
      (zr_entryOf (zr_rowC t ([] : List (ZoneSym k)))) {some (zr_rowDone t), some (zr_rowShort t)}
      (ZoneData k) x :=
  Contract.ofSegment zoneRowPre (fun D d => (zr_rowR t C hC x).time (zr_swapD D) (zr_mir d))
    (zoneRebalancePost false t (zr_rowDone t) (zr_rowShort t))
    (zoneRowLo (zoneRebalanceIndex false t) C) (zoneRowHi (zoneRebalanceIndex false t) C)
    (fun D d hd hp => by
      obtain ⟨hRpre, hRpost, hRlo, hRhi, -⟩ := zr_rowR_spec t C hC x
      have hc : (zr_mir d).state = some (zr_entryOf (zr_rowC t ([] : List (ZoneSym k)))) := hd
      have hpre : (zr_rowR t C hC x).pre (zr_swapD D) (zr_mir d) := by
        rw [hRpre]
        exact zr_mir_pre hp
      have hseg := ((zr_rowR t C hC x).lockstep (zr_mir_lockstep _ _) _ (zr_mirB min _ _)
        (zr_mirB max _ _) (zr_mir_box _ _)).segment (zr_swapD D, zr_mir d) d hd (by
          rw [Contract.lockstep_pre]
          exact ⟨(zr_mir_mir d).symm, hc, hpre⟩)
      rw [Contract.lockstep_post] at hseg
      simp only [Contract.lockstep_time, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul,
        mul_one] at hseg
      rw [hRpost, zr_mir_post] at hseg
      refine hseg.mono le_rfl fun p hb => ?_
      rw [headBox_iff] at hb ⊢
      intro j
      have h := Finset.mem_Icc.mp (hb j)
      rw [Contract.lockstep_lo, Contract.lockstep_hi] at h
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
      obtain ⟨el, eh⟩ := zr_mir_lohi t C D d j
      constructor
      · refine le_trans ?_ h.1
        refine Finset.le_inf' _ _ fun u hu => ?_
        rw [← el, ← hRlo, ← hRhi]
        exact (zr_mir_env _ _ _ hc hpre u (by simpa [Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hu) j).1
      · refine le_trans h.2 ?_
        refine Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun u hu => ?_
        rw [← eh, ← hRlo, ← hRhi]
        exact (zr_mir_env _ _ _ hc hpre u (by simpa [Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hu) j).2)
    (fun D d _ _ => by
      simp only [zoneRebalancePost]
      split_ifs
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr rfl)

/-- **The leftward rebalance row's fields**: the target's at `dir = false`, its time the
rightward row's at the exchanged data. -/

name: zr_rowLeft_spec
header:
private lemma zr_rowLeft_spec {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (C : ℕ) (hC : 2300 ≤ C)
    (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    (zr_rowLeft t C hC x).pre = zoneRowPre ∧
      (zr_rowLeft t C hC x).post = zoneRebalancePost false t (zr_rowDone t) (zr_rowShort t) ∧
      (zr_rowLeft t C hC x).lo = zoneRowLo (zoneRebalanceIndex false t) C ∧
      (zr_rowLeft t C hC x).hi = zoneRowHi (zoneRebalanceIndex false t) C ∧
      ∀ D d, d.state = some (zr_entryOf (zr_rowC t ([] : List (ZoneSym k)))) →
        (zr_rowLeft t C hC x).pre D d →
          (zr_rowLeft t C hC x).time D d ≤ C * (2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex false t D + 1)
chunk:
/-- **The leftward rebalance row's fields**: the target's at `dir = false`, its time the
rightward row's at the exchanged data. -/
private lemma zr_rowLeft_spec {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) (C : ℕ) (hC : 2300 ≤ C)
    (x : List (ZoneSym k)) :
    (zr_rowLeft t C hC x).pre = zoneRowPre ∧
      (zr_rowLeft t C hC x).post = zoneRebalancePost false t (zr_rowDone t) (zr_rowShort t) ∧
      (zr_rowLeft t C hC x).lo = zoneRowLo (zoneRebalanceIndex false t) C ∧
      (zr_rowLeft t C hC x).hi = zoneRowHi (zoneRebalanceIndex false t) C ∧
      ∀ D d, d.state = some (zr_entryOf (zr_rowC t ([] : List (ZoneSym k)))) →
        (zr_rowLeft t C hC x).pre D d →
          (zr_rowLeft t C hC x).time D d ≤ C * (2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex false t D + 1) := by
  refine ⟨funext fun D => funext fun d => by rw [zr_rowLeft, Contract.ofSegment_pre],
    funext fun D => funext fun d => by rw [zr_rowLeft, Contract.ofSegment_post],
    funext fun D => funext fun d => funext fun j => by rw [zr_rowLeft, Contract.ofSegment_lo],
    funext fun D => funext fun d => funext fun j => by rw [zr_rowLeft, Contract.ofSegment_hi],
    fun D d hd hp => ?_⟩
  rw [zr_rowLeft, Contract.ofSegment_pre] at hp
  rw [zr_rowLeft, Contract.ofSegment_time, ← zr_index_swap]
  obtain ⟨hRpre, -, -, -, ht⟩ := zr_rowR_spec t C hC x
  exact ht _ _ hd (by rw [hRpre]; exact zr_mir_pre hp)

name: zr_finHost
header: private def zr_finHost {B : Type} (h : Fintype B) : Fintype (Σ b, zr_hostPh B b)
chunk:
/-- A loop host's states are finite when its body's are. -/
private def zr_finHost {B : Type} (h : Fintype B) : Fintype (Σ b, zr_hostPh B b) := by
  letI : ∀ b, Fintype (zr_hostPh B b) := fun b => match b with
    | false => inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Option Bool))
    | true => h
  exact inferInstance

/-- The rebalance rows' states are finite and have decidable equality. -/

name: zr_rowInst
chunk:
/-- The rebalance rows' states are finite and have decidable equality. -/
private noncomputable def zr_rowInst {k : ℕ} (t : Fin k) :
    Fintype (zr_stOf (zr_rowC t ([] : List (ZoneSym k)))) ×
      DecidableEq (zr_stOf (zr_rowC t ([] : List (ZoneSym k)))) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · repeat' (first | refine @instFintypeSum _ _ ?_ ?_ | refine zr_finHost ?_ |
      exact inferInstance)
  · repeat' (first | refine @instDecidableEqSum _ _ ?_ ?_ | refine zr_decHost ?_ |
      exact inferInstance)

/-! ### The rows -/

/-- **§13d G4, the rebalance rows** (design §13d, G4; decisions 13d.2–13d.4). For every track
count `k` there is a constant `C` such that for every direction `dir` (`true` is a right head
move) and every track `t` (in finite control) there is one two-tape machine over
`Turing.ZoneSym k`, with an entry and two distinct live exits `done` and `short`, whose run is a
`Turing.Contract` with index `Turing.ZoneData k`:

* **precondition** `Turing.zoneRowPre`: the zoned tape of `⟨ℓ, z⟩` on tape `0`, head at home;
  the scratch tape blank;
* **endpoint** `Turing.zoneRebalancePost`: tape `0` holds the zoned tape of `z` with track `t`
  replaced by `Turing.zoneRebalance dir (z t)` — the **total** pure cascade at the scanned index
  `Turing.zoneShiftIndex dir (z t)` when that index is below `ℓ` (exit `done`), the identity
  when every feeding zone is empty (exit `short`, the extension's cue); every other track, every
  separator and every cell beyond the layout unchanged; the scratch tape blank again; both
  heads back; input position and output unchanged;
* **exact time** with the no-earlier-exit cut (the contract's fields), bounded by
  `C · (2^i₀ + 1)` for the scanned index `i₀`;
* **envelopes** `Turing.zoneRowLo`/`Turing.zoneRowHi` at `i₀`: the zoned head within
  `zoneStart (i₀ + 1)` of home, the scratch head within `C · (2^i₀ + 1)` of its start.

For every contents, not only the classical ones (decision 13d.3). [AB09, §1.7]: one shift of
index `i₀`, at cost `O(2^{i₀})`. Deviation: the book's machine assumes the fullness invariant;
this row realizes the guarded cascade on every input, and reports an exhausted feeding side.

**Proof sketch.** Fill plan (design note §4): scan outward on the feeding side from home: zone
`i` is nonempty on track `t` exactly when its innermost slot is occupied (inner packing), the
separators delimit the zones, and two consecutive blanks mark the end of the layout, so the
scan finds `i₀` in `O(2^{i₀})` steps or reaches the end (`short`: rewind and exit). Then run the
cascade's `2i₀ + 1` guarded steps in its order — the descending pairs `i₀, …, 1`, the home move,
the ascending pairs `1, …, i₀` — each pair at level `i` acting on zones `i - 1` and `i` of both
sides in `O(2^i)` steps: a guard is a test of one or two slots (inner packing); a pairwise move
copies the track-`t` column of the zones involved to the scratch tape with the mapped copy
(`extract := zoneSlotOf t`), cuts the copy at the new split by one-cell blanks, and writes the
pieces back with the mapped copy (`merge := zoneSlotSet t`), which keeps the other tracks and
needs no save and restore, since zones are delimited words (`Turing.zonedTape_right_word`,
`Turing.zonedTape_left_word`); the other side is reached through a unary count, on scratch, of
the zones crossed. The scratch tape is
cleared before the exit. The sum `Σ_{i ≤ i₀} O(2^i)` is `O(2^{i₀})`
(`Turing.zoneCascade_cost_le`).

**Implementation.** For `dir = true`, one machine through the pinned branch. The rightward scan
(a loop host whose rounds mark a unary zone count on scratch) is a pinned test with two exits. At
a found index `i₀ < ℓ` the found path runs: the descending inward pass on the right and outward
pass on the left, the walk out between them, the guarded home move, a pop, and the ascending
inward and outward passes with their two returns, each a pinned segment on a loop host whose
rounds keep a count stack on scratch. It cascades track `t` to the right at the scanned index
(`zoneCascadeRight`, through the side-pass reordering valid for every guard), in at most
`1000 · 2^(i₀ + 1) + 200` steps; then the count's clear. At a short scan the return home and the
count's clear. The row runs in at most `2300 · (2^i₀ + 1)` steps, the zoned head within
`zoneStart (i₀ + 1)` of home and scratch within `18 · 2^i₀ + i₀ + 13` of its start. For
`dir = false`, the mirrored machine (tape `0`'s moves reversed) runs the rightward row on the
data with every track's sides exchanged (`Turing.ZoneContents.swap`, the mirrored zoned tape),
in lockstep one step per step (`Turing.Contract.lockstep`), and `Turing.zoneRebalance_false`
identifies its endpoint. The constant is `2300`. -/

name: exists_zoneRebalanceTM
header:
theorem exists_zoneRebalanceTM (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (dir : Bool) (t : Fin k),
      ∃ (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S) (M : MultiTapeTM 2 (ZoneSym k) S)
        (entry done short : S), done ≠ short ∧
        ∀ x : List (ZoneSym k),
          ∃ R : Contract M entry {some done, some short} (ZoneData k) x,
            R.pre = zoneRowPre ∧
            R.post = zoneRebalancePost dir t done short ∧
            R.lo = zoneRowLo (zoneRebalanceIndex dir t) C ∧
            R.hi = zoneRowHi (zoneRebalanceIndex dir t) C ∧
            ∀ D d, d.state = some entry → R.pre D d →
              R.time D d ≤ C * (2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex dir t D + 1)

theorem exists_zoneRebalanceTM (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (dir : Bool) (t : Fin k),
      ∃ (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S) (M : MultiTapeTM 2 (ZoneSym k) S)
        (entry done short : S), done ≠ short ∧
        ∀ x : List (ZoneSym k),
          ∃ R : Contract M entry {some done, some short} (ZoneData k) x,
            R.pre = zoneRowPre ∧
            R.post = zoneRebalancePost dir t done short ∧
            R.lo = zoneRowLo (zoneRebalanceIndex dir t) C ∧
            R.hi = zoneRowHi (zoneRebalanceIndex dir t) C ∧
            ∀ D d, d.state = some entry → R.pre D d →
              R.time D d ≤ C * (2 ^ zoneRebalanceIndex dir t D + 1) := by
  refine ⟨2300, fun dir t => ⟨_, (zr_rowInst t).1, (zr_rowInst t).2, ?_⟩⟩
  cases dir
  · exact ⟨zr_mirTM (zr_machineOf (zr_rowC t ([] : List (ZoneSym k)))), _, zr_rowDone t,
      zr_rowShort t, Sum.inl_ne_inr,
      fun x => ⟨zr_rowLeft t 2300 le_rfl x, zr_rowLeft_spec t 2300 le_rfl x⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨zr_machineOf (zr_rowC t ([] : List (ZoneSym k))), _, zr_rowDone t, zr_rowShort t,
      Sum.inl_ne_inr, fun x => ⟨zr_rowR t 2300 le_rfl x, zr_rowR_spec t 2300 le_rfl x⟩⟩

/-- **§13d G4, the extension row** (design §13d, decision 13d.2). For every track count `k`
there are a constant `C` and one two-tape machine over `Turing.ZoneSym k`, with an entry and a
live exit `done`, whose run is a `Turing.Contract` with index `Turing.ZoneData k`:

* **precondition** `Turing.zoneRowPre`;
* **endpoint** `Turing.zoneExtendPost`: tape `0` holds the zoned tape of the data extended by
  level `ℓ` on every track — on each side a separator and a fresh zone half full of virtual
  blanks (`Turing.zonedTape_extend` says which cells change); every other field unchanged;
* **exact time**, bounded by `C · (2^ℓ + 1)`;
* **envelopes** at level `ℓ`: the zoned head within `zoneStart (ℓ + 1)` of home, the scratch
  head within `C · (2^ℓ + 1)` of its start.

[AB09, §1.7]: zones are made half full "the first time we encounter it".

**Proof sketch.** Fill plan: walk right from home across the layout to the first of two
consecutive blanks (the separator after zone `ℓ - 1`); measure each half of the new zone with a
scratch ruler copied from the last field, zone `ℓ - 1` or, at `ℓ = 0`, the home (zone `ℓ` has
twice its capacity); write the inner half as all-tracks virtual blanks and the outer half as
all-`⊠` cells; return home and do the same on the left with the same ruler; clear the ruler and
return home. Each phase is `O(2^ℓ)`.

**Implementation.** Four contracts composed through stationary seams, from the catalog rows
(`seekEndTM`, `seekStartTM`, `skipTM`, `skipBackTM`, the mapped copy, `walkTM`, `clearTM`), the
one-cell leaf and the phase host. *Right pass:* seek the right end, which stops on the second of the
two consecutive blanks past the last right zone, `zoneStart ℓ`, the new zone's first cell (the
separator is the cell before it; the plan above names the separator); copy the last field (the last
zone, or the home at level zero, both of the new half-capacity `2^ℓ`) to scratch as a ruler; write
the new right zone's two halves, an adjusted walk by the ruler between them. *Return home:* skip the
outer half, then a phase-host loop whose round skips back over one field and tests for the home, the
only one-cell field. *Left pass:* seek the left layout's outermost cell, step across the separator,
and make two left moves by the ruler (skip the ruler on scratch, step back onto its last cell, walk
left over it, step back), writing the inner half after the first and the outer half after the
second. *Final return:* seek across the whole extended layout, run the loop home, clear the ruler.
The time is at most `135 · (2^ℓ + 1)`. -/

          R.hi = zoneRowHi (fun D => D.1) C ∧

second. *Final return:* seek across the whole extended layout, run the loop home, clear the ruler.
The time is at most `135 · (2^ℓ + 1)`. -/
theorem exists_zoneExtendTM (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (C : ℕ) (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S)
      (M : MultiTapeTM 2 (ZoneSym k) S) (entry done : S),
      ∀ x : List (ZoneSym k),
        ∃ R : Contract M entry {some done} (ZoneData k) x,
          R.pre = zoneRowPre ∧
          R.post = zoneExtendPost done ∧
          R.lo = zoneRowLo (fun D => D.1) C ∧
          R.hi = zoneRowHi (fun D => D.1) C ∧
          ∀ D d, d.state = some entry → R.pre D d → R.time D d ≤ C * (2 ^ D.1 + 1) := by
  refine ⟨135, _, ?_, ?_, zr_machineOf (zr_extendContract ([] : List (ZoneSym k))),
    zr_entryOf (zr_extendContract ([] : List (ZoneSym k))),
    Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr SweepPhase.done)), fun x => ⟨Contract.ofSegment zoneRowPre
      (fun D d => (zr_extendContract x).time D d)
      (zoneExtendPost (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr SweepPhase.done))))
      (zoneRowLo (fun D => D.1) 135) (zoneRowHi (fun D => D.1) 135) (fun D d hd hp => ?_)
      (fun D d _ _ => ?_), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · letI := zr_fintypeLoopPh
    set_option synthInstance.maxSize 1024 in exact inferInstance
  · letI := zr_decEqRL
    letI := zr_decEqLoopPh
    exact inferInstance
  · have hp' := (zr_extend_pre D d).mpr hp
    obtain ⟨-, hpost, h0l, h0h, h1l, h1h⟩ := zr_extend_fields D d hp'
    have hseg := (zr_extendContract x).segment D d hd hp'
    rw [hpost] at hseg
    refine hseg.mono (by simp only [Set.image_singleton, Option.map_some]; exact le_rfl)
      fun p hb => ?_
    have hpos : (0 : ℤ) < 2 ^ D.1 := by positivity
    rw [headBox_iff] at hb ⊢
    intro j
    have h := Finset.mem_Icc.mp (hb j)
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    simp only [zoneRowLo, zoneRowHi]
    by_cases hj : j = 0
    · subst hj
      simp only [if_true]
      omega
    · have hj1 : j = 1 := by omega
      subst hj1
      simp only [show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide, if_false]
      push_cast
      omega
  · simp only [zoneExtendPost, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  · funext D d
    rw [Contract.ofSegment_pre]
  · funext D d
    rw [Contract.ofSegment_post]
  · funext D d j
    rw [Contract.ofSegment_lo]
  · funext D d j
    rw [Contract.ofSegment_hi]
  · intro D d _ hp
    rw [Contract.ofSegment_pre] at hp
    rw [Contract.ofSegment_time]
    exact zr_extend_time_le D d ((zr_extend_pre D d).mpr hp)

the rebalanced data is the data. -/

  obtain ⟨ℓ, z⟩ := D

/-- **After a short exit, extend and retry**: the retried rebalance of the extended data scans
to the new level `ℓ`, below `ℓ + 1`, so it exits at `done`.

/-- **After a short exit, extend and retry**: the retried rebalance of the extended data scans
to the new level `ℓ`, below `ℓ + 1`, so it exits at `done`.

**Proof sketch.** A short exit means scanned index `ℓ` (`Turing.zoneShiftIndex_le`);

theorem zoneRebalanceIndex_extend_of_short {k : ℕ} (dir : Bool) (t : Fin k) (D : ZoneData k)
    (h : ¬ zoneRebalanceIndex dir t D < D.1) :
    zoneRebalanceIndex dir t (zoneExtendData D) = D.1 := by
  have hle := zoneShiftIndex_le dir (D.2 t)
  exact zoneShiftIndex_extend dir (D.2 t) (by unfold zoneRebalanceIndex at h; omega)

/-- **The rebalance frames the touched levels**: from an admissible start, its endpoint agrees
with the start outside the zoned tape's cells within `zoneStart (i₀ + 1)` of home (the levels up
to the scanned index `i₀`), and on the whole scratch tape.

**Proof sketch.** The scratch tape is the start's. On tape `0`, a cell farther out than
`zoneStart (i₀ + 1)` is a separator, beyond the layout, or owned by a zone above `i₀`, whose words
the rebalance keeps on track `t` (`Turing.zoneRebalance_frame`) and whose other tracks are
untouched. -/

name: zoneRebalancePost_frames
header:
theorem zoneRebalancePost_frames {k : ℕ} (dir : Bool) (t : Fin k) {S : Type}
    {x : List (ZoneSym k)} (done short : S) (D : ZoneData k) (d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x)
    (hp : zoneRowPre D d) :
    Cfg.SameOutside (fun j => if j = 0 then
        Set.Icc (-(zoneStart (zoneRebalanceIndex dir t D + 1) : ℤ))
          (zoneStart (zoneRebalanceIndex dir t D + 1)) else ∅)
      d (zoneRebalancePost dir t done short D d)
chunk:
/-- **The rebalance frames the touched levels**: from an admissible start, its endpoint agrees
with the start outside the zoned tape's cells within `zoneStart (i₀ + 1)` of home (the levels up
to the scanned index `i₀`), and on the whole scratch tape.

**Proof sketch.** The scratch tape is the start's. On tape `0`, a cell farther out than
`zoneStart (i₀ + 1)` is a separator, beyond the layout, or owned by a zone above `i₀`, whose words
the rebalance keeps on track `t` (`Turing.zoneRebalance_frame`) and whose other tracks are
untouched. -/
theorem zoneRebalancePost_frames {k : ℕ} (dir : Bool) (t : Fin k) {S : Type}
    {x : List (ZoneSym k)} (done short : S) (D : ZoneData k) (d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x)
    (hp : zoneRowPre D d) :
    Cfg.SameOutside (fun j => if j = 0 then
        Set.Icc (-(zoneStart (zoneRebalanceIndex dir t D + 1) : ℤ))
          (zoneStart (zoneRebalanceIndex dir t D + 1)) else ∅)
      d (zoneRebalancePost dir t done short D d) := by
  obtain ⟨ℓ, z⟩ := D
  intro j q hq
  simp only [zoneRebalancePost]
  split_ifs with hj
  · subst hj
    rw [hp.1]
    simp only [if_true, Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le] at hq
    set i₀ := zoneRebalanceIndex dir t ⟨ℓ, z⟩ with hi₀
    have key : ∀ (side : Bool) (n : ℕ), zoneStart (i₀ + 1) < n →
        zoneCellAt side (zoneRebalanceData dir t ⟨ℓ, z⟩).2 n = zoneCellAt side z n := by
      intro side n hn
      simp only [zoneCellAt, zoneRebalanceData]
      cases ho : zoneOwner ℓ n with
      | none => rfl
      | some i =>
        have hi := (Fin.find_eq_some_iff.mp ho).1
        have hgt : i₀ < i.val := by
          by_contra hle
          have := zoneStart_mono (show i.val + 1 ≤ i₀ + 1 by omega)
          have := zoneStart_succ i.val
          omega
        have hfr := zoneRebalance_frame dir (z t) i hgt
        simp only [Option.map_some]
        congr 2
        funext s
        by_cases hs : s = t
        · subst hs
          rw [Function.update_self]
          cases side
          · simp [ZoneContents.words, hfr.1]
          · simp [ZoneContents.words, hfr.2]
        · rw [Function.update_of_ne hs]
    unfold zonedTape
    have h0 : q ≠ 0 := by
      have := two_le_zoneStart (i₀ + 1)
      omega
    rw [if_neg h0, if_neg h0]
    split_ifs with hpos
    · exact key true _ (by omega)
    · exact key false _ (by omega)
  · rfl

/-- **The extension frames the new level**: from an admissible start, its endpoint agrees with
the start outside the two new zones on tape `0`, and on the whole scratch tape.

**Proof sketch.** `Turing.zonedTape_extend`: outside the new zones the extended tape is the old
one. -/

theorem zoneExtendPost_frames {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List (ZoneSym k)} (done : S)
    (D : ZoneData k) (d : Cfg 2 (ZoneSym k) S x) (hp : zoneRowPre D d) :
    Cfg.SameOutside (fun j => if j = 0 then
        {c : ℤ | (zoneStart D.1 : ℤ) ≤ |c| ∧ |c| < zoneStart D.1 + zoneCapacity D.1} else ∅)
      d (zoneExtendPost done D d)
